Leading telecom operator, Pak Telecom Mobile Limited (PTML) has partnered with GNEXT, Pakistan’s leading Apple Authorized Distributor & Service Provider, to launch the latest iPhone portfolio in Pakistan, featuring the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max and DUO. The partnership advances PTML’s 5G journey by bringing together 5G-ready devices and next-generation 5G connectivity to unlock a premium digital experience for its customers.
Chief Commercial Officer, PTML, Syed Atif Raza and CEO, GNEXT, Shahid Khan signed the partnership agreement here in Islamabad. The collaboration brings together PTML’s extensive reach and connectivity ecosystem with GNEXT’s device distribution capabilities to create a convenient and reliable channel for PTML customers to access the latest iPhone models.
The booking and registration process will be accessible through PTML’s digital touchpoints, including an in-app web-view, social media, and the official Ufone & Telenor websites. Customers will be able to avail the offer at Ufone – Telenor Pakistan Joint Shops in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad and Rawalpindi.
As part of the offering, customers will also receive limited-stock freebies such as Apple AirPods and adapters on a first-come, first-served basis, along with free eSIMs with 1TB of data for six months. The offer further includes one time front and back glass coverage for one year and 2 years of warranty coverage under the Shield+ programme.
The launch of the 5G-enabled iPhone 18 Pro series coincides with Pakistan’s entry into the 5G era, with PTML pairing iPhone’s premium devices with its strong 5G spectrum capabilities to deliver fast and immersive digital experiences. PTML holds the largest share of the global-standard 3.5 GHz spectrum, complemented by a diverse portfolio spanning low, mid and high frequency bands, enabling high-speed connectivity and widespread coverage nationwide.
Speaking on the partnership, Chief Commercial Officer, PTML, Syed Atif Raza said,
“PTML’s partnership with GNEXT reflects our commitment to bringing our customers closer to the groundbreaking global technology. We aim to combine Apple’s premium devices with PTML’s 5G capability to provide an enabling digital experience. We will continue to innovate and explore collaborative opportunities to make new technologies more accessible to our customers.”
Shahid Khan, CEO GNEXT said,
“Pakistan is entering an exciting new chapter in digital connectivity, and we are proud to contribute by making the latest Apple technology more accessible through GNEXT’s trusted ecosystem. Our partnership with PTML brings together GNEXT’s expertise in Apple device distribution and customer support with PTML’s connectivity capabilities, creating a seamless way for customers to experience the latest iPhone innovation.”
Strengthened by the union of Ufone and Telenor Pakistan’s digital ecosystems and spectrum assets, PTML transcends traditional connectivity to touch upon multiple aspects of its customers’ lives, helping them enjoy a more connected digital lifestyle.

items.author: Business Desk
items.content:
The National Computer Emergency Response Team (NCERT) has directed all provincial and sectoral Computer Emergency Response Teams (CERTs) to speed up the establishment of dedicated Security Operations Centres (SOCs) and connect them with the National Security Operations Centre (NSOC).
The directive requires CERTs that have not yet established their SOCs, or have not connected them with the NSOC, to complete the process on priority.
November Deadline
According to an official letter, provincial and sectoral CERTs had previously been instructed to establish their respective SOCs within six months and make them operational by November 2026.
The directive was issued under the CERT Rules, 2023 and the National Cyber Security Policy, 2021.
NCERT said the NSOC has been established as the first tier of Pakistan’s national system for monitoring, correlating and coordinating cyber threats. The centre is now operating around the clock.
Several sectoral CERTs have already integrated their SOCs with the NSOC. These centres are sharing telemetry, cyber incident feeds and threat intelligence with the national centre in near real time.
Dedicated Teams Required
CERTs that have yet to establish their SOCs or connect them with the NSOC have been ordered to complete the process on priority.
They have also been directed to nominate dedicated technical focal persons or teams for the process. Their details must be provided to NCERT within seven working days of the letter’s issuance.
The CERTs must also ensure continuous, real-time sharing of high- and medium-severity incident logs, alerts and threat intelligence with the NSOC.
Three-Tier Cybersecurity Structure
NCERT has further directed organisational SOCs operating at Tier 3 to connect with their respective provincial or sectoral SOCs at Tier 2.
The arrangement is intended to ensure end-to-end national visibility of cyber threats through the Tier-1 NSOC.

The Punjab Excise and Taxation Department will launch a province-wide crackdown on token tax and property tax defaulters from October 1, 2026, with vehicle owners facing a 100% penalty on unpaid token tax after the September 30 deadline.

Officials said the enforcement drive will particularly target commercial properties that have remained in default for several years.
The department has urged vehicle owners and property taxpayers with outstanding dues to make their payments before the deadline to avoid additional penalties and recovery action.
Motor vehicle taxation in Punjab is administered under relevant provincial laws, while the Excise Department’s official website allows citizens to check and pay their dues online.
The Excise and Taxation Department is also responsible for urban immovable property tax and motor vehicle registration and taxation across Punjab.
Officials said the intensified recovery campaign is part of the department’s efforts to meet its Rs. 125 billion revenue target, with all possible measures being taken to recover outstanding dues from defaulters.

Managed by the Directorate-General for Higher Education (DGES), the grant supports eligible students enrolled in Bachelor’s, Master’s, and integrated Master’s programs. Applicants must submit their applications through the DGES online portal.
According to the scholarship listing, students can receive up to €15,000 per year. However, DGES calculates the actual grant based on each student’s financial situation and the applicable rules rather than providing a fixed amount to every recipient.
Payments are generally made in 10 monthly instalments, helping eligible students manage their education-related expenses during the academic year.

Who Can Apply
The scholarship is designed for students with limited financial resources who meet the academic and financial conditions set by DGES. Applicants must generally be enrolled in an eligible higher education program in Portugal and meet the required academic progress conditions. Students normally need to register for at least 30 ECTS, subject to the exceptions in the regulations.
DGES also applies nationality and residence rules. Citizens of EU countries with permanent residence rights in Portugal, certain third-country nationals with permanent or long-term residence, people covered by relevant cooperation agreements, stateless persons, and refugees may qualify.
For Pakistani students, this point is important. A Pakistani national who enters Portugal as an international student does not automatically qualify for this government grant. The University of Porto states that students with International Student Status are excluded from its SASUP study scholarships.
Financial Support
DGES calculates the scholarship based on the applicant’s household financial situation rather than paying the same amount to every student.
For the 2026-27 academic year, the government has introduced changes to the higher education support system.
The official government guidance states that the scholarship system continues to provide support for students with fewer financial resources, while the new model will be introduced gradually.
Students may also receive additional support in certain cases, including accommodation assistance for eligible displaced students.
The government has set the accommodation supplement for scholarship students at €161.14 per month in 2026-27 under the stated conditions.
Income and Financial Conditions
Applicants must provide information about their household income and assets during the application process.
DGES currently lists an annual household income limit of €11,049.89 and a movable-asset limit of €115,303.20 for the relevant scholarship assessment. Applicants must also meet the applicable tax and social-security requirements.
The final scholarship amount depends on the student’s individual circumstances and the rules used for the academic year.
University of Porto Students
The University of Porto provides study support through its Social Action Services (SASUP), but these scholarships are not available to students holding International Student Status.
U.Porto also offers other funding options for international students, including merit scholarships and external scholarships. The university advises international students to check the funding opportunities available through their faculty and external partners.

Required Documents
Applicants need to provide financial, academic, and personal information through the online application. Supporting documents can be requested during the assessment process.
Students should keep their academic records, identity information, household financial details, and other supporting documents ready before submitting the application.
DGES handles the application and assessment process through its online system.
Application Deadline
The standard application period for the higher education study grant runs from June 25 to September 30.
Students who enroll after September 30 can still submit an application within 20 working days of enrollment under the applicable rules.
DGES also allows applications from October 1 to May 31, but in those cases the scholarship amount is calculated proportionally for the remaining study period.
How to Apply
Applicants need to submit their application online through the DGES student portal. The process requires students to log into their personal area, complete the application, and upload the requested documents.
Students planning to study at the University of Porto should first confirm their admission and student status because U.Porto says students with International Student Status cannot receive the regular SASUP study scholarship.
The regular application deadline for the 2026-27 academic year is September 30, 2026.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Monster Hunter Outlanders akhirnya memiliki tanggal rilis resmi. Game mobile dikembangkan TiMi Studio Group di bawah lisensi Capcom dan diterbitkan Garena untuk Asia Tenggara ini akan meluncur ke perangkat Android dan iOS pada 29 Oktober 2026.
Pengumuman ini sekaligus mengakhiri penantian fans seri Monster Hunter (Monhunt) yang sudah mengikuti perkembangan game tersebut sejak pertama kali diperkenalkan.
Jelang peluncurannya, Garena dan TiMi Studio Group juga merilis trailer terbaru yang menampilkan sejumlah karakter, monster, serta cuplikan gameplay teranyar di dunia Aesoland.
Baca Juga: Meta Muse Diduga Bagikan Alamat Rumah Tanpa Izin Pengguna
Bukan Sekadar Monster Hunter Versi Mobile
Berbeda dari sebagian adaptasi game mobile yang hanya memindahkan pengalaman atau porting dari platform lain, Monster Hunter Outlanders dibuat sebagai game terpisah dan sendiri dari Monhunt utama dengan dunia, karakter, dan monster orisinal.
Meski begitu, game ini tetap mempertahankan DNA utama dari seri Monhunt berupa berburu monster besar menggunakan berbagai jenis senjata, tetapi dipadukan dengan elemen eksplorasi, crafting, traversal, dan survival lebih menonjol.
Monster Hunter Outlanders sendiri mengambil latar dunia bernama Aesoland, sebuah wilayah luas yang dapat dieksplorasi pemain. Seperti bocoran informasi yang beredar di internet hingga kini, pemain dapat memanfaatkan berbagai alat (tools) untuk menjelajah area, termasuk glider, zipline, hingga platform angin untuk berpindah lokasi dengan lebih cepat.
Pendekatan ini membuat Outlanders terasa lebih dekat dengan konsep open-world survival dibandingkan game Monster Hunter mobile generasi sebelumnya.
Monster Hunter Outlanders Hadirkan Monster dan Karakter Baru
Monster Hunter Outlanders. (Doc: Garena Indonesia)
Trailer terbaru yang diperlihatkan menjelang peluncuran kembali menyoroti Ruger Aidal, Elder Dragon orisinal pertama yang dibuat khusus untuk Monster Hunter Outlanders. Monster tersebut sebelumnya diperkenalkan sebagai salah satu ancaman utama di Aesoland dan menjadi ikon baru game ini.
Selain Ruger Aidal, trailer juga memperlihatkan karakter seperti Freya dan Haze, serta pertarungan melawan Azure Rathalos menggunakan senjata hammer. Elemen traversal dan building juga kembali ditampilkan sebagai bagian penting eksplorasi dunia permainan.
Capcom dan TiMi sebelumnya menyebut bahwa Outlanders akan menghadirkan kombinasi monster klasik Monster Hunter bersama monster eksklusif yang hanya tersedia di game ini.
Dibuat Ramah untuk Pemain Baru
Salah satu tantangan terbesar franchise Monster Hunter selama bertahun-tahun adalah kurva belajar yang cukup tinggi bagi pemain baru.
Untuk mengatasi hal tersebut, Monster Hunter Outlanders menyediakan dua mode kontrol berbeda, yakni Classic dan Adventure. Mode Adventure dirancang untuk memudahkan pemain yang belum familiar dengan mekanisme Monster Hunter agar bisa lebih cepat beradaptasi.
TiMi juga menegaskan bahwa game ini ditujukan bukan hanya untuk penggemar lama seri Monster Hunter, tetapi juga pemain mobile yang baru pertama kali mencoba franchise tersebut.
Hunting Bersama hingga Empat Pemain
Berdasarkan informasi yang telah tersedia di halaman resmi App Store dan Google Play, Outlanders mendukung permainan solo maupun co-op hingga empat pemain dalam satu tim perburuan. Pemain dapat menjelajahi dunia Aesoland sendiri atau langsung membentuk party bersama teman untuk menghadapi monster yang lebih kuat.
Game ini juga tetap menghadirkan sejumlah senjata ikonik Monster Hunter, termasuk Great Sword, Long Sword, Dual Blades, Hammer, Lance, Heavy Bowgun, dan Bow.
Pra-Registrasi Monster Hunter Outlanders Sudah Dibuka
Saat ini pra-registrasi Monster Hunter Outlanders telah dibuka melalui App Store dan Google Play. Garena mengajak pemain untuk melakukan pendaftaran lebih awal sebelum server dibuka pada akhir Oktober mendatang.
Dengan dukungan Capcom sebagai pemilik IP, pengalaman TiMi Studio Group dalam mengembangkan game mobile skala besar, serta distribusi Garena di Asia Tenggara, Outlanders menjadi salah satu peluncuran game mobile yang patut diperhatikan menjelang akhir 2026.
Yang masih perlu dibuktikan tentu adalah apakah formula open-world survival dan hunting yang diusungnya mampu mempertahankan daya tarik jangka panjang setelah hype peluncuran berakhir. Namun setidaknya, kini para penggemar Monster Hunter sudah memiliki satu tanggal penting untuk ditandai: 29 Oktober 2026.
Jadi, Gizmo friends sudah ikutan pra-registrasi game mobile Monhunt Outlanders ini di iOS dan Android?

items.author: Anadolu Agency
items.content:
Eleven current and former Norwegian ministers are set to face parliamentary questioning for two days beginning Wednesday about foreign ministry practices brought under scrutiny by revelations concerning Jeffrey Epstein, the VG newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The hearings will examine what officials knew about concerns of the Foreign Ministry, including grants to the International Peace Institute (IPI), a think tank formerly headed by Terje Rod-Larsen, who had close contact with the late convicted sex offender.
Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store, who served as foreign minister from 2005 to 2012, is among those expected to appear before parliament’s control committee.
Committee chair Per-Willy Amundsen described the information made public so far as “disturbing,” but cautioned that two days of hearings would be insufficient to establish a full account of the matters under review.
A separate commission is investigating the revelations and is due to report in January 2028. Norway’s economic crime authority, Okokrim, is also investigating specific corruption allegations involving former ambassador Mona Juul, Rod-Larsen and former Prime Minister Thorbjorn Jagland.
Former Foreign Minister Borge Brende is also expected to face questions about his roles at the World Economic Forum and his contact with Epstein. Committee member Lars Haltbrekken said he would ask whether Brende’s ties to the forum had influenced his work as foreign minister.
The ministry agreed to support the forum in 2015, during Brende’s tenure. It subsequently received funding from Norway’s development aid budget, according to figures cited by VG.

items.title: CGC Indonesia 2026 Soroti Perkembangan Teknologi Reparasi Smartphone
items.summary:
Perkembangan smartphone membuat pekerjaan reparasi ikut mengalami perubahan. Jika sebelumnya teknisi lebih banyak berurusan dengan penggantian komponen, kini pekerjaan dapat mencakup pemeriksaan motherboard, micro-soldering, diagnostik, hingga pemrograman komponen.
Perubahan tersebut terlihat dalam Circuit Global Championship (CGC) Indonesia 2026: Mobile Phone Repair Exhibition & Competition yang berlangsung pada 26–27 September 2026 di Gedung Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan RI, Jakarta. Selain kompetisi, acara ini mempertemukan teknisi, komunitas, industri, dan produsen peralatan reparasi.
Sejumlah brand seperti iColor, JCID, dan AiXun turut hadir dalam acara tersebut. Ketiganya bergerak pada area berbeda dalam ekosistem perbaikan perangkat, mulai dari peralatan pendukung hingga kebutuhan programming dan pekerjaan elektronik presisi.

iColor, JCID, dan AiXun Dukung Workflow Teknisi
Semakin kompleksnya motherboard
items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Perkembangan smartphone membuat pekerjaan reparasi ikut mengalami perubahan. Jika sebelumnya teknisi lebih banyak berurusan dengan penggantian komponen, kini pekerjaan dapat mencakup pemeriksaan motherboard, micro-soldering, diagnostik, hingga pemrograman komponen.
Perubahan tersebut terlihat dalam Circuit Global Championship (CGC) Indonesia 2026: Mobile Phone Repair Exhibition & Competition yang berlangsung pada 26–27 September 2026 di Gedung Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan RI, Jakarta. Selain kompetisi, acara ini mempertemukan teknisi, komunitas, industri, dan produsen peralatan reparasi.
Sejumlah brand seperti iColor, JCID, dan AiXun turut hadir dalam acara tersebut. Ketiganya bergerak pada area berbeda dalam ekosistem perbaikan perangkat, mulai dari peralatan pendukung hingga kebutuhan programming dan pekerjaan elektronik presisi.
Baca Juga: AMD Akuisisi World Labs Milik Fei-Fei Li Senilai US$8,2 Miliar
iColor, JCID, dan AiXun Dukung Workflow Teknisi
Semakin kompleksnya motherboard smartphone membuat pekerjaan board-level repair membutuhkan tingkat presisi yang lebih tinggi. Teknisi harus bekerja dengan komponen berukuran kecil, sehingga pengalaman, metode kerja, dan perangkat yang digunakan menjadi bagian dari proses reparasi. iColor hadir dalam CGC Indonesia 2026 sebagai salah satu brand yang memperlihatkan perkembangan peralatan pendukung untuk kebutuhan tersebut.
Sementara itu, JCID dikenal melalui perangkat yang berkaitan dengan programming dan diagnostik smartphone. Kebutuhan terhadap perangkat semacam ini menunjukkan bahwa reparasi modern tidak selalu berhenti pada penggantian komponen fisik. Teknisi juga perlu memeriksa kondisi perangkat dan memastikan sistem dapat kembali berfungsi setelah proses perbaikan dilakukan.
AiXun sendiri hadir dengan perangkat yang berkaitan dengan pekerjaan elektronik presisi, termasuk micro-soldering. Pekerjaan pada level motherboard membutuhkan kontrol terhadap panas dan proses pengerjaan yang lebih terukur. Peralatan seperti soldering dan power supply kemudian menjadi bagian dari workflow teknisi ketika menangani kerusakan pada tingkat komponen.
Kompetensi Teknisi Ikut Berubah
CGC Indonesia 2026 juga menghadirkan area Super Expo dengan lebih dari 170 booth yang mencakup sparepart, alat servis, hardware, dan software. Format tersebut mempertemukan kebutuhan teknisi dengan berbagai perangkat yang tersedia di industri, sementara kompetisi menjadi ruang untuk menguji kemampuan reparasi secara langsung.
Perubahan kebutuhan ini membuat kompetensi teknisi menjadi salah satu bagian penting dalam ekosistem reparasi smartphone. Berdasarkan materi penyelenggara, Wakil Menteri Ketenagakerjaan Afriansyah Noor menyoroti perlunya perkembangan standar kompetensi dari kemampuan perbaikan dasar menuju keterampilan yang lebih spesifik, presisi, dan terukur. CGC Indonesia 2026 juga menjadi bagian dari jalur menuju Grand Final CGC World Cup di Guangzhou, China.

Retail investors bid for 6.33 Cr shares against the 1.37 Cr shares reserved for them, translating to an oversubscription of 4.62X.
The portion reserved for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) was subscribed 3.38X, with these investors placing bids for 13.49 Cr shares against 3.99 Cr shares on offer.

Snapdeal parent AceVector’s ₹420 Cr IPO was oversubscribed 4.93X at the end of the final day of bidding today. The issue received bids for 36.61 Cr shares against 7.42 Cr shares on offer, according to BSE data as of 19:00 IST.
Non-institutional investors (NIIs) oversubscribed their quota the highest at 8.16X, placing bids for 16.79 Cr shares against 2.05 Cr shares earmarked for them.
Within this, the portion for NIIs bidding for lots over ₹10 Lakh was oversubscribed 8.92X while bids above ₹2-10 Lakh was over subscribed 6.64X.
Retail investors bid for 6.33 Cr shares against the 1.37 Cr shares reserved for them, translating to an oversubscription of 4.62X.
The portion reserved for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) was subscribed 3.38X, with these investors placing bids for 13.49 Cr shares against 3.99 Cr shares on offer.
Original | September 29, 2026 15:49 IST
Snapdeal parent AceVector’s ₹420 Cr IPO was oversubscribed 2.59X on the final day of bidding, with investors placing bids for 19.25 Cr shares against 7.42 Cr shares on offer, according to BSE data.
The highest number of bids have come from non institutional investors (NIIs) till now, who have placed bids for 8.46 Cr shares against the 2.06 Cr shares earmarked for them. This translates to a 4.11X oversubscription of their quota.
Within the category, the portion reserved for investors bidding between ₹2 Lakh and ₹10 Lakh was oversubscribed 3.58X while the portion for NIIs bidding for lots exceeding ₹10 Lakh was subscribed 4.38X.
Following NIIs, qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) have placed the second highest number of bids for 6.38 Cr shares against the 3.99 Cr shares reserved for them. These investors have oversubscribed their quota by 1.61X.
Within the category, foreign institutional investors have placed bids for 3.99 Cr while domestic financial institutions have placed bids for 1.56 Cr.
Meanwhile, retail investors also oversubscribed their quota by 3.22X so far, placing bids for 4.41 Cr shares against the 1.37 Cr shares reserved for them.
The grey market premium (GMP) for the Snapdeal parent currently is at ₹2, indicating a slight premium listing. Following the close of bidding by today, AceVector’s shares are set to make their public market debut on the BSE and NSE tentatively on October 5.
AceVector has set a price band of ₹30-₹32 per share, valuing the company at up to ₹1,741.4 Cr ($181.7 Mn).
The issue comprises a fresh issue of shares worth ₹287 Cr and an OFS of up to 4.16 Cr shares, worth ₹133 Cr at the upper end of the price band.
Ahead of opening the public issue for subscription, AceVector raised ₹189 Cr from anchor investors yesterday. Helios Mutual Fund and Taurus Ethical Fund were the only domestic mutual funds to participate, together picking up 93.75 Lakh shares, or 15.87% of the anchor allocation.
AceVector plans to use ₹132 Cr of the net proceeds from the fresh issue for Snapdeal’s marketing and business promotion, and another ₹50 Cr for its technology infrastructure.
The remaining proceeds will go towards acquisitions and general corporate purposes. Meanwhile investors like SoftBank and Nexus Venture Partners are offloading their shares via the offer for sale (OFS) component of the IPO.
Founded in 2010 by Kunal Bahl and Rohit Bansal, AceVector started off as ecommerce platform, Snapdeal. Following the collapse of its proposed merger with Flipkart in 2017, it pivoted to a value-focused ecommerce model.
Besides Snapdeal, AceVector’s businesses include listed ecommerce SaaS company Unicommerce and consumer brands business Stellaro Brands. The group adopted the AceVector identity in 2022.
On the financial front, AceVector’s restated net loss narrowed nearly 64% to ₹45.5 Cr in FY26 from ₹126.3 Cr in FY25. Operating revenue rose 29.2% to ₹510.3 Cr from ₹395 Cr.

items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
Ex-Soulfull managing director and cofounder Prashant Parameswaran has launched Arovia Consumer, a new ecommerce rollup venture that intends to acquire controlling stakes in established regional packaged-food businesses.
The new venture has secured a ₹100 Cr capital commitment from Fireside Ventures, with the investment to be drawn down as Arovia closes acquisitions.
The startup is initially targeting to acquire majority stakes in two to four regional packaged businesses and subsequently working with their promoter families to scale beyond their home markets. Parameswaran expects additional capital to be infused as the portfolio expands.
The startup is expected to ramp up its amalgamations in the next 6-12 months and is currently in discussions with multiple identified brands, Parameswaran told Inc42. He said that the startup is targeting businesses that have crossed ₹100 Cr in revenue and are cash-flow positive or profitable.
He believes that while India’s consumer market is full of food brands that have spent decades building loyal customer bases in their home markets but have struggled to make the leap from regional favourites to national businesses.
Arovia will help scale these brands, while promoters may continue to play operational or strategic roles depending on the business. In some cases, promoters could eventually exit the businesses over a three-to-five-year period.
The platform also plans to look for operational synergies across its portfolio, including procurement, manufacturing and supply chains.
The startup is currently scouting in cities like Pune, Kochi, Coimbatore, Madurai, Mysuru, Mangalore, Surat and Indore, among others.
Arovia marks Parameswaran’s return to building consumer businesses after his decade-long journey with millet-based packaged food brand Soulfull, which he cofounded in 2013 with Rasika Prashant, K K Narayanan and Amith Sebastian.
Tata Consumer Products (TCP) acquired 100% of its parent startup in February 2021 for ₹155.8 Cr (about $21.3 Mn), bringing Soulfull into its health and wellness portfolio, subsequently rebranding it as Tata Soulfull.
Post the acquisition, Parameswaran joined TCP as the president of Tata Soulfull in September 2024, a position he held till December 2025.

items.author: AFP
items.content:
US President Donald Trump unveiled an AI-powered website on Tuesday aimed at becoming the first stop for Americans to access federal services, hailing the initiative as a "reinvention" of government.
The "America.gov" platform was developed under Airbnb co-founder Joe Gebbia, who joined the Trump administration last year in the newly formed role of chief design officer.
Like other websites using AI-powered chatbots, users type in queries and converse with the system online. While its functions are currently limited, Trump said that America.gov would eventually be able to process all sorts of complicated tasks involving the government, such as applying for a new passport or accessing health and retirement benefits.
Read: US requiring new AI safeguards for government use, transparency
"We're making it dramatically easier, faster, and more convenient to get what you need exactly when you need it," Trump said at a launch event for the platform in Washington, attended by top government officials.
.@POTUS: For our entire lives, we've become used to a government so big, it makes the citizen feel very, very small — but with https://t.co/tMEB6EUUmO, the entire U.S. government will fit in the palm of your hand. https://t.co/7gW15MiV9J pic.twitter.com/gXQDOMXxb6
— Rapid Response 47 (@RapidResponse47) September 29, 2026
"It's a restoration of America's founding promise, and it's a reinvention of your government for the 21st century and beyond," he said.
.@POTUS on https://t.co/tMEB6EUUmO: "We are launching today something that is not just simply a website, it's a restoration of America's founding promise and it's a reinvention of your government for the 21st Century and beyond." https://t.co/7gW15MiV9J pic.twitter.com/gFWQRdFcgb
— Rapid Response 47 (@RapidResponse47) September 29, 2026
The president also signed an executive order directing all government agencies to integrate their websites with America.gov.
The launch of the new US government platform came the same day that Trump was to meet with an array of top tech executives to discuss the AI sector's rapid development.
President Donald Trump signed an executive order launching https://t.co/FQtHqvwisd, an AI-powered platform designed to consolidate tens of thousands of federal government websites into a single searchable hub.
The site is live now and functions like a chatbot — users type… pic.twitter.com/0oR4CW8REr
— Fox News Politics (@foxnewspolitics) September 29, 2026
A growing list of cyber incidents revealed in recent weeks had raised concerns around the world about risks posed by uncontrollable AI, with some executives urging a slowdown for safety. Trump had dismissed those concerns as a conspiracy to undermine US economic growth and hamper competition with China.
AI and the rapid buildout of data centres have become a significant issue in the November midterm elections. A recent poll published by CNN showed 82 per cent of Americans expressed concern about the pace of AI development.

items.title: Anthropic's $518b AI buildout hinges largely on deals that cannot be canceled, filing shows
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
Anthropic said it expects to spend at least $518 billion over a decade building AI infrastructure with ​six partners, according to a confidential IPO prospectus seen by Reuters — a plan that ranks among the largest AI buildout commitments ‌on record.
The AI lab said in the prospectus that about 80% of that sum is non-cancelable or requires payment regardless of usage. Anthropic is telling investors the commitments are necessary because access to computing power is becoming the key constraint on AI development, as future demand for advanced AI systems is likely to exceed available supply ​and will be "limited principally by the availability of compute."
The company said it plans to spend at least $111.1 billion with Alphabet's Google, $110 billion ​with Amazon and $31.4 billion with Microsoft under long-term infrastructure service obligations over the next seven to 10 years "regardless of ⁠usage."
Anthropic is separately carrying about $161.2 billion of Broadcom -related equipment lease obligations that are largely non-cancelable, according to the prospectus. Anthropic filed for an ​IPO confidentially with the Securities and Exchange Commission in June but its paperwork has not been publicly disclosed.
Anthropic did not immediately respond to a request ​for comment about the filing.
he company said it committed to pay Google between April 2026 and July 2033 and Amazon between May 2026 and April 2036.
"If our actual spend falls short, we must pay Google the difference," the company said, adding that similar terms apply to its Amazon agreement.
It added its commitment with Microsoft of $31.4 billion ​between November 2026 and May 2033 "is non-cancelable except in the event of Microsoft's uncured material breach."
Read More: China's AI agents can lie and scheme - just like their US rivals
Anthropic also said the lease arrangements with Broadcom are ​non-cancelable by either party except in the case of a default.
Additional partnerships with XAI, AMD
The company also disclosed agreements with Elon Musk's xAI that could result in ‌up to $84.5 ⁠billion of spending for Nvidia-based computing capacity through 2029 that are largely cancelable with a 90-day notice.
The filing also showed a deepening relationship with Advanced Micro Devices which committed to buying up to $5 billion of Anthropic stock and to supply AI computing capacity expected to exceed $20 billion.
The overall figure is comparable in scale to OpenAI's Stargate project, a $500 billion AI infrastructure plan whose costs are expected to be shared among OpenAI, SoftBank, Oracle and ​MGX.
Shift to own infrastructure
Anthropic said it ​is increasingly building its own AI ⁠infrastructure, shifting from a cloud-only model toward dedicated data centers and directly leased chips.
It flagged a key risk in its dependence on Amazon, Google and Microsoft, which provide computing infrastructure and distribution while also developing rival ​AI models.
The company said the three tech giants occupy multiple roles at once as investors, customers, cloud providers, ​distributors and competitors, ⁠creating incentives that "may not be fully aligned" with Anthropic's interests.
"If the compute we have access to from third parties is curtailed, repriced, or terminated ... our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be adversely affected," it said.

The latest revision comes after the government decreased the price of petrol and HSD by Rs2.27 and Rs3.56 per litre, respectively, for September 29.
Read: Govt decreases petrol by Rs2.27, diesel by Rs3.56 for Sept 29
On July 17, the government announced a new pricing mechanism under which petroleum product prices would be reviewed and notified daily, replacing the weekly pricing mechanism, as renewed tensions between the United States and Iran continued to drive volatility in global oil markets and raise concerns over fuel supplies.
Earlier this month, PM Shehbaz announced a special relief scheme offering Rs100 per litre off petrol for motorcycles, three-wheeler rickshaws and cars with engines up to 800cc, in an attempt to shield lower-income consumers from the impact of rising petroleum prices.
Under the proposal, an estimated 11.8 million beneficiaries would be covered. Around 10 million two-wheeler users and 800,000 three-wheeler users would be entitled to relief on 20 litres of fuel per month, translating into a maximum monthly benefit of Rs2,000 per beneficiary.
Another one million users of cars up to 800cc would receive relief on 30 litres per month, providing them with a maximum benefit of Rs3,000 each.
On Sept 17, the government reintroduced austerity and fuel conservation measures amid rising fuel prices, tightening business operating hours and restricting public events.
Under the measures, notified with immediate effect, shops, markets, shopping malls, bazaars, departmental stores, grocery stores, general stores and kiryana shops would close by 9pm throughout the week, according to a notification issued by the Cabinet Division.
Marriage halls, marquees and other commercial venues hosting festive events would close by 10pm, while restaurants, cafes, eateries, food outlets and standalone fruit and vegetable shops would be allowed to operate until 11pm. Takeaway and home delivery services would remain exempt from the timing restrictions.
Global geopolitical developments continue to pose significant risks. International oil prices are influenced by decisions taken by OPEC+, conflicts in the Middle East, sanctions on oil-producing nations, and disruptions in critical shipping routes such as the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea. Any interruption in these supply chains can immediately increase crude oil prices and freight costs. Since Pakistan imports the majority of its petroleum requirements, these developments quickly translate into higher domestic fuel prices.
Oil prices declined ​on Tuesday as investors focused on signs of recovering crude exports from the Middle East and ‌lingering concerns over potential supply disruptions in the region stemming from the US-Israeli war on Iran.
Brent crude futures were down $1.38, or 1.3%, to $103.88 a barrel at 1:03 pm ET (1703 GMT). US West Texas Intermediate crude was down $2.04, or 2.16%, to $90.58.
Crude futures were "under pressure this morning ​on news that the Saudi’s East/West pipeline flows have moved up. ... US/Iran negotiations are ⁠also continuing and while seemingly far apart, both are looking for an off-ramp, and as more oil flows ​through the Middle East, the less bargaining power Iran will have," said Dennis Kissler, senior vice president of ​trading at BOK Financial.
Saudi Arabia resumed oil tanker loadings from its Red Sea port of Yanbu after restarting operations on the East-West Pipeline, according to trade sources and shipping data, improving the outlook for oil exports from the Middle East.

items.author: Reuters
items.content:
King Mohammed VI appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri on ​Tuesday as Morocco's first woman prime minister after her liberal-centrist party came out on top in ‌a September 23 parliamentary election, the royal palace said.
The king asked El Mansouri to form a new government, the palace said in a statement.
El Mansouri’s Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM) was created in 2008 by an adviser to the king and has since positioned itself as ​a counterweight to the Islamist Justice and Development Party (PJD) by advocating social modernisation and secular-leaning views.
Morocco is a ​constitutional monarchy where the king retains sweeping powers over foreign policy, defence and other key ⁠portfolios.
Also Read: Israeli settlers attack West Bank village, blocking family's return home
Under Morocco's constitution, the king appoints the head of government from the political party that wins the largest ​number of seats in the House of Representatives.
PAM, which was the second-largest member in the outgoing coalition, moved up to ​the top spot, bolstered by the recruitment of Fouzi Lekjaa, Morocco's football federation chief and two-time government budget manager, who joined weeks before the vote.
El Mansouri, a lawyer who was housing minister in the outgoing government and Marrakech mayor, will lead talks to form ​a coalition government and submit a list of cabinet members for the king's approval.
'No red lines'
The incoming government will ​oversee the last stages of a $20-billion push to get ready for the 2030 World Cup, which Morocco will co-host with Portugal and ‌Spain.
It ⁠will also implement economic policies aimed at addressing widespread youth discontent, an issue highlighted by a mass border rush on the Spanish enclave of Ceuta in July and deadly Gen-Z-led protests last year.
Read more: Spain defends Ceuta sovereignty
PAM won 97 seats, followed by its partners in the outgoing government, the liberal-centrist National Rally of Independents (RNI) with 66 seats, and the conservative nationalist Istiqlal with 65.
During the campaign, ​PAM had ruled out staying ​in a coalition with ⁠the RNI — the two had traded blame over policy shortcomings including a failure to halt rises in food prices.But El Mansouri said on Thursday she would have no "red lines" ​when it came to negotiations. "We have turned the page," she said.
Abdelilah Benkirane, former prime minister ​and leader of ⁠the PJD, which won 54 seats, said the party would stay in opposition.
Three leftist parties took smaller shares of the seats.
Turnout, closely watched as an indicator of trust in elected institutions, fell to about 38% from around 50% in the previous ⁠elections five ​years ago, when the moderate Islamist PJD was dealt a crushing ​defeat after a decade in power.
In recent years, King Mohammed VI has appointed a female adviser, and Morocco has had women in senior institutional ​roles. The outgoing government had four women ministers.

items.author: Palak Sharma
items.content:
Investment advisory startup StockGro pre-filed its draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India for an initial public offering (IPO) earlier this week. StockGro’s parent AssetGro Fintech Ltd announced that it has pre-filed DRHP with SEBI, BSE and NSE under the confidential pre-filing route on September 26.
As per a report by PTI, StockGro is looking to raise up to ₹2,000 Cr-₹2,500 Cr via the IPO, which could include a fresh issue of around ₹800 Cr and an offer for sale (OFS) by existing shareholders. The final issue size and structure could also change during the IPO process.
Inc42 has reached out to StockGro seeking comments on its proposed listing plans. The story will be updated based on the company’s responses.
To note, the startup raised two equity funding rounds within a month in December last year. After raising ₹150 Cr from Param Capital founder Mukul Agrawal in a Series B round, the investment tech startup raised $13 Mn in its Series B1 funding round from existing investor BITKRAFT Ventures.
StockGro is a fintech platform focused on stock-market research, investing and trading. The app combines market research with a social layer, allowing users to track stocks, study portfolios, follow other investors and interact with market experts.
It also offers users research and trade ideas from SEBI-registered analysts, along with tools for deeper analysis.
StockGro recently introduced Stoxo, an AI-powered research assistant that helps users analyse stocks, markets, mutual funds and other investment themes.
As of 2026, the startup claims to have raised $110 Mn in total equity funding and has served over 4.5 Cr users. It counts investors like Roots Ventures, General Catalyst, Nazara cofounder Nitish Mittersain, among others, as its backers.
StockGro adds to the growing list of startups taking the confidential route to go public in recent times.
While Spinny pre-filed its IPO papers earlier this month, companies like Kuku, Razorpay and MakeMyTrip also filed confidential DRHPs in 2026. Meanwhile, Snapdeal parent AceVector, which also had taken the confidential route to file for an IPO last year, completed its initial public offering today.

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
China menyiapkan rencana lima tahun untuk memperkuat industri produksi baterai domestiknya, dengan salah satu target paling ambisius adalah menjadikan baterai solid-state sebagai teknologi yang lebih umum digunakan pada 2030. Rencana tersebut disusun oleh Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) dan mencakup pengembangan teknologi hingga sisi produksi serta daur ulang.
Langkah awalnya berfokus pada optimalisasi proses produksi dan membuat baterai solid-state lebih layak secara ekonomi. Pemerintah China juga ingin meningkatkan siklus hidup baterai tersebut. Untuk mempercepat riset dan pengembangan, MIIT mendorong kolaborasi antarperusahaan, restrukturisasi, hingga kemungkinan merger selama langkah tersebut dapat mempercepat pengembangan teknologi.
Selain solid-state, rencana tersebut mencakup pengembangan baterai lithium-ion dan sodium. China juga ingin memperkuat pasokan bahan baku dengan mendorong eksplorasi sumber daya lithium, kobalt, dan mineral lainnya di dalam negeri. Produsen juga akan diminta meningkatkan pengelolaan baterai bekas, termasuk untuk produk yang diekspor ke pasar luar negeri.
Baca Juga: Geely Siapkan Produksi Mobil Mewah di Eropa Mulai 2028, Manfaatkan Pabrik Volvo
Solid-State Jadi Fokus Pengembangan hingga 2030
Dalam pengembangan solid-state, MIIT memberikan sejumlah arahan teknologi. Salah satunya adalah menggabungkan material katoda bertegangan dan kapasitas tinggi dengan anoda berbasis lithium-metal maupun desain tanpa anoda. Pemerintah juga memasukkan pengembangan isostatic press yang lebih efisien untuk produksi baterai solid-state ke dalam agenda.
Namun, target tersebut tidak hanya bergantung pada kemampuan membuat baterai solid-state. Biaya produksi dan peningkatan masa pakai juga menjadi bagian dari rencana. Artinya, pengembangan teknologi perlu diikuti kemampuan memproduksinya dalam skala besar dengan tingkat keekonomian yang lebih baik.
Lithium-Ion dan Sodium Juga Dikembangkan
Untuk baterai lithium-ion, China menargetkan produk dengan setidaknya 15.000 siklus pengisian dan pengosongan. MIIT juga menetapkan sasaran tingkat cacat produk hingga level parts per billion (PPB). Sementara itu, baterai berbasis sodium diarahkan untuk mendapatkan peningkatan dari sisi biaya, keamanan, ketersediaan sumber daya, kepadatan energi, serta masa pakai.
Rencana tersebut turut mencakup sistem pengumpulan baterai bekas yang harus disesuaikan dengan volume penjualan produsen, termasuk untuk pasar ekspor. China juga mengusulkan sistem manajemen digital untuk baterai yang diproduksi di dalam negeri, serta kemungkinan penerapan battery passport yang diakui secara internasional dan pengakuan bersama data jejak karbon dengan negara lain.

items.author: Web Desk
items.content:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Tuesday said Pakistan offered significant opportunities for high-yield, secure and mutually beneficial foreign investment as the government continued efforts to strengthen the economy during his address at the London Stock Exchange (LSE) headquarters in Paternoster Square.
PM Shehbaz became the first Pakistani premier to open a trading session at the LSE, where he also formally inaugurated Pakistan’s $3 billion dual-tranche sovereign Eurobond.
“We have strengthened our macroeconomic indicators, which are very promising and augur very well for the future,” he said.
The ceremony was attended by LSE Group Chief Executive Officer David Schwimmer, Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb, Adviser on Privatisation Mohammad Ali, Pakistan High Commissioner Tipu Usman, members of the Pakistani delegation and British officials.
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif, today, became the first prime minister from Pakistan to open the London Stock Exchange trading session and formally inaugurated Pakistan’s landmark US$3 billion dual-tranche sovereign Eurobond.
During his address at the LSE headquarters in… pic.twitter.com/yvm6hdA2Uh
— Prime Minister's Office (@PakPMO) September 29, 2026
The premier said the $3 billion dual-tranche sovereign Eurobond reflected the efforts undertaken by the finance ministry and other government institutions to stabilise the economy.
He attributed the transaction to structural reforms, digitalisation of the economy and measures aimed at putting the country’s finances back on track.
The issuance, described as Pakistan’s largest international bond transaction, attracted nearly $6 billion in global investor demand — almost twice the amount raised — from a geographically diverse institutional investor base.
Read: Pakistan, IMF formally begin talks on EFF, climate programme reviews
The transaction is the first issuance under Pakistan’s renewed Global Medium-Term Note (GMTN) Programme and follows the country’s inaugural Panda Bond and successive sovereign credit-rating upgrades.
It forms part of the government’s debt-management strategy aimed at diversifying funding sources, extending maturities and reducing refinancing risks.
Referring to the government’s privatisation programme, PM Shehbaz cited Pakistan International Airlines and First Women Bank and said the government was moving towards divesting several other state-owned enterprises.
Mr. David Schwimmer, CEO of the London Stock Exchange, presenting a memento commemorating Pakistan’s US$ 3 billion dual-tranche sovereign Eurobond listing at the London Stock Exchange to Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, today. pic.twitter.com/ksxlHbD3zz
— Prime Minister's Office (@PakPMO) September 29, 2026
He said such entities should be operated by the private sector and identified privatisation as an area where Pakistan and the United Kingdom could enhance cooperation.
The premier also referred to the Gulf crisis and its impact on emerging economies, saying Pakistan’s economic trajectory could have been stronger had the crisis not erupted.
“Like other emerging economies, we are negotiating this challenge while also playing an important role as a peacemaker, mediating between the United States and Iran. I hope that we will continue in this direction,” he said.
Read more: Trump claims Iran war 'one of the most important things we've done'
PM Shehbaz said changing geopolitical conditions had prompted investors to reassess the relative safety of different markets, adding that Pakistan needed to draw lessons from the evolving situation.
Addressing Schwimmer, the prime minister sought the LSE chief executive’s guidance on increasing Pakistan’s engagement with international financial markets beyond sovereign borrowing and attracting greater investment into the country.
Shehbaz said opening the LSE session was a significant moment for Pakistan and represented a step towards rebuilding the country’s relationship with the London Stock Exchange.
He also invited Schwimmer to visit Pakistan.
The prime minister also praised Aurangzeb, other economic ministers, government secretaries and officials for their role in efforts to strengthen the economy.
PM Shehbaz meets global finance giants in London
Later, PM Shehbaz met with senior executives of Barclays, JP Morgan, Citi, BlackRock and Rothschild & Co in London, where he sought a greater role for global banks in Pakistan’s financial sector and urged leading financial institutions to invest in the country during a series of meetings, according to a statement issued by the Prime Minister’s Office.
“The engagements underscored growing international financial sector interest in Pakistan’s economic reform trajectory and improving investment climate,” the statement said.
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif held a series of meetings today with senior executives from leading global financial institutions — Barclays, J.P. Morgan, Citi, BlackRock and Rothschild & Co — during his visit to the United Kingdom. The engagements underscored growing… pic.twitter.com/ttTmbB67X3
— Prime Minister's Office (@PakPMO) September 29, 2026
The prime minister met Mohammad Kamal Syed, Head of Private Bank and Wealth Management UK at Barclays, and welcomed the bank’s interest in Pakistan, according to the statement.
He briefed Syed on the government’s macroeconomic stabilisation measures and encouraged Barclays to explore opportunities in Pakistan’s financial sector, it added.
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif meets a delegation of Barclays in London, today. pic.twitter.com/0QhqpKDoWC
— Prime Minister's Office (@PakPMO) September 29, 2026
PM Shehbaz also met a high-level JP Morgan delegation led by Matthieu Wiltz, Co-CEO for EMEA, where they discussed deepening the partnership across capital markets, trade finance and investment banking, the statement said.
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif held a meeting with the delegation of J P Morgan headed by co-CEO of EMEA, Mr. Mathieu Wiltz, in London. pic.twitter.com/Oz2mI2SZUi
— Prime Minister's Office (@PakPMO) September 29, 2026
The prime minister invited the firm to expand its footprint in Pakistan. At the same time, the delegation reaffirmed its interest in sovereign debt capital markets and corporate banking opportunities, according to the statement.
The premier also met a group of senior Citi officials led by David Livingstone, Chief Client Officer.
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif held a meeting with the senior leadership of Citi group in London, today. pic.twitter.com/Sfkwf4Rkrt
— Prime Minister's Office (@PakPMO) September 29, 2026
According to the statement, Shehbaz commended the bank’s long-standing presence in Pakistan and encouraged an expansion of its corporate and institutional banking services in the country.
In his meeting with a BlackRock delegation comprising Gordon Fraser and Sam Vecht, Co-Heads of Emerging Markets and Frontiers, and Emily Fletcher, Portfolio Manager and Research Analyst, the prime minister invited increased allocations to Pakistani equities and fixed income within the firm’s frontier markets strategy, the statement said.
Both sides also emphasised the importance of sustained policy consistency in building investor confidence, it added.
During his meeting with Rothschild & Co, represented by Lord Mark Sedwill, Chair of Geostrategic Advisory, and Majid Ishaq, Head of UK Investment Banking, discussions centred on Pakistan’s geo-economic priorities and potential advisory collaboration on capital markets and investment strategy, according to the statement.
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif met delegation of Rothschild & Co. headed by Lord Mark Sedwill, Chair of Geostrategic Advisory in London, today. pic.twitter.com/k744BxlnhG
— Prime Minister's Office (@PakPMO) September 29, 2026
“Across all engagements, the visiting executives expressed confidence in Pakistan’s economic reform momentum and reaffirmed their institutions’ commitment to deepening engagement with the country’s financial sector,” the statement said.
The meetings “reflect the growing traction” of Pakistan’s economic reform programme among leading global financial institutions and mark a significant step in the government’s broader effort to strengthen international investor confidence and attract sustained capital flows into the country, it added.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pakistan’s mobile users continued to experience a wide gap between next-generation 5G speeds and the country’s dominant 4G networks during the second quarter of 2026, with 5G delivering an average download speed of 127.74 Mbps but remaining available for only 3.95 percent of users’ connected time, according to the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority’s (PTA) latest Mobile Network Experience Benchmarking Report.
The report, based on independent Opensignal measurements collected over a 90-day period in the second quarter of 2026, evaluates the real-world experience of mobile users across download and upload speeds, video and gaming experience and time spent connected to mobile networks.
According to the benchmarking results, 4G remained the backbone of mobile connectivity, accounting for an average 93.67 percent Time on Network, compared with just 3.95 percent for 5G.
The average 4G download speed stood at 18.9 Mbps, while users with high-end devices recorded a substantially higher 31.3 Mbps. Average 4G upload speed was 5.32 Mbps, while Video Experience and Games Experience scores stood at 37.53 and 43.85, respectively.
In contrast, 5G users experienced an average download speed of 127.74 Mbps and upload speed of 12.7 Mbps, with Video Experience scoring 67.33 and Games Experience 62.05.
However, PTA cautioned that 5G deployment in Pakistan remained at an early stage, with limited coverage and a small user base, making the 5G results indicative rather than a conclusive assessment of nationwide network performance.
The city-level results also highlighted significant differences in network experience across the country.
Among the major urban centres, Islamabad recorded download speeds ranging from 6.03 Mbps to 20.86 Mbps across operators, while Time on Network ranged from 91.56 percent to 97.17 percent.
In Lahore, operator download speeds ranged from 7.58 Mbps to 21.26 Mbps, while the highest Time on Network reading reached 98.18 percent. Karachi recorded download speeds between 12.19 Mbps and 18.27 Mbps, with the highest Time on Network reaching 97.64 percent.
The report showed even sharper disparities in smaller and geographically challenging locations. In Gwadar, download speeds ranged from only 3.87 Mbps to 12.75 Mbps, while Time on Network varied from 59.18 percent to 94.59 percent.
Similarly, Skardu recorded download speeds between 4.55 Mbps and 14.76 Mbps, with Time on Network ranging from 48.67 percent to 82.77 percent. Muzaffarabad recorded speeds between 8.53 Mbps and 14.7 Mbps, while Time on Network ranged from 68.68 percent to 95.42 percent.
PTA stressed that the Opensignal assessment measures end-to-end quality of experience (QoE) based on real smartphone users, including indoor and outdoor locations and busy and off-peak periods, rather than merely measuring network-level technical performance through controlled testing.
The findings therefore provide a snapshot of what consumers actually experience while using everyday services such as video streaming, voice calls, gaming and web browsing, rather than a conventional drive-test assessment of network infrastructure.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Meta Muse, agen kecerdasan buatan (AI) personal buatan Meta sedang menjadi sorotan publik setelah seorang pengguna Facebook Marketplace mengaku alamat rumahnya dibagikan kepada calon pembeli tanpa sepengetahuannya.
Laporan tersebut datang dari kreator teknologi Matt Robb yang membagikan pengalamannya lewat Threads. Dalam unggahannya, Matt mengatakan seorang pembeli datang langsung ke rumahnya meski dirinya tidak mengetahui proses transaksi telah disepakati.
Tidak hanya bernegosiasi dengan calon pembeli, Meta Muse juga menyetujui harga lebih rendah dari yang diharapkan dan memberikan alamat rumahnya untuk mengambil barang.
Baca Juga: Nothing Headphone (1) Pro Meluncur! Bawa 3 Driver dan ANC 10 Mikrofon
“Agen AI memang mengesankan, sampai pada titik di mana mereka dengan penuh percaya diri memberikan alamat Anda kepada orang asing,” tulis Matt, sebagaimana dikutip dari akun Threads miliknya, Selasa (29/9/2026).
Meta Muse Atur Proses Pikup di Rumah Tanpa Sepengetahuan Pengguna
Berdasarkan tangkapan layar yang dibagikan Robb, Muse kemudian mengirimkan pesan yang mengakui adanya masalah dalam proses pickup tersebut. Agen AI itu menjelaskan, calon pembeli telah beberapa kali menghubungi saat menunggu di lokasi. 
Meta Muse juga meminta maaf karena tidak memberi tahu pemilik akun bahwa ada seseorang yang datang untuk mengambil barang. Dalam percakapan yang sama, Muse disebut telah mengirimkan permintaan maaf kepada calon pembeli menggunakan akun pengguna.
AI tersebut juga mengusulkan perubahan pada sistem balasan otomatis agar tidak lagi mengasumsikan pemilik akun berada di rumah ketika informasi tersebut tidak dapat diverifikasi.
Dari Mana Meta Muse Dapatkan Alamat
Meta Muse Naik Level dari Chatbot Kini Jadi Agen AI di Connect 2026. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Salah satu pertanyaan terbesar dalam kasus ini adalah bagaimana Muse memperoleh alamat rumah pengguna tersebut. Hingga saat ini belum ada penjelasan resmi yang menjelaskan apakah alamat berasal dari data Marketplace, informasi akun pengguna, atau sumber lain yang dapat diakses oleh AI agent tersebut.
Meta juga belum memberikan tanggapan resmi terkait laporan tersebut saat berbagai media mulai memberitakannya. Karena itu, belum dapat dipastikan apakah kasus ini merupakan bug, konsekuensi dari konfigurasi tertentu, atau masalah yang lebih luas dalam sistem agen AI milik Meta.
Sorotan Baru untuk AI Agent
Jensen Huang, CEO NVIDIA ; Mark Zuckerberg, CEO Meta
Kasus ini muncul tidak lama setelah Muse mendapat perhatian terkait isu privasi lainnya. Pekan lalu, laporan terpisah menyoroti dugaan bahwa Muse memiliki akses ke pesan pribadi pengguna lebih luas daripada yang diperkirakan sebagian pengguna. 
Temuan tersebut memicu pertanyaan mengenai transparansi akses data yang dimiliki AI agent. Saat memperkenalkan Muse, Meta menyebut layanan tersebut dirancang sebagai AI agent yang aman, privat, dan dapat digunakan secara luas.
Meski begitu, kasus terbaru ini menunjukkan tantangan yang dihadapi pengembang AI agent ketika sistem tidak hanya memberikan jawaban, tetapi juga mengambil tindakan atas nama pengguna.
Bagi pengguna, insiden seperti ini menjadi pengingat bahwa AI agent tidak hanya membawa potensi otomatisasi yang lebih besar, tetapi juga risiko baru ketika diberi akses untuk berinteraksi dengan orang lain dan membuat keputusan di dunia nyata.
Apa Itu Muse, Personal AI Agent yang Diciptakan oleh Meta
Meta Muse punya fitur baru yang menarik. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Meta resmi memperkenalkan Muse, personal AI agent yang dirancang bukan sekadar untuk menjawab pertanyaan, tetapi juga mengerjakan berbagai tugas atas arahan pengguna. Berbeda dari chatbot konvensional, Muse dapat menyusun rencana, menjalankan tugas secara mandiri, serta kembali meminta persetujuan ketika membutuhkan keputusan pengguna. Untuk tahap awal, Muse tersedia di Amerika Serikat melalui aplikasi khusus dan WhatsApp.
Muse dapat menangani berbagai pekerjaan digital, mulai dari mengirim email, mengisi formulir, memesan perjalanan atau janji temu, hingga melakukan pembelian. Sistem ini juga dapat terus bekerja setelah pengguna menutup aplikasi dan kembali ketika terjadi perubahan atau ketika persetujuan diperlukan. Kemampuan tersebut ditopang Muse Spark, model AI yang dikembangkan Meta untuk menangani pekerjaan agentic dan penggunaan berbagai tools.
Di balik kemampuan tersebut, Meta menempatkan keamanan sebagai salah satu fondasi Muse. Sistem berjalan melalui Muse Secure VM, yaitu komputer virtual khusus dengan browser sendiri dan lingkungan yang terisolasi. Meta juga menggunakan agen keamanan bernama Sentinel untuk mengawasi akses Muse ke internet. Meski begitu, memberikan AI akses ke email, kalender, belanja, dan berbagai data pribadi tetap menghadirkan risiko baru, terutama ketika agen diberi kemampuan untuk mengambil tindakan secara mandiri.
Bukan Sekadar Chatbot
Meta Muse di Connect 2026
Salah satu perbedaan utama Muse terletak pada cara kerjanya. Pengguna cukup memberikan tujuan melalui percakapan, kemudian Muse dapat memecahnya menjadi sejumlah langkah dan menjalankannya. Pengguna juga dapat menghubungkan layanan seperti email, kalender, dan Instagram sehingga agen memiliki konteks yang lebih luas untuk menyelesaikan tugas.
Muse bahkan dirancang untuk bersikap proaktif. Jika mengetahui tujuan dan kebiasaan pengguna, sistem dapat memberikan saran atau menyusun langkah berikutnya tanpa harus selalu menunggu perintah baru. Konsep ini membuat AI bergeser dari sekadar alat untuk mencari informasi menjadi semacam asisten digital yang terus bekerja di belakang layar.

items.title: RayBan Meta Gen 3 Janjikan Baterai Lebih Tahan Lama & Desain Lebih Nyaman, Dikonfirmasi Resmi ke Indonesia
items.summary:
Pekan lalu merupakan pekan yang cukup sibuk bagi Meta, tidak hanya memperkenalkan sebuah AI agen baru, namun juga merilis cukup banyak opsi kacamata pintar terbarunya. Mulai dari pesaing Apple Vision Pro, kacamata pintar tanpa kamera, hingga RayBan Meta Gen 3 yang juga membawa sejumlah peningkatan fitur.
Ya, RayBan Meta Gen 3 diluncurkan bersama dengan RayBan Meta Audio, hingga sejumlah opsi baru Meta Glasses—lini kacamata pintar bikinan Meta sendiri tanpa kolaborasi dengan RayBan, sehingga harga perangkat bisa dibuat lebih terjangkau. Meski begitu, tetap mengandalkan tampilan atau aspek fesyen, berkolaborasi dengan LISA lewat desain bingkai (frame) khusus.
Dalam rilis resminya (23/9), Meta sebutkan bila semua produk baru ini menjadi usaha perusahaan. Di mana pada akhir tahun nanti, setidaknya konsumen akan mendapatkan lebih dari 100 desain atau opsi kacamata pintar dari Meta, baik melalui kolaborasinya bersama RayBan, Oakley, hingga opsi Meta Glasses tersendiri. Untuk pilihan-pilihan

items.content:
Pekan lalu merupakan pekan yang cukup sibuk bagi Meta, tidak hanya memperkenalkan sebuah AI agen baru, namun juga merilis cukup banyak opsi kacamata pintar terbarunya. Ya, RayBan Meta Gen 3 diluncurkan bersama dengan RayBan Meta Audio, hingga sejumlah opsi baru Meta Glasses—lini kacamata pintar bikinan Meta sendiri tanpa kolaborasi dengan RayBan, sehingga harga perangkat bisa dibuat lebih terjangkau. Meski begitu, tetap mengandalkan tampilan atau aspek fesyen, berkolaborasi dengan LISA lewat desain bingkai (frame) khusus.
Dalam rilis resminya (23/9), Meta sebutkan bila semua produk baru ini menjadi usaha perusahaan. Di mana pada akhir tahun nanti, setidaknya konsumen akan mendapatkan lebih dari 100 desain atau opsi kacamata pintar dari Meta, baik melalui kolaborasinya bersama RayBan, Oakley, hingga opsi Meta Glasses tersendiri. Untuk pilihan-pilihan frame yang bisa disesuaikan dengan selera masing-masing pengguna.
Baca juga: Mengenal Muse, Personal AI Agent yang Diciptakan oleh Meta
Tiga Peningkatan Utama RayBan Meta Generasi Terbaru
Menjadi suksesor dari lini kacamata pintar pertama Meta, spesifikasi RayBan Meta Gen 3 membawa sejumlah peningkatan menarik, agar lebih nyaman digunakan sehari-hari maupun memberikan daya tahan lebih lama. Desainnya sekilas terlihat familiar, tetap hadir dalam frame Wayfarer. Namun begitu, diberikan opsi dua frame lainnya: Aviator yang lebih klasik, serta Zena yang menjadi opsi frame berjenis cat-eye.
Walaupun sekilas mirip, sejatinya desain RayBan Meta Gen 3 sudah disempurnakan—disebut dibuat lebih ramping dan dirancang lebih nyaman digunakan. Area sekitar hidung alias temple tips juga kini bisa disesuaikan, dan frame tetap tersedia dalam dua ukuran berbeda (standard serta large).
Aspek desain merupakan satu dari tiga peningkatan RayBan Meta Gen 3, sementara dua aspek peningkatan lainnya ada pada daya tahan baterai serta kualitas panggilan. Ya, baterai RayBan Meta Gen 3 kini diklaim sanggup digunakan hingga 9 jam nonstop, alias 1 jam lebih lama. Sementara charging case memberikan tambahan masa pakai hingga 50 jam.
Dengan begitu, pengguna bisa lebih lama menggunakan RayBan Meta Gen 3 untuk mendengarkan musik, memanfaatkan fitur AI, sampai berkomunikasi via telepon. Kalau generasi sebelumnya punya 5 mikrofon, RayBan Meta Gen 3 kini punya 1 mikrofon tambahan. Diklaim mampu meredam kebisingan di sekitar secara lebih efektif, hingga 90%.
Harga RayBan Meta Gen 3 Smartglasses Mulai Rp8 Jutaan
Selain dari yang disebutkan di atas, spesifikasi RayBan Meta Gen 3 relatif masih sama. Kamera RayBan Meta Gen 3 tetap mengusung sensor 12MP yang mendukung perekaman video 3K30, 1080p60, maupun fitur lain seperti hyperlapse, slow motion, dan foto dalam rentang dinamis tinggi (HDR). Namun begitu, Meta siap berikan fitur baru yang menyusul lewat pembaruan software.
Fitur yang bakal hadir menjadi pelengkap keunggulan RayBan Meta Gen 3, adalah kemampuan merekam video dalam standar Dolby Atmos untuk efek audio spasial 360 derajat. Dan demi keamanan, Meta tetap sematkan lampu LED khusus pada bagian frame sebagai penanda bila fitur kamera maupun AI sedang aktif.
Dan seperti tahun sebelumnya, harga RayBan Meta Gen 3 kembali naik. Kini mulai dari USD449, atau sekitar Rp8 jutaan. Menariknya, dalam rilis resminya pekan kemarin, disebutkan bila Indonesia menjadi salah satu dari sekian negara yang bakal kedatangan opsi kacamata pintar Meta secara lengkap, termasuk Oakley Meta.

items.content:
Three Pakistani sailors were among five crew members killed after Somali pirates opened indiscriminate fire on the abducted crew of the Honour 25 while fleeing the vessel, while four sailors were injured, according to survivors and the Ansar Burney Welfare Trust.
Three of the injured sailors are also reportedly Pakistani nationals.
Somalia’s Puntland Maritime Police Force said in a post on X that it had "carried out a maritime operation off the coast of Dharin-baar, Bandar Beyla District", rescuing the MT Honour 25 oil tanker, which was hijacked by pirates near Somali waters on April 21.
Puntland Maritime Police Force (PMPF) has concluded an operation to secure the MT Honer 25. The vessel is now safe and under Puntland Government control. During the operation, 21 suspected pirates were apprehended, while operations to locate the remaining members continue. pic.twitter.com/GYUvHvFvcy
— Puntland Maritime Police Force (@PMPFOfficial) September 29, 2026
It further said that the vessel was under the control of the Puntland government. The statement initially reported that 21 suspected pirates had been apprehended, but later revised the figure to 16.
Pakistani sailors Hussain Yousuf and Imran Ali, who survived the attack, contacted the Ansar Burney Welfare Trust office in Karachi using the ship captain’s mobile phone and provided details of the incident.
Read More: Pirate hostage blame game
According to the surviving crew members, the governments of Somalia and the semi-autonomous region of Puntland in northeastern Somalia launched a joint operation on Tuesday to free the hostages from the pirates. An exchange of fire took place between Somali security forces and the pirates during the operation.
The Pakistani crew members said that when the pirates came under pressure and began retreating, they opened indiscriminate fire on the abducted crew members before fleeing the vessel.
Speaking to The Express Tribune, Ansar Burney Trust Director Advocate Qurat-ul-Ain said the location where the crew members were killed and injured was a considerable distance from the shore.
She said the pirates also damaged the steering system of the Honour 25 while fleeing, rendering the vessel inoperable. The ship is now being towed to the shore by a Somali naval vessel, a process that is expected to take at least two days.
According to Qurat-ul-Ain, the naval vessel towing the Honour 25 is the same vessel that was used to launch the attack against the pirates.
Also Read: Govt 'actively working' to secure release of Pakistani sailors in Somali pirate captivity: maritime minister
She added that the government of Pakistan and the Ministry of Human Rights had been informed about the entire incident.
Qurat-ul-Ain identified the Pakistani crew members killed in the attack as Second Officer Kashif Umar, Third Engineer Mahmood Ansari and Boiler Rafiullah. An Indian crew member, Tanveer, and the chief engineer from Myanmar were also among those killed.
The injured crew members were identified as Usman, Aqeel, Ameen and Vicky from Indonesia.
Yasir Khan, Hussain Yousuf, Imran Ali and Yaseen remained safe.
All the Pakistani crew members who were killed or injured are from different areas of Karachi. Their families had spent months seeking the safe release of their loved ones, staging peaceful protests and repeatedly approaching government authorities.
The oil tanker Honour 25, sailing under the Somali flag from Oman to Somalia, was hijacked by pirates on April 21. There were 17 crew members aboard, 10 of whom were Pakistani nationals. The families of the Pakistani hostages have continuously appealed to the government for the safe release of their loved ones.
During their captivity, the pirates initially demanded a ransom of $3 million for their release. The demand was later reduced to $1.9 million and subsequently to $1 million.
Puntland police said they had rescued another oil tanker, days after a rescue operation ended with pirates escaping in suspicious circumstances. They added that the Honour 25 had 18,500 barrels of oil on board when it was hijacked.
The police have been chasing three hijacked vessels off the Somali coast in recent days and rescued one of the other oil tankers, Sibu 1, on Friday. However, 28 of the 41 pirates arrested in the operation later escaped while being transferred to jail, with several Puntland security officials accusing local police of complicity.
The Gulf of Aden and Somalia coasts have seen a resurgence in piracy since April, according to figures from the International Maritime Organisation, with at least 15 attacks this year, the highest since 2013.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pakistan’s National Cyber Emergency Response Team has directed provincial and sectoral CERTs to establish and operationalize their Security Operations Centers (SOCs) by November 2026, as part of a broader effort to strengthen nationwide monitoring of cyber threats and attacks.
According to the directives, provincial and sectoral CERTs will also be required to complete their technical connectivity with the National Cyber Security Operations Center (NCSOC), which has begun round-the-clock operations.
The move is aimed at creating a coordinated national cybersecurity monitoring network capable of detecting, analyzing, and responding to cyber incidents in real time. Pakistan’s CERT Rules already place the National CERT at the center of coordination between federal, provincial, and sectoral response teams, with responsibility for dealing with widespread attacks affecting multiple sectors.
Several sectoral Security Operations Centers have already been linked with the national center, according to information shared on the rollout. Remaining provincial and sectoral CERTs have been instructed to complete the required technical integration and nominate a technical focal person or team within seven days.
Under the proposed operating model, cyber incidents, security alerts, and threat intelligence will be shared with the national center without delay. Data relating to medium- and high-severity cyber incidents is expected to be transmitted on a continuous and real-time basis.
National CERT has previously said that functional SOCs are essential for real-time threat monitoring, detection, analysis, and incident response, and has conducted specialized training for officials from provincial and sectoral CERTs on establishing such centers.
Institution-level Security Operations Centers will also be linked with their respective provincial or sectoral CERTs, creating a layered monitoring structure in which cyber threat information can move from individual organizations to sectoral and provincial teams and ultimately to the national center.
The National CERT’s existing mandate includes national-level incident management, rapid response coordination, and the use of threat intelligence and real-time monitoring to address large-scale cyber incidents.
The new arrangement is expected to improve Pakistan’s ability to identify cyberattacks earlier, coordinate responses across institutions, and maintain a centralized view of threats affecting government bodies, critical infrastructure, and other key sectors.
Pakistan has also been expanding its broader cyber resilience framework through initiatives focused on real-time threat intelligence sharing, automated detection, and stronger coordination between government and industry.

items.title: Anthorpic’s Claude Sonnet 5.5 AI Model Launched With Performance and Cost Efficiency Upgrades
items.summary: Anthropic has launched its Claude Sonnet 5.5 AI model, which succeeds the Sonnet 5 model. The Claude Sonnet 5.5 costs the same as the Sonnet 5 at $2 (about Rs. 192) per million input tokens, $10 (roughly Rs. 960) per million output tokens, $0.20 (about Rs. 20) per million tokens for cache reads, and $2.5 (roughly Rs. 240) per million tokens for cache writes. While it costs the same as the Sonnet 5 model, Anthropic claims that it is significantly more cost-efficient. In its internal testing, the company found that the Claude Sonnet 5.5 costs 30 percent less per task compared to its predecessor. At the same time, the new AI model is 30 percent faster at generating outputs than Sonnet. The company says it is Anthropic’s fastest model yet.

items.content:
VC firm Peak XV Partners has launched the twelfth cohort of its accelerator and incubation programme, Surge.
The cohort features 18 startups from India, US and South East Asia operating across sectors like AI, robotics, space, consumer, healthcare, music and fintech. Important to mention that three startups selected in the cohort are operating in stealth mode.
Seven startups in Peak XV’s Surge 12 cohort hail from India.
“What stands out about Surge 12 is that these founders are building these companies on first principles. They are questioning whether the underlying experience should work that way at all,” Peak XV’s managing director Rajan Anandan said.
Peak XV launched the Surge program back in 2019, when it was operating as Sequoia Capital India & SEA, and has launched two cohorts each year since. Under this, it combines up to $3 Mn of seed capital with company-building workshops, community access, and a global curriculum delivered by world-class operators.
As per a report by TechCrunch, Surge 12 cohort is the first to operate under Peak XV’s higher investment ceiling of up to $5 Mn per startup.
Besides Surge, the VC firm manages a capital portfolio exceeding $9 Bn across 13 funds, with investments in over 400 companies across India and Southeast Asia. The firm’s portfolio boasts 36 companies that have gone public via its IPOs till date.
With that, let’s take a look at the startups selected for Surge 12 cohort
Meet The 15 Startups Backed By Surge 12
1. Alma
Founded in : 2025
Founders : Nischith Shadagopan MN, Vinod Ganesan
Headquarters : San Francisco
Total Funding : Undisclosed
Alma is building an AI-native interface that aims to change how people interact with computers. Instead of requiring users to open different applications, navigate menus and manually execute a series of steps, Alma wants users to simply tell the computer what they want to accomplish.
2. August AI
Founded in : 2022
Founders : Anuruddh Mishra
Headquarters : Bengaluru
Total Funding : $3 Mn
August is trying to be an AI layer between patients and the healthcare system. It builds an AI-powered health companion that helps users understand symptoms, medical reports, prescriptions and other health information.
3. Ditto
Founded in : 2024
Founders : Allen Wang, Eric Liu
Headquarters : Berkeley
Total Funding : $9.2 Mn
Ditto is trying to replace dating apps with an AI matchmaker. The AI analyses the preferences of users on the relevant campus, identifies potential matches and sets up an actual date, including the time and location. Ditto had 1.3 Lakh users by mid-2026.

Founded in : 2022
Founders : Antoine Mistico, Easton Dana, Vivek Indlebele Narasimha Prasad
Headquarters : New York
Total Funding : $2 Mn

Founded in : 2026
Founders : Karan Brar, Thomas Boser
Headquarters : San Francisco
Total Funding : Undisclosed
hiloop gives AI companies an automated research team that runs experiments to improve their models. Instead of an AI researcher manually trying hundreds of possible improvements, AI agents can propose and test different approaches themselves.
6. Hoola Health
Founded in : 2024
Founders : Deeksha Senguttuvan
