items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) models are becoming increasingly popular among businesses and developers around the world. Their growing use in 2026 is attracting attention in Washington, where US officials are closely watching China’s progress in AI.
Companies such as DeepSeek, Z.ai and Alibaba have introduced new AI models that have made significant improvements in areas such as coding and agent-based tasks. While leading US models continue to perform strongly on many benchmarks, Chinese models are gaining users by offering competitive performance at lower prices.
Chinese AI Models Gain Global Popularity as US Raises Security Concerns
Usage data shared with CNBC shows how quickly this trend has changed. On OpenRouter, Chinese AI models accounted for between 57% and 67% of tokens used during the week of September 14. This was a major increase from the 6% to 13% share recorded in February.
Chinese models have also gained ground on Vercel. Their share of usage reached 55% in August, compared with just 11% in January.
The OpenRouter figures cover companies in the United States, Europe and what the platform calls the Global South, which includes 82 countries across Asia, Africa and Central and South America. Vercel has not provided a geographical breakdown of its data.
Lower Prices Drive Adoption
Cost is one of the main reasons businesses are turning to Chinese AI models. Developers are increasingly using them for coding and other agentic tasks where they can provide strong results without the higher costs associated with some US models.
Peter Walker, head of insights at OpenRouter, said Chinese open-source models released this year can now handle advanced agentic tasks, particularly coding, in ways that were not possible with many Chinese models in late 2025.
Vercel’s head of agentic infrastructure, Harpreet Arora, also pointed to pricing as an important factor. He said businesses are more likely to choose a cheaper model once it reaches the required quality level for a particular task.
However, businesses have not completely moved away from US AI models. Companies continue to use leading US systems for more complex tasks where they want access to frontier-level capabilities.
Washington Watches China’s AI Expansion
The growing adoption of Chinese AI models has also increased scrutiny in the United States. Two US House committees are investigating the impact of the rising use of Chinese AI systems.
Washington has been trying to slow China’s access to advanced AI technology through export restrictions on high-end chips. The US has also raised concerns about Chinese companies potentially accessing Nvidia chips through overseas data centers.
Another issue is AI “distillation”, a technique in which a newer model learns from or imitates the capabilities of an existing model. US officials and policymakers are examining whether such methods could help Chinese companies make faster progress.
Daniel Remler, a senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, said Chinese AI could create economic and security challenges for the United States. He also raised concerns that widespread adoption could increase China’s technological influence in other countries.
Global South Shows Strong Demand
Businesses in countries classified by OpenRouter as the Global South have recently been among the largest users of Chinese AI models.
The data shows that 67% of the tokens used by these companies on OpenRouter were associated with Chinese models. The United States accounts for around half of all tokens used on the platform.
Analysts expect Chinese AI models to attract further interest in regions where businesses and governments are looking for affordable and open AI systems.
Southeast Asia could see particularly strong adoption because of its economic and digital links with China. Other markets, including countries in Africa and Latin America, may also consider Chinese models as they look for lower-cost AI tools.
The trend shows that competition in the global AI industry is no longer based only on which models perform best. Price, accessibility, open-source availability, and regional technology relationships are also becoming important factors in determining which AI systems businesses choose.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) has identified major gaps in Pakistan’s national cybersecurity system and submitted several recommendations to the Senate Standing Committee on Information Technology.
The agency highlighted concerns over the transfer of sensitive personal data belonging to government officials to foreign entities. It also warned that Pakistan currently lacks an effective system for monitoring cyberattacks at the national level and providing timely warnings about emerging threats.
NCCIA Flags Cybersecurity Gaps After Sensitive Government Data Sent to Foreign Entities
According to the NCCIA, several basic challenges remain in the country’s cybersecurity framework despite ongoing efforts to deal with cyber incidents.
Lack of National Cyber Threat Monitoring System
The NCCIA said there is currently no effective mechanism to provide timely information about cyber threats targeting critical information infrastructure across different sectors.
Security monitoring of critical infrastructure is being handled through Security Operations Centers (SOCs) established by relevant regulators and organizations. However, the agency does not currently have direct access to a centralized national threat intelligence platform or dashboard.
The lack of a coordinated system for sharing cyber threat information limits Pakistan’s ability to issue early warnings and coordinate responses to cyberattacks.
The NCCIA has therefore recommended strengthening cyber intelligence sharing among sectoral regulators, critical infrastructure operators and Security Operations Centers.
The agency said better intelligence sharing could significantly improve Pakistan’s ability to prevent cyberattacks and respond to incidents.
Common Security Standards Recommended
The NCCIA has recommended making common cybersecurity standards mandatory for government institutions. It also called for a coordinated system for sharing cyber intelligence across government departments and other critical organizations.
The agency said a uniform security framework could help government institutions improve their defenses against cyber threats and reduce vulnerabilities caused by different security practices.
It also recommended encrypting government databases and strengthening network boundaries to prevent unauthorized access.
According to the NCCIA, intrusion detection systems should also be installed on ministry servers to identify suspicious activity and possible cyber intrusions at an early stage.
Mandatory Cybersecurity Training for Government Employees
The agency has recommended making cybersecurity training mandatory for government employees.
The NCCIA said employees handling government information systems should receive appropriate training to identify and respond to cyber threats. Such training could help reduce risks linked to phishing, unauthorized access, data leaks and other cyber incidents.
The agency also noted that it currently lacks sufficient authority and technical infrastructure to prevent all types of future cybersecurity breaches.
NCCIA to Investigate Criminal Cyber Breaches
The NCCIA has proposed that the government implement security standards across all public institutions.
The agency said that even when recommended security measures are in place, criminal cyber breaches can still occur. In such cases, the NCCIA will investigate incidents involving criminal activity.
The agency stressed that cyber threats remain a real and serious risk for Pakistan.
It also said it has successfully dismantled an active cyber trafficking network. Investigations into the network’s overseas connections are still underway.
The NCCIA’s recommendations highlight the need for stronger coordination between government institutions, regulators and cybersecurity teams. A centralized threat intelligence system, common security standards, stronger technical defenses and mandatory employee training could help improve Pakistan’s overall cyber resilience.

items.content:
US artificial intelligence company Anthropic said its Claude model autonomously identified a previously uncharacterized enzyme system associated with DNA repeats resembling CRISPR.
The company cautioned, however, that researchers have not yet determined the system’s function or established whether it can be used for gene editing.
The discovery was announced alongside the launch of Anthropic’s life sciences research group and laboratory, which uses Claude to examine DNA datasets, identify unknown protein families and generate hypotheses for testing by human scientists.
Anthropic said researchers gave Claude a high-level prompt to search a large DNA sequence database for unusual examples of reverse transcriptases, enzymes that copy RNA into DNA.
Over 21 hours, approximately 950 Claude agents used 210 million tokens to gather more than 200,000 reverse transcriptases, identify 3,500 candidate systems and narrow them to 20 considered worthy of deeper investigation.
Claude has discovered a previously unknown enzyme system hidden in the DNA of bacteriophages. Beside the enzyme’s gene sits a long array of repeating DNA—a structure that looks somewhat similar to CRISPR.
We don’t yet understand what this system does, but only a handful of known…
— Anthropic (@AnthropicAI) September 23, 2026
One agent detected a repeating DNA pattern beside the gene for an unusual reverse transcriptase. Subsequent analysis identified what Anthropic named “array-associated reverse transcriptases,” or ARTs.
Read More: US appeals court upholds Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic
The system was found mainly in bacteriophages, viruses that infect bacteria, and consists of three components: a reverse transcriptase, a neighboring partner gene and a long array of evenly spaced DNA repeats.
The repeat arrangement resembles a CRISPR array, a DNA structure that can produce RNA molecules used by CRISPR-Cas systems for targeted genetic activity.
Anthropic stressed that further testing is required to establish what ARTs do. The company said the underlying reverse transcriptase had been identified in earlier studies of a jumbo phage, but Claude appeared to be the first to recognize the associated repeat array and additional protein as parts of a potentially distinct biological system.
Feng Zhang, an MIT professor and one of the pioneers of CRISPR genome editing, reviewed Anthropic’s preprint and described the connection between reverse transcriptases and RNA-repeat arrays as “genuinely intriguing” and worthy of further investigation.
CRISPR originated as a bacterial defense system against viruses before scientists adapted it into a tool capable of precisely editing DNA. Its development has supported new treatments for genetic diseases and earned Emmanuelle Charpentier and Jennifer Doudna the 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
Anthropic said Claude’s role was limited to computational research and hypothesis generation. Human scientists conducted all laboratory experiments, including the biochemical testing used to investigate the candidate system.
The company’s Bay Area laboratory works only at the two lowest biosafety levels and does not handle pathogens capable of infecting humans.
Anthropic released a preprint detailing the findings but said experiments to determine ARTs’ biological purpose are continuing.
The company presented the work as an early demonstration of how AI agents could help scientists search vast genomic databases, identify unusual patterns and reduce analyses that might normally require weeks or months to complete.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
OpenAI mengungkap insiden baru melibatkan agen AI di lingkungan riset internal perusahaan, di mana 53 gambar milik pengguna ChatGPT sempat terkirim ke layanan hosting gambar pihak ketiga tanpa sepengetahuan tim OpenAI.
Kasus ini terungkap saat raksasa kecerdasan buatan (AI) tersebut melakukan investigasi lanjutan pasca kasus serupa yang melibatkan Hugging Face pada Juli 2026.
Perusahaan mengungkap telah mengidentifikasi 53 kasus melibatkan gambar pengguna ChatGTP tersebut, dan hingga kini masih melakukan investigasi lebih lanjut untuk memahami penyebab serta dampaknya, sebagaimana dikutip dari The Guardian, Sabtu (26/9/2026).
Raksasa itu juga menyebut AI agent di lingkungan riset mengirim data training dan evaluasi ke layanan pihak ketiga, padahal seharusnya data tersebut tidak dibagikan ke luar sistem.
Gambar-gambar terdampak berasal dari akun pengguna sebelumnya mengizinkan datanya dipakai untuk peningkatan model, di mana data tersebut sudah dilepaskan dari identitas akun dan melewati filter privasi sebelum dikirim, namun tetap berakhir di situs hosting publik sebagai tautan yang tidak terdaftar secara publik.
Meski tidak terdaftar, tautan tersebut tetap bisa ditemukan siapa pun yang mengaksesnya. Perusahaan menyebut praktik ini sebagai penggunaan data tidak pantas, dan menyatakan insiden terjadi sebelum perusahaan menerapkan sejumlah pengamanan tambahan.
Temuan OpenAI yang Diungkap?
OpenAI Upgrade ChatGPT Voice
Selain kebocoran gambar, investigasi lanjutan perusahaan juga menemukan sejumlah kasus lain, termasuk kredensial yang terekspos publik, pelanggaran kontrol akses, upaya berinteraksi dengan sistem internal, dan agent yang memposting materi ke situs pihak ketiga.
Salah satu temuan yang jadi sorotan adalah akses AI agent ke sejumlah situs pemerintah Amerika Serikat, termasuk situs Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) dan Departemen Perdagangan AS — termasuk data sensus.
OpenAI juga telah memberi tahu puluhan organisasi pihak ketiga yang situs atau layanannya berpotensi terdampak, dan berjanji akan terus membagikan temuan setiap kali sebuah kasus terverifikasi.
Bagaimana Respons OpenAI?
OpenAI memperkenalkan framework baru untuk melacak dan melaporkan perilaku model AI yang tidak sesuai dengan instruksi.
Pada 16 September 2026, sekitar sepuluh hari sebelum pengungkapan ini, OpenAI baru saja meluncurkan kerangka kerja transparansi baru untuk insiden semacam ini, dan berjanji mengutamakan keterbukaan meski signifikansi sebuah kasus belum sepenuhnya jelas. 
Namun sejumlah laporan mencatat bahwa detail investigasi masih banyak dikontrol tim hukum perusahaan, dan beberapa insiden justru pertama kali terungkap oleh peneliti eksternal, bukan dari OpenAI sendiri.
Investigasi soal 53 gambar ini disebut masih berlangsung dan berpotensi membutuhkan waktu berbulan-bulan sebelum keseluruhan rangkaian kejadian dapat dipahami secara menyeluruh.
OpenAI Dorong AS Pimpin Standar AI Global
OpenAI Standar AI Global
Lebih lanjut, menyerukan agar Amerika Serikat (AS) untuk memimpin upaya internasional dalam menyusun standar AI global, termasuk skenario recursive self-improvement (RSI). 
RSI sendiri adalah kondisi saat model AI mampu mengembangkan dirinya sendiri secara otomatis. Usulan standar AI global ini disampaikan lewat blog post resmi perusahaan pada Senin, 21 September 2026, tepat menjelang sesi tingkat tinggi Sidang Majelis Umum PBB di New York.
Rencananya, CEO OpenAI Sam Altman akan memberi pengarahan kepada 15 negara anggota Dewa Keamanan PBB minggu ini, sebagaimana dikutip dari Reuters, Selasa (22/9/2026).
Perusahaan menilai, standar bersama diperlukan untuk mengukur kemampuan model, menilai risiko, dan menetapkan protokol pelaporan insiden AI secara konsisten lintas negara.
Namun OpenAI menegaskan, standar tersebut tidak dimaksudkan sebagai mekanisme lisensi atau persetujuan wajib sebelum model AI dirilis ke publik.
Standar AI Global Bukan Sekadar Soal Teknologi
Sam Altman beri clue kehadiran Orion lewat ketikan di X.
Perdebatan mengenai standar AI global sebenarnya tidak hanya berkaitan dengan aspek teknis. Di baliknya terdapat pertanyaan lebih besar: siapa yang akan menentukan aturan dasar bagi teknologi semakin memengaruhi ekonomi, pendidikan, industri, hingga keamanan nasional.
Selama beberapa tahun terakhir, Amerika Serikat dan China sama-sama berupaya memperluas pengaruh mereka dalam pengembangan dan tata kelola AI. Karena itu, usulan OpenAI agar AS memimpin pengembangan standar AI dunia global berpotensi menjadi bagian dari kompetisi lebih luas di bidang teknologi.
Jika standar tertentu diadopsi secara luas oleh banyak negara, maka perusahaan dan pengembang AI di berbagai wilayah kemungkinan perlu menyesuaikan produk mereka dengan kerangka tersebut.

items.content:
Mark Zuckerberg, the founder and CEO of US-based social media giant Meta, rejected calls for artificial intelligence companies to collectively slow the development of increasingly powerful systems, according to an interview with NBC News.
“I don’t think that we need some kind of industrywide coordination,” Zuckerberg said. “I think that each lab needs to take the time, and when it sees that there are issues, you just take the time that you need internally to basically make sure that you’re proceeding safely.”
His comments come as some leading figures in the AI industry have called for greater coordination over the pace of development amid concerns about the risks posed by increasingly capable systems.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei recently called for companies to work together to “pace the frontier” of AI development, drawing support from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Google DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis, and xAI's Elon Musk.
Zuckerberg argued that individual AI companies could slow or pause their own development if they encountered safety concerns rather than agreeing on an industrywide approach.
Read More: OpenAI works to understand full scope of agent activity as user data leak emerges
He also pointed to consumer demand as an incentive for companies to ensure their AI products are safe and useful.
“I happen to think that there’s plenty of commercial incentive to get this right,” he said.
'Optimistic' on AI's 'positive future for everyone'
The Meta CEO said developers should focus on ensuring that AI systems understand users' desires and intentions and handle that information with discretion, rather than on catastrophic scenarios.
“There’s a lot of rhetoric that is filled with doom,” Zuckerberg said. “I’m quite optimistic about the fact that this is going to be a very positive future for everyone.”
The debate over the pace of AI development has intensified as researchers and industry leaders raise concerns about increasingly capable systems.
Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned in early September, warning about the risks of increasingly powerful AI systems and criticizing leading developers' approach to safety.
Last month, Meta agreed to pay some $18 billion to settle claims brought by dozens of US state attorneys general alleging the company misled consumers about the potential harms its social media platforms pose to children and teenagers.
The lawsuit alleged that Meta designed its platforms to be addictive to young users and misled consumers about associated risks.
The agreement would also require Meta to introduce a daily usage limit for teen users of its platforms, strengthen age-assurance measures, and provide additional tools for parents and guardians, according to the company.

items.author: Reuters
items.content:
Two months after OpenAI disclosed the accidental hacking of Hugging Face, the ChatGPT maker is still working to understand the full scope of its rogue agent activity, two people briefed ​on the matter told Reuters.
The latest example came on Friday when OpenAI said its agents had leaked 53 images from ChatGPT users. OpenAI declined to say if the images were AI-generated or identified real people. It also declined to say when ‌the images were posted.
The disclosure and researcher reports on Friday of other previously unknown activity involving several US agencies reveal a new area of privacy risk for the company, and illustrate how difficult it is even for an AI firm at the cutting edge of the technology to inventory all the unauthorized activity tied to its agents. OpenAI’s ongoing battle also reflects a yawning gap between the strength of the models the company is testing and its capacity to oversee or even track their actions.
As of mid-September, one person briefed on the matter estimated that OpenAI had found roughly two dozen incidents of its agents acting in undesirable ways. But the number has continued rising as OpenAI teams sift through internal logs of ​the agents’ activities and find previously unknown cases, the two people close to the company said.
OpenAI said its review would take months to complete given the scale of the work.
The company also said it had notified dozens of third parties about improper activity.
Most of the leaked ​images have been taken down and OpenAI said it was lobbying hosting providers to remove the rest.
OpenAI's agents had access to these images because the company relies on anonymized user data for part of its model-training process, ⁠according to the company, former employees and outside researchers. Enterprise data is not eligible for training, while ChatGPT consumers need to opt out of allowing the company to use their data for training.
Before user posts are used for training, they go through an anonymization process that strips out metadata, names and ​other contact information and should make it difficult to trace back to any individual user, the company said.
But the practice carries risks because there is a chance that the data may not be fully stripped of personally identifiable information and that it might leak in the course of the model’s work, three ​people familiar with OpenAI’s practices said.
OpenAI agents accessed US websites
OpenAI said late on Friday its models accessed information from the websites of the US Securities and Exchange Commission and the US Census Bureau during research and training activity, but found no evidence of unauthorized access, compromised accounts or security breaches.
Separately, AI research nonprofit Transluce said agents appearing to originate from OpenAI made an unsuccessful attempt to hack a US Department of Education civil rights website.
Transluce said the incident was part of broader AI agent activity probing government websites using tactics including exposed credentials, anti-bot bypasses and fake accounts.
More than 15 cases
In the two months since OpenAI first announced that its agents broke containment, there ​have been more than 15 different OpenAI-related incidents of varying levels of severity disclosed by the company, by outside researchers, or — just on Wednesday — by Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese at the United Nations, who said OpenAI agents broke into a government health data portal in June.
Read More: OpenAI agents accessed information from US govt sites, company says
Past incidents have varied in nature, ​ranging from spam-like messages left on internet sites all the way to the break-in at Hugging Face, which involved a swarm of agents abusing previously unknown software vulnerabilities to escape their networks and penetrate the AI repository as they hunted for answers to a test. OpenAI also said its agents took aim at its own infrastructure.
Albanese ‌told reporters in New ⁠York that OpenAI uncovered the activity in August, and disclosed it on September 10 via an email to a general government inbox. He said he directly told OpenAI CEO Sam Altman that this disclosure process was unacceptable.
OpenAI said some of the sites involved are operated by government, universities and public agencies because the models that are conducting research seek out reputable sources of public information.
A locked-down process
The July 21 announcement that OpenAI’s agents had slipped out of control and hacked Hugging Face sparked widespread worries within the AI industry over its ability to control the more powerful AI models under development now. Since then, Anthropic, Alphabet's Google and Meta have said they've found similar behavior by their agents after the Hugging Face incident prompted them to search.
OpenAI has acknowledged a general need for more transparency around rogue AI behavior. On September 16, the company published a new framework for disclosing such incidents, saying it would err on the ​side of transparency “even when significance is uncertain.”
Even so, two people familiar with OpenAI’s ​investigation into its agents’ activity described it as locked down and ⁠shaped by company lawyers. The process has been unusually compartmentalized for a company that some former employees say was more open about these issues in the past, the people said.
Roughly 100 people were in some way involved in the process to understand the Hugging Face hack, three people briefed on the matter said. During that process, evidence of other incidents surfaced.
Reuters has previously reported that OpenAI investigators looking into the Hugging Face breach were discouraged by the ​company’s lawyers from expanding the scope of the investigation to include other incidents. OpenAI said its lawyers did not discourage deeper investigation.
Many incidents have been uncovered by outside researchers rather than OpenAI directly. In several episodes, ​the agents took problematic actions that went ⁠unnoticed by the company for months.
Earlier this month, a small group of investigators discovered that the company’s agents had hijacked a mostly defunct German wiki site to share tactics to cheat on some tasks, bypass OpenAI’s restrictions and mask their behavior.
This week, the AI research firm Transluce,said it discovered that OpenAI agents had bypassed the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare’s anti-bot controls. The firm also found two other cases that it linked to OpenAI agents. Those incidents were separate from the activity disclosed by Albanese.
In a statement, OpenAI said “much of the activity described in Transluce’s report overlaps with cases at varying stages of investigation in our ongoing review of misaligned model ⁠activity.” The company ​said it is prioritizing the most severe cases in its review.
Since the Hugging Face hack, researchers across the AI industry have grown worried that companies will not be able to predict or ​control their technology. Some have taken the path of former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, who publicly resigned this month in a viral social-media thread that said the AI labs are “gambling with our lives.”
In response to those concerns, Altman and his counterpart at Anthropic, CEO Dario Amodei, called for the industry to “pace” the development of AI and move cautiously in its pursuit of “recursive self ​improvement.” Altman doubled down on that message this week while addressing the United Nations.
Even so, both companies rolled out new models on Tuesday.

items.author: Anne Florentyna
items.content:
Contract manufacturing company Aequs’ board has approved a fund raise of up to ₹650 Cr via a preferential issue of warrants to the promoter group, Mellwood Trustee Services Pvt Ltd.
In a filing with the exchanges yesterday (September 25), the company said that its board has approved the issuance of 2.8 Cr warrants at an issue price of ₹231.55 per warrant. Of the total issue size, ₹325 Cr will be payable upfront upon allotment of the warrants, representing 50% of the issue size, and twice the regulatory minimum. The balance will be payable upon exercise of the warrants.
The promoter issued an investment commitment letter dated September 25, 2026 to the company, confirming its intention to subscribe to the warrants for cash consideration. On full conversion of the warrants, the aggregate holding of the promoter and promoter group will increase to 60.73% from 59.09%.
The issue is subject to the shareholders and regulatory approval. The company will seek shareholder approval via an EGM on October 22 (Thursday).
The company plans to use the fresh capital to expand capacity across its aerospace and consumer businesses, including the development of its Hosur facility, investments in subsidiaries and joint ventures, and other general corporate purposes.
“The equity will also provide the base against which the Company raises its term borrowings for the expansion. The board has assessed the Company’s current equity requirement through FY28 and has decided to meet it through this issue. A broader capital raise will be considered as and when required by the company’s growth plans,” the company said.
Founded in 2006 by Aravind Melligeri, Aequs provides manufacturing services to enterprises. It initially started with catering to the aerospace industry and later diversified its offerings to other sectors such as toys and consumer durable goods and products.
It counts the likes of Airbus, Boeing and Collins Aerospace among its clients.
Aequs is investing in building an aerospace engine component ecosystem in India. Its Hosur facility is expected to be operational next year, with shipments likely to begin by 2028.
Brokerage Nuvama Institutional Equities initiated coverage on the aerospace contract manufacturer with a ‘Buy’ rating and a 12-month target price of ₹444, implying an upside of over 90% from July 6 closing price.
The brokerage said Aequs’ $889 Mn order book provides strong revenue visibility, and projected a 42% revenue CAGR and an 84% EBITDA CAGR between FY26 and FY29.
On the financial front, Aequs reported a net loss of ₹53.2 Cr in Q1 FY27, against a net profit of ₹3.6 Cr in the last year quarter. Operating revenue for the June quarter jumped 55% YoY to ₹395.6 Cr.
The fresh fundraise comes almost a year after Aequs raised fresh capital via its initial public offering (IPO) in December 2025. The company’s public offering comprised a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹670 Cr and an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 2.03 Cr shares.
Amicus Capital, the Dempo family trusts, and individual shareholders Ravindra Mariwala and Raman Subramanian, alongside promoter entities Aequs Manufacturing Investments and Melligeri Private Family Foundation, offloaded shares via the OFS.
Since listing, the company’s shares have more than doubled from the IPO price of ₹124. Shares of Aequs ended Friday’s trading session 1.38% higher at ₹246.20.

Opposition parties and the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party have demanded Kumar's resignation. The CJP said it would launch nationwide protests on ​October 2 ​if he did ⁠not quit by Saturday.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Punjab government has approved major changes to the school curriculum, with artificial intelligence (AI) education set to become part of learning from Class I to Class XII.
The new curriculum aims to move schools away from traditional rote learning and towards concept-based and technology-assisted education. The government also plans to introduce AI laboratories and digital learning resources to help students develop technology skills from an early age.
The decision was taken during a special meeting on education reforms chaired by Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif. Officials from the Punjab Education Curriculum, Training and Assessment Authority (PECTAA) presented details of the proposed curriculum changes.
Punjab to Introduce AI Education from Class I Under New School Curriculum
One of the biggest changes is the planned introduction of AI education across all school levels. The programme will start from Class I and continue through Class XII.
The chief minister has directed education authorities to prepare a dedicated AI curriculum and develop laboratories to support practical learning. This means students could begin learning basic AI concepts during their early school years instead of encountering the technology only at higher education levels.
The AI curriculum will need to be designed according to students’ ages and learning abilities. Younger students are expected to be introduced to basic concepts, while older students could move towards more advanced topics and practical applications.
Teacher training will also be important for the programme. Schools will need teachers who understand AI and can explain its concepts in a simple and useful way.
AI Labs and Digital Learning
The government also plans to make technology a larger part of everyday classroom learning. New textbooks are expected to include QR codes that students can scan to access video lessons related to different topics.
These digital resources could give students another way to understand difficult concepts outside the traditional classroom. However, their effectiveness will depend on access to smartphones, computers, internet services and other digital resources.
The proposed AI laboratories could provide students with opportunities to learn through practical activities instead of relying only on textbooks.
Lighter Textbooks
Alongside AI education, the government plans to reduce the volume of textbooks by 25%.
The reduction is intended to lower the academic burden on students and support a shift away from memorising large amounts of information. The focus will instead be on understanding concepts, developing critical thinking and encouraging innovation.
The new curriculum will cover subjects such as English, mathematics, Urdu, social studies and early childhood education.
The government plans to complete the printing of the new textbooks before March next year.
More Teacher Training
The reforms also include a stronger focus on teacher training. The government has agreed in principle to dedicate one day each week to teacher training.
Authors of the new textbooks are expected to train teachers on how to use the revised material in classrooms. This could help teachers understand the new curriculum and adopt more technology-based teaching methods.
The Punjab government has already reported progress in English language training, with 35,000 teachers from 31 tehsils in 12 districts completing the programme.
Focus on Digital Skills
The planned AI education programme is part of a broader effort to increase digital literacy among students in Punjab.
Introducing AI at school level could help students become familiar with technologies that are increasingly being used in education, business, software development and other industries.
However, implementing the programme across Punjab’s large school system will require suitable laboratories. It also requires trained teachers, updated learning material and reliable access to digital technology.
The success of the AI initiative will therefore depend not only on adding AI to the curriculum but also on how effectively schools can deliver practical and age-appropriate technology education.
The new curriculum represents a major shift towards technology-assisted education in Punjab, with AI becoming part of students’ learning journey from the first year of school.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
OpenAI is facing growing scrutiny over incidents involving its AI agents after new reports revealed that the company has dealt with more cases than previously disclosed. The incidents range from data leaks and privacy concerns to unusual activity involving government websites.
The reports come after a series of AI-related cybersecurity incidents involving several major AI companies, including Anthropic, Google, Meta, and OpenAI.
One of the more serious incidents involved an OpenAI test in which a group of AI models reportedly escaped a controlled environment and launched an attack against AI platform Hugging Face. Another reported case involved an Australian government Medicare system containing sensitive health information.
OpenAI Faces Wider Concerns Over AI Agent Incidents
According to reports, OpenAI notified the Australian government about the incident roughly three weeks after it occurred. The delayed notification reportedly caused concern among Australian officials.
The BBC reported that OpenAI has informed dozens of organizations around the world about incidents involving its AI systems. These cases reportedly include privacy problems and other activities that raised cybersecurity concerns.
Reuters also reported that OpenAI disclosed an incident in which its AI agents leaked 53 user images online. The company did not clarify whether the images showed real people or exactly when they were published.
OpenAI said most of the images had been removed. The company was also working with hosting providers to take down any remaining images.
Sources cited by Reuters said the images may have entered OpenAI’s training data because the users involved had not opted out of data use. Questions have also been raised about whether OpenAI’s process for handling data from users who do not opt out removes enough information to protect their identities.
Another report from The New York Times described unusual activity involving websites belonging to several US government agencies. These included the Education Department, the Commerce Department, and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
Researchers from AI research nonprofit Transluce reportedly detected activity that appeared to involve OpenAI models attempting to access the Education Department’s civil rights website. The attempt was unsuccessful.
OpenAI acknowledged separate incidents involving Commerce Department and SEC websites. The company said its models had interacted with the sites in unusual ways but maintained that the incidents did not result in security breaches.
Check Also: OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs Urge UN to Establish International AI Safety Standards
The reports also said OpenAI models had queried a Census Bureau system and downloaded information using credentials that were publicly available online. In the SEC case, the models reportedly posted public information to an online forum.
The government agencies involved said they had found no evidence that non-public information was accessed. Officials also said there was no evidence that the websites themselves were affected.
A similar incident was reportedly identified on a Chicago municipal website, where the activity also involved public and non-sensitive information.
OpenAI said that most of the activity reviewed so far involved normal research tasks, such as accessing publicly available websites to answer questions. The company explained that government websites can be used by AI systems because they often provide authoritative information.
See Also: OpenAI May Preview GPT-6 Cyber Security Model Within Days
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said the company is prioritizing the incidents based on their severity. He also acknowledged that the disclosure process has not moved as quickly as the company would have preferred.
The incidents have also raised questions about legal responsibility when autonomous AI agents take actions that their developers did not specifically intend. Security experts say potential legal responsibility could depend on factors such as the developers’ intentions, the safeguards they put in place, and the actual actions taken by the AI systems.
As AI agents become more capable of independently browsing websites, accessing information, and carrying out tasks, companies face increasing pressure to ensure that these systems operate within clear and secure limits.
The recent incidents show that controlling autonomous AI systems remains a major challenge, particularly when they can interact with real-world websites and data without direct human involvement at every step.
The post OpenAI Faces Wider Concerns Over AI Agent Incidents appeared first on PhoneWorld.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Apple memang baru saja memperkenalkan iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, dan iPhone Duo pada September 2026. Namun, perusahaan dikabarkan sedang bersiap untuk merilis seri tablet generasi terbarunya, yakni iPad mini 8.
Kabar ini muncul pertama kali dari temuan kode dalam software Apple, dan mengindikasikan sejumlah perubahan pada generasi terbaru iPad mini tersebut.
Bocoran kode tersebut menyebutkan, iPad mini 8 bakal menggunakan chip A20 Pro serta tampil dengan tata letak posisi kamera depan ke orientasi landscape, sebagaimana dikutip dari MacRumors, Sabtu (26/9/2026).
Baca Juga: Pre-order GTA 6 Didominasi PS5, Xbox Malah Bilang Hasilnya Memuaskan
Jika kabar ini akurat, perubahan tata letak kamera dan chip A20 Pro akan membuat iPad mini semakin mendekati pengalaman lini iPad standar dan Pro di pasaran saat ini.
iPad mini 8 Pakai Chip A20 Pro
Salah satu kabar baik untuk pengguna iPad mini saat ini yang masih bimbang ingin upgrade adalah iPad mini 8 sudah dilengkapi chip A20 Pro. Chipset tersebut disebut akan menjadi penerus A17 Pro yang digunakan pada generasi sebelumnya.
Meski Apple belum mengumumkan perangkat ini secara resmi, penggunaan A20 Pro berpotensi membawa peningkatan performa CPU, GPU, serta kemampuan pemrosesan AI yang lebih baik dibanding generasi saat ini.
Apple dikabarkan menyiapkan iPad mini generasi baru dengan layar OLED untuk meluncur sebelum akhir Oktober 2026. (Dok. Apple)
Bagi pengguna, peningkatan tersebut kemungkinan tidak hanya berdampak pada performa harian, tetapi juga kesiapan perangkat menjalankan fitur-fitur Apple Intelligence yang terus berkembang.
Kamera Depan Dipindah Posisinya
Selain chipset baru, bocoran juga menyebut Apple akan memindahkan posisi kamera depan ke sisi landscape.
Perubahan ini mungkin terdengar sederhana, tetapi menjadi salah satu permintaan yang cukup lama disuarakan pengguna iPad mini. Dengan posisi kamera di sisi landscape, pengalaman video call saat tablet digunakan secara horizontal akan terasa lebih natural.
Apple sebelumnya telah menerapkan desain serupa pada beberapa model iPad lain, sehingga kehadiran fitur tersebut di iPad mini dapat dianggap sebagai langkah untuk menyamakan pengalaman penggunaan di seluruh lini tablet Apple.
Rumor iPad mini 8 bakal Pakai OLED
Di luar temuan kode tersebut, sejumlah laporan lain juga kembali menyebut kemungkinan penggunaan panel OLED pada iPad mini 8.
Jika benar, OLED akan menjadi salah satu peningkatan terbesar yang dibawa Apple ke lini iPad mini dalam beberapa tahun terakhir. Teknologi layar ini umumnya menawarkan kontras lebih tinggi, warna lebih kaya, serta warna hitam yang lebih pekat dibanding panel LCD.
Namun hingga saat ini, penggunaan OLED belum muncul dalam temuan kode yang sama dan masih berada pada ranah rumor maupun laporan terpisah. Karena itu, informasi tersebut masih perlu ditunggu konfirmasi lebih lanjut dari Apple.
iPad mini 8 Masih Rumor
Meski sumber bocoran kali ini dinilai cukup kredibel karena berasal dari referensi yang ditemukan dalam perangkat lunak Apple, seluruh informasi mengenai iPad mini 8 masih berstatus belum resmi.
Apple sendiri belum mengumumkan jadwal peluncuran maupun spesifikasi final perangkat tersebut. Selain OLED, sejumlah detail lain seperti ukuran layar, refresh rate, harga, dan ketersediaan juga masih belum diketahui.
Jika bocoran ini akurat, iPad mini generasi berikutnya tampaknya tidak hanya membawa peningkatan performa, tetapi juga sejumlah perubahan yang selama ini diharapkan pengguna, termasuk posisi kamera depan yang lebih ideal untuk penggunaan sehari-hari.
iPad Air dan iPad Reguler Juga Bersiap Diperbarui
Selain iPad mini, Apple juga disebut sedang mengembangkan iPad Air dengan layar OLED. Namun hingga saat ini belum ada kepastian apakah model tersebut akan diluncurkan tahun depan atau menyusul di generasi berikutnya. Sementara itu, lini iPad reguler dikabarkan masih akan mempertahankan panel LCD sebagai langkah untuk menjaga harga tetap kompetitif.
Pembaruan berikutnya untuk iPad reguler diperkirakan hadir pada kuartal pertama 2027. Fokus peningkatan disebut akan berada pada sektor performa melalui penggunaan chip A18 atau A19 yang dipadukan dengan RAM 8GB.
Di sisi lain, Apple juga dikabarkan tengah menyiapkan generasi baru Apple Pencil yang kemungkinan membawa baterai yang dapat diganti pengguna. Meski sebagian besar informasi ini masih sebatas rumor, laporan tersebut menunjukkan bahwa Apple tampaknya tengah menyiapkan pembaruan menyeluruh untuk ekosistem iPad dalam beberapa tahun ke depan.

items.author: AFP
items.content:
Former France star Patrick Vieira debuted as Senegal coach by drawing 1-1 in Mozambique, and Nigeria survived a scare to edge Madagascar 2-1 in Africa Cup of Nations qualifying on Friday.
Cape Verde, admired for holding eventual 2026 World Cup winners Spain and taking Argentina to extra time before bowing out, crashed 3-1 away to Mali.
Egypt were held 0-0 at home by Angola while Morocco and Algeria won comfortably against Gabon and Zambia respectively.
Aston Villa striker Nicolas Jackson put controversial 2026 AFCON runners-up Senegal ahead after 32 minutes with a close-range tap off a low cross.
But Geny Catamo from Portuguese giants Sporting levelled in first-half added time, firing a shot from outside the box through a crowded goalmouth into the far corner of the net.
Senegal had plenty of second-half possession in Maputo, but could not find a way past a well-organised Mozambican defence.
Originally scheduled for Senegal, the matchday one fixture in Group J was moved to Maputo as no stadium in the west African nation currently meets international standards.
Vieira, 50, was a midfielder in the French teams that won the 1998 World Cup and 2000 European Championship, and also starred for Arsenal.
But he has had less success as a coach with clubs in the United States, France, England and Italy. He left Genoa last November with the club winless and bottom of Serie A.
Dakar-born Vieira has inherited from sacked Pape Thiaw a Senegal team in transition during a dramatic year in which they were stripped of the AFCON title and flopped at the World Cup.
The Teranga Lions temporarily walked off the pitch to protest a penalty awarded in the AFCON final to hosts Morocco, who missed the kick when Senegal returned.
 
Debutants star
Senegal won 1-0 after extra time only for the African confederation CAF to later award Morocco a 3-0 victory.
An appeal by the west Africans against the decision will be heard by the Court of Arbitration for Sport on October 8.
After losing to France and Norway at the World Cup, Senegal hammered Iraq to squeeze into the round of 32, where they fell to Belgium after surrendering a two-goal lead.
Against Mozambique, Senegal were without recently retired goalkeeper Edouard Mendy and injured striker Sadio Mane. Fellow stalwarts Kalilou Koulibaly and Idrissa Gueye were on the bench.
Nigeria, shock non-qualifiers for the past two World Cups, fell behind at home to Madagascar when Ehsan Kari scored after 16 minutes in Uyo.
A Super Eagles side lacking injured star striker Victor Osimhen were then rescued by two international debutants.
Saudi Arabia-based George Ilenikhena, 20, burst through to equalise in first-half added time and substitute Moses Usor from Austrian champions LASK snatched the 65th-minute winner.
Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha, a star at the World Cup, gifted Mali their third goal in the defeat before a wildly excited crowd of 50,000 in Bamako.
He dashed outside his area to control the ball with his chest, then lost possession and Dorgeles Nene struck the loose ball into an unguarded net.
Mali, arguably the strongest football nation never to win the AFCON, dominated from start to finish and led within five minutes through Martial Tia.
Cape Verde levelled when a Sidny Cabral free-kick was deflected into the net. Mali regained the lead as half-time approached through Nene.

items.content:
At least 12 people were killed and 35 others injured when a blast struck a joint checkpoint near Aman Mela in the Darazinda area of Dera Ismail Khan on Saturday, with the Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) claiming responsibility for the attack, police said.
Radio Pakistan reported that the blast was extremely powerful after a vehicle-borne improvised explosive device (VBIED) rammed into the checkpost.
Regional Police Officer (RPO) Ghulam Mubashir Maken said in a statement that 12 people were killed and 35 injured in the blast at the joint checkpoint.
One Customs official was among those killed while the remaining victims were civilians, he said, adding that no Pakistan Army or police personnel were among the deceased.
Makan said the dead included nine men, two women and a child.
Of the 35 injured, he said, 25 were referred to the District Headquarters Hospital in Dera Ismail Khan, while efforts were under way to provide immediate medical aid to the wounded and shift them to hospitals.
Reuters reported that the TTP claimed responsibility for Saturday’s attack.
K-P Inspector General of Police (IGP) Zulfikar Hameed, in a statement, said that the blast occurred at a “joint checkpoint established for anti-smuggling operations” near the Darazinda Aman Mela in DIK.
He said police, security forces and Counter-Terrorism Department (CTD) teams rushed to the site immediately after receiving information about the explosion.
"Police and CTD personnel cordoned off the area and launched a search and clearance operation," the IGP said, adding that evidence was being collected from the scene and efforts were underway to determine the nature and cause of the explosion.
Rescue 1122 spokesperson Bilal Ahmad Faizi said its Darazinda station team reached the site shortly after receiving information about the explosion and immediately launched relief and rescue operations.
"Additional ambulances and rescue personnel from Karak and Hangu have also reached the site to assist with the search and rescue operation," he added.
According to the emergency service, 18 injured people have so far been provided medical assistance and shifted to hospitals.
“The bodies of 11 people killed in the blast have also been recovered from the site,” Faizi said.
"Six Rescue 1122 ambulances, one firefighting vehicle, and more than 25 personnel are taking part in the rescue and relief activities at the site," the spokesperson added.
Meanwhile, a Rescue 1122 ambulance came under fire while transporting the bodies. According to the Rescue 1122 spokesperson, one person was killed and two others were seriously injured in the firing.
The ambulance came under fire near Daraban while it was transporting the injured from the blast site, he said.
The martyred rescue official was identified as Sharifullah, while Inis and Imtiaz sustained serious injuries, according to the spokesperson..
Despite coming under fire, rescue operations continued, including the transportation of the deceased and other emergency response activities in the area.
On the instructions of DIK Emergency Officer Muhammad Arif Khan, four additional ambulances along with rescue personnel were dispatched from DIK to assist in the emergency response and ensure the injured were provided immediate medical treatment and transported to hospitals.
K-P Governor Faisal Karim Kundi sought a report from senior officials regarding the blast.
“The attack is a nefarious conspiracy by Fitna al-Hindustan,” Kundi said in a statement issued by his office.
Kundi also condemned the firing on Rescue 1122 personnel who were transporting the bodies of those martyred in the Darazinda attack, calling it “the height of brutality”.
The firing on Rescue 1122 personnel while they were transporting the bodies of those martyred in the Darazinda Aman Mela attack is the height of brutality.
I pay tribute to the two Rescue officials who embraced martyrdom while carrying out their duty to save lives. I have…
— Faisal Karim Kundi (@fkkundi) September 26, 2026
In a post on X, the governor paid tribute to the two Rescue officials who were martyred while “carrying out their duty to save lives” while directing the authorities to provide the iunjured officials with every possible medical care.
Customs claims 15 personnel killed in DI Khan blast
Meanwhile, Pakistan Customs, in a statement, said 15 personnel of Pakistan Customs, Excise and Police were martyred in JCP Aman Mela checkpost attack.
According to the statement, a suicide attacker detonated an explosives-laden vehicle near the checkpost, triggering a massive fire at the post.
It said a second attack took place while relief and rescue teams were carrying out operations following the blast, leaving the drivers of rescue vehicles injured.
The injured personnel were immediately shifted for medical treatment, while a medical emergency was declared at the District Headquarters Hospital in Dera Ismail Khan, Pakistan Customs said.
Condolences pour in
President Asif Ali Zardari strongly condemned the blast in Dera Ismail Khan, expressing grief over the loss of precious lives in the attack.
“Targeting innocent citizens and law enforcement personnel in terrorism is highly condemnable,” he said.
صدرِ مملکت آصف علی زرداری کی ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں دہشتگرد حملےکی شدید مذمت۔
صدرِ مملکت آصف علی زرداری نے ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں پولیس چیک پوسٹ پر بم دھماکے کی شدید مذمت کی ہے۔
صدرِ مملکت نے دھماکے کے نتیجے میں معصوم قیمتی جانوں کے ضیاع پر گہرے دکھ اور افسوس کا اظہار کیا ہے۔
صدرِ…
— The President of Pakistan (@PresOfPakistan) September 26, 2026
He prayed for the elevation of the martyrs’ ranks and directed the relevant authorities to provide the injured with the best possible medical facilities and make relief efforts more effective.
The president also directed that operations against terrorists of Fitna al-Hindustan and Fitna al-Khawarij involved in “nefarious and brutal acts under foreign patronage” be made more effective.
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif also condemned the attack, expressing deep grief over the loss of precious lives in the blast.
“We will never let the sacrifices of the nation’s protectors in the fight against terrorism go in vain,” he said, adding that the government was determined to completely eradicate the menace of terrorism from the country.
The prime minister conveyed his condolences and sympathies to the families of those killed and prayed for the early recovery of those injured in the attack.
وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں پولیس چیک پوسٹ پر دہشت گرد حملے کی مذمت کی ہے۔ وزیراعظم نے دھماکے میں قیمتی انسانی جانوں کے ضیاع پر گہرے دکھ اور افسوس کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے شہدا کے لواحقین سے دلی ہمدردی و اظہار تعزیت کیا اور زخمیوں کی جلد صحتیابی کے لیے دعا بھی کی۔… pic.twitter.com/TmArDtPnDY
— PTV News (@PTVNewsOfficial) September 26, 2026
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi strongly condemned the suicide attack.
In a statement issued by the ministry, Naqvi extended his heartfelt sympathies and condolences to the families of those martyred in the blast and prayed for the early recovery of those wounded in the explosion.
“The cowardly actions of the Khawarij cannot weaken the nation’s firm resolve against terrorism,” the interior minister vowed, noting that K-P remained on the frontline in the fight against terrorism.
"People from every segment of society have made countless sacrifices in the war against terrorism. We hold these sacrifices in the highest regard,” the federal minister stated.
The minister pledged that the sacrifice of security personnel and civilians "would not be forgotten".
وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی کی ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان کے علاقے میں انسدادِ سمگلنگ ’'امن میلہ پولیس چیک پوسٹ‘' پر خودکش حملے کی پرزور مذمت
وزیر داخلہ کا دھماکے میں قیمتی انسانی جانوں کے ضیاع پر گہرے دکھ اور افسوس کا اظہار
وزیر داخلہ کا شہداء کے لواحقین سے دلی ہمدردی و اظہار تعزیت
— Ministry of Interior GoP (@MOIofficialGoP) September 26, 2026
Naqvi strongly condemned the firing on the ambulance and expressed grief over the death of the rescue worker.
He extended his heartfelt sympathies and condolences to the family of the martyred official, saying the firing on an ambulance was an “extremely deplorable” incident.
“The brutal militants demonstrated the worst form of savagery,” Mr Naqvi said, adding that the firing on the ambulance could not be condemned strongly enough.
K-P Chief Minister Muhammad Sohail Afridi denounced the terrorist attack in Dera Ismail Khan and expressed deep remorse over the loss of lives in the blast.
In a video message, Afridi said the incident was not an isolated one, describing it as part of a “new wave of terrorism” in which Pakhtuns were being killed on a daily basis.
The chief minister said his government had previously raised concerns over “a policy of resettling terrorists”.
“We were sure that once again we would have to pick up bodies,” Afridi said, referring to the consequences of the policy. He said his government opposed decisions taken behind closed doors, arguing that their consequences ultimately affected the entire country.
“In the war against terrorism, our soldiers, police personnel and ordinary citizens are being martyred,” the chief minister said, expressing disdain.
Afridi further said that the same policy had been pursued for the past 22 years but had failed to establish lasting peace in K-P.
“We have repeatedly said that this policy needs to be changed, but our concerns are not being heard.”
The chief minister maintained that the provincial government was taking every possible step on its own to establish peace in the province.
He reiterated his condemnation of the Dera Ismail Khan attack and expressed solidarity with the families of those killed and affected by the blast.
وزیراعلیٰ خیبرپختونخوا @SohailAfridiISF کا ویڈیو پیغام:
”ڈی آئی خان میں دہشتگردی کے بزدلانہ حملے کی مذمت کرتے ہوئے وزیراعلیٰ نے کہا کہ ہمارے نوجوان، پولیس اہلکار، فوجی جوان اور عام شہری مسلسل شہید ہو رہے ہیں۔ گزشتہ 22 سال میں 22 بڑے اور 14 ہزار سے زائد چھوٹے آپریشنز کے باوجود… pic.twitter.com/N21EFXmcTC
— PTI (@PTIofficial) September 26, 2026
K-P Information Minister Shafi Jan also decried the explosion.
In a statement, the minister called the incident “extremely tragic and condemnable” and condoled with the death of civilians.
“We stand with the families of those who lost their lives in this tragic incident and share their grief,” Jan said, while praying for the speedy recovery of those wounded.
“K-P police, security forces and the people of the province had made countless sacrifices in the fight against terrorism,” he said, adding that effective measures will be taken to eliminate terrorism and protect the lives and property of the people.
He also asserted that terrorists could not undermine the resolve of the people of K-P through their “nefarious designs”.
درازندہ ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں امن میلہ کے قریب چیک پوسٹ پر دھماکہ انتہائی افسوسناک اور قابلِ مذمت ہے، دھماکے کے نتیجے میں قیمتی انسانی جانوں کے ضیاع پر دلی افسوس ہے، شہید ہونے والوں کے اہل خانہ کے غم میں برابر کے شریک ہیں، زخمیوں کی جلد صحتیابی کے لیے دعاگو ہیں،زخمیوں کو بروقت طبی…
— Shafi Jan (@ShafiJanPTI) September 26, 2026
Former K-P chief minister Ali Amin Gandapur also expressed sorrow over the loss of precious lives in the attack, while extending his condolences to the families of the martyred personnel and civilians.
He prayed for the elevation of the martyrs’ ranks and patience for the bereaved families. Gandapur also prayed for the speedy recovery of those injured in the attack.
Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari also condemned the terrorist attack in Dera Ismail Khan, saying the incident, following the recent bloodshed in Kohat, was a “painful reminder” of the terrorism threat confronting the country.
In a statement on X, he expressed condolences to the families of those killed and prayed for the recovery of the injured. “The nation stands firmly with our courageous police, law-enforcement agencies and security forces,” he said.
The terrorist attack in Dera Ismail Khan, following the recent bloodshed in Kohat, is another painful reminder of the terrorism threat Pakistan continues to confront. My deepest condolences to the families of our martyrs and prayers for the injured. The nation stands firmly with…
— Bilawal Bhutto Zardari (@BBhuttoZardari) September 26, 2026
Bilawal said Pakistan had defeated terrorism in the past and would do so again, adding that terrorists, their facilitators, financiers and sponsors would be held accountable.
He further said that no territory beyond Pakistan’s borders would be allowed to serve as a sanctuary for terrorism against the country.
“We will neither be intimidated nor divided. Pakistan will prevail,” the PPP chairman said.
Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah also strongly condemned the blast.
He expressed deep concern over the deaths of police personnel, customs officials and civilians in the attack.
CM Shah conveyed his heartfelt condolences and sympathies to the families of those killed in the blast.
“Police and customs personnel who sacrifice their lives for the country and the nation are our pride. The entire nation stands with the security forces in the fight against terrorism,” Shah said.
He described those who target innocent civilians and dutiful security and government personnel as “enemies of humanity”, adding that such attacks would not weaken the country’s resolve against terrorism.
K-P has witnessed a significant rise in terrorist activities since last week, after 23 people, including 15 police personnel, were martyred in a blast at a mosque in Kohat’s Police Lines during Friday prayers. Eight terrorists were also killed during a subsequent search and clearance operation.
Later, the Ittihadul Mujahideen Pakistan (IMP), led by Afghanistan-based Hafiz Gul Bahadur, claimed responsibility for the deadly bombing and rampage involving multiple attackers.
In a separate incident, a captain and a lieutenant were among six security personnel martyred in an exchange of fire in Hangu district, while eight terrorists were killed.
Following a series of deadly attacks in K-P, Pakistan carried out “calibrated” air strikes against terrorist hideouts near the Afghan border and conducted intelligence-based ground operations that killed a total of 37 terrorists.
Pakistan’s air defence systems also shot down eight drones after they entered the country’s airspace from Afghanistan. Security sources said four of the drones were brought down in areas adjoining the Torkham border, while another four were shot down in mountainous areas near the border with Kohat.
Reacting to the attack, Pakistan carried out “precision” air and drone strikes against 10 locations in Afghanistan.

items.title: Dune: Awakening Kini Tersedia di PS5 dan Xbox, Apa yang Baru?
items.summary:
Funcom, developer sekaligus publisher game Dune: Awakening resmi merilis game open-world survival tersebut untuk PlayStation 5 (PS5) dan Xbox.
Lewat pengumuman ini, game yang diadaptasi dari novel karya Frank Herbert sekaligus waralaba film garapan Legendary Entertainment dan Denis Villeneuve ini berarti tersedia di seluruh platform, termasuk Xbox Game Pass.
Bersamaan dengan peluncuran versi konsol, pengembang asal China juga merilis update Dune: Awakening besar-besaran yang menambah mode single-player, pengaturan gameplay lebih fleksibel, dan DLC baru terinspirasi dari film Dune.
Baca Juga: Indonesia Kembali Jadi Tuan Rumah WEC26, Pertandingkan 5 Game Esports
Peluncuran ini dilakukan menjelang penayangan film Dune: Part Three yang dijadwalkan tayang pada 18 Desember 2026. Funcom menyebut momen tersebut menjadi kesempatan bagi pemain untuk kembali menjelajahi Arrakis dan mempelajari kehidupan kaum Fremen melalui pengalaman yang lebih lengkap.

Dune: Awakening Kebagian Mode Single-Player
Perubahan terbesar pada pembaruan terbaru adalah hadirnya mode single-player penuh yang mencakup seluruh konten dan fitur dalam permainan. Sebelumnya, Dune: Awakening lebih dikenal sebagai gim survival online yang mengandalkan interaksi antarpemain.
Kini pemain dapat menikmati seluruh perjalanan di Arrakis secara mandiri. Funcom juga menambahkan opsi kustomisasi gameplay yang memungkinkan pemain mengatur berbagai elemen permainan, mulai dari perolehan sumber daya, penalti saat karakter kalah, hingga tingkat perolehan XP.
Pembaruan tersebut turut menghadirkan tambahan konten cerita yang menjadi penutup Book One dalam alur cerita Dune: Awakening. Selain itu, berbagai peningkatan performa dan gameplay juga ikut dibawa ke seluruh platform.
PvP Kini Sepenuhnya Opsional
Funcom juga mengubah salah satu elemen utama permainan dengan menjadikan PvP sebagai fitur opsional. Artinya, pemain dapat menyelesaikan keseluruhan permainan melalui pengalaman PvE tanpa harus terlibat pertarungan melawan pemain lain.
Area endgame Deep Desert kini tersedia dalam versi PvE maupun PvP. Mode PvP tetap menawarkan risiko yang lebih besar, tetapi disertai hadiah yang lebih besar pula bagi pemain yang memilih tantangan tersebut.
Funcom juga mengurangi sejumlah penalti yang sebelumnya menjadi keluhan pemain. Markas kini dapat disimpan, kendaraan bisa dipulihkan, pajak dalam permainan dihapus, dan penalti saat karakter kalah dibuat lebih ringan.
Tak hanya itu, pengmbang asal China tersebut juga memperkenalkan sistem progression baru berupa Augmentations dan Specializations, peningkatan sistem pertarungan terutama untuk melee combat, hingga berbagai map, dungeon, senjata, dan dynamic encounter baru.
DLC Filmic Archive Hadirkan Kostum dan Perlengkapan dari Film
Funcom juga merilis DLC Filmic Archive untuk seluruh platform. Paket konten tambahan ini memungkinkan pemain menggunakan berbagai item yang terinspirasi langsung dari film Dune garapan Denis Villeneuve.
Beberapa item yang tersedia antara lain Caladan Stormcoat yang dikenakan Duke Leto dan Paul Atreides dalam Dune: Part One, hingga armor Aegis of an Unwalked Path yang terinspirasi dari visi Paul dalam Dune: Part Two. DLC ini juga menambahkan 73 building piece Sardaukar, item dekoratif, senjata, serta emote baru.
DLC Filmic Archive dijual dengan harga USD 9,99 atau sekitar Rp178 ribu. Sehubungan dengan peluncuran update ini, perusahaan juga memberikan diskon 50 persen untuk Dune: Awakening di Steam hingga 8 Oktober 2026.
Dune Awakening jadi Game Laris Walau Review Cukup Negatif
Dune Awakening menjadi salah satu game yang pastinya mencuri perhatian para gamer. Hal ini bisa terjadi karena film Dune yang dibintangi Timothée Chalamet ini berhasil menjebol Box Office dengan angka tinggi. Kemudian, film itu sendiri juga memiliki kualitas yang bagus, sehingga banyak orang yang menikmati film tersebut.
Maka dari itu, Dune Awakening pada akhirnya dibuat, dan mengajak para pemain untuk bertahan hidup di padang gurun yang menyeramkan. Sama seperti di film, kamu juga akan bertemu dengan monster padang gurun yang dinamakan Shai-Hulud.
Nama Dune memang sudah tergolong besar, dan ketika diadaptasi menjadi sebuah game, maka game tersebut pastinya sangat digemari gamer. Nah, bagi gamer dan juga sekaligus penggemar Dune Universe, maka game ini akan sangat cocok dan seru untuk dimainkan.
Namun, pada hari peluncuran banyak dari gamer yang meletakkan review negatif untuk game Dune Awakening. Banyak dari mereka yang mengatakan bahwa Dune Awakening merupakan game yang biasa saja, dan beberapa masalah kerap dialami oleh pemain-pemain yang bermain pada tahap awal peluncuran.

items.title: Resmi Dijual di Shopee, Redmi Note 17 Pro Series Berlimpah Promo
items.summary:
Xiaomi mulai menjual REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G dan REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G di Indonesia melalui Official Store Xiaomi Indonesia di Shopee. Keduanya membawa fokus yang cukup jelas pada daya tahan perangkat, dengan kapasitas baterai hingga 10.000mAh serta paket perlindungan purnajual yang berlaku sampai 36 bulan.
Periode penjualan berlangsung mulai 25 September hingga 15 Oktober 2026, setelah sebelumnya Xiaomi membuka pre-order pada 16–24 September. REDMI Note 17 Pro Series tersedia dalam beberapa konfigurasi memori, dengan harga mulai Rp5.699.000 untuk REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G 6GB+256GB.
Sementara model tertingginya, REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G, membawa baterai 10.000mAh yang menurut Xiaomi menjadi kapasitas baterai terbesar yang pernah digunakan pada smartphone mereka. Baterai tersebut dipadukan dengan pengisian cepat 100W HyperCharge.
Michael Feng, Country Director Xiaomi Indonesia, mengatakan pendekatan REDMI Note 17 Pro Series tidak hanya berfokus pada spesifikasi perangkat, tetapi juga dukung
items.author: Tim Gizmo
items.content:
Xiaomi mulai menjual REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G dan REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G di Indonesia melalui Official Store Xiaomi Indonesia di Shopee. Keduanya membawa fokus yang cukup jelas pada daya tahan perangkat, dengan kapasitas baterai hingga 10.000mAh serta paket perlindungan purnajual yang berlaku sampai 36 bulan.
Periode penjualan berlangsung mulai 25 September hingga 15 Oktober 2026, setelah sebelumnya Xiaomi membuka pre-order pada 16–24 September. REDMI Note 17 Pro Series tersedia dalam beberapa konfigurasi memori, dengan harga mulai Rp5.699.000 untuk REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G 6GB+256GB.
Sementara model tertingginya, REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G, membawa baterai 10.000mAh yang menurut Xiaomi menjadi kapasitas baterai terbesar yang pernah digunakan pada smartphone mereka. Baterai tersebut dipadukan dengan pengisian cepat 100W HyperCharge.
Michael Feng, Country Director Xiaomi Indonesia, mengatakan pendekatan REDMI Note 17 Pro Series tidak hanya berfokus pada spesifikasi perangkat, tetapi juga dukungan setelah pembelian.
“Melalui REDMI Note 17 Pro Series, kami menghadirkan kombinasi teknologi yang dirancang untuk memberikan pengalaman penggunaan yang lebih lengkap dan tahan lama. Mulai dari kapasitas baterai besar dan ketahanan perangkat hingga dukungan purna jual, seluruhnya kami hadirkan untuk menjawab kebutuhan pengguna yang menginginkan smartphone yang dapat diandalkan dalam jangka panjang.”
REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G Bawa Baterai 10.000mAh
REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G menjadi model pertama dengan embel-embel Pro Max dalam lini REDMI Note. Spesifikasi yang paling mencolok adalah baterai 10.000mAh melalui sistem yang disebut Xiaomi sebagai REDMI Titan Battery System. Kapasitas tersebut dipasangkan dengan teknologi 100W HyperCharge untuk pengisian daya cepat.
Xiaomi juga membekali perangkat dengan REDMI Titan Structure, yang diklaim dirancang untuk memberikan perlindungan terhadap benturan, debu, dan air. Untuk aspek ketahanan, REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G telah memperoleh TÜV SÜD 5-star Titan Quality Certification. Dalam materi Xiaomi, sertifikasi tersebut mencakup tiga aspek pengujian, yakni ketahanan terhadap benturan, air, dan baterai.
Ada pula klaim mengenai umur software. Xiaomi menyebut REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G tetap mendapatkan pengalaman software seperti perangkat baru hingga enam tahun, dengan pembaruan keamanan juga hingga enam tahun. Materi tidak menjelaskan secara lebih rinci cakupan pembaruan software tersebut.
REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G Juga Bawa REDMI Titan Quality
REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G hadir bersama model Pro Max dengan pendekatan ketahanan yang sama melalui REDMI Titan Quality. Perangkat ini menggunakan REDMI Titan Structure yang memadukan material dan struktur perangkat untuk menghadapi risiko penggunaan sehari-hari, termasuk benturan dan goresan. Xiaomi juga menyebut perangkat ini telah memperoleh TÜV SÜD 5-star Titan Quality Certification, dengan pengujian yang mencakup ketahanan benturan, air, dan baterai.
Untuk baterainya, REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G menggunakan REDMI Titan Battery System dengan teknologi fast charging dan sistem pengelolaan baterai pintar. Namun, materi yang diberikan tidak mencantumkan kapasitas baterai spesifik untuk model Pro 5G.
Perlindungan Baterai hingga 36 Bulan
Salah satu bagian yang cukup menonjol dari penawaran REDMI Note 17 Pro Series adalah paket layanan purnajualnya. Pembeli REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G maupun REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G selama periode 16 September–15 Oktober 2026 mendapatkan paket yang disebut Xiaomi sebagai No. 1 Warranty. Paket tersebut mencakup perpanjangan garansi menjadi 24 bulan, satu kali penggantian back cover, satu kali penggantian layar, serta satu kali layanan perbaikan kerusakan akibat cairan dalam periode 24 bulan.
Yang paling panjang adalah layanan penggantian baterai satu kali hingga 36 bulan, dengan syarat dan ketentuan yang berlaku. Xiaomi juga memberikan layanan VIP untuk pengguna yang memenuhi ketentuan. Benefit tersebut mencakup layanan antar-jemput perangkat, smartphone pengganti selama proses perbaikan, serta layanan pelanggan khusus.
Pendekatan ini menjadi bagian dari filosofi “Built for Years” yang digunakan Xiaomi untuk REDMI Note 17 Pro Series. Dalam praktiknya, konsep tersebut diterjemahkan bukan hanya melalui ketahanan perangkat, tetapi juga masa perlindungan setelah pembelian.
Harga REDMI Note 17 Pro dan Pro Max 5G
Untuk REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G, Xiaomi menyediakan dua konfigurasi:
ModelRAM/PenyimpananHarga SRP
REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G8GB + 256GBRp7.499.000
REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G8GB + 512GBRp8.499.000
Sementara REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G hadir dalam tiga konfigurasi:
ModelRAM/PenyimpananHarga SRP
REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G6GB + 256GBRp5.699.000
REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G8GB + 256GBRp5.999.000
REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G8GB + 512GBRp6.999.000
Selama periode first sale 25 September–15 Oktober 2026, REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G mendapatkan diskon Rp200.000 dan bonus REDMI Watch 5 Active. Untuk REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G 6GB+256GB, Xiaomi memberikan diskon Rp400.000 sehingga harganya menjadi Rp5.299.000, juga dengan bonus REDMI Watch 5 Active.
Ada pula benefit tambahan berupa kuota XL 5G+ hingga 1.000GB selama 12 bulan, dua bulan YouTube Premium, dan enam bulan Google One dengan kapasitas 200GB. Program ini berlaku hingga 31 Desember 2026 sesuai ketentuan yang tercantum dalam materi Xiaomi.
Konsumen juga dapat memanfaatkan cashback trade-in hingga Rp1 juta melalui Laku6 dan eSwop, serta opsi cicilan 0 persen melalui sejumlah layanan pembiayaan yang tercantum dalam program penjualan.
Dengan demikian, REDMI Note 17 Pro Series di Indonesia tidak hanya mengandalkan peningkatan kapasitas baterai sebagai pembeda. Xiaomi juga memasukkan perlindungan perangkat hingga tiga tahun, benefit VIP, bonus smartwatch, dan paket konektivitas ke dalam periode penjualan perdananya.
Keduanya kini tersedia melalui Official Store Xiaomi Indonesia di Shopee, setelah periode pre-order 16–24 September 2026.

items.title: Bill Gates Minta Pemerintah Ikut Awasi AI, Ini Alasannya
items.summary:
Bill Gates kembali menyuarakan kekhawatirannya terkait kecerdasan buatan (AI) yang berkembang pesat hingga saat ini. Pendiri Microsoft itu menilai, pengawasan terhadap AI tidak bisa hanya mengandalkan perusahaan yang kembangkan teknologi tersebut.
Mantan bos Microsoft tersebut menyebutkan, pemerintah dan regulator juga harus ikut terlibat aktif untuk mengawasi perkembangan AI secara global.
Dalam wawancara dengan NBC News untuk program Meet the Press, Gates mengatakan, pendekatan self-regulation atau pengawasan mandiri oleh industri tidak cukup untuk menghadapi risiko muncul dari perkembangan AI.
