items.author: Reuters
items.content:
Executives from three of the world's leading artificial intelligence companies briefed the UN Security ​Council on Wednesday amid warnings that increasingly powerful AI systems could soon improve themselves, slip beyond human control and pose a ‌threat to international security.
Among those addressing the 15-member council during the annual General Assembly gathering were OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Hugging Face co-founder Clément Delangue, three of the industry's most prominent executives.
"If managed poorly, I even believe that AI could be a risk to humanity as a whole," Anthropic's Amodei told the Security ​Council.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei brief UN Security Council on Risks of AI – LIVE on C-SPAN3 https://t.co/oduqtPYc7w
— CSPAN (@cspan) September 23, 2026
Governments have grappled with how to oversee AI systems that are advancing faster than regulators can keep up while the United States ​and China — the two dominant players in AI development — remain divided over whether the technology needs global guardrails or ⁠should be left largely to market forces.
Read: AI risks to humanity revive a long-running debate
“If AI is to be democratic, the most important decisions cannot be made by labs in San ​Francisco alone. They must be shaped through democratic processes and by governments accountable to the people they serve," Altman told the council. "At the international level, ​this will require cooperation."
"In our history, there have been times when countries who compete and don’t always like each other very much still come together for shared interests and the collective good in the face of a powerful new technology. We believe this must be one of those times," he said.
Yoshua Bengio, a Canadian considered one ​of the "Godfathers of AI" and co-chair of the Independent International Scientific Panel — created by the UN General Assembly last year — told the Security Council: "The ​dangers are real and imminent."
"This council faces an unprecedented threat, one that none of its members would choose, that none can contain alone, and that does not ‌respect the ⁠borders we defend," he said.
Council members, including leading AI rivals, the United States and China, were also set to speak. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot chaired the meeting.
Trump wants to encourage AI, not rein it in
Ahead of a meeting between US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Washington on Thursday, the US and China have discussed setting up a notification system for common goals and common threats that would cover AI-related ​incidents that rise to a national ​security level.
Trump told world leaders at the ⁠UN General Assembly on Tuesday that he "rejects any attempt to construct a globalist scheme to control" AI, describing the technology as amazing, but noted that the US would be careful.
"We're leading now over China by a ​lot, and everyone else, and we're going to keep it that way," Trump said. "I'm not going to stifle ​growth of something ⁠that will be bigger than the Industrial Revolution."
Trump on AI:
Whoever wins AI — you have to remember this — and now I say, whoever wins SI, whoever wins superintelligence, wins.
That’s the group that wins.
And we’re leading now over China by a lot, and everyone else. We’re going to keep it that way. We’re going to keep it… pic.twitter.com/U3vFTZenHs
— Clash Report (@clashreport) September 22, 2026
"We're going to encourage it, not rein it in. We're going to watch it closely through the Department of Justice," he said.
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres, who has long pushed for global governance of AI, has warned that rapidly advancing artificial intelligence poses risks that cannot ⁠be ignored, ​putting him at odds with Trump.
Read More: UN chief calls for AI curbs and end to wars in his last assembly address
The Security Council met for the first time on the ​risks of AI in 2023, when China said the technology should not become a "runaway horse" and the United States warned against its use to censor or repress people. Then-US Secretary ​of State Antony Blinken chaired a Security Council meeting on AI in 2024.

items.author: Seun Adeuyi
items.content:
Lamine Yamal has made a case for a broader interpretation of what it means to be the world’s best footballer, arguing that goals alone should not determine who wins the Ballon d’Or.
The Barcelona forward believes the award should also recognise players whose style, creativity and ability to entertain make them stand out and inspire fans to watch the game.
Yamal spoke to L’Equipe as he continues his pursuit of the individual honour after finishing behind Ousmane Dembélé in last year’s voting.
He is again among the leading contenders for the award, with Dembélé, Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappé and Bayern Munich’s Harry Kane also in contention.
The winner will be announced at a ceremony in London on October 26.
For Yamal, the current contest is particularly interesting because of the number of players with strong claims to the award.
“It’s fun that there are more players [up for the prize], more debate and people can have different opinions,” he told L’Equipe.
He acknowledged that the final choice would ultimately be determined by journalists, who he said faced a difficult task because of the quality of the candidates.
“At the end of the day, it comes down to the journalists. It’s a difficult job for them. We all have good arguments to win it. We are all great players, so let’s see,” Yamal said.
The teenager argued that the history of the Ballon d’Or shows that the award has traditionally been associated with players capable of producing something special on the pitch, rather than simply accumulating goals.
“The Ballon d’Or is for the best player of the year, someone different, someone we have enjoyed watching, who has that magic, makes you smile and look forward to watching games just to see them play,” he said.
“It’s not to do with the sheer number of goals. When I think of the Ballon d’Or, I think of [Lionel] Messi, Ronaldinho… different players, players that make you dream.”
The statistics, however, remain an important part of the debate surrounding this year’s contenders.
Kane finished the season with 61 goals for Bayern, helping the club win the Bundesliga, while Mbappé scored 42 goals for Real Madrid, who ended the campaign without a trophy.
Yamal scored 24 goals, while Dembélé recorded 20 goals for Paris Saint-Germain, who won the European title.
But Yamal believes his case should not be judged on his goalscoring figures alone.
The Barcelona forward pointed to his playing style, his success with the club and his achievements with Spain as factors that distinguish him from the other contenders.
“On the pitch I enjoy myself. I have also been lucky enough to win a lot of trophies with Barcelona.
“And I won the biggest trophy of them all, the World Cup with my national team. But beyond all that, I think the way I play is the strongest argument and what makes me different,” he said.
Despite his age, Yamal has already built an impressive collection of honours, including the European Championships and World Cup with Spain.
The Champions League remains the major team trophy yet to be added to his list of achievements.
While the Ballon d’Or is clearly one of his ambitions, Yamal insisted that he is not consumed by the prospect of winning it.
“Yes, I dream of winning [the Ballon d’Or],” he said. “I always say that everyone has to aim as high as possible. If I was a waiter, I would want to own the restaurant.”
Yamal also said his broader ambition is to leave a lasting legacy in football rather than spend his career measuring himself against the sport’s greatest names.
“I play to make history, so that in 30 years kids say: ‘He was really good.’ But it’s not an obsession. I never think ‘I want to be better than Pele or Messi.’ I don’t want to compare myself with others.
“I want to be Lamine Yamal. I want to be remembered as Lamine Yamal. I hope to be remembered among the greats. I have the capacity to do it; it depends on me.”

items.title: Meta testing a 'human concierge' for its new personal AI agent, Muse
items.summary:
Meta has been testing a “human concierge” for its new personal AI assistant, Muse, which entails having human contractors quietly handle some of the ​phone calls placed via the digital agent, according to internal company posts seen by Reuters.
The Facebook and Instagram owner told employees about the test last week, shortly ‌after the company publicly launched a phone-calling feature for Muse.
The Muse agent, which has topped US app download charts in the two weeks since its debut, is designed to autonomously perform tasks like sending emails, shopping and booking travel on a person's behalf.
With the phone-calling feature, a Muse user can tell the agent to dial phone numbers for US businesses and talk with people on the other end to handle errands like booking haircuts, checking whether a store has ​an item in stock or getting quotes from different contractors.
EXCLUSIVE: Meta testing a 'human concierge' for its new personal AI agent, Muse https://t.co/tDwVczSM0
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
Meta has been testing a “human concierge” for its new personal AI assistant, Muse, which entails having human contractors quietly handle some of the ​phone calls placed via the digital agent, according to internal company posts seen by Reuters.
The Facebook and Instagram owner told employees about the test last week, shortly ‌after the company publicly launched a phone-calling feature for Muse.
The Muse agent, which has topped US app download charts in the two weeks since its debut, is designed to autonomously perform tasks like sending emails, shopping and booking travel on a person's behalf.
With the phone-calling feature, a Muse user can tell the agent to dial phone numbers for US businesses and talk with people on the other end to handle errands like booking haircuts, checking whether a store has ​an item in stock or getting quotes from different contractors.
EXCLUSIVE: Meta testing a 'human concierge' for its new personal AI agent, Muse https://t.co/tDwVczSM0q https://t.co/tDwVczSM0q
— Reuters (@Reuters) September 22, 2026
Some employees have raised privacy concerns about humans handling those calls, warning that the approach could result in sensitive information being ​shared unintentionally with contractors in call centres, according to internal posts.
"It's baffling to me why we think this feature is worth the risk," one employee ⁠wrote in an internal post. "We are one bug away from unnecessary information being leaked to human callers."
Another employee, who had asked Muse to call an internet and cable provider to negotiate his bill, ​said a transcript showed the human contractor had made a racist reference during the call.
In response, a vice president in Meta's Superintelligence Labs unit acknowledged that "it was a miss" to start testing contractor-placed calls without ​proper disclosures and said the company had "rolled back this feature" for now.
Meta was still "hillclimbing AI calling," she added in her post, noting that some tests indicated that having humans make the calls could get their success rate up to the 95% to 98% range, instead of the "lower percentage of AI calling."
Read: Meta's Zuckerberg says AI agent tech progressing slower than expected
She also apologised to the employee who reported the mention of race during a Muse call and promised that the "human agent" involved would not work on any Meta ​projects going forward.
Human labour behind AI promises
The Muse test offers a window into how tech companies sometimes rely on human labour behind the scenes to deliver on the promises of autonomous AI, as ​they bump up against reluctance to engage from those on the receiving end of robocalls.
It harks back to an earlier experiment Meta conducted a decade ago, when the company, then known as Facebook, trialled a digital assistant ‌called "M" in its ⁠Messenger service. Media reports later estimated that around 70% of the agent's tasks were actually carried out by humans.
Asked about the Muse "human concierge" plan, a Meta spokesperson said the response from employees had been "overwhelmingly positive" and that the purpose of the test was to "get feedback so we can implement safety and privacy protections and improve features before we release them publicly."
"We're working with merchants to continue improving this potential calling feature, and will only roll it out when it's ready and with the proper disclosures," said the spokesperson, Daniel Roberts.
Meta's Muse agent has had more than 2.5 million downloads since its release, according ​to data provided by market intelligence firm Sensor ​Tower.
The company's stock has soared more than 20% since ⁠the launch, adding more than $200 billion in market capitalisation to touch its highest level in more than seven months as of last close.
Shares edged down 0.6% on Tuesday, however.
Undercutting a key selling point
Meta heavily emphasised the AI assistant's safety protections during its launch, telling would-be users that each agent would have ​its own secure “virtual machine,” or a dedicated computer in the cloud designed to keep people’s sessions isolated, and would keep sensitive information like ​passwords in separate secure storage.
Employees ⁠critiquing the human concierge plan inside Meta cited those security measures in their feedback, warning that it risked undercutting a key selling point for the agent.
Meta began having employees test out the phone-calling capability in August and gradually started rolling it out to Muse users in the days after the app’s debut, the internal posts showed.
Some users have reported problems with those calls, however, including one employee who said he tried calling ⁠his insurance company ​and "they keep hanging up on Muse when they hear it is AI."
Meta enabled the human concierge feature, also referred to ​as “human agent calls,” for half of its employees last week to overcome those issues, according to the internal posts.
“Muse is now able to hand requests to a trained agent, who places the call and works it through,” the post announcing the feature ​to employees said.
Employees who did not want to be included could join an opt-out group, according to the post.

items.title: LG DUALCOOL AI Air Resmi di Indonesia, Bawa AI untuk Atur Pendinginan dan Konsumsi Daya
items.summary:
LG Electronics Indonesia memperluas portofolio pendingin udara dengan meluncurkan tiga lini AC baru di Indonesia. Salah satu yang paling menarik perhatian adalah LG DUALCOOL AI Air, yang membawa teknologi akal imitasiuntuk menyesuaikan kinerja pendinginan berdasarkan kondisi ruangan dan pola penggunaan.
Selain LG DUALCOOL AI Air, perusahaan juga memperkenalkan DUALCOOL New Terminator Inverter dan Turbocool New Terminator. Ketiganya ditujukan untuk kebutuhan pendinginan dengan karakteristik ruangan dan penggunaan yang berbeda.
Menurut Ha Sang-chul, President of LG Electronics Indonesia, kehadiran LG DUALCOOL AI Air di pasar Indonesia merupakan komitmen untuk menghadirkan inovasi yang relevan dengan kebutuhan sehari-hari. “Kami juga terus memperluas edukasi konsumen agar semakin banyak keluarga di Indonesia dapat merasakan pengalaman pendinginan ruangan yang lebih cerdas, praktis, dan efisien,” ujarnya.
LG DUALCOOL AI Air Bisa Menyesuaikan Pengaturan Pendinginan
Pada LG DUALCOOL AI
items.author: Bambang Dwi Atmoko
items.content:
LG Electronics Indonesia memperluas portofolio pendingin udara dengan meluncurkan tiga lini AC baru di Indonesia. Salah satu yang paling menarik perhatian adalah LG DUALCOOL AI Air, yang membawa teknologi akal imitasiuntuk menyesuaikan kinerja pendinginan berdasarkan kondisi ruangan dan pola penggunaan.
Selain LG DUALCOOL AI Air, perusahaan juga memperkenalkan DUALCOOL New Terminator Inverter dan Turbocool New Terminator. Ketiganya ditujukan untuk kebutuhan pendinginan dengan karakteristik ruangan dan penggunaan yang berbeda.
Menurut Ha Sang-chul, President of LG Electronics Indonesia, kehadiran LG DUALCOOL AI Air di pasar Indonesia merupakan komitmen untuk menghadirkan inovasi yang relevan dengan kebutuhan sehari-hari. “Kami juga terus memperluas edukasi konsumen agar semakin banyak keluarga di Indonesia dapat merasakan pengalaman pendinginan ruangan yang lebih cerdas, praktis, dan efisien,” ujarnya.
LG DUALCOOL AI Air Bisa Menyesuaikan Pengaturan Pendinginan
Pada LG DUALCOOL AI Air, perusahan membekali AC dengan teknologi AI yang dapat menyesuaikan sejumlah parameter pendinginan berdasarkan kondisi ruangan dan pola penggunaan. Parameter yang dapat disesuaikan mencakup suhu, kecepatan kipas, hingga arah hembusan udara. Dengan pendekatan ini, pengguna tidak perlu terus-menerus mengubah pengaturan AC secara manual.
Konsep tersebut membuat AI pada AC bukan sekadar fitur tambahan, tetapi digunakan untuk mengotomatisasi sebagian pengoperasian perangkat. LG DUALCOOL AI Air juga dibekali dengan Window Detection. Fitur ini dapat mendeteksi kondisi jendela terbuka untuk membantu mengoptimalkan penggunaan energi. Ada pula kW Manager yang memungkinkan pengguna memantau sekaligus mengelola konsumsi daya listrik AC.
Dari sisi perawatan, DUALCOOL AI Air memiliki All Cleaning, yang menjalankan proses pembersihan internal secara otomatis dalam beberapa tahap. Untuk penggunaan pada malam hari, tersedia Sleep Timer+ yang dapat menyesuaikan pengaturan suhu berdasarkan pola tidur pengguna.
Bisa Dikontrol dari Smartphone
Fitur pintar pada DUALCOOL AI Air juga terhubung dengan ekosistem LG ThinQ. Melalui koneksi Wi-Fi, pengguna dapat memantau dan mengontrol AC dari jarak jauh menggunakan smartphone. Artinya, pengoperasian perangkat tidak sepenuhnya bergantung pada remote control yang berada di dalam ruangan.
Kombinasi AI dan konektivitas ini menjadi pembeda utama DUALCOOL AI Air dibandingkan dua lini AC baru LG lainnya yang diluncurkan bersamaan.
Baca juga: Uji Lab UI: Biaya Listrik AC LG DualCool Inverter New Terminator Rp912 per Hari
DUALCOOL New Terminator Inverter Fokus pada AC Inverter
Di luar lini berbasis AI, LG memperkenalkan DUALCOOL New Terminator Inverter. Lini ini menggunakan Dual Inverter Compressor. LG mengklaim teknologi tersebut mampu mendinginkan ruangan hingga 40 persen lebih cepat serta menghemat listrik hingga 70 persen dibandingkan AC konvensional.
Klaim tersebut merupakan pernyataan LG dan tidak disertai detail metode pengujian atau kondisi pembanding dalam materi peluncuran. Salah satu fitur yang menjadi perhatian adalah Watt Control. Pengguna dapat memilih tingkat konsumsi daya dalam empat pilihan, yakni 100 persen, 80 persen, 60 persen, dan 40 persen. Pengaturan tersebut memberikan pilihan bagi pengguna untuk menyesuaikan penggunaan daya sesuai kebutuhan.
Untuk distribusi udara, DUALCOOL New Terminator dilengkapi Dual Swing Auto yang mengarahkan hembusan udara ke empat arah. Sementara Gold Fin pada bagian kondensor dirancang untuk membantu meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap korosi.
Khusus varian premium tipe NVB, LG juga menyediakan Filter PM 2.5 untuk membantu menyaring partikel debu halus dan polutan di udara dalam ruangan. Seperti DUALCOOL AI Air, lini ini juga dapat dikendalikan dari jarak jauh melalui LG ThinQ.
Bagi konsumen yang mencari AC untuk ruangan lebih kecil hingga menengah, LG menghadirkan Turbocool New Terminator. LG menyebut seri ini ditujukan untuk ruangan berukuran sekitar 6–18 meter persegi. Fitur Turbo Mode dan Jet Cool dirancang untuk mempercepat proses pendinginan setelah AC diaktifkan. Sementara Dual Swing memungkinkan arah hembusan udara diatur ke kiri dan kanan.
Untuk pengelolaan daya, tersedia Energy Save Mode. Dari sisi kualitas udara, Turbocool New Terminator dilengkapi Fine Dust Filter yang dirancang untuk menyaring partikel berukuran kecil dari udara dalam ruangan.
Dengan demikian, ketiga lini baru tersebut memiliki pendekatan yang berbeda. LG DUALCOOL AI Air menjadi model yang paling menonjolkan otomatisasi berbasis AI, DUALCOOL New Terminator membawa teknologi inverter dan pengaturan konsumsi daya, sementara Turbocool New Terminator menyasar kebutuhan pendinginan untuk ruangan kecil hingga menengah.
Garansi Kompresor hingga 10 Tahun
Untuk layanan purnajual, LG memberikan garansi kompresor hingga 10 tahun, serta garansi suku cadang dan PCB selama 10 tahun untuk seluruh rangkaian model DUALCOOL dan TURBOCOOL seri NSB. Ketentuan garansi tetap mengikuti syarat dan ketentuan yang berlaku.
Ketiga lini AC terbaru LG tersedia dalam berbagai kapasitas pendinginan dan dapat diperoleh melalui jaringan ritel resmi LG di berbagai wilayah Indonesia.
Bersamaan dengan peluncuran lini AC barunya, LG juga menggelar AC Social Challenge melalui kanal media sosial resmi perusahaan. Program yang berlangsung pada 21 September–20 Oktober 2026 ini ditujukan untuk mencari 10 konsumen pengguna AC LG di Indonesia.
Ikuti media sosial Gizmologi untuk mendapatkan info teknologi terkini di Instagram, TikTok dan YouTube.

Confirming the Tuesday night ambush, the Director of Public Affairs, of the group , Tubwot Joël Sunday, said the victims were victims who were keeping watch on the community.
He gave the names of the victims as Samson Dachet, 45; Gambo Fwangyil, 50; and Zughumnan Bamaiyi, 35.
“The Mwaghavul Youth Movement is deeply disturbed that this deadly attack occurred during the period of the newly imposed 6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. curfew, a measure introduced by the Plateau State Government with the stated objective of protecting lives and enabling security agencies to stabilise affected communities,” he said.
The movement questioned the effectiveness of the curfew if armed criminals could still move and attack communities during the restricted hours.
“If law-abiding citizens are confined to their homes from 6:00 p.m., while armed Fulani criminals continue to move, attack and kill with impunity during the same period, who is the curfew ultimately protecting?” He asked.
Also, the National President of Mwaghavul Development Association, Bulus Dabit, condemned the incident, describing it as dangerous.
“The curfew is not working with lawless persons. While our people observe the curfew these bandits don’t. Rather they take advantage of it as they attack soft targets of our communities especially those at the borders during the curfew period,” he noted.
“The show of force is in semi-urban areas while the Rural areas remain vulnerable. We don’t need much security personnel in the urban areas. They took down three of our boys and mutilated their bodies. Now they are taking the attacks to our door steps knowing we will not respond due the presence of security agents. The curfew creates the enabling environment for them to escalate the attack on our communities.”
When contacted, the spokesperson of Operation Enduring Peace, Captain Polycarp Oteh, declined to comment.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Infinix memperluas portofolio laptop mereka di Indonesia dengan meluncurkan Infinix XBook 14 Neo. Menyasar pengguna yang butuh laptop dengan desain ringan untuk dibawa kemana-mana, perusahaan juga melengkapi perangkat barunya ini dengan chipset berperforma mumpuni.
Hanya memiliki bobot 1,2kg, Infinix XBook 14 Neo sudah menggunakan prosesor Intel Core generasi ke-13, layar 14 inci, serta penyimpanan SSD berkapasitas besar.
Baca Juga: Claude Opus 5.5 Meluncur, Anthropic Fokus Perketat Keamanan AI
Hadir sebagai penerus lini laptop Infinix di Tanahg Air, XBook 14 Neo tersedia dalam beberapa konfigurasi prosesor mulai Intel Core i3-1315U hingga varian tertinggi Intel Core 5 320.
Terkait harga Infinix XBook 14 Neo, laptop baru ini dibanderol mulai dari Rpv7.999.000 untuk varian Core i3 dengan RAM 8GB dan SSD 256GB.
Menurut Christian Sudibyo, Vice President Transsion Indonesia, peluncuran laptop ini dilakukan di tengah tantangan industri yang masih menghadapi kenaikan harga komponen dan tekanan rantai pasok global.
“Di tengah kenaikan harga komponen dan tantangan rantai pasok, kami melihat peluang untuk memberikan proposisi produk dan pengalaman lebih baik kepada konsumen,” kata Christian saat acara peluncuran di Jakarta, Rabu (23/9/2026).
Ia menambahkan, “karena itu, Infinix Xbook 14 Neo hadir dengan desain lebih tipis, harga terjangkau, serta ketahanan terus ditingkatkan,” Laptop ini juga tidak hanya menrgetkan untuk dipakai oleh pelajar.
“Infinix Xbook 14 Neo tidak hanya ditujukan untuk pelajar. Laptop ini juga dirancang untuk menunjang kebutuhan bisnis, pekerjaan kantoran, dan berbagai aktivitas yang membutuhkan mobilitas tinggi,” jelasnya.
Bodi Infinix XBook 14 Neo Ringan, Tapi Bersertifikasi Militer
Infinix XBook 14 Neo. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Salah satu daya tarik utama XBook 14 Neo adalah bobotnya yang hanya 1,2 kilogram. Dengan dimensi 314,2 x 219,7 x 17,4 mm, laptop ini dirancang agar mudah dibawa bepergian tanpa membebani pengguna.
Infinix juga menyematkan sertifikasi US Military Grade yang diklaim telah melalui berbagai pengujian ketahanan. Pengujian tersebut mencakup temperatur ekstrem, tekanan rendah, perubahan suhu secara drastis, hingga ketahanan terhadap guncangan mekanis.
Untuk pilihan warna, Infinix menghadirkan empat opsi yang lebih ekspresif yakni Twilight Purple, Sonic Yellow, Shadow Blue, dan Volcano Grey.
Layar 14 Inci Rasio 16:10
Pada sektor visual, XBook 14 Neo menggunakan panel IPS berukuran 14 inci dengan resolusi 1.920 x 1.200 piksel (WUXGA).
Layarnya mengusung rasio 16:10 yang memberikan ruang vertikal lebih luas dibanding layar 16:9 konvensional. Format ini cocok untuk aktivitas produktivitas seperti mengolah dokumen, membuka spreadsheet, maupun browsing.
Panel tersebut memiliki refresh rate 60Hz dan cakupan warna 45 persen NTSC.
Intel Core Generasi Ke-13 dan RAM Bisa Di-upgrade
Infinix XBook 14 Neo Debut di Indonesia, Harganya? (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Untuk performa, varian dasar mengandalkan Intel Core i3-1315U, sementara model yang lebih tinggi menggunakan Intel Core i5-1335U. Infinix juga menyediakan konfigurasi hingga Intel Core 5 320 sebagai opsi tertinggi. Seluruh varian menggunakan grafis terintegrasi Intel.
Menariknya, Infinix masih memberikan fleksibilitas upgrade. Laptop ini menggunakan dua slot SODIMM sehingga kapasitas RAM DDR4 dapat ditingkatkan sesuai kebutuhan pengguna.
Pilihan penyimpanan SSD tersedia dalam kapasitas 256GB maupun 512GB tergantung varian. Agar suhu tetap terjaga saat digunakan dalam waktu lama, Infinix turut menyematkan sistem pendingin internal.
Dilengkapi Wi-Fi 6 dan Asisten AI Folax
Untuk konektivitas, XBook 14 Neo menyediakan satu port USB-C full-function, tiga USB-A, HDMI 1.4, serta audio combo jack. Konektivitas nirkabel didukung Wi-Fi 6 dan Bluetooth 5.2.
Laptop ini juga dibekali webcam HD 720p, keyboard backlit, touchpad berbahan Mylar, serta fitur penutup kamera untuk menjaga privasi pengguna. Di sisi perangkat lunak, Infinix menghadirkan asisten AI bernama Folax yang ditujukan untuk membantu berbagai aktivitas produktivitas.
XBook 14 Neo menggunakan baterai berkapasitas 55Wh yang dipadukan dengan adaptor USB-C 65W. Penggunaan charger USB-C membuat perangkat ini lebih praktis karena dapat berbagi adaptor dengan perangkat lain yang mendukung standar pengisian serupa.

Harga Infinix XBook 14 Neo. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)

Intel Core i3-1315U + RAM 8 GB + SSD 512GB: Rp 8.999.000
Intel Core i5-1335U, RAM 8GB + SSD 512GB: Rp 10.490.000
Intel Core 3 304 + RAM 8 + SSD 512GB: Rp 9.299.000
Intel Core 5 320 + RAM 8 + SSD 512: Rp 10.599.000

items.title: DoorDash agrees to $131.5m after payment errors affected 200,000-plus NYC workers
items.summary: DoorDash will pay $131.5 million to settle a probe regarding its payment practices for delivery workers. The settlement will directly benefit over 260,000 Dashers, addressing both missing and late payments. An additional dispute over calculation methods for on-call pay times has also been resolved in this agreement. DoorDash has acknowledged the issues caused by technical errors and improved its payment processes.

items.author: Team Inc42
items.content:
More than 70 founders, ₹30,000 Cr in collective revenue and three days on a private island. Those numbers might tell you who was in the room, but not what happened after. Between September 17-19, Raffles Udaipur became the setting for candid conversations, unexpected connections and stories that stayed off the record for India’s D2C and retail ecosystem.
The three days showed what happens when people building some of India’s most consequential consumer businesses get the time, distance, and trust to step away from the noise.
The founder journey changes as companies scale. Decisions become heavier. The problems become more complex. And finding people who understand those problems from experience becomes harder.
And Inc42’s the D2C Retreat was built around that reality.
Set across a 21-acre private island framed by the Aravallis, the third edition of the retreat brought together founders from across India’s D2C, consumer and retail ecosystem for three days of conversations, connections and experiences, all under the Chatham House Rule.
The idea was simple: take founders away from the usual conference setting and create enough space for conversations that could continue beyond a stage or a scheduled session.
And they did.
From conversations about growth and durability, reinvention, liquidity, and the changing role of the founder, to more personal questions about identity, relationships, and life beyond the company, the D2C Retreat created room for founders to talk about what rarely makes it onto a conference agenda.
Some of those conversations happened around tables. Others happened over meals, by the lake, on boat rides or late into the evening. And many had little to do with the formal programme at all. That was intentional.
The D2C Retreat has always been built on the belief that founders building at scale do not need another room full of presentations and familiar success stories. They need peers who understand the decisions they are wrestling with, without lengthy explanations.
The third edition took that idea further as, for three days, the island became a space where some of India’s leading consumer founders could be themselves. And while what was said under the Chatham House Rule stays there, the connections and conversations created in that room can travel much further.
But none of these would have been possible without the partners who helped bring the D2C Retreat 2026 to life.
Inc42’s D2C Retreat 2026 was presented by Shadowfax and powered by IDFC FIRST Bank, Elements Wellness, CashKaro, NITRO Commerce, IndigoEdge, Snapmint, Razorpay, and HYPD. Their support helped us create an environment where the focus could remain on the founders, the conversations and the experience itself.
To every founder who made the journey to Udaipur, every partner who backed the idea and every person who helped build the experience behind the scenes, thank you.
 
View this post on Instagram
 
Presenting Partner
Shadowfax
Shadowfax is a last-mile and hyperlocal logistics major, with a nationwide network spanning over 16,372 pin codes across first-mile, last-mile and sort centres. It serves ecommerce, quick commerce, food delivery and on-demand mobility clients, offering express parcel delivery alongside reverse pickups, exchanges and same-day delivery. The company listed on the NSE and BSE in January 2026.
Its technology stack also includes solutions such as Shadowfax 360, SF Maps and SF Shield, aimed at improving shipping visibility, operational efficiency and delivery outcomes.
Powered By
IDFC FIRST Bank
The private sector bank, formed from the merger of IDFC Bank and Capital First in 2018 under the leadership of V Vaidyanathan, offers a suite of financial products and services across retail, MSME and corporate segments. With a strong focus on technology-driven banking, customer-first products and ethical practices, IDFC First Bank has built a differentiated franchise centred around transparency and accessibility.
IndigoEdge
IndigoEdge is an investment bank that works with founders and investors across fundraising, strategic transactions and other key moments in a company’s journey. Founded in 2006, the firm positions itself as a long-term partner to ambitious founders, with a focus on creating value beyond individual transactions and helping businesses navigate critical stages of growth.
Snapmint
Snapmint is a no-cost EMI and buy-now-pay-later platform that helps ecommerce and D2C brands offer flexible, easy-to-access financing at checkout, aimed at improving affordability and conversion for a wider base of Indian shoppers.
Razorpay
Razorpay is a full-stack financial technology platform that helps businesses accept and disburse payments while managing a wider range of financial operations. Its product suite spans payment gateways, payouts, business banking, payroll, credit and other financial tools, serving businesses across ecommerce, SaaS, education, BFSI and other sectors.
Elements Wellness
Elements Wellness is the flagship wellness brand of Indiashoppe, bringing together Ayurvedic formulations with modern research, quality manufacturing and scalable distribution. Since its 2014 launch, it has grown into one of India’s fastest-expanding wellness brands, with a presence across 750+ distribution centres and a growing digital education push for its distributor network.
CashKaro
CashKaro is India’s leading cashback and coupons platform, helping shoppers save on purchases across major ecommerce and D2C sites while giving brands a high-intent channel to drive traffic, conversions and repeat purchases.
NITRO Commerce
Nitro is a revenue-as-a-service full-stack platform for ecommerce, D2C and retail brands, built to solve acquisition and retention bottlenecks with technology. The platform addresses challenges like anonymous visitor conversion, simplifying complex marketing workflows for growing consumer brands.
HYPD
HYPD is a creator-commerce platform that enables influencers and content creators to build their own online stores, curate products and turn their content into shoppable experiences. Creators can share product recommendations through their personalised storefronts and earn from purchases made through their stores, creating a direct link between content, influence and commerce.
Gifting Partners
NUUK
Reimagining everyday appliances through design-first thinking, NUUK brings together thoughtful engineering, modern aesthetics and practical functionality. From fans and kitchen essentials to vacuum cleaners and garment care, the brand is building a new generation of home appliances designed around how modern Indian homes actually live.
Wonderchef
Bringing together Italian design, German quality standards and a love for cooking, Wonderchef creates kitchenware and appliances that make everyday cooking more convenient and joyful. From cookware and bakeware to air fryers, mixers and other kitchen essentials, the brand blends functionality with considered design, helping turn the kitchen into a space for creativity and connection.
GADO Living
Rooted in India and inspired by a love for thoughtful living, GADO Living creates timeless homeware that brings together craftsmanship, functionality and understated design. From tableware and barware to décor and gifting, the brand works with Indian artisanal traditions to create pieces designed to bring warmth, character and a sense of togetherness into everyday spaces.

items.author: Web Desk
items.content:
The federal government on Wednesday decreased the price of petrol and high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs1.93 and Rs4.21 per litre, respectively, for September 24.
According to a notification issued by the Petroleum Division, the price of petrol was fixed at Rs390.12 per litre, while HSD would cost Rs414.75 per litre for Thursday.
The latest revision comes a day after the government decreased the price of petrol by Rs1.7 per litre while reducing the price of HSD by Rs3.12 per litre for September 22.
Read: Govt decreases petrol by Rs1.7, HSD by Rs3.12 for Sept 23
On July 17, the government announced a new pricing mechanism under which petroleum product prices would be reviewed and notified daily, replacing the weekly pricing mechanism, as renewed tensions between the United States and Iran continued to drive volatility in global oil markets and raise concerns over fuel supplies.
Earlier this month, PM Shehbaz announced a special relief scheme offering Rs100 per litre off petrol for motorcycles, three-wheeler rickshaws and cars with engines up to 800cc, in an attempt to shield lower-income consumers from the impact of rising petroleum prices.
Under the proposal, an estimated 11.8 million beneficiaries would be covered. Around 10 million two-wheeler users and 800,000 three-wheeler users would be entitled to relief on 20 litres of fuel per month, translating into a maximum monthly benefit of Rs2,000 per beneficiary.
Another one million users of cars up to 800cc would receive relief on 30 litres per month, providing them with a maximum benefit of Rs3,000 each.
On Sept 17, the government reintroduced austerity and fuel conservation measures amid rising fuel prices, tightening business operating hours and restricting public events.
Under the measures, notified with immediate effect, shops, markets, shopping malls, bazaars, departmental stores, grocery stores, general stores and kiryana shops would close by 9pm throughout the week, according to a notification issued by the Cabinet Division.
Marriage halls, marquees and other commercial venues hosting festive events would close by 10pm, while restaurants, cafes, eateries, food outlets and standalone fruit and vegetable shops would be allowed to operate until 11pm. Takeaway and home delivery services would remain exempt from the timing restrictions.
Global geopolitical developments continue to pose significant risks. International oil prices are influenced by decisions taken by OPEC+, conflicts in the Middle East, sanctions on oil-producing nations, and disruptions in critical shipping routes such as the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea. Any interruption in these supply chains can immediately increase crude oil prices and freight costs. Since Pakistan imports the majority of its petroleum requirements, these developments quickly translate into higher domestic fuel prices.
Oil prices rose on Wednesday as Brent crude prices climbed over 3% after five straight sessions of declines, bouncing off a ​near two-week low.
"Saudi Arabia is acting, not waiting," said Phil Flynn, senior analyst at Price Futures Group. "After Houthi hits on the East-West pipeline forced a shutdown of Yanbu loadings, Aramco loaded about 14 million barrels of crude onto seven VLCCs inside the Gulf. Satellite and tracker data showed ​Saudi oil moving through Hormuz, averaging about 2.9 million barrels a day over the last six days, up from roughly 700,000 barrels ​a day in August.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said at the UN that Tehran would never surrender to the US, but still believes in diplomacy, a day after President Donald Trump threatened to "annihilate" Iran.
The dueling speeches bookended the first US-Iran shuttle talks in months, underscoring the lack of progress ​toward ending the Middle East conflict.

Kini, Meidy melihat lanskap AI sudah berubah jauh dibanding ketika Nodeflux berdiri. AI yang dulu relatif langka dan mahal mulai menjadi semakin mudah diakses, sementara kemampuan model berkembang sangat cepat.
Perubahan itu ikut memengaruhi cara Nodeflux membangun produk dan mengelola organisasi. Jika sebelumnya porsi pengembangan perusahaan banyak diarahkan pada riset dan pembangunan model AI, kini Meidy menyebut fokus Nodeflux lebih banyak berada di software engineering dan pemanfaatan AI.
Dalam episode perdana The Chief di Gizmotalk, Meidy Fitranto berbicara mengenai perjalanan tersebut, termasuk pelajaran paling mahal sebagai founder, dampak AI terhadap pekerjaan, kemampuan yang perlu dimiliki talenta, hingga rencana Nodeflux membawa produknya ke pasar global.
Siapa Meidy Fitranto, Co-Founder dan CEO Nodeflux?
Meidy Fitranto merupakan Co-Founder dan CEO Nodeflux, perusahaan teknologi Indonesia yang didirikannya bersama Faris pada 2016. Nodeflux awalnya tidak langsung berfokus pada Vision AI. Meidy menceritakan bahwa perusahaan tersebut sempat dibangun sebagai platform data analytics yang dapat memproses berbagai jenis data, mulai dari database dan sensor hingga video stream.
Perubahan menuju Vision AI terjadi secara bertahap. Setelah beberapa kali melakukan pivot dan menghentikan sejumlah arah produk yang dinilai kurang mendapat respons pasar, Nodeflux mulai benar-benar fokus pada Vision AI pada awal 2017.
Dalam perjalanannya, Nodeflux terlibat dalam sejumlah proyek teknologi, termasuk implementasi yang berkaitan dengan smart city Jakarta. Dalam wawancara, Meidy juga menceritakan hubungan awal Nodeflux dengan NVIDIA, termasuk keterlibatan perusahaan dalam program NVIDIA Inception dan kemudian Metropolis Software Partner Program.
Hari ini, Meidy Fitranto tidak lagi melihat Nodeflux semata sebagai perusahaan computer vision atau bahkan perusahaan AI. Vision AI masih menjadi salah satu bisnis utamanya, tetapi Nodeflux juga mulai mengembangkan solusi berbasis agentic LLM serta proyek teknologi lain seperti satelit dan synthetic aperture radar (SAR).
Berikut perbincangan Siti Sarifah Aliah sebagai host Gizmotalk by Gizmologi dengan Meidy Fitranto.
Nodeflux: dari data analytics ke Vision AI
Ketika Nodeflux didirikan pada 2016, saat itu AI belum sepopuler sekarang. Apa yang membuat Anda yakin masuk ke bidang ini?
Sebenarnya di awal kita juga enggak yakin. Nodeflux itu awalnya malah enggak langsung Vision AI. Kita dulu data analytics platform. Waktu itu sedang eranya big data. Kita membuat platform yang cukup universal, bisa memproses data dari database, sensor yang real-time, sampai video stream.
Kebetulan pada sekitar 2015 ada milestone besar dalam image recognition. Kemampuan komputer untuk melakukan deteksi mulai mencapai titik di mana error rate-nya lebih baik dibanding manusia. Karena kita juga masuk ke computer vision, akhirnya kita melihat ada peluang.
Waktu pitching, responsnya cukup menarik. Orang mulai bertanya, “Kalau ini bisa, berarti bisa melakukan ini juga?” Dari situ kita coba fokus satu per satu sampai akhirnya benar-benar masuk ke Vision AI pada awal 2017.
Jadi sebenarnya bukan langsung bertaruh, tetapi kita bertahap melakukan pivot. Yang tidak terlalu bagus kita drop, kemudian fokus ke sesuatu yang respons pasarnya lebih baik.
Berarti salah satu tantangan terbesar adalah mengubah teknologi menjadi bisnis?
Banget. Ini mungkin pelajaran paling besar dari Nodeflux. Kadang kita sebagai engineer terlalu mulai dari teknologinya. Ada teknologi apa yang bagus, apa yang keren, lalu kita bawa ke konsumen.
Padahal seharusnya bergerak mundur. Mulai dari konsumennya dulu, kemudian lihat teknologi apa yang bisa digunakan untuk menyelesaikan pain atau memberikan gain bagi konsumen.
Nodeflux pada awalnya lebih berat ke technology push. Masalahnya, ketika kita menemukan teknologi yang bisa menyelesaikan sebuah persoalan, pertanyaannya belum selesai. Apakah konsumen merasa itu worth it untuk dibayar?
Ada masalah yang kita senang karena berhasil menyelesaikannya, tetapi ketika disuruh membayar, konsumen bilang tidak perlu. Jadi mencari masalah dulu sebelum membuat solusi itu sangat penting.
Apakah pernah ada teknologi yang menurut Nodeflux bagus, tetapi akhirnya tidak punya pasar?
Kalau enggak ada konsumen yang mengadopsi, mungkin memang teknologinya enggak bagus. Kita sebagai engineer kadang punya ego ingin membuat sesuatu yang sophisticated. Akhirnya lupa bahwa tujuannya untuk bisnis atau cuma untuk membuat laboratorium supaya ego kita senang.
Itu trap yang nyata.
Kapan Mas Fitranto mulai merasa Nodeflux bukan cuma perusahaan teknologi, tetapi bisa menjadi bisnis besar?
Ketika mendapatkan klien besar dan investor. Klien adalah bentuk pengakuan bahwa produk kita punya value. Investor adalah pengakuan bahwa perusahaan kita punya value. Di situ kita merasa, “Oh, berarti kita enggak mimpi sendiri.”
Awalnya klien Nodeflux juga macam-macam. Ada yang berkaitan dengan inventory, kulkas, sampai receipt. Jadi memang di awal kita banyak eksplorasi. Sementara untuk NVIDIA, mereka bukan klien. Mereka partner. Kita memang menggunakan teknologi NVIDIA dan sudah menjadi partner sejak awal.
Pelajaran Termahal Nodeflux: Cash Flow, Produk Gagal, Hingga Layoff
Setelah hampir 10 tahun, apa kesalahan paling besar yang pernah terjadi di Nodeflux?
Kalau kesalahan, mungkin bukan di awal, tetapi di tengah perjalanan. Lebih ke manajemen, terutama financial management yang berantakan di awal. Spending sana-sini.
Dulu kita menggunakan kontrak sebagai acuan. Begitu kontrak didapat, kita menganggap kemampuan perusahaan pada tahun itu sudah seperti nilai kontrak tersebut. Padahal dari kontrak sampai implementasi selesai, kemudian sampai cash benar-benar masuk, jaraknya bisa empat sampai delapan bulan.
Itu yang membuat proyeksi finansial menjadi kacau. Sekarang kita jauh lebih prudent dan melihat sampai cash in. Variansnya menjadi lebih kecil dan lebih pasti.
Apakah ada momen ketika Nodeflux benar-benar merasa berada dalam situasi sulit?
Banyak. Masalah paling berat pasti seputar uang. Sekitar 2017 pernah masuk bulan gajian dan kita tidak punya uang. Waktu itu investor sebelumnya sudah ada, tetapi next round-nya belum masuk.
Yang paling berat mungkin saat COVID-19. Sekitar April 2020 banyak proyek hilang karena perusahaan melakukan realokasi anggaran. Beberapa piutang juga tidak dibayar, perusahaan menahan cash, sementara investor juga sedang wait and see. Akhirnya kita harus melakukan layoff.
Apa keputusan paling sulit yang pernah Anda ambil sebagai CEO?
Layoff. Kalau ada keputusan bisnis lain, misalnya ada kesempatan mendapatkan uang tetapi caranya tidak sesuai dengan value kita, sebenarnya masih lebih mudah untuk menolak.
Tapi layoff itu selalu berat. Ketika membangun perusahaan, kita bekerja bersama tim seperti sedang kuliah bersama. Ada perasaan bahwa kita ingin tumbuh bersama. Ketika akhirnya harus melakukan layoff, dampaknya bukan hanya soal bisnis. Ada hubungan yang mungkin tidak lagi terjaga, ada yang marah atau kecewa. Padahal sebelumnya kita ingin tumbuh bersama.
Jadi kalau ditanya satu hal yang paling berat, pasti layoff. Sisanya lebih seperti business decision making.
Meidy Fitranto juga mengungkapkan bahwa salah satu produk Nodeflux pada 2018–2019 pernah menghabiskan biaya pengembangan yang sangat besar sebelum akhirnya gagal. Kegagalan tersebut menjadi salah satu pelajaran paling mahal bagi perusahaan dan ikut berkontribusi terhadap keputusan layoff.
Nodeflux Tidak Ingin Hanya Dikenal sebagai Perusahaan Vision AI
Sekarang Nodeflux sebenarnya perusahaan Vision AI, perusahaan AI, atau perusahaan teknologi?
Kayaknya lebih ke perusahaan teknologi. Sekarang kita sebenarnya tidak hanya mengerjakan Vision AI. Vision AI masih menjadi menu utama yang sudah cukup firm. Tapi kita juga mulai masuk ke agentic LLM untuk membantu organisasi menjalankan pekerjaan sehari-hari, integrasi data dan lainnya.
Selain itu ada juga proyek satelit dengan teknologi SAR, yang bukan Vision AI dan bahkan bukan berbasis gambar seperti yang biasa kita lihat.
Jadi kita melihat Nodeflux lebih luas sebagai perusahaan teknologi. AI masih menjadi dasar yang kita gunakan secara luas, tetapi tidak harus selalu menjadi identitas perusahaan.
Mas Meidy tadi sempat menyebut ada perubahan besar dalam perkembangan AI. Seperti apa perubahan yang paling terasa sekarang?
Kalau saya melihatnya, ada dua abundance yang cukup kritikal di dunia saat ini. Pertama, intelligence abundance, kedua software abundance. Kalau intelligence, kita bisa melihatnya dari perkembangan model AI. Waktu pertama kali GPT muncul, rasanya luar biasa. Kita bisa ngobrol dengan AI, walaupun waktu itu masih ada masalah seperti halusinasi.
Kemudian muncul Gemini. Setelah itu muncul DeepSeek, Claude, dan berbagai model lainnya. Kalau dulu kita harus menunggu cukup lama untuk melihat model baru, sekarang hampir setiap bulan ada model baru yang semakin canggih.
Menurut saya, intelligence yang awalnya sesuatu yang langka sekarang mulai masuk ke fase abundance, setidaknya untuk kebutuhan bisnis secara umum. Banyak kebutuhan yang sebelumnya membutuhkan kemampuan khusus sekarang mulai bisa dibantu oleh AI.
Hal yang sama terjadi di software engineering. Membuat software sekarang menjadi sangat cepat dan mudah. Sampai kalau ditanya bagaimana mahasiswa seharusnya belajar programming sekarang, saya sendiri bingung menjawabnya karena perubahannya terlalu cepat.
Sekarang ada istilah vibe coding. Produktivitasnya juga bisa berubah sangat besar. Pekerjaan yang sebelumnya membutuhkan waktu berminggu-minggu atau berbulan-bulan bisa dikerjakan jauh lebih cepat dengan bantuan AI.
Bagi Nodeflux, perubahan ini juga memengaruhi cara kami membangun tim. Kami pernah punya tim sampai sekitar 150 orang, sementara sekarang sekitar 35 orang. Bukan semata-mata karena kami perusahaan AI, tetapi karena kami juga mengadopsi AI dalam pekerjaan sehari-hari. Kami menggunakan berbagai model dan tools AI untuk membuat tim menjadi lebih produktif.
Perubahan ini membuat fokus Nodeflux juga bergeser. Kami sekarang lebih banyak berada di software engineering, sementara porsi AI menjadi lebih kecil dibandingkan sebelumnya.
Kalau AI membuat software development semakin produktif, apakah perusahaan akhirnya tidak membutuhkan banyak orang?
Bukan begitu. AI tidak berarti perusahaan tidak membutuhkan manusia. Justru yang terjadi adalah produktivitas meningkat. Misalnya awalnya kita membutuhkan lima orang, kemudian dengan AI pekerjaan tersebut bisa dilakukan dua orang dengan produktivitas yang sama.
Bukan berarti dari lima menjadi nol. Tetapi produktivitas itu memang memberikan tekanan terhadap job position. Dan itu terasa di kita. Kita menjadi lebih hati-hati ketika ingin menambah orang karena kita harus melihat apakah kapasitas yang ada sekarang sebenarnya sudah cukup dengan boosting dari AI.
Perubahan tersebut membuat cara perusahaan melihat kebutuhan talenta ikut berubah. Nodeflux sendiri saat ini memiliki sekitar 35 orang dalam timnya, tetapi jumlah tersebut menurutnya bukan semata karena Nodeflux perusahaan berbasis AI.
Sekarang yang penting adalah learning agility. Kemampuan untuk belajar A dengan cepat, kemudian belajar B, C, dan seterusnya. Termasuk punya curiosity untuk mempelajari sesuatu tanpa harus selalu disuruhMeidy Fitranto
Talenta Masa Depan Tidak Harus Jago Coding
Lalu kemampuan apa yang paling penting dimiliki seseorang agar tetap relevan di era AI?
Kita bukan harus mengalahkan AI. Ketika manusia menciptakan mobil, kita tidak meminta anak kita berlari lebih cepat daripada mobil. Jadi bukan soal manusia harus lebih pintar daripada AI.
Menurut saya, sekarang yang penting adalah learning agility. Kemampuan untuk belajar A dengan cepat, kemudian belajar B, C, dan seterusnya. Termasuk punya curiosity untuk mempelajari sesuatu tanpa harus selalu disuruh.
Learning agility itu terdiri dari beberapa hal. Pertama rasa penasaran. Kemudian kemampuan menyerap informasi menjadi pengetahuan yang terstruktur. Setelah itu melakukan eksperimen berdasarkan pengetahuan tersebut. Ada juga kemampuan untuk learn to unlearn, yaitu melepaskan pengetahuan atau asumsi lama ketika kondisi sudah berubah.
Karena itu, Meidy tidak melihat bahwa semua orang harus belajar AI atau coding hanya karena AI berkembang cepat. Menurutnya, kemampuan untuk terus belajar justru lebih fundamental dibanding menguasai satu teknologi tertentu.
Masa Depan Nodeflux
Apa yang paling membuat Anda khawatir sebagai CEO hari ini?
Future, unfortunate future. Kalau ditanya Nodeflux lima atau 10 tahun lagi seperti apa, saya sendiri tidak bisa membayangkannya.
Bukan karena tidak mau membuat visi. Kalau sekadar membuat cerita, gampang. Kita bisa bilang lima atau 10 tahun lagi akan seperti ini.
Tapi kalau benar-benar percaya pada prediksi tersebut, rasanya terlalu sulit. Dunia berubah terlalu cepat.
Karena itu, trajectory yang kita pikirkan tidak pernah lebih dari tiga tahun. Untuk perusahaan bahkan biasanya hanya setahun. Kita fokus memikirkan apa yang akan dilakukan dalam satu tahun ke depan.
Kalau melihat satu tahun ke depan, apa yang sedang dipersiapkan Nodeflux?
Kami sedang berusaha going global dengan produk-produk baru. Bukan berarti kami mau listing di bursa. [tertawa] Kami ingin mendapatkan pasar yang lebih luas.
Kalau dari sisi software, kami melihat produk yang kami punya seharusnya bisa berkompetisi dari sisi kualitas. Hanya saja, selama ini kami terlalu banyak fokus di pasar dalam negeri. Jadi sekarang kami ingin mencoba keluar dan melihat pasar yang lebih luas.
Di saat yang sama, kami juga sedang mencari ide produk baru yang kira-kira bisa menjadi next item di Nodeflux. Dan produk baru itu tidak harus Vision AI, karena untuk Vision AI sendiri kami sudah punya rumahnya.
Jadi sekarang kami juga sedang mengeksplorasi, kira-kira apa lagi yang bisa kami bangun dan menjadi produk berikutnya untuk Nodeflux.

items.content:
Ukraine and Russia have both ​voiced an interest in a limited ceasefire involving grain and energy-related targets, US Secretary of State ‌Marco Rubio said on Wednesday after meeting Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov in New York.
Ukraine, which fears Russia plans to pound power and heating facilities with missiles and drones this winter, has been pressing for ceasefires covering energy infrastructure and Black Sea shipping.
"I think both ​sides have expressed an interest in some limited ceasefire that involves grain and energy. Obviously, you know, that ​won't be easy either," Rubio told reporters.
Marco Rubio on Russia-Ukraine:
Both sides have expressed an interest in some limited ceasefire that involves energy.
Zelensky has done so publicly. pic.twitter.com/101wosUXfs
— Clash Report (@clashreport) September 23, 2026
Russia has given no public indication it is ready ⁠to agree to a maritime or energy truce with Ukraine, and it was not immediately clear if Rubio was suggesting ​there had been movement on the Russian side after his talks with Lavrov.
Read: Russia is ready for new ideas on Ukraine peace, but with conditions, senior diplomat says
Rubio noted that it was a particular challenge ​that energy strikes were at the core of both countries' tactical priorities in their war, which is now in its fifth year.
World leaders converged on New York this week for the annual UN General Assembly debate.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, who was expected to address ​the General Assembly later on Wednesday, met US President Donald Trump on Tuesday and said they had discussed a ​ceasefire on energy-related targets.
The Ukrainian president told leaders at the United Nations earlier that Kyiv was ready for a maritime truce in ‌the Black ⁠Sea based on proposals such as those by Egypt, India and Turkey and said it was now up to Russia to respond.
Zelenskiy spoke at Ukraine's Crimean Platform summit ahead of a Security Council meeting on Russia's war in Ukraine.
"We are waiting for Russia's response. Ukraine is ready ... to ensure safe shipping and food security in the Black Sea if Russia ​is ready to take real ​steps towards de-escalation too. We ⁠have to start somewhere," he said.
Top wheat importers in Asia, the Middle East and Africa that count on the Black Sea region for wheat have been finding it hard ​to secure supplies. Global wheat prices have soared.
French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot told the Security ​Council that ⁠France backed moratoriums on attacks against energy infrastructure and in the Black Sea as a first step toward de-escalation.
Ahead of the Lavrov-Rubio meeting, the Kremlin said there were no grounds for wider Ukraine peace talks, while saying it remained open to such ⁠talks.
"For now, ​there are no prerequisites for moving on to a peaceful negotiating ​track, although we, as the Russian side, remain open to peace talks," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters.
Zelenskiy said on Tuesday that he would be ​ready to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at a trilateral meeting with Trump.
Rubio slams international order, says US will always act in its national interest
Meanwhile, Rubio criticised the current international system as "failing" and asserted that Washington would consistently prioritise its national interests over the international order.
Marco Rubio:
We will never put the international order above the interests of the U.S. pic.twitter.com/cY7BJ8FfEz
— Clash Report (@clashreport) September 23, 2026
Addressing journalists on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, Rubio argued that multilateral bodies had lost their core purpose and failed to resolve major global flashpoints.
"The international system is not in good shape right now, and these international norms people talk about," Rubio said. "At the end of the day, the president (Donald Trump) and I reflected this going back to the very beginning. The view of this administration is that the number one obligation of every government is the national interest of their country."
Marco Rubio:
Look, the international system is not in good shape right now. pic.twitter.com/5pUWJ9DckV
— Clash Report (@clashreport) September 23, 2026
Rubio pointed out that world leaders increasingly shared a consensus that global institutions were no longer working as intended. "Multiple leaders pointed to the fact that the international system is failing, and it's failing because it has grown beyond its mandate," he said.
"It has grown beyond its intent. It's involved in all kinds of things it shouldn't be involved in, and it's unable to solve virtually any major conflict in the world."
Highlighting ongoing global tensions, Rubio questioned the efficacy of global institutions in managing disputes such as clashes between Thailand and Cambodia, tensions between India and Pakistan, conflicts in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Rwanda, and maritime friction in the Strait of Hormuz involving Iran.
Read More: UN's moment of reckoning
In the absence of a functional system, nation-states must look out for their own security, Rubio said, emphasising the administration's foreign policy approach.
"At the end of the day, the United States will always act. At least as long as President Trump is in office, we will always act in the national interest of our country, not in the interest of the international order," he stressed. "We will never put the international order above the interest of the United States."

items.content:
Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) Admiral Naveed Ashraf on Wednesday called for translating maritime policies, regulations and international commitments into practical action, stressing that Pakistan’s maritime potential could only be realised through a safe, secure and sustainable maritime environment.
In a message issued on the occasion of World Maritime Day 2026, being observed on September 24, the naval chief extended his felicitations to Pakistan’s maritime community and the international maritime fraternity.
CNS Ashraf acknowledged the contributions of seafarers, maritime professionals, fishermen and coastal communities, saying their efforts remained vital to maritime connectivity, economic prosperity and the country’s overall economy.
He said Pakistan’s coastline and Exclusive Economic Zone offered significant opportunities for growth in shipping, shipbuilding, ship recycling, fisheries, offshore resources, energy, tourism and other activities linked to the blue economy.
“Realising this potential requires not only a safe, secure and sustainable maritime environment but also effective institutional oversight, responsible practices and continued investment in developing maritime capacity,” he said.
Read: Naval chief recalls 'Operation Somnath' on Navy Day, says legacy of courage continues as reflected in Marka-e-Haq
The chief of naval staff highlighted this year’s World Maritime Day theme, “From Policy to Practice: Powering Maritime Excellence”, saying for Pakistan, this meant continued efforts to strengthen maritime safety, protect the marine environment, enhance professional capacity and ensure that the maritime sector operates in accordance with international standards.
He also emphasised cooperation, knowledge sharing and capacity building among maritime stakeholders. “Pakistan Navy remains committed to safeguarding Pakistan's maritime interests and contributing to a secure and stable maritime environment,” CNS Ashraf said in a statement.
“Through continuous surveillance of our maritime areas, protection of sea lines of communication and contribution to regional maritime security, Pakistan Navy plays a vibrant role in creating an environment conducive to the growth of maritime trade and other economy-related activities,” he added.
The naval chief stressed that sustainable development of Pakistan’s maritime sector required a national approach, with greater awareness, protection of the ecosystem, responsible use of resources and stronger linkages among government institutions, industry, academia and coastal communities.

items.author: Ahtesham Bashir
items.content:
The Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) Cabinet on Wednesday approved the K-P Police Act 2026, introducing sweeping reforms aimed at making the provincial police force more accountable, professional and efficient.
The new legislation empowers the provincial government to return the services of federal police officers, including the Inspector General, in cases of unsatisfactory performance. It also establishes a clear separation between police policy and operational matters, creates new oversight boards, and overhauls the investigation and dispute-resolution systems.
Provincial Minister for Information, Science, Technology and Information Technology Shafi Jan briefed the media after the cabinet meeting, describing the proposed law as an important step towards introducing key reforms in the police system. He said the legislation would make the police more accountable to the public, strengthen the investigation system, improve officers’ professional development, and distinctly separate policy from operational affairs.
Under the new Act, the chief minister will chair the Police Policy Board, while the Inspector General of Police will lead the Police Operations Board. Furthermore, the provincial police chief will be required to prepare an annual policing plan outlining priorities, performance targets and future actions, and present it to the Policy Board for approval. The law also provides for the appointment of Regional Investigation Officers across the province after its passage by the provincial assembly.
Read: K-P police bill sparks autonomy concerns
Minister Jan said the measure is designed to enhance the police’s investigative capacity and professional competence. He further stated that appointments and transfers of Regional Police Officers and District Police Officers will be regulated under the K-P Rules of Business 1985 to ensure greater accountability.
To address long-standing barriers to career progression, the Act rebalances promotion, fast-track promotion and direct recruitment quotas. The minister said this would expand opportunities for officers and establish a more structured system of career advancement.
In a significant move towards transparency and uniformity, all existing Dispute Resolution Councils will be dissolved and reconstituted under the new law. Jan noted that the current legal framework lacks a clear procedure for these councils; the new Act introduces a standardised mechanism applicable across the province.
The cabinet meeting, chaired by Chief Minister Muhammad Sohail Afridi, was attended by Chief Secretary Shahab Ali Shah, the Inspector General of Police, departmental secretaries and cabinet members.
In addition to the Police Act, the cabinet approved the K-P Stamp (Amendment) Bill 2026. It also gave the green light to the revised cost estimates for the intake structure and tunnel (up to daylight) under the Peshawar Water Supply Scheme, and approved the release of remaining funds and a supplementary grant for land acquisition under an Annual Development Programme scheme for the construction of sports complexes in District Chitral.
The reforms mark one of the most comprehensive overhauls of the provincial police framework in recent years, with the government positioning the new law as a foundation for improved public service delivery and institutional accountability.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
OpenAI has introduced two new AI models, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, as part of its latest effort to make advanced artificial intelligence more affordable. The new models focus on improving performance while reducing the cost of using them.
The launch comes only a few weeks after OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Sol and Luna, the company is now targeting users who need strong AI performance without paying the higher costs associated with its more advanced models.
OpenAI has also significantly reduced the API prices of the new models. GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are both 50% cheaper to use compared with GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Luna. This could make them more suitable for developers and businesses that rely heavily on AI services.
OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna with Better Performance and Lower Costs
According to OpenAI’s internal testing, GPT-6 Sol delivers stronger results across a wide range of tasks. The company claims that the model can outperform Claude Opus 5 while costing much less to operate. For demanding tasks such as coding, OpenAI says GPT-6 Sol can match Claude Fable 5.1 while requiring a lower budget.
However, comparisons with competing models are still developing. Anthropic has also introduced newer versions of its Claude models with improvements in speed and cost. As a result, broader independent testing will be needed to determine how GPT-6 Sol performs against the latest competition.
Accuracy is another major focus of the new models. OpenAI says GPT-6 Sol makes around half as many mistakes as GPT-5.6 Sol in its internal evaluations. GPT-6 Luna also reportedly improves factual accuracy compared with its predecessor.
GPT-6 Luna appears to benefit particularly from higher reasoning effort levels. This allows the model to spend more processing power on difficult tasks, which can improve the quality of its responses.
The two models are now being rolled out in ChatGPT Work and Codex. They are available to ChatGPT Pro, Plus, Business, Enterprise, and Edu subscribers. Access is being introduced gradually, so some users may not see the models immediately.
See Also: OpenAI AI Agents Linked to RubyGems Cyberattack in May
Users on the Free and Go plans can also access GPT-6 Luna through the ChatGPT desktop app. OpenAI is expected to expand availability as the rollout continues.
With GPT-6 Sol and Luna, OpenAI is placing greater emphasis on the balance between performance and cost. The combination of lower API prices, improved accuracy, and stronger performance could make the new models useful for a wider range of AI tasks.

items.author: Reuters
items.content:
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on Wednesday accused Israel and the US of applying ‘double standards’, pointing to Israel’s nuclear arsenal and its actions in Gaza while Iran faces inspections and sanctions. He called for equal treatment under international law.
Addressing the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York, Pezeshkian said Iran was ready for dialogue but would not submit to pressure.
He said that Tehran remained open to dialogue and negotiations but would not accept what he described as the “language of force” or talks conducted under threats. “We will never bow our head,” he said, adding that Iran was prepared for negotiations provided they were not accompanied by threats.
Addressing the UN General Assembly, Pezeshkian displayed images of victims of an American strike on a school in Minab at the start of the war, along with images of a sports hall in Lamerd destroyed by US bombardment.
The ​United States delegation walked out at the ⁠start of Pezeshkian's speech. The US mission to the ​United Nations did not immediately respond to a request ​for comment.
🔴 LIVE: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian delivers a speech at the UNGA on the second day of the annual general debate in New York. https://t.co/wo8MrOIloL
— Al Jazeera English (@AJEnglish) September 23, 2026
“The United States, by using weapons with multiple warheads, targeted that sports hall. They martyred and assassinated our scientists, our men, women and children. Innocent children who in truth had committed no crimes, no sins,” he said.
Pezeshkian stressed that while Iran had responded to strikes by the United States and Israel, it had not targeted civilian areas.
“Yes, they did hit us, but we did not bend the knee. We did not bow our head,” he said. “We responded, but we did not hit civilian populations.
“They came into surrounding territories and targeted our universities, our healthcare centres, our schools, our hospitals, our infrastructure; all of it against international law,” Pezeshkian added.
He also said that Hamas chief Ismail Haniyeh had been assassinated in Tehran by Israel on the day of his inauguration as president.
Pezeshkian said there was clear hypocrisy in the fact that Israel possessed nuclear weapons and was not a signatory to the Nuclear Nonproliferation Treaty, “but the inspectors are requested to come to Iran.”
"Israel has the bombs, has weapons of mass destruction but is not a member of the non-proliferation treaty and, during her shameful life, has not allowed a single inspection. I will repeat: the nuclear weapon is in Israel, but the inspectors are in Iran," he underlined. “They (Israelis) kill, we are sanctioned, we are punished.”
“Israel has murdered savagely over 70,000 innocents in Gaza, but Iran, while behind the table of negotiation, was bombed.”
Pezeshkian reiterated Iran’s claim that it was not pursuing nuclear weapons. However, he said Iran had an “inherent” right to peaceful nuclear technology.
“We will not bow our head and give up the right that is inherently ours,” said the Iranian president. “We say it clearly: No nuclear weapons and no limitations to peaceful nuclear technology,” he added.
'We are not terrorists, we are victims of terrorism'
He also rejected US President Donald Trump’s characterisation of Iran as a sponsor of terrorism.
“Yesterday, Trump said we are terrorists. We are not terrorists; we are victims of terrorism,” Pezeshkian told the General Assembly, referring to Trump’s address a day earlier in which the US president described Iran as the “number one sponsor of terror.”
Pezeshkian said Iran’s leader had been killed “without any justification,” referring to the US-Israeli military attacks against Iran that began earlier this year.
He also accused Israel of targeting neighbourhoods across Iranian cities and provinces and carrying out assassinations, describing such actions as “true terrorist” behaviour.
“The people of Iran have been defending their country for the past seven months,” Pezeshkian said.
In the first part of his speech, the Iranian leader held up an image of the Islamic Republic's late supreme leader Ali Khamenei, who was killed in an airstrike on his compound in Tehran on the first day of the US-Israeli assault on Iran.
He also held up images of children killed in a strike on a school.
A UN fact-finding mission on Iran said earlier this month that it had reasonable grounds to believe that the US was behind two military strikes on a school and a sports facility in Iran, and that these constituted war crimes.
Hormuz cannot be used for passage of weapons used against Iran: Pezeshkian
Pezeshkian said Iran wants to have "strong neighbours" near the Strait of Hormuz, but cannot allow those who seek to impose "insecurity" on Iranians to have access to it.
"We cannot let some have free access and gain their interest from a waterway, while at the same time using that waterway to impose their aggressions upon us, to impose insecurity upon us, to forbid us access to our own waterways," he stated.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian:
Iran does not see her neighbors as security rivals — we want to have strong neighbors.
In the waters of the Strait of Hormuz, we do not want to impose insecurity. We cannot let some have free access and gain their interest from a waterway,… pic.twitter.com/q9YcnRREJw
— Clash Report (@clashreport) September 23, 2026
"It cannot be the case that everyone benefits from the Strait of Hormuz while we are denied access to shipping through this waterway. The permanent deployment of hostile fleets and the expansion of the war will not lead to peace," Pezeshkian said.
Iran needs nuclear energy, not a nuclear bomb, Pezeshkian says
Pezeshkian said Iran needs peaceful nuclear energy, not a nuclear bomb.
"For our country, peaceful nuclear technology is part of our inherent progress," he said, adding, "Iran does not accept nuclear technology to be at the exclusive disposal of some, of a handful."
"We say it clearly: no nuclear weapons and no limitations to peaceful nuclear technology," he said.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian:
We will not bow our head and give up the right that is inherently ours.
We say it clearly: no nuclear weapons, and no limitations to peaceful nuclear technology. pic.twitter.com/YsMSrKNuw0
— Clash Report (@clashreport) September 23, 2026
Pezeshkian ⁠addressed the 193-member General Assembly a day after US President Donald Trump spoke. ​Trump used his speech on Tuesday to ​make ⁠the case for his war on Iran, arguing he has prevented Tehran from obtaining a nuclear weapon and ⁠warning ​that he could "annihilate the Islamic ​Republic" if no deal is reached to end the conflict.
After agreeing to a Pakistan-mediated ceasefire in April, the US and Iran signed the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding in June, which gave the two sides 60 days to discuss a long-term agreement.
But the two sides soon engaged in retaliatory attacks, and the US reimposed its military blockade of Iranian ports while Tehran closed the Strait of Hormuz.

The federal government has shifted asset declarations of BS-17 and above civil servants to a digital system, giving the Federal Board of Revenue a central role in submission and verification.
Under the new mechanism, officers will file their income and asset declarations through the FBR’s dedicated online portal instead of the previous manual process.
The system has been introduced by the Establishment Division in coordination with the FBR under Section 15-A of the Civil Servants Act, 1973, and Rule 12 of the Civil Servants (Conduct) Rules, 2026.
The filing deadline for financial year 2025-26 has been set for October 30, 2026, while corrections may be made until November 30 with authorization from the relevant Cadre Administrator.
What Officers Will Have to Disclose
The digital declaration will cover properties, local and foreign bank accounts, investments, vehicles, liabilities, income, and major expenses.
Officers will also be required to provide information relating to their spouses and dependents, along with social media accounts and any foreign nationality or permanent residency status.
The FBR will carry out risk-based verification of submitted information and share the findings with the relevant Cadre Administrator.
Selected non-sensitive portions of the declarations may also be published on the FBR website.
The Establishment Division has warned that inaccurate information, concealment, or failure to submit declarations may lead to disciplinary action under the relevant rules.
The move marks a wider shift toward digital monitoring and verification of asset disclosures across the federal bureaucracy.

items.content:
Veteran actor Hina Dilpazeer offered a candid take on acting and the state of Pakistani television in an interview with Vasay Chaudhry.
She said acting required complete surrender of the ego. “True acting requires breaking one's ego and completely shedding the self to step into another's life,” she said, describing the profession as a “sea of fire” that newcomers must be prepared to dive into fully if they want to succeed.
She added that she gives her full effort to every role, regardless of genre, noting that a serious performance can bring “a flood of grief”, while a comic one can help audiences forget their sorrows.
Dilpazeer also recalled the most difficult performance of her career, which came just days after her father’s death, when she had to return to the set of a comedy.
“Maintaining the character and the illusion of happiness for the audience while grieving,” she said, “was the most difficult acting task she has ever faced.”
The actor also criticised current trends in Pakistani television, arguing that many dramas are being let down by weak writing.
“Many dramas today lack strong, well-written stories. That television's reach makes it powerful enough to shape public sentiment, and that filling it with weak filler content wastes both time and money.”
She was equally critical of what she described as the industry’s “blind race” towards stardom, warning that chasing superstar status can become a “black hole” for a serious acting career, pulling actors away from the depth their work requires.
