items.author: Ankush Das
items.content:
India’s manufacturing story is entering a new era. After years of policy support and incentives, capital is now flowing into factories, production lines and specialised industrial technology.
The semiconductor industry offers the clearest signal of this shift. At Semicon India 2026 earlier this month, the Centre said it has received investment commitments totalling ₹1 Lakh Cr under the recently notified Semicon 2.0 mission.
Global suppliers are also beginning to treat India as part of their production strategy. At Semicon India 2026, Applied Materials alone committed $5 Bn to the country – an investment that reinforces India’s evolution to a potential manufacturing hub.
The funding momentum is also picking up across manufacturing-intensive sectors. Advanced hardware and technology startups, spanning aerospace, defence, semiconductors and robotics, raised $365 Mn across 66 deals in the first half (H1) of 2026. And the momentum is percolating into the second half as well.
Pixxel recently bagged $100 Mn to expand satellite manufacturing, while DheyaTech mopped up capital to develop indigenous gas turbines. Then, there is Aeron Systems, which secured funding to scale navigation and weather-monitoring systems.
Yet, the manufacturing opportunity is not limited to strategic technologies. New regulations are creating demand for domestic capabilities in materials and industrial components. Simultaneously, India’s energy transition is creating another market, driving investor interest in manufacturing required to support electric mobility.
Taken together, these developments point to a growing manufacturing ecosystem that is broadening beyond conventional assembly. As a result, a new wave of startups is building products and technologies for the next phase of India’s industrial growth.
Against this backdrop, Inc42 is back with the latest edition of its ‘Five Manufacturing Startups To Watch‘. This edition features startups building low-carbon metals, power electronics, MEMS devices, metal additive manufacturing systems and EV charging hardware.
With that said, here are the five manufacturing startups that caught our eye in September.
Editor’s Note: This list is not a ranking. It is a curated selection of manufacturing startups that have stood out to the Inc42 editorial team this month.
Alteon | Builds Ultra-High-Endurance Autonomous Aircraft
Conventional aircraft need to land for refuelling and maintenance, making continuous monitoring of oceans, borders and remote infrastructure both expensive and intermittent. Albatrosses, a large sea bird, however, can stay airborne for long periods by harnessing wind energy. The same principle is now being applied to aircraft.
Alteon is a Bengaluru-based aerospace startup building autonomous aircraft that fly on dynamic soaring instead of conventional propulsion. It operates in India’s UAV market, valued at $470 Mn in 2025 and projected to reach $1.39 Bn by 2030, with defence and surveillance use cases expected to drive growth.
Founder Samay Sanghvi began working on the technology with radio-controlled aircraft in 2023 and incorporated the startup in 2025 without a formal engineering degree. It has since grown to a team of 20 and raised $2.5 Mn in pre-seed funding led by Lachy Groom, with Together Fund participating, after earlier grants from Emergent Ventures and 1517.
Alteon recently completed an offshore flight test in which its aircraft autonomously flew consecutive loops less than a metre above the ocean surface, and it is now working towards aircraft that can stay airborne for over a year, enabling continuous monitoring of illegal fishing and drug trafficking.
Grevoro | Leading India’s Low-Carbon Industrial Shift
The carbon emissions embedded in steel and aluminium are now adding to export costs. The European Union’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism entered its payment phase in January 2026, meaning exporters must report a shipment’s emissions or face an additional cost.
Grevoro is a Bengaluru-based industrial manufacturing startup producing low-carbon steel, aluminium and allied metals through a network of contract manufacturing partners, with every tonne carrying auditable emissions data. It operates in India’s green steel market, where demand is projected to reach 4.49 Mn tonnes by 2030, with construction and infrastructure absorbing most of it.
Founded in October 2025 by former Zetwerk executives Vijayanand K and Raghav Jaju, its manufacturing intelligence platform GREMI quantifies embedded carbon at product and lot level from live plant data, built to satisfy CBAM and green steel certification requirements. Its steel line spans scrap-route billets, flat products, structurals, transmission towers and solar mounting structures, and a recycling vertical covers PET bales, rPET flakes and granules.
Grevoro raised ₹43 Cr (about $4.7 Mn) in seed funding from the family offices of the Atha and Misra groups, and supplies structural steel for renewable energy projects and construction chemicals.
INFAB Semiconductor | Fabricating MEMS Devices In India
Sensors that run aircraft, medical devices and industrial machinery, and the microfluidic chips used in diagnostics are largely imported, which means higher prices and long lead times.
INFAB Semiconductor is a Bengaluru-based deeptech startup that designs and fabricates micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) pressure switches, transducers and lab-on-chip platforms.
Founder and CEO Muthuraman Swaminathan spent years working hands-on with pressure sensors, accelerometers and inertial sensors, incorporating the startup in December 2021.
Working out of the cleanroom at IISc’s Centre for Nano Science and Engineering, where it was incubated, INFAB supplies qualification-stage pressure switches and transducers to aerospace and defence programmes, with DRDO, ADA and HAL among its customers, and a revenue run rate of ₹1.5 Cr in FY26. It operates in India’s sensors market, projected to grow from $8.5 Bn in 2025 to $17.2 Bn by 2034, and in India’s microfluidics market, forecast to grow from $1.08 Bn in 2025 to $1.83 Bn by 2030.
Leanwatts | Building Chargers For India’s EV Boom
India’s electric two- and three-wheeler market is scaling faster than the components that keep the vehicles running, and much of the charging hardware is still imported.
Leanwatts is a Hyderabad-based power electronics manufacturer building chargers and converters for electric vehicle makers.
Founded in October 2023 by Pradeep Chowdary, Sujith Kumar and Abhilash Reddy, the startup designs and produces portable and on-board chargers between 500W and 6.6kW for electric two- and three-wheelers and electric tractors. Its in-house capabilities span hardware design, embedded firmware, product engineering, validation and testing, and it runs a manufacturing facility in Hyderabad.
Leanwatts operates in India’s EV charging station market, projected to grow from $0.71 Bn in 2025 to $2.48 Bn by 2030. The country had 29,151 charging stations as of December 2025, including 8,805 fast chargers.
With $2 Mn (about ₹18.15 Cr) in seed funding, the startup plans to expand into public charging solutions, rectifiers, and hybrid inverters, targeting an annualised revenue run rate of nearly ₹60 Cr by March 2027.
ThinkMetal | Advanced Material Manufacturing Solutions
Factories rely on custom-made tools such as moulds, dies, jigs and fixtures to make products. These tools can take two to four weeks to produce, often overseas, slowing manufacturers down when they need to quickly test and refine a new product.
ThinkMetal is a Chennai-based metal additive manufacturing startup building compact industrial printing systems for these parts.
Founded in March 2021 by Sabyasachi Ghosh and Arushi Sharma, the startup’s SistemT1 machine uses a process it calls metal fused additive manufacturing, in which it deposits wound metal feedstock layer by layer, then debounds and sinters it to reach full strength. It pairs the hardware with its own FuseX materials and Thinkware software, and claims manufacturers can produce metal parts up to 10X faster and at half the cost of conventional routes.
It operates in India’s additive manufacturing market, projected to grow from $677.4 Mn in 2023 to $3.75 Bn by 2030. The startup’s customers include Ants Ceramics, ZeQube Technologies and Hosur CNC, and its parts go into automotive, aerospace and defence applications. ThinkMetal has raised about $1.1 Mn so far, including a pre-Series A round led by YourNest Venture Capital, and is scaling production of its first-generation system.
With Inputs From Venu Rathore
Edited by Shishir Parasher
Creatives by Abhyam Gusai

items.summary:
US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that US government documents would use "super intelligence" instead of artificial intelligence going forward, and repeated his previous claims that warnings about AI were a hoax.
"From this point forward, all of United States documents, and hopefully the world's will be changed to use the much more accurate term 'super' as opposed to artificial. So it's super intelligence," Trump said in a speech to the UN General Assembly.
"I'm not going to stifle growth of something that will be bigger than the industrial revolution," he said.
He also firmly rejected calls for international supervision of artificial intelligence, calling them a "globalist scheme" to control the new technology.

US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that US government documents would use "super intelligence" instead of artificial intelligence going forward, and repeated his previous claims that warnings about AI were a hoax.
"From this point forward, all of United States documents, and hopefully the world's will be changed to use the much more accurate term 'super' as opposed to artificial. So it's super intelligence," Trump said in a speech to the UN General Assembly.
"I'm not going to stifle growth of something that will be bigger than the industrial revolution," he said.
He also firmly rejected calls for international supervision of artificial intelligence, calling them a "globalist scheme" to control the new technology.
Read More: From smart glasses to AI pins, privacy fears challenge tech's next big bet
Meanwhile, UN chief Antonio Guterres called for AI superpowers, widely viewed as the United States and China, to start a dialogue on the technology's future, similar to US-Soviet engagement at the height of the Cold War.
"Governments with the greatest AI capabilities have the greatest responsibilities to humanity. To establish channels for dialogue, transparency, trust and cooperation," Guterres said.
"At a pivotal moment during the Cold War, strategic rivals came to recognise the need to manage shared existential risks."

items.author: Razzak Abro
items.content:
A proposed amendment to Sindh’s local government law has emerged as the sole point of disagreement between the government and opposition parties, with the Pakistan People’s Party (PPP) insisting on retaining existing mayors and chairmen as administrators after their terms expire until fresh local government elections.
The provision was among several amendments proposed by the PPP to the Sindh Local Government Act. However, all opposition parties represented in the Sindh Assembly, including the Muttahida Qaumi Movement (MQM), Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) and Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), opposed it.
Members of all parties were part of a special committee constituted to examine the proposed amendments. The committee reviewed the changes clause by clause, with the government and opposition showing flexibility on most provisions. As a result, several additional proposals were also incorporated into the bill.
However, neither side was willing to compromise on the provision allowing existing mayors and chairmen to continue as administrators until new elections. The PPP subsequently used its numerical majority in the Sindh Assembly to get the amendments passed, including the contentious provision.
Opposition representatives said they opposed the amendment on principle, arguing that neutral administrators should be appointed between the expiry of local governments’ terms and fresh elections.
Speaking to The Express Tribune, MQM Deputy Parliamentary Leader in the Sindh Assembly Taha Ahmed said the amendment would allow existing mayors and chairmen to serve as administrators until the new elections.
“These are political people. How can they be neutral?” he said, adding that the MQM would challenge the amendment in court.
Read More: Mustafa Kamal says 18th Amendment created 'four countries' instead of empowering provinces
JI Sindh Assembly member Muhammad Farooq also said the provision was the only point on which his party had disagreed with the government.
Farooq pointed out that JI-affiliated chairmen currently head nine towns and 87 union councils in Karachi. Despite this, he said, his party opposed the amendment because political figures should not be appointed as administrators during an interim period.
He said government officials had traditionally been appointed as administrators after local governments’ terms expired.
PPP Sindh Assembly member and Sindh government spokesperson Sukhdev Asardas Hemnani, however, defended the amendment, saying government officials had traditionally been appointed during interim periods, but political parties had repeatedly criticised the practice.
According to Hemnani, opposition parties had argued that government officials could not be neutral because they worked under the provincial government.
“To avoid this criticism, the PPP introduced this amendment,” he said.
Hemnani said that during the interim period, mayors and chairmen serving as administrators would only carry out essential day-to-day functions. He added that election-related powers would remain with the Election Commission of Pakistan.
He also claimed that opposition representatives had not offered an alternative and were instead seeking to delay the amendment bill.
However, he maintained that the government remained open to further changes in the law. “Laws change with time. If the opposition comes forward with good proposals, the government can introduce further amendments to the local government law,” he said.
Hemnani added that the government was willing to discuss with opposition parties granting further powers to local government institutions.
The terms of the existing local government bodies are due to expire in mid-2027. Under the amended law, the Sindh government will have to inform the Election Commission of Pakistan three months before their terms expire, after which the commission will begin preparations for new elections.
The Election Commission will also have to carry out fresh delimitation of local government constituencies at least six months before the elections. The exercise could increase the number of union councils, towns and other local government units across Sindh, including Karachi.

items.title: Coldcard Whitehats Transfer Stolen 52.37 BTC to Recovery Trust
items.summary: Whitehat researchers have moved 52.37 BTC linked to the July Coldcard wallet exploit into an address associated with the Crypto Recovery Trust. Galaxy Digital Research Head Alex Thorn said the Bitcoin came from several tracked exploit clusters and represented 2.8 percent of the funds monitored by his team. The trust is designed to hold recovered digital assets while ownership claims are reviewed before eligible funds are returned.

items.author: Web Desk
items.content:
US President Donald Trump on Tuesday again claimed credit for helping avert a full-fledged war between nuclear-armed India and Pakistan, while calling Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif a “terrific man” during his address to the United Nations General Assembly.
Addressing the opening session of the 81st UN General Assembly, Trump highlighted what he described as his diplomatic achievements over the past year, saying he had helped settle eight wars, including the conflict between India and Pakistan.
“Since I took office, it has been my great honour to settle eight wars and in so doing, become friendly with the leaders of many of those countries,” he said.
Trump says Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif is 'a terrific man' pic.twitter.com/73iihZ4IDY
— Pakistan TV Digital (@PakistanTVcom) September 22, 2026
“It was a great honour to do it,” Trump told the gathering of world leaders, including PM Shehbaz, who arrived in New York on Monday to attend the UNGA session, adding that he had used his “very relationships” to help reach the settlements.
“Very special relationships to this day, very, very special trade, the use of tariffs and the threat of tariffs and various other reasons depending on the country,” he said.
Trump specifically highlighted his role in the India-Pakistan conflict while also referring to other settlements involving Cambodia and Thailand, Kosovo and Serbia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda, Armenia and Azerbaijan, as well as the war in Gaza.
PM Sharif arrives at UN headquarters to attend the UNGA session pic.twitter.com/dUqSGvtygv
— Pakistan TV Digital (@PakistanTVcom) September 22, 2026
He said “almost every one” of the countries involved had written him a letter of thanks, singling out PM Shehbaz, whom he described as a “terrific man”.
“The prime minister of Pakistan, terrific man, said that Donald Trump was responsible for saving 30 million lives, and probably many more than that,” Trump said.
This is not the first time President Trump has publicly praised the premier; he previously commended PM Shehbaz and Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, calling them “two fantastic people”.
At the inaugural meeting of the Board of Peace, he also praised PM Shehbaz’s leadership while recalling Pakistan’s role in halting regional escalation with India.
Trump has on other occasions praised Field Marshal Munir, describing him as a “highly respected general”, a “great fighter” and “my favourite”.
Shehbaz, meanwhile, has previously described Trump as a “man of peace” and praised his efforts to end conflicts around the world.
Thanking Trump for his role in mediating the ceasefire between India and Pakistan following their four-day military conflict in May, the prime minister had said the US president helped “avert a major catastrophe in South Asia”.
Read More: 'Two fantastic people': Trump all praise again for PM Shehbaz, CDF Munir after Hormuz breakthrough
The Pakistan-US relationship experienced a significant thaw in 2025–2026, transitioning from a cold period to warm, strategic, and pragmatic engagement during Trump's second term. This shift was largely driven by a major reset in relations following President Trump's intervention in regional conflicts, particularly his role in brokering a ceasefire between Pakistan and India in May 2025.
The first thaw in Pakistan-US relations came via secret counterterrorism exchanges, signalling substantive cooperation. In March last year, Trump unexpectedly praised Pakistan’s counterterrorism efforts during a national address, prompting a policy shift.
The short but intense May skirmish with India in May 2025 became a decisive turning point, showcasing Pakistan’s military discipline, strategic focus, and asymmetric capabilities — qualities that reportedly surprised Trump.
Despite India’s repeated denials, PM Shehbaz continued to praise President Trump for his role in brokering a ceasefire between the two nuclear-armed neighbours, and nominated him for the Nobel Peace Prize, saying his intervention had helped save millions of lives.
The praise was reciprocated, with Trump commending the premier and also lauding CDF Munir, as he reiterated claims that he had helped avert a war between Pakistan and India in May 2025.
Ties between the countries took a further turn when Trump invited CDF Munir to a luncheon — the first such meeting for a Pakistani military chief — followed by a red-carpet visit to US Central Command headquarters for high-level talks.
Following a ceasefire after the prolonged war in Gaza, Trump announced the formation of a “Board of Peace” that included Pakistan, again singling out PM Shehbaz for praise during its inaugural summit.
Read: Trump lavishes praise on CDF Munir
Addressing the event, Trump said, “I like this guy,” referring to the premier, as he recounted efforts that led to last year’s ceasefire between Pakistan and India. He also praised CDF Munir during his remarks.
In June this year, President Trump credited Pakistan with “really helping” the United States secure a peace deal with Iran while especially praising Field Marshal Munir and PM Shehbaz.
“In Pakistan, you have Field Marshal Asim Munir, who is great, and you have the Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, and they just get along great,” he said during an interview with Axios.

items.title: Saudi Arabia restarts East-West oil pipeline, sources say
items.summary:
Saudi Arabia ‌has restarted operations at its East-West Pipeline and could resume exports from the Red Sea port of Yanbu later on Tuesday, three sources briefed on the matter said, as signs mounted of an increase in Middle Eastern oil flows.
The resumption of supplies on Tuesday helped ​to drive selling on global oil markets. Global oil benchmark Brent crude fell by more than $2 a ​barrel towards $97, its lowest since September 8.
Drone attacks, which Saudi Arabia has blamed on an Iraqi ⁠militia, forced the kingdom to shut the pipeline on September 11, halting crude loadings at the kingdom's Yanbu port.
Since the U.S.-Israeli war ​on Iran disrupted oil flows from Saudi Arabia and its Gulf neighbours through the Strait of Hormuz, Riyadh has been ​using the pipeline to reroute around 4 million barrels per day — around 4% of global supply — to Yanbu.
State oil firm Saudi Aramco did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Full resumption could take weeks, sources
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
Saudi Arabia ‌has restarted operations at its East-West Pipeline and could resume exports from the Red Sea port of Yanbu later on Tuesday, three sources briefed on the matter said, as signs mounted of an increase in Middle Eastern oil flows.
The resumption of supplies on Tuesday helped ​to drive selling on global oil markets. Global oil benchmark Brent crude fell by more than $2 a ​barrel towards $97, its lowest since September 8.
Drone attacks, which Saudi Arabia has blamed on an Iraqi ⁠militia, forced the kingdom to shut the pipeline on September 11, halting crude loadings at the kingdom's Yanbu port.
Since the U.S.-Israeli war ​on Iran disrupted oil flows from Saudi Arabia and its Gulf neighbours through the Strait of Hormuz, Riyadh has been ​using the pipeline to reroute around 4 million barrels per day — around 4% of global supply — to Yanbu.
State oil firm Saudi Aramco did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Full resumption could take weeks, sources say
The pipeline was pumping at a low rate after ​its restart, two of the sources said.
Read More: G7 leaders condemn Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
Aramco was seeking to get the pumping rate back to four million bpd, ​one of the sources said. The pipeline has a capacity of 7m bpd.
Reaching a rate of 40% of capacity will take ‌a ⁠couple of days and a full restart will take six to eight weeks, a security source said. A separate oil industry source said a return to full pumping rates would take up to six weeks.
Three pumping stations serving the pipeline were damaged in the drone attack, according to satellite imagery and industry sources. The line is serviced by 11 ​pumping stations and two separate ​pressure relief stations, according ⁠to industry assessments.
The pipeline will resume crude supply to Aramco refineries located on the Red Sea coast, one of the sources said, adding that one cargo was scheduled to load ​at Yanbu later on Tuesday. The person said it would be bound for China.
Traders ​were getting ⁠ready for Saudi oil loadings by moving tankers to Egypt's Mediterranean Port Said for ship-to-ship transfers and also to Sidi Kerir, another two trading sources said.
Oil prices have also dropped this week after Iran said it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz ⁠within seven ​days and because Saudi Arabia has loaded more ships at its Ras ​Tanura port, raising expectations of increased exports through the Strait.

items.author: Anadolu Agency
items.content:
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned on Tuesday that Israeli violence, displacement and illegal settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank are undermining prospects for peace and raising the risk of “ethnic cleansing”.
“Violence, displacement, and settlement expansion by Israel in the occupied West Bank are bulldozing the path to peace and raising the spectre of ethnic cleansing,” Guterres said in an address to the 81st UN General Assembly in New York.
“We cannot allow the two-state solution to disappear before our eyes,” he added.
Guterres said the devastating situation in the occupied Palestinian territories must not be overlooked amid the broader turmoil engulfing the Middle East.
He described the October 7, 2023 attacks by Hamas as “abhorrent” but said they were followed by “an onslaught on Palestinians in Gaza, with a scale of killing and destruction unlike anything I’ve witnessed in my years as secretary-general”.
He recalled that the International Court of Justice had issued legally binding provisional measures in the case concerning the application of the Genocide Convention in the Gaza Strip.
The UN chief also referred to an advisory opinion issued by the court, saying the UN must be allowed to carry out its mandates in Gaza and that its staff and humanitarian personnel must be protected.
“All parties must comply with international law and the court’s orders,” he stressed.
Appeal for de-escalation
Turning to the wider region, Guterres said conflicts were “cascading” across the Middle East, while so-called ceasefires had amounted to “little more than lesser fires”, with civilians continuing to bear the cost.
“I appeal to the leaders in this chamber to maximise this high-level week for de-escalation and dialogue,” he said.
Guterres urged the international community to send a clear message that the fighting must end, humanitarian assistance must be allowed to flow, and navigational rights and freedoms must be fully restored in line with international law.
On Ukraine, Guterres said Russia’s war had subjected a sovereign country to “a brutal war in blatant violation” of the UN Charter.
He described the conflict in Sudan as “a war on civilians”, pointing to mass displacement, hunger, attacks on hospitals and homes, sexual violence and ethnically driven attacks.
Read More: Pakistan, seven other Muslim countries demand Israel to fulfil Gaza ceasefire commitments
The UN chief also said that Myanmar’s crisis risked slipping from global attention.
He called for reform of the UN Security Council, saying: “A 21st-century Security Council without permanent African seats is unjust and indefensible.”
AI requires global oversight
Guterres said today power was increasingly derived from data, computing capacity and algorithms, while control of those resources was highly concentrated.
“The danger is not technology. The danger is technology without accountability, capability without oversight, decision-making without transparency,” he said.
Countries with the greatest AI capabilities also carry the greatest responsibilities, he said, urging them to share information on emerging safety risks, cooperate on testing and work toward common safeguards.
Guterres called for a multilateral AI risk-management framework supported by credible and independent oversight, while ensuring that no country is left behind.
“Artificial intelligence must be shaped by humanity, with humanity, and for all humanity,” he said, adding that “children must never become the test subjects for unregulated systems.”

items.author: Redaksi
items.content:
Inisiatif Hansaplast dan Grab Indonesia melalui program First Aid On The Go berhasil meraih penghargaan dari Museum Rekor-Dunia Indonesia (MURI). Penghargaan tersebut diberikan setelah program edukasi perawatan luka ini diikuti 2.238 mitra pengemudi Grab di 10 kota di Indonesia.
Program yang diluncurkan sejak Juni 2026 tersebut memberikan edukasi mengenai pertolongan pertama dan perawatan luka ringan kepada mitra pengemudi. Kolaborasi ini juga diperluas ke ekosistem digital Grab melalui GrabAds serta akses produk Hansaplast First Aid Kit On The Go di GrabMart Kilat.
Edukasi Perawatan Luka Menjangkau 10 Kota
Antusiasme Mitra Pengemudi roda dua Grab di Surabaya saat mengikuti pelatihan keselamatan berkendara. Kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari kolaborasi “First Aid On The Go” antara Grab dan Hansaplast yang mencakup edukasi mengenai pertolongan pertama dan perawatan luka bagi Mitra Pengemudi saat beraktivitas di jalan.
Aktivitas mitra pengemudi yang banyak berlangsung di jalan menjadi konteks utama program First Aid On The Go. Hansaplast dan Grab memberikan materi mengenai langkah yang dapat dilakukan ketika terjadi luka ringan saat beraktivitas.
Sebanyak 2.238 mitra pengemudi mengikuti program tersebut di Jakarta, Depok, Balikpapan, Makassar, Manado, Medan, Palembang, Solo, Surabaya, dan Yogyakarta. Atas capaian tersebut, Hansaplast dan Grab menerima penghargaan MURI pada 12 September 2026 untuk kategori “Edukasi Pelatihan Perawatan Luka Secara Seri Kepada Mitra Pengemudi Online dengan Jumlah Peserta Terbanyak.”
Materi yang diberikan mencakup 1-2-3 Siap Rawat Luka, dengan tiga langkah utama yaitu Bersihkan, Lindungi, dan Sembuhkan. Peserta diperkenalkan pada tahapan membersihkan luka menggunakan cairan antiseptik pembersih luka, melindunginya dengan plester, kemudian merawat luka menggunakan salep luka.
Roy Nugroho, Director of Commercial Grab Indonesia, mengatakan keselamatan mitra pengemudi menjadi salah satu fokus Grab, mengingat aktivitas mereka memiliki mobilitas tinggi dan banyak berlangsung di jalan.
“Dalam kesehariannya, Mitra Pengemudi juga kerap menjadi orang pertama yang membantu pengguna jalan lain saat menghadapi berbagai situasi di jalan,” ujar Roy.
Menurutnya, kerja sama dengan Hansaplast juga membekali mitra pengemudi dengan pengetahuan perawatan luka yang dapat digunakan untuk diri sendiri maupun ketika membantu orang lain.
First Aid Kit Bisa Diakses lewat GrabMart Kilat
Program First Aid On The Go kemudian dilanjutkan dengan menyediakan akses terhadap perlengkapan pertolongan pertama. Grab dan Hansaplast menghadirkan Hansaplast First Aid Kit On The Go yang tersedia secara eksklusif melalui GrabMart Kilat.
Menurut informasi dalam materi kampanye, paket tersebut dapat diperoleh konsumen melalui GrabMart Kilat dalam waktu kurang dari 30 menit.
Dengan skema tersebut, edukasi yang diberikan dalam program memiliki kaitan langsung dengan ketersediaan perlengkapan pertolongan pertama. Konsumen yang membutuhkan produk dapat mengaksesnya melalui layanan Grab yang sama.
Kolaborasi ini menjadi bagian dari rangkaian aktivitas First Aid On The Go yang menggabungkan edukasi bagi mitra pengemudi dengan akses produk untuk konsumen.
GrabAds Dipakai untuk Memperluas Jangkauan Kampanye
Selain aktivitas edukasi dan commerce, Hansaplast juga memanfaatkan GrabAds untuk membawa pesan kampanye ke lebih banyak pengguna.
Melalui berbagai touchpoint dalam ekosistem Grab, pesan mengenai pentingnya kesiapan pertolongan pertama dapat disampaikan ketika pengguna sedang menggunakan atau mengeksplorasi layanan Grab. Kampanye tersebut kemudian terhubung dengan produk Hansaplast yang tersedia melalui GrabMart Kilat.
Bagi Hansaplast, penggunaan GrabAds menjadi bagian dari strategi untuk menjangkau konsumen melalui beberapa tahap dalam perjalanan mereka, mulai dari membangun awareness hingga memperkenalkan produk yang dapat dibeli.
Pendekatan tersebut juga memperlihatkan peran platform digital yang semakin luas dalam kampanye consumer brand. Kanal media dan kanal transaksi dapat ditempatkan dalam satu ekosistem, sehingga pesan kampanye memiliki jalur yang lebih dekat dengan layanan atau produk yang ditawarkan.
Dalam kolaborasi ini, Grab memiliki beberapa titik temu dengan konsumen, mulai dari aplikasi, layanan mobilitas, GrabAds, hingga GrabMart Kilat.
Hansaplast Ingin Perluas Edukasi Pertolongan Pertama
Vivilya Lukman, Business Unit Health Care Director PT Beiersdorf Indonesia, mengatakan edukasi mengenai pertolongan pertama menjadi bagian penting dalam kolaborasi tersebut. “Edukasi tentang pertolongan pertama sama pentingnya dengan menghadirkan produk yang dapat diandalkan ketika dibutuhkan,” ujar Vivilya.
Ia mengatakan kerja sama dengan Grab membuat Hansaplast dapat membawa edukasi tersebut lebih dekat dengan kelompok yang relevan, termasuk mitra pengemudi, sekaligus menjangkau konsumen melalui berbagai touchpoint di ekosistem Grab.
Menurut Vivilya, kolaborasi ini juga menjadi bagian dari upaya Hansaplast membangun ekosistem edukasi yang melibatkan tenaga farmasi serta komunitas dengan mobilitas tinggi.
Program First Aid On The Go sebelumnya juga telah menghadirkan Hansaplast First Aid Kit On The Go di GrabMart Kilat. Sementara itu, pemanfaatan GrabAds memperluas sisi komunikasi kampanye dengan menempatkan pesan edukasi di berbagai titik dalam ekosistem Grab.
Grab dan Hansaplast menyatakan akan terus mendorong perhatian terhadap keselamatan dan kesiapan menangani luka ringan dalam aktivitas sehari-hari. Untuk saat ini, program tersebut telah menjangkau 2.238 mitra pengemudi di 10 kota dan menjadi bagian dari kolaborasi yang menggabungkan edukasi, akses produk, serta kanal digital Grab.
Temukan kampanye-kampanye menarik lainnya dari GrabAds di sini.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro May Offer 1TB Storage, but RAM Could Remain Limited

Samsung may bring a 1TB storage option to its upcoming Galaxy S27 Pro, giving users more space for apps, photos, videos, and other files. However, a new leak suggests that the phone may still feature only 12GB of RAM, unlike the Galaxy S27 Ultra, which could offer 16GB of memory.

The standard Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27 Plus, meanwhile, could continue to offer 256GB and 512GB storage options. Samsung may also introduce a 128GB variant in select markets.

Galaxy S27 Ultra May Offer 16GB RAM

Why RAM Matters on a Flagship Phone
A phone’s storage and RAM serve different purposes. Storage holds apps, photos, videos, and other files, while RAM helps the device manage active apps and background processes.
For everyday activities such as browsing the internet, messaging, and watching videos, 12GB of RAM should provide sufficient capacity for most users. However, users who frequently switch between demanding apps or perform intensive tasks could benefit from additional memory.
The extra RAM could also be useful for on-device artificial intelligence features, which may require more memory when processing tasks locally. A 16GB configuration could allow a phone to handle more demanding workloads while keeping additional apps active in the background.

items.content:
Erafone resmi mengelar Parade Festival Belanja Erafone 2026 dengan konsep carnival, mulai dari 21 September hingga 27 September 2026 di Grand Atrium, Kota Kasablanka, Jakarta.
Selama acara berlangsung, penggunjung bisa menikmati beragam rangkaian penawaran dan aktivitas interaktif, salah satunya Fun Podcast on Stage bersama beberapa podcaster ternama di Indonesia, Arafah Rianti.
Baca Juga: Pajak iPhone Duo dari Luar Negeri Tembus Rp 8 Juta, Berapa Biaya iPhone 18 Pro?
“Festival belanja ini sebenarnya sudah berjalan sejak 15 Agustus dan akan berlangsung hingga 11 Oktober. Acara yang digelar hari ini bisa dibilang merupakan puncak dari rangkaian program tersebut,” ujar Deputy CEO Erajaya Digital, Kim Jong Won, dalam acara Parade Festival Belanja Erafone di Jakarta, Selasa (22/9/2026).
Konsep carnival dipilih untuk menghadirkan pengalaman belanja offline yang lebih meriah dan interaktif, mengadaptasi berbagai elemen dari pengalaman pameran erafone sebelumnya, sekaligus menambahkan sejumlah aktivitas baru yang dirancang untuk memberikan pengalaman berbeda bagi pelanggan selama periode FBe 2026.
“Itulah sebabnya kami menghadirkan berbagai experience zone di Parade Festival Belanja Erafone 2026, mulai dari area living room, area belajar, hingga beberapa zona interaktif memungkinkan pengunjung merasakan langsung pengalaman menggunakan teknologi. Kami ingin menunjukkan perbedaan dan perubahan yang bisa dihadirkan teknologi,” ucap Kim.
Promo di Parade Festival Belanja Erafone 2026
Selama tujuh hari penyelenggaraan Parade Festival Belanja Erafone 2026, pengunjung dapat menikmati berbagai carnival-themed attractions serta booth dari para sponsor dan business partners, yaitu OPPO, XL, BCA, dan Indodana PayLater.
Kehadiran para partner menjadi bagian dari kolaborasi Erafone dalam menghadirkan rangkaian penawaran dan pengalaman yang lebih lengkap bagi pelanggan selama Parade Festival Belaja Erafone 2026.
Selain berbagai aktivitas, pelanggan juga dapat memanfaatkan sejumlah promo khusus selama Parade Festival Belanja erafone 2026, termasuk, benefit hingga Rp 12 Juta khusus pembelian produk OPPO, Program promo dari XL yaitu XL PRIORITAS Unlimited cukup bayar Rp 67rb-an per bulan selama 24 bulan, serta tambahan diskon hingga Rp 1,5 juta dengan cicilan 0 persen hingga 24 bulan bagi nasabah Bank BCA, BNI, BSI, CIMB Niaga, HSBC dan Bank Mandiri. 
Pelanggan Parade Festival Belanja Erafone 2026 juga berkesempatan mendapatkan gratis Loops bluetooth headphone atau ACMIC Turbo Fan, gratis Lamina Proflex Flexguard Film dan IT Wireless Magnetic Powerbank*, serta menikmati tebus murah mulai Rp 14 ribu .
Penawaran lain di Parade Festival Belaja Erafone 2026 meliputi voucher belanja, diskon hingga Rp 500 ribu untuk TecProtec, serta gift card eraspace. Beragam promo tersebut dihadirkan sebagai penawaran tambahan bagi pelanggan yang bertransaksi selama periode offline event, melengkapi program FBe 2026 yang berlangsung secara nasional.
Dari sisi pengalaman, pelanggan dapat mengeksplorasi Ecosystem Area yang menghadirkan tiga ruang interaktif, yaitu Living Room, Gaming Room, dan Working Room. 
Di area Parade Festival Belanja Erafone 2026 ini, pelanggan dapat merasakan secara langsung bagaimana berbagai produk tersedia di erafone dapat digunakan dan saling melengkapi dalam berbagai aktivitas sehari-hari, mulai dari kebutuhan hiburan dan gaming hingga mendukung produktivitas.
Kehadiran Ecosystem Area menjadi bagian dari upaya erafone untuk memberikan pengalaman yang lebih interaktif sekaligus membantu pelanggan mengenal lebih dekat ekosistem produk yang tersedia di erafone.
Parade Festival Belanja Erafone 2026 menjadi bagian dari upaya erafone untuk menghadirkan pengalaman FBe yang lebih dekat, lengkap, dan interaktif bagi pelanggan.
iPhone 18 Pro dan Pro Max Sudah TKDN, Erajaya Beri Jawaban Ini
Kehadiran iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max di Indonesia semakin dekat, apalagi kedua ponsel baru Apple tersebut sudah tercatat dan lolos Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) dari Kemenperin, juga sertifikasi Postel Komdigi.
Walau begitu, Erajaya, selaku distributor resmi sekaligus reseller untuk produk Apple di Indonesia mengaku masih menunggu arahan lebih lanjut dari pihak Apple sehubungan rencana peluncuran resmi iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max di Tanah Air.
Dalam sesi tanya jawab dengan media di acara Parade Festival Belanja Erafone 2026 di Kota Kasablanka, Jakarta, Selasa (22/9/2026). Deputy CEO Erajaya Digital, Kim Jong Won, menyatakan, akan mengikuti seluruh perencanaan yang ditetapkan Apple.
“Kalau dari Apple suruh kita siap, ya siap. Tapi kita juga belum terima complete planning penjualan iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max di Indonesia,” ujar Kim kepada media.
Pernyataan itu menjadi sinyal, distributor dan reseller resmi tersebut masih menunggu detail terkait peluncuran dua iPhone 18 Pro series. Saat ditanya tentang jadwal penjualan dan aktivitas Apple di Tanah Air.
Selain itu, Erajaya juga masih tutup mulut saat ditanyakan tentang apakah perusahaan bakal mengadakan acara midnight launch. Menurutnya, seluruh rencana kegiatan masih dalam tahap pembahasan.
“Acara semuanya kita belum confirm ya. Bisa jadi yes, bisa jadi enggak,” ujarnya. Saat ini, iPhone 18 Pro menjadi salah satu perangkat Apple yang paling dinantikan di Indonesia. 
Kemunculan sertifikasi TKDN dan Postel membuat peluang peluncuran resmi semakin terbuka, meski Apple belum mengumumkan tanggal penjualan maupun jadwal pre-order untuk pasar Indonesia.
Sejumlah laporan sebelumnya menyebut iPhone 18 Pro berpotensi mulai dipasarkan di Indonesia pada Oktober 2026, namun informasi tersebut masih sebatas prediksi dan belum mendapat konfirmasi resmi dari Apple.

Federal Minister for Planning, Development and Special Initiatives Ahsan Iqbal on Tuesday said that the world was passing through a rapid knowledge revolution and only those nations that made knowledge and research the foundation of their development would be able to move forward. Pakistan Must Modernize Education System to Compete Globally.
Addressing the inaugural session of an international conference on Education, Research and Action in Islamabad, the Minister said artificial intelligence had emerged as a defining force of the contemporary world, making it imperative for Pakistan to transform its education system in line with the demands of the future.
Ahsan Iqbal said Pakistan could not achieve meaningful progress while remaining attached to outdated methods and called for an education system that promotes creativity, critical thinking and problem-solving skills rather than merely transferring information.
Pakistan Must Modernize Education System to Compete Globally, Says Ahsan Iqbal
He observed that Pakistan was still struggling to move beyond a colonial legacy in education, where the system had historically discouraged independent thinking. He said English was important, but no nation had achieved development merely on the basis of the English language. “When the language of thinking and the language of expression are different, creative minds cannot fully develop,” he said.
The Minister said the curriculum was being revised to promote creativity and equip students with the knowledge and skills required to compete in a rapidly changing world. He emphasized that Pakistan’s path to development lay through quality education, modern research and the development of skilled human resources.
Ahsan Iqbal stressed that research should not remain confined to books and laboratories but must be connected with practical action and solutions to the country’s real challenges. He called upon universities to play a more effective role in research, innovation and addressing national problems.
He also emphasized the need to align teacher training with modern technologies, changing educational requirements and the practical needs of classrooms. He said the country’s youth were its greatest asset and equipping them with modern knowledge, technology and future-oriented skills should remain a priority.
The Minister said Pakistan needed to significantly enhance its intellectual, research and creative capacities to compete globally. He added that successful implementation of any policy or plan required not only a vision but also effective institutions and a strong implementation mechanism.
See Also: SDPI Proposes National Roadmap for Battery Storage in Pakistan
Ahsan Iqbal said sustainable national development depended not only on technology but also on remaining connected with national traditions, values and cultural identity. He noted that the Holy Quran encouraged human beings to reflect upon and explore the universe, making research and inquiry an integral part of the country’s intellectual and religious heritage.
Recalling the teachings of Allama Muhammad Iqbal, the Minister said, “Iqbal urged us to become authors of books rather than merely readers of books.”
He said Pakistan needed an education system that prepared young people not merely for employment but also for leadership, innovation, and contributing to national development.

items.author: Press Release
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Most phones aren’t destroyed outright. They’re worn down, by monsoon rain on a commute, by dust on a work site, by a drop from pocket height onto a hard floor. TECNO built the SPARK 50 Pro’s “689” Ultra Tough Protection system, backed by SGS Five-Star Premium Drop certification, to fight exactly that kind of gradual, everyday damage.
Drop It. It’ll Be Fine.
The SPARK 50 Pro carries SGS Five-Star Premium Drop certification, a Swiss-verified standard tested well beyond typical requirements: 1.2 metres for repeated multi-angle drops at everyday pocket and hand height, 1.8 metres for extreme-height drop endurance, 41 consecutive falls with continued stable operation, and full 360° coverage across corners and edges, not just flat faces.
Protecting the most vulnerable component, the camera module sits inside a ring of aviation-grade 6-series aluminium, the material grade used in aircraft structures and the Tesla Model S, machined as a precision CNC unibody, adding impact resistance while reducing weight.
Six Metres Deep, Zero Worries
The SPARK 50 Pro is certified IP68 for immersion up to 6 metres for 30 minutes. That depth is the part worth noting. IP68 is a common badge, but the depth to which phones are tested varies enormously, and most phones in this price range are rated for much shallower depths. In practice, that extra margin covers the situations that actually happen: rain that arrives without warning during monsoon season, a phone left on a table when a glass tips over, or a splash while washing up.
Hot, High-Pressure, No Problem
Separately, the SPARK 50 Pro holds IP69 certification, resistance to high-pressure water jets at up to 80°C. This is a standard drawn from industrial equipment that gets hosed down, and it means the phone can be properly cleaned rather than gingerly wiped. For anyone whose hands are dirty at work, this is the more useful of the two ratings.
Dust Doesn’t Stand a Chance
Level 6 dust protection is the maximum grade, a complete seal against dust ingress. It’s relevant for outdoor work, construction and workshop environments, travel, and the ordinary reality of Pakistani roads in dry season, where fine dust works its way into ports and speaker grilles over months.
Customers can see the certifications demonstrated in person at TECNO partner outlets nationwide, where live water-immersion and drop demonstration units are on display. The SPARK 50 Pro is available nationwide at PKR 74,999/- in the 8GB + 128GB variant.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Pakistan Single Window (PSW) has integrated with the National Database and Registration Authority’s (NADRA) PakID Mobile App, enabling PSW users to complete the mandatory verification process remotely through the App for PSW subscription, subscription renewal and profile updates.
Previously, completing biometric verification required users to physically visit a NADRA e-Sahulat Centre. With the PakID integration, users can now complete their biometric verification remotely through their smartphones, subject to applicable NADRA verification requirements, reducing the need for physical visits. The facility offers a particularly significant convenience for overseas Pakistanis engaged in trade-related activities in Pakistan. Eligible overseas users can now complete their PSW biometric verification remotely through the PakID Mobile App.
To ensure a smooth transition and uninterrupted facilitation for the business community, both verification channels will remain operational during an interim period. During this phase, users can choose to verify their biometrics either digitally via the PakID Mobile App or continue visiting NADRA e-Sahulat Centres.
“The integration with NADRA’s PakID Mobile App reflects our commitment to listening to the PSW community both in Pakistan and overseas and responding to their needs”, said Syed Aftab Haider, CEO of PSW. “By enabling remote biometric verification, we are removing another physical trip in the onboarding process and making the PSW user journey more convenient, accessible, and user driven.”
Integration with the PakID app eliminates the only physical visit required for PSW subscription and makes the entire process seamlessly digital. The integration reflects PSW’s continued focus on using digital solutions to make its services more accessible, responsive and convenient, while addressing the practical needs of businesses and Pakistanis engaged in trade from abroad.

items.title: India to Enforce BIS Registration Rules for Smartphone Screen Protectors From April 2027
items.summary: The Indian government has brought smartphone screen protectors under its compulsory registration framework, with the new requirement set to apply from April 1, 2027. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology has specified IS 19348:2025 as the applicable Indian Standard. The standard covers glass quality, dimensions and strength, along with features such as adhesives, anti-shatter films, oleophobic and anti-glare coatings, blue-light filtering and privacy layers. The new framework could affect product availability and add testing and certification costs for businesses.

items.author: Palak Sharma
items.content:
IPO-bound Zetwerk and US-based transformer startup Ayr Energy have reached a settlement by agreeing to dismiss all claims in lawsuits pending before the Texas Business Court and a separate case involving Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses and Ayr Energy’s founder Anirudh Reddy before a Bengaluru court.
“The companies have dismissed all claims asserted in the lawsuits pending in the Texas Business Court and those asserted in the case involving Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited and Anirudh Reddy in XXXV Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge in Bengaluru, India, and they have jointly sought termination of the related US International Trade Commission investigation,” the statement read.
The settlement comes more than a year after the dispute began. At the heart of the dispute is Zetwerk’s allegation that Reddy incorporated Ayr Energy while still serving as a senior executive at Zetwerk. Reddy resigned from Zetwerk in January 2025, months after incorporating Ayr, the manufacturing company had alleged.
The company claimed Reddy had downloaded hundreds of internal documents before leaving, including customer lists, pricing information and strategic plans. Zetwerk also alleged that Ayr used the information and relationships to secure contracts from customers in its sales pipeline.
In May 2025, Zetwerk initiated a discovery proceeding against Ayr Energy in Delaware, which was denied in August 2025. The dispute escalated in October 2025 when Zetwerk and its US subsidiary filed a lawsuit in Texas against Ayr Energy and Reddy, alleging misuse of confidential information and trade secrets.
Ayr Energy filed counterclaims against Zetwerk, accusing the company of trade secret theft, trademark infringement, false advertising, fraud and unfair competition. It sought at least $1 Bn in damages and approached the USITC over alleged trade-secret and other violations. Zetwerk disputed the allegations.
In May 2026, the Texas Business Court allowed Zetwerk’s claims to proceed after declining Ayr Energy’s motion to dismiss.
For context, Ayr Energy builds high-voltage and medium-voltage equipment, including transformers and switchgear, for data centre developers, utilities and power producers. The California-based startup was founded by Reddy after his stint at Zetwerk and has raised $3.5 Mn in a seed round led by General Catalyst.
Meanwhile, Zetwerk was founded in 2018. It operates a manufacturing and supply chain platform serving sectors including energy, renewables, aerospace, defence, automotive and electronics. The company has raised funding from investors including Peak XV Partners and Lightspeed and is preparing for a public-market debut.
Zetwerk is currently in the run up to making its public markets debut. After receiving the regulator’s approval for its confidential filing, Zetwerk filed its updated IPO papers in August. Its public issue is expected to comprise a fresh issue of shares worth ₹2,600 Cr and an offer-for-sale (OFS) component of up to 9.6 Cr equity shares.
On the financial front, its net loss climbed 333% to ₹1,606.1 Cr during the fiscal under review from ₹370.7 Cr in FY25. The surging loss came at the behest of a ₹450 Cr provision related to the discontinued civil infrastructure business and around ₹800 Cr accounting charge related to the founders increasing their ownership from 15% to about 20%.
The manufacturing company’s operating revenue jumped over 40% to ₹15,913.3 Cr in FY26 from ₹11,300 Cr in the previous fiscal year. Of this, approximately ₹9,300 Cr came from manufacturing, while the remainder from its ecosystem/raw-material business.
The post Zetwerk, Ayr Energy Settle Legal Dispute appeared first on Inc42 Media.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Senate Standing Committee on Information Technology and Telecommunication is set to examine allegations of Rs 6.58 billion in excess charges by Jazz, around $800 million in outstanding Etisalat dues linked to the privatisation of PTCL, and a reported Rs 172 billion fraud allegedly involving call centers.
The committee, chaired by Senator Palwasha Mohammad Zai Khan, will seek briefings from the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA), Auditor General of Pakistan, Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication (MoITT), and Federal Investigation Agency (FIA).
The panel will particularly examine a purported audit report alleging that Jazz collected Rs 6.58 billion in excess charges from mobile users after being allowed to increase tariffs by up to 15 per cent quarterly. The PTA chairman and auditor general will be asked to clarify the findings and explain any action taken to protect consumers. The Senate committee had previously examined the same audit objection.
The committee will also take up the reported $800 million outstanding amount owed by Etisalat in connection with the privatisation of PTCL. MoITT will brief members on the matter and provide minutes of PTCL Board meetings held during the past six months.
The FIA will separately brief the committee on the reported Rs172 billion fraud allegedly involving call centres, including details of the case and investigation and enforcement measures.
Data security and telecom issues also on agenda
The committee will also examine allegations that sensitive personal data of Pakistani government officers was obtained and transferred to foreign entities. The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) will brief the panel on the alleged data transfer and measures to prevent similar incidents.
Other matters on the agenda include the continued closure of mobile services in Lakki Marwat, telecom and internet connectivity projects in Qila Abdullah under the Universal Service Fund, and the status of Telecom Competition Rules under the Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-organization) Act, 1996.
The panel will also consider a request from Pak Datacom employees concerning termination of their employment.
The committee’s agenda comes amid broader scrutiny of telecom regulation, consumer protection, connectivity and data security. Recent Senate proceedings have also covered network connectivity, telecom competition rules and concerns surrounding the transfer of government data to foreign satellite infrastructure.

items.author: Akshit Pushkarna
items.content:
Walmart-backed PhonePe has received in-principle approval from the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) for two payment licences, taking the IPO-bound fintech major closer to launching its first locally regulated payments operation outside India.
The approvals cover Retail Payment Services and Card Schemes (RPSCS) and Stored Value Facilities (SVF). While the RPSCS licence covers regulated retail payment services, the SVF licence permits the issuance and operation of stored-value products such as digital wallets.
However, the in-principle approvals do not allow PhonePe to immediately begin commercial operations. The fintech major will have to fulfil the remaining regulatory requirements and secure final approval from the CBUAE.
Following the final nod, PhonePe plans to collaborate with regional banks, licensed payment service providers, and local technology vendors in the UAE. It will also explore opportunities to support Aani and Jaywan, the country’s domestic payment networks, using its technology platform.
The development would mark PhonePe’s first international foray involving domestic business operations. The fintech major already enables Indian travellers in the UAE to scan local QR codes and make UPI payments at NEOPAY and Network International terminals through its partnership with NPCI International Payments.
PhonePe has been laying the groundwork for overseas expansion for some time. In September 2025, it incorporated PhonePe International Holdings Ltd in Abu Dhabi with a share capital of AED 20,000.
In its UDRHP, PhonePe said its UPI payment service was available to Indian users in Singapore, the UAE, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, France, Qatar, and Mauritius through the infrastructure provided by NPCI International Payments. However, this cross-border facility is different from the domestic operations that PhonePe plans to launch in the UAE after receiving the final regulatory approvals.
The development comes days after PhonePe’s monetisation prospects in India received a boost from the reintroduction of MDR on certain UPI merchant transactions.
PhonePe remains India’s largest UPI app by transaction volume. It processed around 11.25 Bn transactions worth ₹14.26 Lakh Cr in August, translating into a volume market share of 45.9%. However, its share slipped marginally from 46.1% in July.
Despite its market leadership, the fintech major’s net loss widened 62% YoY to ₹2,792 Cr in FY26 from ₹1,727.4 Cr in the previous fiscal year. The increase was driven by higher employee and marketing expenses, ESOP costs, and one-time write-offs.
Meanwhile, operating revenue rose 11.5% to ₹7,920.5 Cr from ₹7,105 Cr in FY25. Including other income of ₹467.4 Cr, total revenue increased 10% YoY to ₹8,387.9 Cr.
PhonePe paused its IPO plans in March amid geopolitical tensions in West Asia and volatility in global equity markets. However, the fintech major is now looking to revive the listing process following greater clarity on the UPI MDR framework.
Sources told Inc42 last week that PhonePe is targeting a public listing between February and March 2027.
“They have an almost 45% share of merchant payments. With greater clarity on the MDR regime, PhonePe is now looking to revise its IPO plans and could target a listing between February and March 2027,” the sources said.

According to customer notifications shared with PhoneWorld, the company has informed subscribers that the 100 Seconds service will no longer be available after the announced date. Zong Announces Monthly Super Card Mini Package
Alongside these changes, Zong has communicated details of its Monthly Super Card Mini package, which provides internet data, calling minutes, and SMS benefits for a 30-day period.
The package is available against a load of Rs 1,500, according to the customer notification.
Zong’s official package page confirms the price and data allowance but lists 5,000 Zong minutes and 5,000 SMS rather than the unlimited on-net minutes and SMS mentioned in the notification.
In a separate communication, Zong has also notified customers of a data rate of Rs 20 per MB while outside Pakistan.
The rate was communicated through customer notifications, and subscribers should confirm the applicable international roaming charges for their destination before using mobile data abroad.
The latest announcements reflect changes to Zong’s prepaid portfolio and associated services. Customers have been informed through SMS notifications, with the 100 Seconds discontinuation scheduled for October 1.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Kehadiran iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max di Indonesia semakin dekat, apalagi kedua ponsel baru Apple tersebut sudah tercatat dan lolos Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) dari Kemenperin, juga sertifikasi Postel Komdigi.
Walau begitu, Erajaya, selaku distributor resmi sekaligus reseller untuk produk Apple di Indonesia mengaku masih menunggu arahan lebih lanjut dari pihak Apple sehubungan rencana peluncuran resmi iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max di Tanah Air.
Dalam sesi tanya jawab dengan media di acara Parade Festival Belanja Erafone di Kota Kasablanka, Jakarta, Selasa (22/9/2026). Deputy CEO Erajaya Digital, Kim Jong Won, menyatakan, akan mengikuti seluruh perencanaan yang ditetapkan Apple.
Baca Juga: Pajak iPhone Duo dari Luar Negeri Tembus Rp 8 Juta, Berapa Biaya iPhone 18 Pro?
“Kalau dari Apple suruh kita siap, ya siap. Tapi kita juga belum terima complete planning penjualan iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max di Indonesia,” ujar Kim kepada media.
Pernyataan itu menjadi sinyal, distributor dan reseller resmi tersebut masih menunggu detail terkait peluncuran dua iPhone 18 Pro series. Saat ditanya tentang jadwal penjualan dan aktivitas Apple di Tanah Air.
Selain itu, Erajaya juga masih tutup mulut saat ditanyakan tentang apakah perusahaan bakal mengadakan acara midnight launch. Menurut Erajaya, seluruh rencana kegiatan masih dalam tahap pembahasan.
“Acara semuanya kita belum confirm ya. Bisa jadi yes, bisa jadi enggak,” ujarnya. Saat ini, HP baru Apple tersebut menjadi salah satu perangkat yang paling dinantikan di Indonesia.
Kemunculan sertifikasi TKDN dan Postel membuat peluang peluncuran resmi semakin terbuka, meski Apple belum mengumumkan tanggal penjualan maupun jadwal pre-order untuk pasar Indonesia.
Sejumlah laporan sebelumnya menyebut penerus iPhone 17 Pro series itu berpotensi mulai dipasarkan di Indonesia pada Oktober 2026, namun informasi tersebut masih sebatas prediksi dan belum mendapat konfirmasi resmi dari Apple.
Bocoran Harga iPhone 18 Pro Series di Indonesia
Lebih lanjut, bocoran tentang kemungkinan harga iPhone Duo dan 18 Pro series. Informasi tersebut dibagikan Apple enthusiast Bhaguz Hernawan melalui akun X pribadinya di @bhaguz_403. Dalam cuitannya, Bhaguz menyebut kemungkinan iPhone 18 Pro dibanderol mulai Rp 27.999.000.
Sedangkan untuk 18 Pro Max mulai dari Rp 29.999.000. Lalu untuk harga iPhone Duo dibanderol mulai Rp 44.999.000.
Apple sendiri belum mengumumkan harga iPhone Duo, 18 Pro, dan 18 Pro Max di Tanah Air. Karena itu, angka yang dibagikan Bhaguz ini masih sebatas bocoran atau perkiraan hingga ada pengumuman resmi dari Apple atau jaringan reseller.
Jika bocoran tersebut benar, varian Pro dan Pro Max bakal mengalami kenaikan harga cukup besar dibanding generasi sebelumnya. Sedangkan harga iPhone Duo akan menjadi kategori baru.
Saat pertama dijual di Indonesia pada Oktober 2025, harga iPhone 17 Pro 256GB dibanderol mulai dari Rp 23.749.000. Sedangkan untuk varian iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB dijual dengan harga Rp 25.749.000.

ModelHarga Generasi SebelumnyaBocoran Harga BaruSelisih
iPhone 17 Pro → iPhone 18 ProRp 23.749.000Rp 27.999.000Rp 4.250.000
iPhone 17 Pro Max → iPhone 18 Pro MaxRp 25.749.000Rp 29.999.000Rp 4.250.000
Jika bocoran harga ini benar, maka harga iPhone 18 Pro series ini naik sekitar Rp 4.250.000. Kenaikan tersebut juga sejalan dengan perubahan harga di pasar Amerika Serikat.
Meski demikian, harga global tidak bisa dijadikan patokan langsung untuk Indonesia. Harga iPhone Duo dan Pro Series lokal dapat dipengaruhi berbagai faktor, termasuk struktur harga Apple untuk setiap pasar.

iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max akan hadir di Indonesia, tetapi Apple belum mengumumkan tanggal penjualan. (Foto: Apple)
Sebelumnya, generasi baru iPhone tersebut dikabarkan bakal meluncur secara resmi di Indonesia pada 16 Oktober 2026. Informasi ini dibagikan oleh Bagus Hernawan lewat akun pribadinya di X (dulunya bernama Twitter).
Selain model Pro dan Pro Max, eks-MakeMac dan founder Appleisme ini juga , iPhone 18 Series siap meluncur resmi di Indonesia pada 16 Oktober 2026.
Tak hanya duo iPhone 18 Pro, Bagus juga mengungkap deretan perangkat Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, hingga AirPods 5 bakal ikut diluncurkan pada tanggal tersebut.

Shares of insurtech company Turtlemint soared 9% to touch an intraday high of ₹142.90 apiece on the BSE today. The shares pared some of the gains later, closing 6.6% higher at ₹139.75 apiece. At the time, Turtlemint’s market capitalisation stood at ₹4,115.34 Cr ($431 Mn).
The rally today comes days after brokerage Motilal Oswal initiated a “buy” rating for the stock and set a price target (PT) of ₹180 on the stock. This implies a 22% upside from today’s close.
Motilal Oswal said that the PoSP-driven premiums are growing at nearly twice the industry rate. The company, with its presence across 19,186 pin codes, is well-positioned to capture this opportunity.
The brokerage further said, “While we expect 1.3–1.5 Lakh partner additions annually, active DPs are poised to grow at about 24% FY26–29 CAGR, driven by Turtlemint’s training-led activation engine and strong partner retention.”
As per Motilal Oswal, Turtlemint’s key margin opportunity lies in controlling corporate overheads with partner payouts accounting for most direct costs. As growth shifts from adding partners to improving their activation and productivity, the brokerage expects operating leverage to improve, with corporate overheads projected to grow at a 6% CAGR between FY26-29. This is expected to help Turtlemint achieve adjusted EBITDA breakeven in FY27 while expanding margins to around 11% by FY29.
The development comes a month after Jefferies initiated coverage on the company with a ‘Buy’ rating and a price target of ₹190.
Founded in 2015, Turtlemint operates an insurance distribution platform, connecting consumers with insurers through a network of financial advisors for car, bike, health, and term life insurance.
The company made its market debut on the exchanges on June 29. Its shares were listed at ₹134.90 on the NSE, an 11.25% discount to the IPO price of ₹152. On the BSE, the stock debuted at ₹136.20, down 10.4% from the issue price earlier in June.
On the financial front, Turtlemint managed to trim down its Q1 FY27 net loss 19% to ₹37.8 Cr from a loss of ₹46.7 Cr in the same quarter last year. Operating revenue jumped 40% to ₹294.1 Cr in the quarter under review, from ₹210.5 in Q1 FY26.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pakistan could use battery energy storage systems (BESS) to address several challenges facing its electricity grid, according to a new study by the Sustainable Development Policy Institute (SDPI). SDPI, in collaboration with the Network for Clean Energy Transition (NCET), has presented a national roadmap for the deployment of grid-scale battery storage systems in Pakistan. The study focuses on identifying suitable locations where large battery systems can provide the greatest benefits to the power network.
SDPI Proposes National Roadmap for Battery Storage in Pakistan
The report, titled “Optimal Siting of Grid-Scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) in Pakistan,” examines how battery storage can improve grid flexibility and support the country’s shift towards cleaner energy.
Battery storage could support renewable energy
Experts, regulators and researchers discussed the potential role of BESS in Pakistan’s power sector during the launch of the study.
Battery storage can help integrate variable renewable energy sources such as solar and wind into the national grid. It can also reduce renewable energy curtailment, ease transmission congestion, and help manage power supply when the grid faces limitations.
Dr Kashif Imran, a professor at the US-Pakistan Centre for Advanced Studies in Energy at NUST, said the study provides useful information about where battery storage systems could be installed.
However, he pointed out that there is still uncertainty across the power sector about how and where BESS should be deployed. He suggested a three-tier approach that could provide greater clarity for investors and other stakeholders.
Dr Imran also highlighted the importance of better data and analytics for planning battery storage projects. He noted that BESS can help reduce transmission losses and manage voltage fluctuations, but storage systems are not available continuously. Their applications therefore need to match specific requirements of the electricity grid.
Study identifies potential locations
Muhammad Umer, a research associate at SDPI, said Pakistan’s power sector continues to experience Energy Not Served (ENS) losses of around 2.77 GWh.
The study aims to address these challenges through a data-driven approach to selecting locations for battery storage systems. It also looks at reducing transmission congestion and renewable energy curtailment.
Researchers conducted an initial screening of the National Grid Company’s 500kV and 220kV grid stations. They used a ranking-based method to compare potential locations according to technical and geographical factors.
The study identified locations including Shikarpur, Faisalabad, Dadu and Rawat as candidates for further consideration for grid-scale BESS deployment.
Call for changes in energy planning
The researchers also proposed several policy and planning measures to support battery storage in Pakistan.
They recommended making BESS modelling part of the Indicative Generation Capacity Expansion Plan (IGCEP). They also called for integrating battery storage into Transmission System Expansion Planning (TSEP) cycles.
The study further recommended bottom-up electricity forecasting and the development of a national BESS deployment roadmap.
According to the researchers, a clear policy and regulatory framework could also help attract investment in battery storage. The study aims to support the development of a business case for BESS projects, including potential investment opportunities linked to CPEC 2.0.
With Pakistan expanding renewable energy capacity, battery storage could become an important part of future power-sector planning. The SDPI roadmap provides a framework for identifying where large-scale storage could help improve the reliability and flexibility of the national electricity grid.

items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
Days after rival RentoMojo’s strong stock market debut, furniture and appliance rental startup Furlenco is reportedly gearing up for a potential ₹1,000-1,200 Cr IPO.
The Bengaluru-based startup is seeking a valuation of around ₹7,000 Cr (about $732.2 Mn) through the proposed issue, the Economic Times reported, citing sources. However, the final valuation is expected to be decided closer to the IPO, depending on market conditions and investor feedback during roadshows.
Furlenco is looking to launch the IPO in FY28 and is expected to soon appoint ICICI Securities as an advisor for the public issue, the report added.
Questions sent to Furlenco remained unanswered at the time of publication. The story will be updated upon receiving a response.
The IPO plans come after Furlenco turned profitable in FY25 and further expanded its bottom line in FY26.
Founded in 2012 by Ajith Mohan Karimpana, Furlenco operates a subscription-driven furniture and appliance rental platform. It offers more than 300 SKUs across 28 cities, including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Chennai, and Kolkata. Besides rentals, the startup also sells new furniture.
Its operating revenue surged 61.9% to ₹370.4 Cr in FY26 from ₹228.7 Cr in the previous fiscal year. Its net profit jumped nearly 20X to ₹59.5 Cr from ₹3.1 Cr in FY25.
The company’s EBITDA nearly doubled to ₹129.5 Cr in FY26 from ₹66.4 Cr in FY25, while its EBITDA margin expanded to 35.01%.
Furniture and office equipment rentals accounted for around 92% of Furlenco’s operating revenue in FY26. Rental income jumped 64% YoY to ₹341.1 Cr, while revenue from furniture sales rose 38% to ₹29.4 Cr.
Meanwhile, total expenditure increased 45.1% YoY to ₹343.9 Cr from ₹236.9 Cr in FY25.
The startup raised ₹125 Cr (about $15 Mn) in a funding round led by existing investor Sheela Foam, along with participation from Whiteoak and Madhu Kela, in December last year. The capital was earmarked towards strengthening its presence in existing markets, entering new markets and investing in product innovation, technology and customer experience.
Furlenco has raised more than $290 Mn in funding to date from investors like Lightbox Ventures, Crescent Ventures, Whiteoak, and Madhu Kela.
Furlenco Joins Growing Startup IPO Queue
Furlenco’s IPO plans come shortly after primary rival RentoMojo raised ₹1,255.6 Cr through its public issue. The IPO closed with an overall subscription of 72.88X before RentoMojo’s shares listed at ₹482.45 on the NSE, a premium of 19.42% over the issue price of ₹404.
Several other Indian startups are also preparing to tap the public markets. Digital lending platform Moneyview’s IPO will open for subscription on Thursday (September 24), while Snapdeal parent AceVector’s public issue will open on Friday (September 25).
Used-car marketplace Spinny has also filed its draft IPO papers through the confidential route for a ₹2,500-₹3,000 Cr issue.
Meanwhile, PhonePe is targeting an IPO by March 2027 after the government introduced MDR on certain UPI transactions. Other startups in the IPO pipeline include Kuku, Razorpay, OYO, Zetwerk, and Atomberg.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Microsoft and Google have worked together to disrupt a major cybercrime marketplace that allegedly helped criminals launch phishing campaigns, business email compromise attacks and other online scams.
The marketplace, known as RedVDS, sold access to virtual machines (VMs) that came with software and tools used for cybercrime. The service allowed criminals to quickly set up systems for attacks while making it harder for investigators to trace their activities.
Microsoft’s Digital Crimes Unit monitored RedVDS and gathered information about its activities. The company then shared threat data with Google through the Global Signal Exchange (GSE), a secure platform designed to help technology companies exchange information about cyber threats.
Microsoft and Google Take Down $66 Million Cybercrime Marketplace
Microsoft took legal action in January 2026 and obtained court orders in the United States and the United Kingdom to seize RedVDS domains. The operation also involved the seizure of servers linked to the marketplace.
Google used the shared information to identify related accounts operating across its services and suspended them. Authorities also seized RedVDS servers in Germany, while Europol took action against servers located elsewhere in Europe.
The scale of the operation was significant. According to the information released about the takedown, RedVDS-provided virtual machines targeted around 130,000 organizations between September and December 2025. During the same period, about 191,000 Microsoft email accounts were compromised.
RedVDS reportedly offered access to basic virtual machines prepared for scams for as little as $24 per month. This low cost allowed cybercriminals to gain access to ready-to-use infrastructure without having to build their own systems.
The case also highlights the growing role of information sharing in fighting online crime. Large technology companies can see different parts of a cyberattack, but sharing those signals can help connect otherwise separate incidents.
See Also: Fake Microsoft Teams IT Support Calls Used to Spread EtherRAT Malware
The Global Signal Exchange is a UK-based nonprofit organization that was co-founded with Google in 2025. It aims to provide a secure way for organizations to share information about cybercrime and threats in real time.
The RedVDS operation is one example of how this type of collaboration can help companies identify criminal infrastructure and take action across multiple platforms and jurisdictions.
Microsoft and Google are expected to continue sharing threat information through the GSE. The organization also works with other major technology companies, including Meta and Amazon, as part of its broader effort to improve cooperation against cybercrime.
