items.content:
Setelah merilis teaser resmi sejak beberapa pekan terakhir, akhirnya vivo secara resmi menghadirkan jajaran flagship terbarunya yang kini tersedia dalam tiga opsi berbeda. Ya, vivo X500 Series kembali hadir membawa setup kamera superior, tetap berkolaborasi dengan ZEISS, dan andalkan cip rilisan terbaru dari MediaTek.
Kalau generasi sebelumnya hanya tersedia dalam dua varian berbeda, vivo kini kembali menawarkan lini vivo X500 Series dalam tiga opsi; vivo X500, vivo X500 Pro, dan vivo X500 Pro Max. Varian standar justru hadir dalam penyegaran desain dengan dimensi layar sedikit membesar, sementara varian Pro tetap andalkan desain kompak, dan varian Pro Max membawa setup kamera paling superior—termasuk sensor Sony LYT-910 terbaru yang mendukung arsitektur LOFIC.
Melalui kehadiran vivo X500 Series, vivo ingin mengedepankan kemampuan perekaman video tingkat lanjut, sekaligus memberikan pengalaman fotografi yang juga ikut disempurnakan. Tidak hanya lewat peningkatan sensor, namun fitur yang ikut ditambahkan, serta aksesori pelengkap di mana varian standar juga membawa dukungan aksesori teleconverter.
Baca juga: Mengintip Desain vivo X500, Tampilan Berubah Total Mirip iPhone?
Kamera vivo X500 Pro Max Bawa Peningkatan Hardware & Software
Dari ketiga varian yang diluncurkan hari ini, vivo X500 Pro Max tentu menjadi opsi tertinggi dan paling menggoda. Desain vivo X500 Pro Max sendiri masih tergolong mirip, namun dengan perbedaan pada opsi warna, di mana permukaan bodi belakang kini mengadopsi gaya dual tone. Tetap membawa sertifikasi hingga IP69, sementara bagian lensa terproteksi lapisan “ultra hard AR” khusus.
Layar vivo X500 Pro Max mengadopsi panel OLED 2K ZEISS Master Color Display berukuran 6,85 inci yang sudah berjenis BOE Q11 terbaru, membawa refresh rate hingga 144Hz, serta tingkat kecerahan maksimum sampai 4400 nits. Chipset yang digunakan adalah Dimensity 9600 Pro terbaik dari MediaTek, dipasangkan bersama RAM 12GB.
Bagaimana dengan setup kameranya? Sensor utama kamera vivo X500 Pro Max kini mengusung Sony LYT-910, beresolusi 50MP, dengan dimensi sensor besar 1/1,28 inci dan sudah mendukung teknologi LOFIC, sehingga mampu menangkap cahaya lebih optimal dalam skenario lebih ekstrem seperti backlight dan sejenisnya. Tetap memiliki stabilisasi gimbal-grade hingga 3 derajat.
Sensor telefoto 200MP-nya juga ikut diperbarui, berjenis HP0 yang mendukung standar stabilisasi CIPA 7.0. Kedua sensor ini mendukung autofocus tracking hingga 60fps, dan vivo X500 Pro Max membawa dukungan 8K Live serta 4K 240fps yang bisa memberikan efek slow-motion dalam kualitas visual jauh lebih tajam.
Kedua sensor andalan tersebut dipasangkan bersama sensor 50MP ultra-wide JN5 yang mendukung autofokus, serta 50MP JN1 (20mm) dengan autofokus di sisi depan (alias kamera selfie). Dan untuk memberikan kemampuan zoom lebih jauh, kamera vivo X500 Pro Max dirancang kompatibel dengan lensa 400mm ZEISS Teleconverter G2 Ultra. Plus, sistem empat mikrofon untuk perekaman audio lebih superior.
vivo X500 Pro tampil dalam desain familiar namun lebih kompak
vivo juga sematkan fitur AI Creative Camera terbaru, hingga sejumlah mode baru pada perekaman video yang memungkinkan pengguna untuk hasilkan footage lebih sinematik, termasuk dengan efek berputar 360 derajat tanpa memutar smartphone secara langsung. Sementara kapasitas baterai vivo X500 Pro Max kini mencapai 7800 mAh, dan tetap mendukung 90W FlashCharge. Menjalankan OriginOS 7 berbasis Android 16 dengan jaminan setidaknya 5 tahun pembaruan versi OS.
Selain varian Pro Max, juga turut hadir vivo X500 Pro yang membawa hampir semua keandalan Pro Max dalam dimensi kompak, dengan layar 6,36 inci 144Hz. Tentu karena dimensi perangkat mengecil, kapasitas baterai juga lebih kecil di 6510 mAh. Dengan perbedaan lain seperti sensor telefoto Sony LYT-610 64MP, dan triple-mic system.
Harga vivo X500 Series Mulai Rp Jutaan
vivo X500
Beralih ke opsi yang paling terjangkau, yakni vivo X500, justru tampil dalam desain yang paling berbeda dibandingkan kedua varian lainnya. Dimensinya sedikit membesar dibandingkan generasi sebelumnya, dengan layar 6,59 inci 144Hz, namun tetap terasa relatif kompak. Kini membawa setup kamera yang hampir menyerupai kamera vivo X300 Pro sebelumnya. Mulai dari kamera selfie 50MP JN1, ultra-wide 50MP JN1, hingga sensor utama Sony LYT-828 dengan dimensi sensor besar 1/1,28 inci.
Memang, sensor telefotonya belum beresolusi 200MP. Namun jenis Sony LYT-610 64MP yang diusungnya sudah meningkat dibandingkan generasi sebelumnya. Menjalankan cip Dimensity 9600M, tetap diberikan cukup banyak fitur pengambilan gambar maupun perekaman video baru, meski belum mendukung mode 4K240. Kapasitas baterai vivo X500 mencapai 7500 mAh, dan tetap mendukung 90W FlashCharge.
OriginOS 7 pada vivo X500 Series menghadirkan tampilan antarmuka yang disempurnakan, termasuk opsi wallpaper interaktif baru, lebih banyak elemen transparan a-la Liquid Glass pada platform Apple, serta fitur penunjang produktivitas seperti Origin Workbench, Snap Note, AI Recorder, hingga vivo Office Kit.
Harga vivo X500 Series dibanderol mulai CNY5499 (Rp14,6 jutaan) untuk varian 12+256GB. Sementara vivo X500 Pro mulai CNY6499 (Rp17,3 jutaan), dan harga vivo X500 Pro Max mulai CNY6999 (Rp18,6 jutaan). Khusus opsi dengan penyimpanan tertinggi, tersedia dalam opsi paket khusus “Photographer Kit” lengkap dengan dua tambahan lensa telefoto, hingga grip dan pelengkap lainnya, dibanderol CNY12999 atau sekitar Rp34,6 jutaan.

vivo baru saja memperkenalkan lini flagship terbarunya, vivo X500 Series lewat sebuah acara peluncuran yang berlangsung di Shanghai, China (21/9). Karena hadir sebagai opsi termahal, maka wajar bila pengalaman unboxing vivo X500 Pro Max Photographer Kit menjadi begitu spesial. Kemasan perangkat dibuat jauh lebih besar, yang di dalamnya terdapat kotak smartphone, serta set khusus di mana aksesori perangkat ditata rapi. Apa saja yang diberikan?

Pengalaman Unboxing vivo X500 Pro Max Photographer Kit Cukup Ekstensif
Seperti yang sudah disebutkan sebelumnya, isi kotak unboxing vivo X500 Pro Max Photographer Kit, sudah termasuk dengan case tambahan alias vivo Imaging Grip Kit. Case tersebut tidak hanya berfungsi untuk melindungi smartphone, namun juga agar kompatibel untuk dipasangkan bersama dua lensa telefoto ZEISS, serta grip yang juga memberikan sejumlah tombol tambahan. Membuat pengalaman penggunaan smartphone benar-benar mendekati kamera profesional.
Selain pelengkap tambahan lainnya seperti pengait hingga strap khusus, tentunya di dalam kotak unboxing vivo X500 Pro Max itu sendiri, masih disematkan aksesori standar smartphone vivo. Mulai dari soft case, pengisi daya smartphone, hingga kabel pengisi daya. Ya, benar-benar komplit sehingga Gizmo friends tak perlu membeli aksesori tertentu secara terpisah.
Selepas unboxing vivo X500 Pro Max, desain perangkatnya sendiri terasa sangat familiar. Baik dimensinya secara keseluruhan hingga bentuk modul kamera belakangnya, masih dibuat mirip seperti vivo X300 Pro generasi sebelumnya. Alih-alih membawa perubahan desain yang lebih masif seperti apa yang dilakukan oleh vivo pada varian standar alias vivo X500.
Keunggulan vivo X500 Pro Max
Dalam “kemasan” yang masih identik, ada banyak peningkatan yang disematkan oleh vivo ke dalam vivo X500 Pro Max. Selain mengusung cip Dimensity 9600 Pro terbaru, setup sensor kameranya juga turut disegarkan. Sensor utamanya gunakan Sony LYT-910 rilisan tahun ini, sudah mengusung teknologi LOFIC. Sementara sensor telefoto 200MP yang dibawanya juga pakai generasi terbaru HP0.
Kombinasi tersebut diklaim mampu memberikan kualitas foto dan video lebih baik, termasuk dukungan perekaman video 4K240, untuk efek gerak lambat atau sinematik dalam ketajaman yang lebih baik. Chipset yang lebih kencang juga memungkinkan vivo untuk sematkan fitur tambahan lainnya, seperti fitur perekaman kreatif berbasis AI.
Kapasitas baterai vivo X500 Pro Max juga diperbesar, kini mencapai 7800 mAh, dan sudah mengusung layar berjenis BOE Q11 2K 144Hz LTPO. Apakah Gizmo friends tertarik untuk mendapatkan flagship vivo terbaru edisi spesial satu ini ketika nanti sudah tersedia resmi di Indonesia?

items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
Info Edge Ventures backed NBFC Ascend Capital’s profitability improved significantly in the fiscal year FY26, growing 6.25X to ₹10 Cr from ₹1.6 Cr in FY25.
As per ratings assigned by ICRA, the Jaipur-based EV-focused lender’s total income for the fiscal jumped about 131% to ₹50.3 Cr in FY26 from ₹21.8 Cr in FY25. Its total managed assets (AUM) also expanded 46% to ₹238.6 Cr from ₹163.7 Cr during the period.
ICRA noted that the cumulative collection efficiency from Ascend’s securitised EV loan portfolio, comprising of three-wheeler EVs like e-autos, loaders and L5 vehicles, stood at 97.5% as on July 2026, while the 90+ days past due (dpd) delinquency stood at 1.3%.
Its gross non-performing assets (GNPA) increased to 2.6% in FY26 from 1.7% in FY25 while capital-to-risk weighted assets ratio (CRAR moderated to 34.8% from 41% a year earlier, though it remained well above the regulatory capital requirement.
Despite the healthy pool performance, ICRA highlighted that the NBFC poses risks such as limited operational history and geographical concentration.
As of September 2025, Ascend Capital was present across 60 cities in five states and UTs, although its top three states made up for 87.5% of the portfolio. Its total borrower base stood at 18,975 at the time.
Tapping The Growing EV Demand
Founded in 2019 by Lokesh Chandra and Gaurav Maheshwari, Ascend Capital extends loans of up to ₹2-4 Lakh to consumers looking to buy EVs and batteries for e-rickshaw and L5 vehicles.
Ascend originates EV loans through its NBFC and funds its lending book through a mix of institutional debt and securitisation, where pools of EV loans are packaged into securities and sold to investors, allowing the lender to recycle capital into fresh loans.
To overcome underwriting and collection challenges related to EV financing, the NBFC has developed an internal benchmark for valuing batteries and maintains a data repository covering OEMs, distributors and drivers.
It started disbursing loans against e-autos and e-loaders in January 2024. The NBFC’s PAT stood at just ₹0.1 Cr in FY24, while income stood at ₹13.7 Cr, highlighting a notable acceleration in its scale over the past two years.
It also raised ₹50 Cr in equity funding from Info Edge Ventures and Asha Ventures in 2024. The investors own a 24.8% stake in the NBFC as of now.
The development comes as a growing set of specialised lenders targets the financing gap in India’s EV ecosystem. A record 24.5 Lakh EVs were sold in India in FY26, up 25% YoY, with electric three-wheelers accounting for 8.31 Lakh units, or 34% of total EV sales, as per Vahan data. E3Ws also crossed a 60% share of India’s overall three-wheeler sales during the year.

items.content:
A University of Karachi professor and the man accused of assaulting him and his nephew have settled after the suspect apologised to the professor.
Professor Dr Arif Khan Saqi, chairman of KU’s Islamic Learning Department, told The Express Tribune that Konain Ali Shah visited his residence on Sunday night along with his father-in-law, relatives and family elders and apologised for the incident.
Prof Saqi said he accepted the apology and forgave Konain, adding that the two sides had reached an understanding.
He said Konain’s father had also been visiting his residence from time to time to meet him. “They came to my home on Sunday night and I forgave Konain Ali Shah,” he said.
Read More: Karachi court sends main suspect on three-day remand over alleged threats to KU professor
The professor added that compensation had also been paid for damage caused to his nephew’s vehicle during the incident.
On September 8, Prof Saqi and his nephew were subjected to physical assault after Konain’s SUV hit their car near Safoora Chowrangi in the Sachal Police Station area. According to police, two cases were registered against Konain over the assault and alleged threats of serious consequences. He is currently out on bail in both cases.
The latest development comes after the suspect’s family approached Prof Saqi and sought his forgiveness, resulting in a settlement between the two sides.

items.author: Pop Culture & Art
items.content:
Anne Hathaway is set to campaign for supporting actress for her performance as Penelope in Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey, with Universal Pictures positioning the Oscar winner in the category for the upcoming awards season. Variety reported the decision exclusively.
Hathaway plays Penelope, the wife of Matt Damon’s Odysseus, in Nolan’s adaptation of Homer’s ancient Greek epic. The film follows Odysseus as he attempts to return home after the Trojan War, with Hathaway appearing alongside an extensive ensemble that includes Damon, Tom Holland, Zendaya, Robert Pattinson and Samantha Morton.
Universal’s decision settles the category in which the studio will campaign Hathaway after her placement had been a subject of awards season discussion. Morton, who plays Circe, will also be part of the film’s supporting actress campaign, creating the possibility of two acting contenders from the same production in the category.
Hathaway already has an Academy Award in the supporting actress category. She won for her performance as Fantine in the 2012 musical drama Les Misérables, making another supporting actress campaign particularly notable as The Odyssey enters the awards conversation.
The new campaign also arrives during a significant box office run for Nolan’s film. The Odyssey has earned more than $1.6bn worldwide and became Universal Pictures’ highest grossing film of all time in September. It also surpassed Deadpool & Wolverine to become the highest grossing R rated film ever.
Hathaway’s Penelope is one of the central figures in the film’s story, as Odysseus remains separated from his family for years during his journey home. Nolan’s version features Hathaway alongside Holland, who plays Telemachus, the son of Odysseus and Penelope.
The campaign comes during a particularly busy period for Hathaway. She also appeared in Mother Mary and returned as Andy Sachs in The Devil Wears Prada 2 earlier this year. Her upcoming projects include Verity, in which she stars alongside Dakota Johnson and Josh Hartnett.
For Universal, Hathaway’s supporting actress placement forms part of a broader awards campaign for The Odyssey. The studio is also expected to pursue recognition across major technical categories, while Damon is being positioned in the lead actor field.
With the awards season still developing, Hathaway’s campaign now gives her a defined path for consideration following her acclaimed Oscar winning performance in Les Misérables. Her category placement will be closely followed as nominations approach.

items.title: How Modi silenced Kashmir
items.summary:
On 19 November 2025, Indian police raided the ‘Kashmir Times’ in Jammu. They said they were on an “anti-terror” operation. The offices had been shut since 2022 and were in dilapidated condition, the equipment largely defunct. Yet, the police claimed to have recovered a “pistol and live AK-47 cartridges.” 
Since 2018, only five journalists have faced cases under India’s draconian anti-terror Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act. Trials rarely start, leaving journalists in a state of perpetual purgatory, even if they are out on bail under onerous conditions.

items.author: Our Correspondent
items.content:
The judicial commission probing the Mir Raza Ali murder case warned businessman Ahmed on Monday over his media interviews, terming them an apparent attempt to undermine the commission’s proceedings, while the doctor who conducted the first post-mortem stood by his findings that the bullet entered the body from the front and exited through the back.
The commission issued its written order for Monday’s proceedings, stating that the statements of Umer Khan, Ali Shaz, Kazim Hussain, Ahmed Hassan Sheikh and Health Services Director General Pervez Ahmed Sheikh were recorded. DG Sheikh also submitted documents relating to the formation and replacement of the medical board.
According to the order, Ahmed was allowed to answer questions raised by Mir Raza’s family and provide relevant information. However, he could not provide anything beyond the statements he had already made before the commission.
The commission observed that Ahmed’s social media interviews apparently appeared aimed at undermining its proceedings and warned him against such conduct in future. It also noted that he had failed to use an opportunity to provide information through an affidavit.
During the proceedings, a lawyer who had taken a journalist’s mobile phone apologised, which was accepted by the journalist.
Read More: Mir Raza commission summons first IO
Mir Raza’s fiancée also contacted the commission and informed it about the confiscation of the mobile phone and the alleged transfer of data by the investigating officer. The commission said it would question DSP Siraj Lashari when his statement is recorded.
Dr Usama also appeared before the commission and later spoke to the media. “I stand by my first post-mortem report,” he said, adding that the bullet had entered from the front and exited through the back.
Dr Usama said he personally conducted the post-mortem on July 29 and that no other person had performed the examination. He said he had not known Mir Raza and had shared his findings with Police Surgeon Dr Summaiya Syed, adding that he had acted on her instructions.
He said the physical copy of the report was submitted on August 3 and had been prepared to the best of his professional ability based on his findings from July 29.
Dr Usama also clarified that he did not intend to declare Mir Raza’s death a suicide, saying he wanted to explain his position regarding the bullet wound to the chest.
Regarding his observations about hydrochloric acid and decomposition, he said acid could cause certain changes to a body, including reddening of the face, while decomposition could appear differently on different parts of the body.
He said he had informed Dr Summaiya about the matter at around 5 pm and maintained that if acid had been used, its effects would not necessarily have appeared uniformly across the entire body.
However, the commission observed that Dr Usama’s further statement appeared aimed at levelling allegations against Dr Summaiya and the Sindh chief minister. It said the commission should not become a forum for allegations and that it had sufficient information to establish the facts of the case and determine whether any negligence had occurred.
Dr Usama said he had brought all his July 29 findings before the commission and remained satisfied with his original report. He added that doctors generally had 24 hours to submit a post-mortem report and that he had not anticipated the matter would become such a major controversy.
He said photographs taken during the autopsy were kept for his professional record, adding that Dr Summaiya was the signing authority for the first report. “My family has been worried since the first day,” he said, adding that his clinic had also remained closed for a month.
The commission has issued notices to ASP Nida, Asif, Abid, Faizur Rehman and Sarim to appear during proceedings scheduled for September 22.

items.author: Anne Florentyna
items.content:
Ahead of its IPO, digital lending platform Moneyview reported a 158.8% jump in its consolidated profit to ₹173.8 Cr in Q1 FY27 from ₹67.2 Cr in the year-ago quarter.
The Bengaluru-based fintech company’s operating revenue rose 50.2% to ₹1,041.1 Cr from ₹693 Cr during the quarter, according to its RHP.
Including other income of ₹24 Cr, Moneyview’s total income increased 51.5% to ₹1,065.1 Cr from ₹702.9 Cr.
EBITDA rose 88.1% to ₹424.3 Cr from ₹225.6 Cr in Q1 FY26.
Fees and commission income, Moneyview’s largest revenue stream, climbed 61.5% to ₹632.9 Cr from ₹391.8 Cr. Its share of operating revenue increased to 60.8% from 56.5% in the year-ago quarter, driven by higher loan disbursals and managed AUM.
Interest income rose 36.9% to ₹387.2 Cr from ₹282.9 Cr, aided by a 32.4% increase in average gross loans to ₹5,614.4 Cr. It accounted for 37.2% of operating revenue, down from 40.8% a year earlier as fee income grew faster.
The remaining operating revenue comprised a ₹9.8 Cr gain on derecognition of financial assets and ₹11.3 Cr in other operating income.
Moneyview’s loan disbursals rose 40.3% to ₹7,152 Cr during Q1 FY27 from ₹5,099.3 Cr in the year-ago quarter. Its managed AUM increased 27.2% to ₹22,520.2 Cr as of June 30, 2026, from ₹17,707.8 Cr a year earlier.
Of the total managed AUM, ₹5,657.5 Cr was held on the books of its NBFC subsidiary Whizdm Finance, while the remaining ₹16,862.7 Cr was serviced for external lending partners.
For FY26, Moneyview’s operating revenue grew 43.3% to ₹3,351.2 Cr from ₹2,339.1 Cr in FY25. However, its consolidated profit increased just 1% to ₹242.7 Cr from ₹240.3 Cr due to exceptional losses of ₹206.7 Cr.
The exceptional items included a ₹160 Cr one-time performance-linked incentive paid to cofounder, MD, and CEO Puneet Agarwal and a ₹46.65 Cr loss arising from a cyber incident at Whizdm Finance.
Excluding exceptional items, Moneyview’s FY26 profit rose 65.4% to ₹397.3 Cr.
How Does Moneyview Make Money?
Founded by Puneet Agarwal and Sanjay Aggarwal in 2014, Moneyview operates a digital financial services platform focused on what it calls “Middle India” — households with annual incomes ranging from ₹3 Lakh to ₹11 Lakh.
For personal loans, the startup functions as an LSP for banks and NBFCs. It helps lending partners with customer onboarding, credit evaluation, loan origination, collections, and servicing, earning fees and commissions in return.
Moneyview also provides loans through Whizdm Finance, its wholly owned NBFC subsidiary. Loans disbursed from the subsidiary’s balance sheet generate interest income for the startup.
Its personal loan offering remains its primary business, but the startup has expanded into credit cards, earned-wage access, home loans, loans against property, insurance, digital gold, UPI payments, and bill payments.
Moneyview had 140.28 Mn registered users as of June 30, as against 114.38 Mn a year earlier. Its monetised user base grew 46.2% to 11.9 Mn from 8.14 Mn during the period.
Nearly 80% of the startup’s monetised users lived in Tier II and smaller cities. Their average age was 32 years, while their average monthly income stood at about ₹46,518. The startup offered financial products through 48 financial partners as of June 30.
A Closer Look At Moneyview’s Expenses In Q1
Moneyview’s total expenses rose 35.7% to ₹832.3 Cr in Q1 FY27 from ₹613.2 Cr in the year-ago quarter.
Here is a breakdown of the company’s major expenses during the quarter.
Employee Benefit Expenses: Employee costs, which comprise salaries, wages, bonus, gratuity expense, provident and other funds, rose 52.6% to ₹93.4 Cr during the period under review, from ₹61.2 Cr in Q1 FY26.
Impairment Of Financial Instruments: Impairment expenses rose 30.4% to ₹261.4 Cr from ₹200.4 Cr and accounted for 31.4% of total expenses. This included ₹160.1 Cr in impairment allowances and write-offs related to loans on Whizdm Finance’s books and ₹101.3 Cr in expenses related to default loss guarantee arrangements.
Finance Costs: Expenses such as interest on borrowings, interest on lease liabilities and bank charges constituted 22.6% of the total expenses. Finance costs stood at ₹188.1 Cr in the June quarter, up 40.9% increase from ₹133.5 Cr a year ago.
Moneyview’s gross Stage 3 loan ratio stood at 2.72% as of June 30, marginally higher than 2.58% a year earlier but slightly lower than 2.74% at the end of FY26. Its net Stage 3 loan ratio improved to 0.59% from 0.65% a year earlier.
Moneyview IPO Details
Moneyview’s IPO will comprise a fresh issue of shares worth ₹750 Cr and an OFS of up to 10.05 Cr equity shares. The startup has fixed the price band at ₹32-₹34 per share.
At the upper end of the price band, the IPO will be worth ₹1,092 Cr and value the company at about ₹5,985 Cr ($624 Mn).
The IPO will open for subscription on September 24 (Thursday) and close on September 28 (Monday). Anchor investors can place bids on September 23 (Wednesday), while the company’s shares are expected to begin trading on the BSE and NSE on October 1 .
Cofounders Puneet Agarwal and Sanjay Aggarwal plan to offload up to 1.35 Cr shares worth ₹46.06 Cr each via the OFS. Other investors participating in the OFS include Tiger Global’s Internet Fund III, Accel India IV, Accel Growth IV, Crimson Winter, Ribbit Capital, NLI Strategic Venture Investment, TI JPNIN India Holdco, and DI Investment.
Moneyview plans to use ₹325 Cr of the fresh issue proceeds to support loan disbursals under default loss guarantee arrangements. Another ₹250 Cr will be infused into Whizdm Finance to augment its capital base, while the remainder will be used for general corporate purposes.
Moneyview has raised more than $250 Mn to date from investors including Accel, Tiger Global and Ribbit Capital to date. Accel was its largest shareholder, with a 21.9% stake before the IPO.

items.content:
Rahim Yar Khan's Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology (KFUEIT) has constituted an inquiry committee after screenshots and allegations concerning the alleged harassment of a female student by a university lecturer surfaced on social media.
According to the claims circulating online, the student accused the lecturer of sending inappropriate messages, allegedly pressuring her to meet him and threatening academic consequences if she refused.
The university, however, said no formal written complaint had so far been received from any student and that the committee would examine the screenshots, available information and other relevant records to establish the facts.
The student further claimed that she was allegedly offered better marks and grades and was repeatedly contacted through WhatsApp messages, SMS and phone calls.
She said she had retained records of the alleged communications and claimed that the matter had also been brought to the attention of the vice chancellor through email.
The allegations have not been independently verified.
Meanwhile, the KFUEIT administration said that some negative reports and claims concerning students and faculty members were circulating on social media. However, it said no formal written complaint had so far been received from any student in this regard.
Read More: 'I live in fear': 1.5 million Pakistani children sexually exploited online
The administration said it had constituted an inquiry committee to establish the facts surrounding the claims circulating online.
The committee would examine the available information, screenshots and other relevant records before submitting its recommendations to the university administration.
The university said that if a formal written complaint was submitted by a student or any other relevant person, the matter would be investigated in accordance with the applicable rules and procedures.
It added that necessary action would be taken if any violation was established.
The administration reiterated that providing students with a safe, healthy and conducive academic environment was among the university’s priorities.
It said matters relating to academic standards and student safety would be dealt with according to university rules and regulations.

items.author: Gaurav Bagur
items.content:
Virat Kohli-backed D2C fashion brand WROGN’s net loss surged 17.1% to ₹88.4 Cr in FY26 from ₹75.5 Cr in FY25. The youth-focused fashion brand’s loss increased despite an uptick in its top line performance during the fiscal year.
The startup, which is a portfolio brand of Aditya Birla Group’s TMRW, recorded a 9% uptick in its FY26 operating revenue to ₹243.9 Cr from ₹223.2 Cr recorded in FY25.
Including other income of ₹10.2 Cr, the startup’s total income for the fiscal year stood at ₹254 Cr.
In a statement, the startup said that FY26 EBITDA loss for the fiscal year improved 34% to ₹38 Cr from ₹54 Cr, delivering an 8.5-point margin gain.
It claimed to have opened FY27 on a strong note. It is targeting ₹600 Cr gross merchandise value (GMV) in the ongoing fiscal year after recording a 40% YoY uptick in Q1 GMV to ₹125 Cr.
WROGN said its owned channels – D2C sales and exclusive brand outlets (EBOs) – grew 120% YoY in the June quarter. These channels will be a key focus for WROGN in FY27 as the brand is targeting 100+ EBOs by March 2027 to “strengthen owned-channel economics and customer experience”.
It attributed this growth to a revamp of its store identity and operations as well as its sourcing and supply chain.
“While denim and shirts remain strong anchor categories, WROGN has also expanded into new categories built on robust R&D, design, and sourcing capability – with WROGN Active and Footwear (₹60 Cr ARR) already seeing strong consumer traction and scaling up rapidly,” it said.
Founded in 2014 by siblings Anjana and Vikram Reddy, WROGN is a men’s fashion brand which sells a wide range of casual wear, footwear and accessories. It sells the products via its own website, ecommerce platforms like Myntra, Flipkart, and Meesho, as well as the aforementioned offline channel.
While cricketer Virat Kohli is cited as a key co-creator and stakeholder of WROGN, ABFRL, via its roll-up arm TMRW, invested ₹125 Cr in WROGN to acquire a 16% stake in the brand. TMRW later doubled down on the brand with further investment, taking its total stake in WROGN to 32.84%. Besides, VC firm Accel is also an early backer of the startup.
Where Did WROGN Spend?
WROGN’s total expenses for FY26 rose in proportion with its revenue, growing around 9.5% to ₹342.4 Cr from ₹312.6 Cr in the year-ago period. Here’s where the brand spent the most:
Purchase Of Stock-In-Trade: Stock purchases increased 14.4% YoY to ₹141.2 Cr from ₹123.4 Cr in FY25, comprising its biggest expense.
Changes In Inventories Of Stock-In-Trade: As this line item featured a negative amount, the brand earned ₹21.4 Cr due to inventory accumulation during the year under review, as compared to spending ₹2.3 Cr in FY25.
Employee Benefits Expense: Employee related costs grew 13.6% YoY to ₹44.2 Cr from ₹38.9 Cr in the prior year.
Finance Costs: Spending under this line item climbed 36.1% YoY to ₹16.8 Cr from ₹12.4 Cr in FY25.
Depreciation And Amortisation Expense: Depreciation expenses surged 73.8% YoY to ₹14.5 Cr from ₹8.3 Cr in the year-ago period.
Other Expenses: The company’s other expenses accounted for a significant portion of its total spending, rising 15.5% YoY to ₹147.2 Cr from ₹127.4 Cr in the previous fiscal year.

items.content:
Ada sesuatu yang berbeda dari kolaborasi antara brand teknologi dan franchise hiburan. Biasanya, sebuah smartphone edisi khusus cukup mengganti warna bodi, menambahkan logo, kemudian memasukkan beberapa aksesori bertema ke dalam kotak penjualan. realme mengambil pendekatan yang sedikit lebih jauh lewat realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition.
Konteksnya juga cukup menarik. Harry Potter bukan hanya sekadar novel atau film, tapi juga jadi merek hiburan yang punya banyak penggemar dari semua generasi. Buku pertama terbit 1997, sementara filmnya mulai tayang pada 2001 dan kemudian diikuti total delapan film. Tahun 2026 menjadi penanda 25 tahun sejak film pertama membawa Hogwarts ke layar lebar.
Nah, kolaborasi realme dengan Warner Bros. Discovery Global Consumer Products ini berupaya membawa berbagai elemen khas dunia Hogwarts ke dalam sebuah smartphone, realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition. Bedanya dengan varian realme 16 Pro biasa adalah pada pengalaman yang mengelilingi perangkat tersebut. Mulai dari kemasan kolektor, desain bodi, material, perubahan warna, antarmuka, animasi, watermark kamera, hingga kemasan kolektor hingga lebih dari 10 Easter egg bertema Hogwarts.
Kemasan Kolektor realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition
realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition memang benar-benar dibuat untuk fans yang memburunya sebagai item koleksi. realme terlihat sangat serius dalam merancang kemasan edisi khusus tersebut. Ini penting karena pada produk edisi kolaborasi, kemasan bukan sekadar tempat menyimpan perangkat. Ia menjadi bagian dari alasan mengapa seseorang membeli versi khusus tersebut.
Paket penjualan realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition menjadi bagian dari pengalaman kolektornya melalui Hogwarts Limited Edition Collector’s Gift Set. Jika kita membeli edisi khusus ini, maka akan mendapatkan koper Hogwarts ikonik replika dengan ukuran 1:1 yang dibawa Harry Potter dan murid lainnya ketika sekolah kembali ke sekolah sihir. Ketika membuka kopernya itulah, kita mendapatkan “magic” berupa realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition.
Isi di dalam paket merchandisenya pun melimpah, mulai dari Container, Train Ticket, Bookmark, Acceptance Letter, dan Character Postcard. Juga terdapat phone case bernuansa Harry Potter. Bahkan Phone Pin untuk mengeluarkan SIM tray pun memakai logo Hogwarts.
Tonton video unboxing realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition
Desain
Begitu melihat perangkat ini, pendekatan realme terhadap desain Harry Potter langsung terlihat. Warna cokelat pada bodinya mengambil inspirasi dari atmosfer Hogwarts, lengkap dengan tekstur yang menyerupai kulit. Bagian kamera juga mendapatkan sentuhan khusus melalui dekorasi yang terinspirasi dari mata Hedwig.
Pada frame, terdapat ukiran laser bertuliskan “Welcome to Hogwarts” yang menjadi salah satu detail kecil tetapi cukup efektif memperkuat identitas edisi khusus ini. Namun detail yang paling menarik adalah teknologi yang disebut realme sebagai Quadra Light-Sensing Color-changing Tech.
Berdasarkan informasi yang kami terima, teknologi tersebut terinspirasi dari momen Sorting di dunia Harry Potter, ketika para siswa Hogwarts ditempatkan ke dalam salah satu dari empat House. Jadi, perubahan warna bukan sekadar efek visual, tetapi punya hubungan langsung dengan tema yang ingin dibawa realme.
Di bawah paparan sinar matahari atau ultraviolet, empat warna pada lambang Hogwarts dapat muncul secara bertahap, kemudian bisa menghilang secara bersamaan. Impresif sekali. Dan menurut saya, fitur semacam ini lebih menarik dibandingkan sekadar mencetak logo Harry Potter di bagian belakang. Sebab, desainnya memiliki elemen yang baru terlihat ketika smartphone berinteraksi dengan lingkungan. Dan untuk sebuah perangkat koleksi, detail seperti ini justru yang membuatnya berbeda.
Layar
Untuk urusan layar, realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition semua aspek di atas kertas sudah flagship-grade. Benar-benar memanjakan mata. Ukuran layarnya 6,78 inci yang cukup lapang untuk menampilkan berbagai konten. Meski demikian, dimensi smartphone tetap relatif kompak, berkat keempat sisi bezel tipisnya serta desain lengkung pada sisi tepi, membuatnya terasa lebih ramping dalam genggaman.
Spesifikasi realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition membawa panel AMOLED dengan refresh rate hingga 144Hz layaknya smartphone flagship gaming. Tingkat kecerahan puncak hingga 6.500 nit pada kondisi tertentu, dengan panel 10-bit dan dukungan HDR10+.
Praktis, layarnya mampu tampilkan warna dan kontras maksimal, bisa menyala sangat cerah di luar ruangan tanpa membuat mata jadi terasa kurang nyaman. Dan seperti smartphone realme Number Series pada umumnya, diberikan opsi penyesuaian warna sesuai selera, lengkap dengan in-display fingerprint sensor yang juga dapat diandalkan serta akurat. Secara umum, kualitas layar realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition sudah memuaskan, sesuai standar flagship.
Kamera 200 MP
Dibanding generasi sebelumnya, realme meningkatkan kualitas kameranya secara signifikan pada seri ini dengan memakai kamera utama 200MP ISOCELL HP5 dengan dimensi sensor besar 1/1,56 inci yang menghasilkan diafragma f/1.8, serta dukungan OIS.
Ditambah lagi terdapat kamera ultrawide 8MP dengan sudut pandang 112 derajat sebagai pendampingnya, sementara kamera depan menggunakan sensor 50MP. Untuk perekaman video, kamera belakang mampu merekam hingga 4K pada 30fps.
realme juga membawa sistem algoritma LumaColor yang merupakan hasil kolaborasi mendalam bersama TÜVRheinland.  Tujuannya untuk memastikan agar semua skenario foto termasuk portrait yang lebih maksimal, baik detail wajah, separasi dengan latar, hingga pencahayaan pada skenario lebih menantang seperti backlight.
Hasilnya, foto-foto yang dihasilkan dari kamera  realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition memang benar-benar memanjakan mata, dengan warna yang vibrant tanpa membuat skenario keseluruhan jadi kurang natural. Secara default, kamera menggunakan profil warna “vibrant”, dan kalau Gizmo friends mau lebih natural tanpa membuatnya terlalu pucat, bisa pakai profil warna “natural”. Masalah warna dan dynamic range, rasanya LumaColor IMAGE terbaru benar-benar bekerja optimal.
Satu fitur yang cukup relevan dengan tema edisi khusus ini adalah watermark kamera bertema empat asrama Hogwarts. Jadi, hasil foto yang diambil dengan perangkat ini pun dapat membawa identitas Harry Potter tanpa perlu menambahkan elemen tersebut secara manual.
Hasil foto kamera realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition
Hasil foto lainnya dari kamera realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition bisa dilihat di galeri album Google Photos
Antarmuka dan Fitur Unggulan
Sebagai edisi khusus, realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition sejumlah hal yang eksklusif dibanding versi reguler. Bukan hanya packaging saja yang melimpah dengan berbagai elemen khas Harry Potter, tetapi juga isi di dalamnya. realme memberikan wallpaper dan desain ikon khusus bertema Harry Potter. Bahkan, terdapat lebih dari 10 Easter egg tersembunyi yang berkaitan dengan dunia Hogwarts.
Ada pula elemen khusus seperti animasi booting, animasi charging, unlock animation, GT Mode, serta watermark kamera yang terinspirasi dari empat asrama Hogwarts. Di sinilah realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition terasa berbeda dari sekadar smartphone dengan desain belakang bertema Harry Potter. Ketika tema tersebut muncul kembali saat smartphone dinyalakan, diisi daya, membuka layar, mengambil foto, atau mengaktifkan mode tertentu, identitas kolaborasinya menjadi bagian dari penggunaan sehari-hari.
Buat penggemar biasa, mungkin ini hanya detail kecil. Tetapi bagi kolektor atau penggemar Harry Potter, justru detail kecil semacam ini yang kemungkinan paling bernilai. Meski demikian, akan lebih menarik lagi kalau kustomisasi tema tersebut bisa lebih fleksibel dengan pilihan yang bervariasi.
realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition sendiri menjalankan realme UI 7 berbasis Android 16. Smartphone ini dijanjikan untuk mendapatkan setidaknya tiga kali pembaruan versi OS dan empat tahun pembaruan keamanan rutin. Tampilan antarmukanya tidak hanya memanjakan mata dengan nuansa Harry Potter yang sangat kental, namun juga kaya akan fitur ekstra yang berguna.
Smartphone ini memiliki fitur AI Smart Loop juga sangat berguna saat multitasking, terutama kemampuannya untuk mengambil gambar langsung dari aplikasi Instagram dan langsung dibagikan ke aplikasi berikutnya, alih-alih mengambil screenshot dan melakukan cropping.
Masih banyak fitur AI bermanfaat lainnya seperti AI Gaming Coach yang bisa berikan tips hingga prediksi probabilitas kemenangan saat bermain game, AI Camera yang membantu framing hingga komposisi, AI Translate termasuk transkrip rekaman suara, sampai AI Writer untuk menyempurnakan tulisan atau bisa dianggap seperti memiliki asisten virtual untuk brainstorming. Editor fotonya juga benar-benar komplit, bisa menghapus pantulan atau flare, sempurnakan ekspresi wajah, hingga AI Portrait Glow yang bisa berikan tambahan pencahayaan di sekitar wajah secara natural.
Mau bikin konten visual lebih fun? Ada AI Edit Genie yang bisa mengubah gaya rambut, tampilan baju, sampai latar foto hanya dengan input perintah suara. Fitur satu ini disempurnakan dengan AI LightMe yang bisa berikan template pencahayaan menarik, hingga AI Style Me untuk ubah gaya foto menjadi a-la kartun atau emoji tiga dimensi. Membuat realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition hasilkan karya visual menarik tanpa harus mengunduh aplikasi tambahan.
Selain itu, smartphone ini juga dibekali sensor inframerah untuk kendali perangkat rumah, dua slot kartu nano-SIM, dan speaker stereo dengan kualitas yang tergolong baik meski bukan yang paling lantang atau jernih. Overall, fitur realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition tergolong sangat komplit, bahkan beberapa fitur yang dibawa langsung diturunkan dari lini flagship.
Kinerja
Secara fundamental, realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition menggunakan platform yang sama dengan realme 16 Pro. Pada dapur pacunya, perangkat ini menggunakan MediaTek Dimensity 7300 Max 5G.
Di atas kertas, chipset ini memang bukan kelas flagship. Tetapi konfigurasi tersebut tetap ditujukan untuk memberikan performa yang seimbang antara penggunaan harian, multitasking, kamera, hingga gaming. MediaTek Dimensity 7300 Max 5G adalah chipset kelas menengah atas berfabrikasi 4nm yang dioptimalkan untuk performa gaming stabil, multitasking mulus, dan efisiensi daya
Dalam penggunaan sehari-hari, akses aplikasi harian terasa mulus, termasuk ketika harus multitasking. Tidak ada lag yang mengganggu saat berpindah antar aplikasi, yang rasanya terbantu berkat jenis RAM dan memori yang tergolong kencang.
Meski demikian, pengguna tetap perlu menyadari bahwa ini adalah prosesor kelas menengah atas, bukan flagship. Sehingga perlu menyesuaikan ekspektasi saat ingin memainkan judul game favorit dalam fps dan kualitas grafis tinggi. Secara umum, performa realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition cukup lancar dan cepat, konsumsi daya efisien, serta optimal untuk pemrosesan AI.
Baterai 7.000mAh
Kalau ada satu spesifikasi hardware yang langsung terasa relevan untuk pengguna sehari-hari, baterai 7.000mAh adalah salah satunya. realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition menggunakan Titan Battery 7.000mAh dengan dukungan pengisian cepat 80W. realme juga menyediakan fitur seperti bypass charging dan reverse wired charging.
Untuk skenario penggunaan lebih ringan, realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition bisa mencapai dua hari penuh dengan mudah. Salah satu faktornya adalah realme UI terbaru yang mampu menekan konsumsi daya lebih efektif saat standby. Sehingga ketika tidak sedang menjalankan aplikasi yang berat, persentase baterai tidak cepat turun. Dan ketika baterai hampir habis, Super Power Saving Mode cukup menolong, untuk mencegah kemungkinan smartphone benar-benar habis daya.
Berkat dukungan 80W Ultra Charge, mengisi daya tergolong cepat, sekitar 30 menit saja sudah bisa mencapai lebih dari 60%, sementara untuk mencapai penuh butuh waktu sekitar 60 menit saja. Opsi lain seperti mematikan fitur fast charging, bypass charging, hingga memberikan limit hingga persentase tertentu juga hadir untuk memperpanjang masa pakai baterai perangkat. Dan realme sendiri memberikan klaim bila kesehatan baterai bakal tetap lebih dari 80%, meski sudah digunakan sampai 5 tahun.
Satu Lagi: realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition
Selain smartphone, kolaborasi realme X Harry Potter ini juga diperluas cakupannya ke TWS realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition. Pada produk ini, kemasannya pun diberi elemen Harry Potter baik case, earbuds case, dan lanyard.
Produk ini basisnya adalah realme Buds T500 Pro, sebuah earbuds yang memberikan pengalaman kelas flagship di harga kelas entry. Meski harganya terjangkau, namun fitur yang dibawanya sangat komplit mulai dari kemampuan untuk tersambung ke tiga perangkat, ANC yang bersifat adaptif, sampai kemampuan terjemah suara secara real-time. Dalam bodi yang kecil, klaim masa pakai baterainya juga jempolan.
Sertifikasi Hi-Res Audio juga sudah dibawa, secara teori memungkinkan pengguna untuk mendengarkan musik lebih jelas dengan lebih minim kompresi. Menariknya, ada dua fitur ekstra yang ditawarkan lewat realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition: MindFlow Mode serta AI Translation.
Mindflow Mode memberikan opsi lebih dari 10 ambient sound, seperti efek suara hujan, hembusan angin di hutan, atau nuansa berkemah di malam hari, bisa dipakai ketika ingin lebih fokus atau relaksasi. Sementara AI Translation memberikan kemampuan terjemah secara live, mendukung 34 bahasa, dan ditenagai oleh Google Gemini.
Meski bukan TWS kelas premium, realme Buds T500 Pro sudah menggunakan standar Bluetooth 6.1 dengan opsi latensi rendah 45ms, yang seharusnya bisa memberikan sambungan lebih stabil. Terdapat fitur Find My Earbuds yang bisa sedikit membantu ketika lupa meletakkan TWS di sekitar, hingga dukungan untuk tersambung ke tiga jenis perangkat sekaligus, tidak hanya perangkat rilisan realme, namun juga termasuk tablet hingga komputer.
realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition memberikan pengalaman audio kelas premium. Tidak hanya melalui driver besar 12,4mm berlapis material titanium, namun juga sertifikasi Hi-Res Audio plus dukungan codec LHDC. Cocok digunakan untuk mendengarkan musik atau nostalgia nonton franchise film Harry Potter.
Kesimpulan
Pendekatan yang menarik bagi realme untuk meningkatkan value produknya dengan rutin melakukan kolaborasi. Sebelumnya, realme 15 Pro Series hadir dalam edisi Game of Thrones dengan kelengkapan eksklusif dan jumlah terbatas. Lalu pada segmen flagship, ada realme GT 7 Dream Edition yang menggandeng Aston Martin Aramco F1.
Kini, kolaborasi tersebut berlanjut dengan Warner Bros. Discovery Global Consumer Products untuk sebuah produk yang terinspirasi dari Harry Potter. Sebagai franchise global yang memiliki jutaan penggemar yang tersebar di seluruh dunia, realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition tampil eksklusif dengan semangat “wizarding world”.
Jika kalian adalah fans, sudah jelas smartphone ini wajib dimiliki. Ada desain Hogwarts, dekorasi Hedwig, ukiran “Welcome to Hogwarts”, teknologi perubahan warna, UI khusus, Easter egg, animasi, watermark empat asrama, hingga collector set. Dan menurut saya, di situlah keberhasilan sebuah smartphone edisi kolaborasi seharusnya dinilai. Di luar itu, kemampuannya sama persis dengan realme 16 Pro versi reguler.

items.author: Web Desk
items.content:
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Monday assured Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian that Pakistan was determined to expand multisector cooperation during his visit to Tehran.
Iranian media outlet Press TV reported that Pezeshkian stated that Pakistan and Iran could meet many of their needs by tapping their "domestic and regional capabilities”.
Pezeshkian further noted that continued engagement between the two countries could further strengthen bilateral cooperation across all areas, adding that "US pressure on the region had contributed to greater convergence and interaction among Muslim countries".
“Pakistan is determined to further expand bilateral cooperation in trade, economy, tourism, politics, culture, and science,” Naqvi was in turn quoted as saying by Press TV.
🔴 Pakistan's Interior Minister Naqvi meets with Iran's President Pezeshkian in Tehran:
🔸 Pezeshkian:
🔺 Iran and Pakistan could meet many of their needs by tapping their domestic and regional capacities. pic.twitter.com/npmxpm8bq6
— Press TV 🔻 (@PressTV) September 21, 2026
Naqvi earlier met Iranian counterpart Eskandar Momeni and exchanged views on bilateral relations and the latest situation in the region.
In a post on X, the interior ministry noted that progress was reviewed in the meeting on the ongoing cooperation between the interior ministries of both countries in various sectors.
وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی کی ایرانی وزات داخلہ آمد، ایرانی ہم منصب اسکندر مومنی سے ملاقات
پاک ایران دوطرفہ تعلقات اور خطے کی تازہ ترین صورتحال پر تبادلہ خیال
ملاقات میں دونوں ممالک کی وزارت داخلہ کے درمیان مختلف شعبوں میں جاری تعاون پر پیش رفت کا جائزہ لیا گیا pic.twitter.com/bEjeAaTKj5
— Ministry of Interior GoP (@MOIofficialGoP) September 21, 2026
According to the ministry, Momeni stated that Naqvi's recent visit was "very beneficial" and thanked Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir for their efforts towards regional peace and stability.
He further added that Iran was grateful for Pakistan's "continuous efforts" to establish peace in the region.
Read: Naqvi to visit Tehran today for bilateral discussions: Iranian foreign ministry
The statement added that Naqvi said that "in the coming times, bilateral relations would become even stronger".
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi met Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni in Tehran to discuss bilateral ties, regional developments and cooperation between their ministries. Momeni thanked Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir for their efforts… pic.twitter.com/bA4xR7O1qo
— Pakistan TV (@PakTVGlobal) September 21, 2026
 
Pakistani government sources earlier told Anadolu that Naqvi, who has been actively involved in the mediation process alongside CDF Munir, would discuss matters related to attacks by the Yemeni Houthi group on Saudi Arabia's oil and economic infrastructure, and how to revive the stalled peace talks with the US.
Islamabad had already warned that the recent escalation in Yemen would further complicate the already complex regional scenario.
This was Naqvi's sixth visit to Tehran since the US and Israel launched war against Iran in February.
Read More: Pakistan plans fresh diplomatic push
Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei on Saturday said Naqvi’s visit to Tehran would focus on bilateral relations, and there was no plan to exchange any specific messages regarding mediation.
Pakistan has remained the primary mediator between Iran and the US throughout the war, and has maintained close contact with both sides.
The US and Iran signed the Islamabad memorandum of understanding in June and launched negotiations toward a final agreement. However, the talks later collapsed over disagreements on security guarantees and freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most strategic routes for global energy supplies and trade.
The US and Iran then exchanged military strikes in July.
Trump on Sunday said he was contemplating three possible paths for Iran: continue targeting it economically, destroy the regime or make a deal.
After securing a ceasefire in April, Pakistan hosted the first high-level direct talks between the US and Iran since they broke diplomatic ties in 1979.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Microsoft kedapatan sudah mengajukan permohonan paten iklan untuk Xbox berjudul “Contextually Aware Management of Interactive Software Application Access” ke kantor paten Amerika Serikat (USPTO) dengan nomor pengajuan 20260260258.
Kabar ini pertama kali diulas oleh Business Insider. Mengutip TechSpot, Senin (21/9/2026), dokumen tersebut menjelaskan sistem memungkinkan iklan tampil saat jeda gameplay, termasuk setelah pemain menyelesaikan level atau mencapai titik transisi tertentu dalam game.
Dalam paten itu, Microsoft menggambarkan mekanisme paten iklan untuk Xbox ini dapat memberikan imbalan kepada pemain setelah mereka menonton iklan yang ditawarkan sistem.
Konsep tersebut lebih dekat dengan model rewarded ads yang sudah lama digunakan di game mobile. Dalam model ini, pemain secara sukarela menonton iklan untuk memperoleh manfaat tertentu, seperti akses tambahan, bonus, atau keuntungan dalam permainan.
Paten Iklan untuk Xbox Muncul Saat Jeda Gameplay
Sebaliknya, sistem paten iklan untuk Xbox ini dirancang untuk memanfaatkan momen yang dianggap tidak terlalu mengganggu pengalaman bermain, misalnya setelah sebuah level selesai atau saat terjadi transisi tertentu.
Microsoft juga menjelaskan, sistem dapat mempertimbangkan konteks permainan dan aktivitas pemain sebelum menawarkan iklan.
Pendekatan ini menunjukkan upaya untuk mengurangi gangguan terhadap gameplay dibanding model iklan yang memaksa pemain berhenti di tengah permainan.
Apakah Xbox Pasti Akan Tampilkan Iklan di Game?
Belum tentu. Paten iklan untuk Xbox ini hanya menunjukkan sebuah ide sudah diajukan secara hukum, bukan bukti bahwa teknologinya akan benar-benar diterapkan. Dokumen ini juga tidak disebutkan terikat pada gim, layanan, atau produk Xbox tertentu.
Jak Connor, editor TweakTown menyebutkan paten ini bisa dibaca sebagai eksplorasi soal bagaimana model akses ber-iklan bisa bekerja, bukan sebagai tanda ilklan akan segera masuk ke gim Xbox dalam waktu dekat.
Belum Ada Konfirmasi Akan Digunakan di Xbox
Meski menarik perhatian, penting untuk dicatat bahwa dokumen tersebut masih berupa paten. Perusahaan teknologi sering mengajukan paten untuk berbagai ide dan teknologi yang pada akhirnya tidak pernah menjadi produk komersial. 
Microsoft sendiri belum mengumumkan rencana penerapan sistem ini pada konsol Xbox atau layanan gaming miliknya. Karena itu, keberadaan paten belum bisa dianggap sebagai konfirmasi bahwa iklan semacam ini akan segera hadir di platform Xbox.
Sejalan dengan Eksperimen Model Bisnis Baru
Meski belum ada pengumuman resmi, paten ini muncul di tengah berbagai eksperimen Microsoft terkait monetisasi layanan gaming. Sebelumnya, Xbox juga mulai menguji akses cloud gaming gratis yang didukung iklan. Model tersebut memungkinkan pemain mengakses layanan tertentu setelah menonton iklan terlebih dahulu.
Jika dikembangkan lebih lanjut, konsep dalam paten ini bisa menjadi bagian dari upaya Microsoft mencari sumber pendapatan tambahan di luar penjualan game, hardware, dan langganan Game Pass.
Untuk saat ini, dokumen tersebut lebih tepat dibaca sebagai petunjuk arah riset dan eksplorasi Microsoft daripada gambaran fitur yang pasti akan hadir di Xbox dalam waktu dekat.

items.author: Yasir Ali
items.content:
The Peshawar High Court (PHC) on Monday halted the forced deportation of Afghan students enrolled in various medical and dental colleges across Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa, issued notices to the concerned parties and sought their written replies within 14 days.
A division bench comprising Justice Waqar Ahmad and Justice Farah Jamshed was hearing a writ petition filed by 14 Afghan students. Advocate Waseemuddin Khattak appeared for the petitioners, while Assistant Attorney General Ishaq Khalil and National Database & Registration Authority Law Officer Muhammad Mubarak Jan represented the respondents.
Counsel for the petitioners informed the court that the students, all Afghan nationals, had been granted admission under the Afghan quota in different medical and dental colleges through the prescribed legal process. The Higher Education Commission (HEC) had also issued them no objection certificates (NOCs) to facilitate the grant of visas.
Read More: LHC extends stay for Afghan medics
The students are currently pursuing education in various disciplines. However, following the launch of the government’s repatriation plan for Afghan refugees, the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council (PMDC) issued notices on 31 July and 1 September cancelling the admissions of all Afghan students and directing them to return to their country.
Advocate Khattak argued that the cancellations were ordered without any show-cause notice, in clear violation of Article 25 of the Constitution as well as other constitutional provisions and international law. He further contended that the PMDC notices and letters contradicted the NOCs earlier issued by the HEC and that the Council lacked the authority to take such action.
The counsel also drew the court’s attention to a similar case in which the Lahore High Court, on September 11, had suspended the PMDC’s orders and directed Afghan students to continue their studies. He prayed that the authorities be restrained from harassing or pressuring the petitioners.
The bench stayed the forced deportation of the 14 students, issued notices to the respondents seeking replies within 14 days, and adjourned the matter to October 12. The court also directed that the petitioner Afghan students be allowed to continue their education in the meantime.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) has initiated the procurement of a spam protection system for its employees as part of efforts to strengthen the security of its internal email communications.
According to a procurement notice published on the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority (PPRA) portal, the telecom regulator has invited bids for the supply of a spam protection device along with employee licenses. The tender was advertised on September 4, 2026, with a bid submission deadline of September 21.
The proposed system is intended to improve the protection of official email accounts against potentially harmful communications, including phishing attempts, suspicious attachments, and messages designed to impersonate legitimate senders.
The procurement comes as email remains a common entry point for cyber threats targeting organizations, where attackers may attempt to obtain confidential information, steal login credentials, or introduce malicious software through deceptive messages.
New System to Protect Official Emails and Maintain Communication
The planned security solution is expected to filter unwanted messages and identify potentially dangerous content before it reaches employees’ inboxes.
According to the reported procurement details, the system is also intended to help maintain access to incoming official correspondence if PTA’s primary email service experiences a temporary disruption.
Such functionality could reduce the risk of important communications being lost or interrupted during an email service outage.
The employee licenses would extend the security solution to official accounts, providing protection across the authority’s internal email environment.
The procurement is specifically intended for PTA’s own communications infrastructure and should not be confused with systems designed to block fraudulent calls or spam text messages received by mobile subscribers.
The tender has been issued under reference number PTA/ICT/P63698/2026 through a competitive bidding process using the single-stage, one-envelope procedure. Bids were scheduled to close at 11 am on September 21, with opening scheduled for 11:30 am.
The available procurement information does not establish that a contract has been awarded or that the system has already been deployed.
The initiative represents a proposed addition to the regulator’s internal cybersecurity infrastructure, with its eventual implementation depending on completion of the procurement process.

items.title: Humanoid robot sales tally hit 7,000 globally last year
items.summary:
Around 7,000 humanoid robots were sold worldwide last year for industrial and professional service use, figures compiled by the International Federation of Robotics showed.
The relatively small number contrasts with forecasts for a boom in the coming years, particularly in China, the world's largest market for industrial robots, which last month showcased humanoid running and boxing at its robot games.
To qualify as humanoid under the IFR's criteria, a robot must have a human-like appearance and operate autonomously in an environment designed for humans. Legs are not required.
The IFR data, reviewed by Reuters ahead of publication, offer one of the first industry-wide measures of a technology that is attracting billions of dollars in investments and producing impressive demonstrations.
However, the numbers of humanoids remain "a fraction" of the overall robot population globally, Susanne Bieller, secretary general of Frankfurt-based IFR, told Reuters.
 Read More: Founder
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
Around 7,000 humanoid robots were sold worldwide last year for industrial and professional service use, figures compiled by the International Federation of Robotics showed.
The relatively small number contrasts with forecasts for a boom in the coming years, particularly in China, the world's largest market for industrial robots, which last month showcased humanoid running and boxing at its robot games.
To qualify as humanoid under the IFR's criteria, a robot must have a human-like appearance and operate autonomously in an environment designed for humans. Legs are not required.
The IFR data, reviewed by Reuters ahead of publication, offer one of the first industry-wide measures of a technology that is attracting billions of dollars in investments and producing impressive demonstrations.
However, the numbers of humanoids remain "a fraction" of the overall robot population globally, Susanne Bieller, secretary general of Frankfurt-based IFR, told Reuters.
 Read More: Founder of Chinese startup Spirit AI says robot brains set for 2027 breakthrough
This compares with around 542,000 regular industrial robots installed in 2024 and another estimated 199,000 service robots sold that year for use in transport, hospitality and cleaning.
FILE PHOTO: An engineer works on a Tiangong Omni humanoid robot in the research and testing area of the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center, also known as X-Humanoid, in Beijing, China, September 4, 2026. REUTERS
The 2025 data for industrial and service robots will be published September 24.
Bieller said that among humanoids sold in 2025, many were not doing productive work but were bought by research institutions or companies using them to generate data for improving AI models.
Carmakers, key early adopters, are running pilots with "single-digit or sometimes double-digit numbers of robots in their plants," Bieller said.
IFR has compiled robotics statistics for three decades, and has begun collecting humanoid data alongside its much larger industrial robot and service robot figures for the first time.
Bank of America Global Research estimates that 90,000 humanoid robots will be shipped this year and 1.2 million by 2030.
The IFR's tally is based on supplier and national industry association data, and excludes consumer and military humanoid robots, while medical robots are classified separately.

Engro Holdings Limited (“Engro Holdings”) today announced that the Board of Directors of Engro Corporation Limited (“Engro Corporation”) has approved Mr. Junaid Iqbal as the successor to Mr. Ahsan Zafar Syed for the role of President and CEO of Engro Corporation. Mr. Junaid Iqbal currently serves as Advisor to the CEO of Engro Holdings and, upon completion of Mr. Ahsan Zafar Syed’s term in April 2027, will assume the role of President and CEO.
The succession plan reflects Engro’s next phase of growth. Over six decades, Engro has built strong industrial businesses and developed deep capabilities in engineering, project development, execution, and governance. These businesses and capabilities remain the foundation of the Company’s success. Looking ahead, Engro sees opportunities to build on these strengths while creating new platforms for growth that can generate long-term value, attract capital, and continue addressing important needs in the economy.
Mr. Junaid Iqbal’s experience is aligned with this ambition. Across technology, finance, and media, he has built, scaled, and transformed businesses in complex environments. At Careem, he scaled the Pakistan business, led the Saudi Arabia market, and later served as Managing Director and Global Head of Careem Pay. Earlier, as CEO of Elixir Securities, he helped reposition the firm and worked on privatization transactions, including the Government’s USD 1 billion sale of a 40 percent stake in HBL. His experience in platform building, capital allocation, and partnership development complements Engro’s existing strengths and will support the Company’s next phase of growth as it looks to enhance its portfolio to deliver sustainable long-term returns.
The Board also thanked Mr. Ahsan Zafar Syed for his exceptional contributions, noting that he would continue to lead Engro Corporation for the rest of his term, as he has done with distinction. During his tenure, Engro Corporation has achieved significant milestones, including the Supplemental Implementation Agreement for EVTL, the reintegration of thermal assets into the portfolio, and key transactions including the Deodar and EPCL deals. Under his leadership, Engro Corporation was also consistently recognized among the leading companies on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Upon completion of his term, Mr. Ahsan Zafar Syed will be elevated as Counsel to the Chairman of Engro Holdings, enabling the Company to continue benefitting from his experience and institutional wisdom.
The coming months will support a structured and seamless leadership transition. During this period, Mr. Junaid Iqbal will engage closely with Engro’s businesses and operations, gaining a deep understanding of the organization and the collective contributions that drive its long-term success. Under Mr. Ahsan Zafar Syed’s mentorship, he will also contribute to key strategic priorities before formally assuming the role of President and CEO of Engro Corporation in April 2027. This transition reflects Engro’s longstanding commitment to thoughtful succession planning, strong corporate governance, and continuity of leadership.

items.content:
Foto Rosé BLACKPINK pegang iPhone 18 Pro menjadi perbincangan di media sosial. Sejumlah warganet menuding perangkat dalam foto promosi di Instagram pribadinya dan akun resmi Apple pada 10 September 2026 itu merupakan hasil editan digital atau AI.
Namun kontroversi tersebut akhirnya mendapat tanggapan langsung dari Rosé. Penyanyi asal Korea Selatan itu membantah, iPhone di dalam foto merupakan hasil editan digital.
Unggahan foto Rosé BLACKPINK pegang iPhone 18 Pro tersebut merupakan bagian dari kampanye “Shot on iPhone” yang mengiringi peluncuran single terbarunya, “New Trick”
Hal tersebut diungkap langsung oleh Rose dalam wawancara program Apple Music di The Zane Lowe Show. Awalnya, penyanyi APT ini menanggapi dengan bercanda.
Mengapa Foto Rosé BLACKPINK Pegang iPhone 18 Pro Disebut Editan AI?
“Dan ketika melihatnya, saya berpikir, ini memang terlihat seperti Photoshop. Jadi saya setuju,” ujar Rosé. Namun, ia membantah tegas bahwa wujud iPhone 18 Pro dalam fotonya adalah hasil rekayasa digital yang ditambahkan pakai AI.
Baca Juga: Ini Rahasia Apple Tingkatkan Performa iPhone 18 Pro
Rosé mengonfirmasi, unit ponsel tersebut benar-benar ia pegang secara fisik saat sesi pemotretan berlangsung. Ia menjelaskan bahwa proses penyuntingan (retouching) memang dilakukan karena posisi tangannya yang canggung.
“Aku harus mengakui, posisi jariku memang aneh di foto ini,” jelas pelantun lagu “New Trick” tersebut. “Anda bisa tahu ini asli karena jari saya terlihat aneh. Jadi, mereka mengedit posisi jariku untukku.”
Selain perbaikan pada bentuk jari, tim produksi juga melakukan pembersihan kosmetik pada bodi ponsel dalam foto Rose BLACKPINK pegang iPhone 18 Pro tersebut. “Kalau dilihat lebih dekat, ada seperti sidik jari di sana. Jadi, mereka berusaha menghilangkan sidik jari tersebut dan membuatnya terlihat bersih untuk diunggah,” tambah Rosé.
Pernyataan ini juga didukung langsung oleh Apple. Senior Vice President Apple, Greg Joswiak, memastikan keaslian perangkat burgundy dipegang sang artis. “Itu benar-benar asli. Bukan AI, dia benar-benar punya yang asli. Ini 100 persen asli,” tegas Joswiak.
Dari Kontroversi Viral ke Krisis Kepercayaan Foto Digital
Kasus foto Rose BLACKPINK pegang iPhone 18 Pro ini mungkin terlihat seperti kontroversi media sosial biasa. Namun di baliknya terdapat fenomena yang lebih besar.
Perkembangan teknologi AI generatif membuat publik semakin sulit membedakan mana foto asli dan mana gambar hasil manipulasi. Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, kualitas gambar yang dihasilkan AI meningkat pesat hingga mampu meniru pencahayaan, tekstur, hingga detail wajah secara meyakinkan.
Akibatnya, standar skeptisisme pengguna juga ikut berubah. Jika sebelumnya orang cenderung mempercayai foto sebagai bukti visual, kini banyak pengguna justru mempertanyakan keaslian sebuah gambar terlebih dahulu sebelum mempercayainya.
Ironisnya, perdebatan mengenai foto Rosé BLACKPINK pegang iPhone 18 Pro ini muncul ketika Apple baru saja memperkenalkan Apple Reference Image, sebuah teknologi yang dirancang untuk membantu memverifikasi keaslian foto digital.
Apple menjelaskan bahwa sistem tersebut memungkinkan foto tertentu menyimpan referensi yang dapat digunakan untuk memverifikasi bahwa gambar berasal dari sumber asli dan belum mengalami perubahan yang mengubah konteks visualnya secara signifikan.
Langkah tersebut menjadi bagian dari upaya industri teknologi untuk menghadapi meningkatnya penyebaran konten sintetis dan manipulasi berbasis AI.
Ketika Foto Asli Terlihat Seperti Hasil AI
Kasus Rosé dan iPhone 18 Pro memperlihatkan tantangan baru yang mulai muncul di era AI.
Jika sebelumnya perhatian lebih banyak tertuju pada bagaimana mendeteksi gambar palsu, kini muncul persoalan lain: foto asli pun bisa dianggap hasil manipulasi karena ekspektasi publik terhadap visual digital telah berubah.
Belum tentu semua tuduhan tersebut benar, tetapi fenomena ini menunjukkan bahwa kepercayaan terhadap foto digital tidak lagi otomatis diberikan seperti beberapa tahun lalu.
Pada akhirnya, kontroversi foto iPhone 18 Pro bersama Rosé mungkin akan segera berlalu. Namun diskusi yang muncul di sekitarnya menjadi pengingat bahwa di era AI, tantangan terbesar bukan hanya membuat foto terlihat nyata, melainkan juga meyakinkan publik bahwa foto yang nyata memang benar-benar asli.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Selain fitur yang serba komplit hingga kemampuan AI canggih, salah satu alasan utama konsumen memilih akan sebuah perangkat flagship tidak lain adalah agar bisa digunakan untuk jangka panjang. Namun tidak hanya spesifikasi di atas kertas saja yang harus diperhatikan—dukungan pembaruan perangkat lunak juga menjadi penting. Dan Samsung Galaxy S26 FE hadir membawa kombinasi terbaik agar dapat digunakan hingga bertahun-tahun lamanya.
Baca Juga: Edit Foto Lebih Praktis di Samsung Galaxy S26 FE dengan Photo Assist
Ya, Samsung menghadirkan Galaxy S26 FE sebagai opsi yang lebih terjangkau pada lini Galaxy S26 Series. Walau begitu, fitur yang dihadirkan tidak kalah lengkap mulai dari fitur kamera berbasis AI seperti My Fancam hingga stabilisasi kelas atas setara aksesori tambahan seperti gimbal. Menariknya lagi, Galaxy S26 FE justru hadir sebagai Galaxy S pertama dengan Android 17 dan One UI 9 sejak awal perangkat dinyalakan.
Tentunya hal tersebut menjadikan Samsung Galaxy S26 FE memiliki nilai plus tersendiri, pas untuk Gizmo friends yang mencari sebuah perangkat pendamping aktivitas harian dengan masa pakai jauh lebih lama. Agar dapat terasa seperti sebuah investasi yang pas di tengah kenaikan harga komponen yang terbilang cukup masif sepanjang tahun ini.
Mengapa Jaminan Pembaruan Software Menjadi Sangat Penting
Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, Flagship yang Pas Untuk Jangka Panjang. (Gizmologi/ Prasetyo Herfianto)
Seperti flagship Samsung terbaru lainnya, Galaxy S26 FE siap mendapatkan hingga tujuh generasi pembaruan OS dan hingga tujuh tahun pembaruan keamanan rutin. Masing-masing dari keunggulan tersebut membawa benefit yang sangat besar, terutama bagi Gizmo friends yang memang ingin terus menggunakan smartphone yang sama tanpa harus upgrade dalam periode waktu lebih singkat.
Dengan kata lain, pengguna Galaxy S26 FE bisa terus menikmati smartphone mereka sembari terus mendapatkan versi Android terbaru, setidaknya hingga versi Android 24. Apa saja keuntungannya? Tidak lain adalah fitur-fitur baru yang siap hadir dari masa ke masa, baik fitur yang dihadirkan lewat Google, maupun fitur eksklusif dari Samsung. Memberikan pengalaman software yang lebih andal ke depannya.
Tampilan bodi belakang Samsung Galaxy S26 FE. (Gizmologi/ Prasetyo Herfianto)
Sementara pembaruan keamanan rutin juga tidak kalah penting—ketika spesifikasi hardware sudah dirancang optimal agar tetap mulus dan lancar digunakan sampai bertahun-tahun ke depan, benefit tersebut akan terasa percuma ketika tidak dibarengi dengan pembaruan keamanan, yang bisa membuat aplikasi tidak kompatibel karena versi keamanan bukan yang terbaru.
Sehingga pada masa pemakaian tahun ketujuh sampai berikutnya pun, pengguna Galaxy S26 FE masih tetap dapat mengakses aplikasi harian mereka seperti aplikasi berkirim pesan maupun media sosial, tanpa harus takut tidak bisa mengaksesnya akibat versi software terlalu lama. Smartphone juga akan terus terlindungi dari risiko keamanan yang tentunya selalu ada celah baru setiap waktu.
Galaxy S26 FE Hadir dengan One UI 9 dan Kecerdasan Galaxy AI Komplit
One UI 9 di Galaxy S26 FE. (Gizmologi/ Prasetyo Herfianto)
Selain mendapatkan jaminan pembaruan jangka panjang dan paling superior di segmennya, Samsung Galaxy S26 FE juga hadir secara langsung membawa One UI versi terbaru, yakni One UI 9. Membawa Galaxy AI dengan fitur cerdas yang sangat komplit, mempermudah produktivitas hingga kreasi konten berkualitas dengan lebih mudah.
Mulai dari My FanCam yang memungkinkan pengguna untuk fokus ke satu orang dalam sebuah video performance beramai-ramai dengan framing yang pas, Audio Eraser yang mampu menghapus suara bising atau noise dalam sebuah video agar suara lokal obyek utama terdengar lebih jelas, hingga Photo Assist yang kini memungkinkan kamu untuk lakukan proses edit foto hanya menggunakan input teks dengan bahasa kasual sekalipun.
Tampak bagian belakang Galaxy S26 FE. (Gizmologi/ Prasetyo Herfianto)
Ingin scan dokumen penting? Tak perlu gunakan aplikasi pihak ketiga, karena fitur Document Scan langsung tersedia dan bisa meningkatkan hasil scan otomatis termasuk lipatan sudut hingga gangguan seperti jari yang masuk ke dalam frame. Dan tentu saja fitur seperti Circle to Search, hingga gratis berlangganan Google AI Pro selama 6 bulan yang sudah termasuk dengan penyimpanan cloud 5TB senilai Rp1,8 juta.
Semua poin di atas membuat harga yang ditawarkan oleh Samsung untuk Galaxy S26 FE terasa lebih worth-it, di mana Gizmo friends bisa mendapatkan sebuah pengalaman flagship dalam harga lebih terjangkau. Dibanderol dengan harga promo mulai Rp9,249 juta, membawa jaminan software update maupun security update dalam waktu yang sangat panjang, secara teori memberikan biaya kepemilikan per tahun yang lebih baik.

Namun, peningkatan kapasitas tersebut juga menghadirkan persoalan dalam distribusi global karena baterai lithium dengan kapasitas sel di atas 20Wh memiliki aturan pengiriman yang lebih ketat.
Salah satu cara yang selama ini digunakan produsen adalah membagi baterai menjadi beberapa sel agar masing-masing tetap berada di bawah batas tersebut. Informasi tersebut tercantum pada halaman dukungan iPhone 18 Pro Max. Apple menjelaskan bahwa perangkat menggunakan pembatasan pengisian daya yang membuat kapasitas baterai berada di bawah ambang 20Wh selama proses p
items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Kapasitas baterai smartphone flagship terus meningkat dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, salah satunya berkat penggunaan teknologi silicon-carbon yang memungkinkan sel baterai memiliki kepadatan energi lebih tinggi. Namun, peningkatan kapasitas tersebut juga menghadirkan persoalan dalam distribusi global karena baterai lithium dengan kapasitas sel di atas 20Wh memiliki aturan pengiriman yang lebih ketat.
Salah satu cara yang selama ini digunakan produsen adalah membagi baterai menjadi beberapa sel agar masing-masing tetap berada di bawah batas tersebut. Pilihan lainnya adalah membuat versi dengan kapasitas lebih kecil untuk pasar tertentu. Apple justru menggunakan pendekatan berbeda pada iPhone 18 Pro Max dengan menerapkan pembatasan berbasis software selama proses pengiriman.
Informasi tersebut tercantum pada halaman dukungan iPhone 18 Pro Max. Apple menjelaskan bahwa perangkat menggunakan pembatasan pengisian daya yang membuat kapasitas baterai berada di bawah ambang 20Wh selama proses pengiriman. Setelah iPhone pertama kali dinyalakan, pembatas tersebut dapat dinonaktifkan sehingga pengguna bisa memanfaatkan kapasitas baterai secara penuh.
Baca Juga: iPhone 18 Pro Max dan iPhone Duo Lolos Postel Komdigi, Ini Bocoran Harganya
Baterai iPhone 18 Pro Max Tembus 20Wh
Untuk model iPhone 18 Pro Max dengan eSIM yang dijual di Amerika Serikat, kapasitas baterainya tercatat sebesar 5.567 mAh atau 21,75Wh. Sementara versi yang memiliki slot SIM fisik di Eropa memiliki kapasitas 5.391 mAh atau 21,06Wh. Keduanya secara kapasitas terukur tetap berada di atas batas 20Wh.
Angka tersebut merupakan kapasitas rated, sehingga tidak bisa dibandingkan secara langsung dengan angka typical capacity yang biasanya digunakan produsen smartphone Android. Perbedaan metode pengukuran tersebut penting diperhatikan agar kapasitas baterai antarperangkat tidak dibandingkan hanya berdasarkan angka mAh.
Software Jadi Solusi Sementara Aturan Pengiriman
Metode Apple tersebut dimungkinkan setelah regulator transportasi Amerika Serikat mengizinkan metode pengiriman semacam ini pada Juni 2025. Namun, sejumlah badan regulasi internasional seperti ADR, IATA, dan ICAO belum secara resmi memberikan posisi yang sama berdasarkan informasi yang tersedia. Apple juga memungkinkan fitur pembatasan tersebut diaktifkan kembali jika pengguna ingin mengirim perangkat ke luar negeri.
Persoalan ini kemungkinan tidak berhenti pada iPhone. Dalam pembahasan PBB pada 2026, muncul proposal mengenai baterai single-cell yang menilai batas 20Wh saat ini semakin kurang relevan terhadap perkembangan teknologi baterai.
