items.author: Asif Mehmood
items.content:
Lambeth Palace, the London residence and office of the Archbishop of Canterbury, has withdrawn the Hubert Walter Award for Reconciliation and Interfaith Cooperation 2026, days after presenting it to Pakistan Ulema Council Chairman Hafiz Muhammad Tahir Mahmood Ashrafi, citing previous comments over Osama bin Laden.
Ashrafi was presented with the award on the 25th anniversary of 9/11 at a ceremony held at Lambeth Palace in London in recognition of his services to interfaith reconciliation and cooperation.
Read: Tahir Ashrafi receives Hubert Walter Award for reconciliation, interfaith cooperation in London
The comment that led to the withdrawal dated back to 2007, when Ashrafi said he would confer the title “Saifullah”, meaning “Sword of God”, on then-Al Qaeda chief Osama bin Laden — the orchestrator of the Sept 11 attacks — in protest against Britain awarding a knighthood to writer Salman Rushdie, whose book he described as blasphemous.
In a video statement posted on X regarding the withdrawal, Ashrafi said some of his statements had been presented "out of context" and that the decision to withdraw the award was based on them. He alleged that an “Indian and Ahmadi lobby” had played a role in the decision.
حافظ محمد طاہر محمود اشرفی نے کہا: “ہم ناموسِ رسالت ﷺ، عقیدۂ ختمِ نبوت اور اپنی اسلامی اقدار پر قائم تھے، قائم ہیں اور قائم رہیں گے؛ اور اسی مضبوطی کے ساتھ امن، مکالمے، بین المذاہب ہم آہنگی اور ہر انسان کے جائز حقوق کے لیے اپنی جدوجہد بھی جاری رکھیں گے۔ ایوارڈ ہونا یا نا ہونا… pic.twitter.com/TUfgq4tz8r
— TahirMahmoodAshrafi حافظ محمد طاهراشرفى (@TahirAshrafi) September 17, 2026
He said the Office of the Archbishop of Canterbury had sought clarification from him before withdrawing the award over several matters, including Pakistan’s blasphemy law, Salman Rushdie, Osama bin Laden and his wife’s hijab.
Ashrafi said he had clarified that he supported retaining the blasphemy law but opposed its misuse.
Explaining an earlier statement about Osama bin Laden, he said he was opposed to the use of religion for terrorism and had cited “Saifullah” as an example at the time.
Regarding his previous remarks about Salman Rushdie, Ashrafi said he could not retract the statement and would not withdraw from his views.
Read More: Religious leadership must play active role in ending wars, global peace: Ashrafi
A statement issued by Lambeth Palace on Sept 17 said interfaith dialogue and cooperation required engagement “across deeply-held differences”.
“It is a longstanding principle of interfaith dialogue and co-operation that we must engage with one another across deeply-held differences, and that remains the case,” it said.
“However, previous comments made by Imam Ashrafi have come to light that have led Lambeth Palace to reconsider this award, and we can now confirm today that the award has been withdrawn.”
Church of Pakistan honours Ashrafi
In a related development, the Church of Pakistan honoured Ashrafi on Friday with a Global Peace Award for his services to peace, interfaith harmony and religious tolerance.
President of the Church of Pakistan Bishop Azad Marshall presented the award to Ashrafi at a ceremony in Lahore.
According to the Church of Pakistan, the award recognised his services in promoting peace, religious harmony, dialogue among followers of different faiths and protection of the rights of non-Muslim citizens.
 
Church of Pakistan honours Hafiz Muhammad Tahir Mehmood Ashrafi with Global Peace Award https://t.co/1RPXQeHCdT
— TahirMahmoodAshrafi حافظ محمد طاهراشرفى (@TahirAshrafi) September 18, 2026
Bishop Marshall said Ashrafi had continued to play a role in promoting dialogue and harmony among followers of different religions in Pakistan. He also appreciated his efforts for interfaith peace and harmony at national and international levels.
After receiving the award, Ashrafi thanked the Church of Pakistan and Bishop Marshall.
He said that under Bishop Marshall’s leadership, the Church of Pakistan was working with leaders of different religions and Muslim schools of thought for peace, national security and stability in Pakistan.
Ashrafi said joint efforts by Muslim and non-Muslim religious leaders through the National Paigham-e-Peace Committee would further strengthen peace, interfaith and sectarian harmony and national unity in Pakistan.
He also expressed his resolve to continue working for peace, religious harmony and the protection of the legitimate rights of all Pakistanis.

Tokenisation involves converting ownership rights
items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pakistan’s growing virtual asset sector could create new opportunities for freelancers and other digital workers to receive international earnings through formal financial channels. The Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (PVARA) has started issuing no-objection certificates (NoCs) to major global crypto exchanges. Binance and HTX are among the global exchanges that have received NoCs, while PVARA has reportedly received around 70 more applications from international digital asset platforms seeking regulated operations in Pakistan.
The increased interest from global exchanges could help expand Pakistan’s digital asset ecosystem. Potential areas include virtual asset trading, investment, custody, tokenisation and blockchain-based financial services, subject to regulatory approval.
Pakistan Moves to Regulate Global Crypto Exchanges as Freelancer Earnings Rise
Tokenisation involves converting ownership rights in a real-world asset, such as property, artwork or company shares, into digital tokens that can be recorded on a blockchain.
Gracy Chen, CEO of Bitget, said the interest from international digital asset companies reflects the policy steps being taken by the government and regulators. She said a regulated virtual asset sector could also support Pakistan’s wider digital economy, particularly freelancers, software developers, remote workers and other professionals earning money from international clients.
According to Chen, regulated platforms could potentially provide faster ways for digital workers to settle international earnings and convert digital assets into local currency. However, such services would depend on applicable regulations, foreign exchange rules, anti-money laundering requirements and banking arrangements.
She also stressed the importance of establishing compliant links between licensed virtual asset service providers, banks and payment companies. Such arrangements would be necessary if digital exchanges are to play a larger role in international payments.
Pakistan has nearly three million freelancers, making it one of the world’s major freelance markets. State Bank of Pakistan data cited in the report showed that Pakistani freelancers generated a record $1.76 billion in foreign exchange during the 2025-26 financial year.
Despite this growth, freelancers continue to face challenges when receiving international payments. Pakistan Freelancers Association (PAFLA) Chairman Ibrahim Amin said the role of international digital exchanges should go beyond cryptocurrency trading and tokenisation.
Amin said regulated platforms could potentially help connect Pakistan’s digital workforce with international financial infrastructure. They could also help freelancers receive payments more quickly and potentially lower transaction costs, provided compliant banking and payment arrangements are available.
See Also: Pakistan restricts govt employees from uploading sensitive data to public AI tools
He added that many Pakistani freelancers are young technology professionals who are already familiar with cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and international investment products. According to him, freelancers with higher earnings could also benefit from access to more regulated savings and investment options, including global equities and digital assets where permitted.
However, digital exchanges cannot automatically operate as international payment providers simply because they receive regulatory approval. Their ability to handle freelancer payments will depend on the activities allowed under their licences, foreign exchange regulations and their relationships with banks and payment institutions.
A regulated virtual asset market could nevertheless give Pakistan another channel for bringing digital earnings into the formal financial system. As the country’s freelance and technology workforce continues to expand, the development of compliant digital financial services could become an important part of the wider digital economy.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The next generation of flagship smartphones could become more expensive as chip manufacturers move to advanced 2nm technology in chips. New reports suggest that some upcoming flagship processors could cost smartphone makers more than $200 per unit.
According to Taiwanese business publication TaiSounds, MediaTek’s upcoming Dimensity 9600 Pro could cost as much as $220 per unit. If accurate, this would make it the most expensive flagship smartphone chip from MediaTek so far.
The reported price would also represent an increase over the previous-generation Dimensity 9500. Earlier industry reports estimated that chip’s cost at around $180 to $200 per unit.
2nm Flagship Chips Could Make High-End Smartphones More Expensive – Here’s Why
However, these figures are not official prices. MediaTek does not normally publish the prices it charges smartphone manufacturers. The actual cost can vary depending on agreements between the chipmaker and individual phone companies.
The higher price is linked partly to the move to TSMC’s 2nm manufacturing process. Smaller manufacturing nodes can improve chip efficiency and performance, but they can also increase production costs.
Early benchmark results for the Dimensity 9600 Pro suggest that the new processor may not deliver a major performance increase over its predecessor. However, it could offer noticeable improvements in power efficiency.
See Also: OpenAI Deepens Samsung Partnership to Develop Next-Generation AI Chips
Qualcomm and Apple Chips Could Cost Even More
MediaTek may not be the only chipmaker facing higher costs. The report claims that Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro could cost between $240 and $260 per unit.
Apple’s upcoming A20 Pro chip is also reportedly priced at around $260. If these estimates prove accurate, several major flagship processors could cross the $200 mark for the first time.
The rising cost of flagship chipsets could put additional pressure on smartphone manufacturers. Companies such as Apple, Samsung and other major brands will have to decide whether to absorb the higher component costs or pass some of them on to customers.
A more expensive processor does not automatically mean that smartphone prices will rise by the same amount. Manufacturers consider many other factors, including displays, cameras, memory, batteries, software and marketing costs when setting final prices.
For now, the reported chipset prices remain unconfirmed. However, if the estimates are accurate, the shift to 2nm technology could become another factor affecting the price of high-end smartphones in the coming generation.

items.author: Gaurav Bagur
items.content:
Identity and access management startup OTPless has elevated cofounders Satyam Nathani and Tanmay Sagar as CEO and COO, respectively, as incumbent CEO Bhavik Koladiya steps away.
Koladiya told Inc42 that he plans to retire but did not comment further on his future plans.
Under the new leadership structure, Nathani will lead the startup’s strategy and expansion, while Sagar will oversee its operations and execution. OTPless said the appointments come as it looks to expand its offerings across authentication, identity, and payments.
In a LinkedIn post announcing the leadership transition, Koladiya described his entrepreneurial journey as “exhilarating and exhausting”. He also expressed confidence in Nathani and Sagar leading OTPless through its next phase of growth.
Before joining OTPless, Koladiya cofounded fintech unicorn BharatPe and later founded VC firm Finix Partners.
OTPless was founded in 2021 by Nathani and Sagar, with Koladiya taking charge as CEO in January 2023. Nathani and Sagar were founding members of BharatPe.
The Bengaluru-based startup helps consumer internet enterprises offer authentication services through its SDKs and APIs. Its offerings include silent network authentication, WhatsApp authentication, device intelligence, and passkeys.
These offerings are aimed at reducing dependence on OTPs, PINs, and passwords while enabling enterprises to identify users, prevent fraud, and improve conversion during sign-ups and transactions.
OTPless claims to authenticate more than 300 Mn mobile users and serve enterprises including Meesho, Navi, PhysicsWallah, ShareChat, Shiprocket, ixigo, and Zepto.
It said it has reached ₹36 Cr in annualised revenue, representing a 2.5X increase over the previous year. The startup also claimed to have been profitable for the past two quarters.
OTPless has raised over $6 Mn to date from Venture Highway, White Venture, FJ Labs, SIDBI , Piper Serica, among others.
It last raised $3.5 Mn in a pre-Series A funding round led by SIDBI in May 2024. At the time, OTPless said it would use the capital to expand globally and extend its product suite beyond authentication into authorisation.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
BYD, the world’s No. 1 NEV brand, in partnership with Mega Motor Company (MMC), is showcasing the next chapter of new energy mobility in Pakistan at the Pakistan Auto Show (PAPS) 2026, bringing together electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles alongside the introduction of a new brand and a range of genuine BYD accessories designed to enhance the ownership experience. At the centre of the showcase is the BYD SEALION 6, which is planned to become BYD’s first locally assembled vehicle in Pakistan, with production targeted to commence in Q4 2026.
The entire lineup at PAPS 2026 features the BYD ATTO 2 – Pakistan’s most popular electric vehicle; the BYD SHARK 6 Anniversary Edition in Outback Orange; the BYD SEALION 6 – Pakistan’s first locally assembled BYD; and BYD’s luxury technology brand, DENZA, with the B8. Together, the lineup showcases BYD’s confidence in the Pakistan market, highlighting the breadth of its New Energy portfolio and the growing choice available to consumers beyond conventional powertrains.
The BYD SEALION 6 represents a particularly significant step in this evolution, building on the global success of BYD’s Super DM (Dual Mode) technology, which has surpassed 8.5 million vehicles sold worldwide. Powered by BYD’s Super DM-I (Dual Mode – intelligence) platform, its latest-generation intelligent hybrid system, the SEALION 6 combines the benefits of electric driving with the flexibility of a plug-in hybrid, offering a total range of up to 1,100 km. Designed to deliver an EV-led driving experience, Super DM-i intelligently manages electric and hybrid power to achieve strong fuel efficiency without compromising performance. The technology is designed to address the practical realities of everyday driving in Pakistan, providing efficient electric mobility while reducing range concerns on longer journeys.
The model’s planned local assembly will commence from Q4 2026 and will mark an important transition for BYD-MMC, from bringing global NEV innovation to Pakistan to establishing a local production footprint. It also reflects the broader evolution of Pakistan’s automotive market, as consumer demand expands from conventional vehicles towards a wider spectrum of electrified mobility solutions.
“Pakistan has shown strong potential for new energy mobility, and the response to BYD since our entry into the market has reinforced our confidence in the country,” said Lei Jian, Country Head – BYD Pakistan. “PAPS provides an opportunity to demonstrate not only the breadth of our current technology and products, but also where we are heading. The planned local assembly of the BYD Sealion 6 is an important step in building a long-term presence in Pakistan and supporting the country’s transition towards new energy mobility.”
Danish Khaliq, VP Sales & Strategy, BYD Pakistan – Mega Motor Company (MMC), said:
“Over the last two years, the Pakistani mobility market has shown us that consumers are ready to embrace new technologies and experience what the world has to offer. Our PAPS lineup reflects that evolution — from pure electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids to the introduction of a new luxury brand from the BYD universe. The BYD SEALION 6 takes this evolution one step further by bringing localisation into the equation. As we move towards local assembly, we are not simply expanding our portfolio; we are helping shape what the next generation of mobility in Pakistan can look like.”
BYD’s showcase will be available to experience at the Pakistan Auto Show (PAPS) 2026 from 18 September to 20 September in Hall no. 2 at the Expo Center in Lahore. As part of the PAPS 2026 offer, all orders booked at the BYD pavilion during the show will be eligible for 1st Year Free Service, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Government employees have been barred from uploading classified documents, official emails, software source code, and citizens’ personal information to publicly available artificial intelligence tools.
The restrictions are part of the National Cyber Security Handbook 2026-27, issued by the National Cyber Emergency Response Team under the Pakistan Information Security Framework 2026.
The handbook warns that sharing sensitive information with public AI platforms could expose government and personal data to leaks and unauthorized use.
Under the new guidelines, government officials will only be allowed to use AI tools and platforms approved by their respective departments. Employees have also been instructed to remove names and other sensitive information from prompts and files before submitting them to AI systems.
Officials have further been prohibited from sharing passwords, administrative login credentials, and API keys with AI tools.
The guidelines also prohibit the installation of unauthorized AI extensions and plug-ins on government devices.
Any accidental disclosure of confidential information through an AI tool must be reported immediately to the relevant IT or cybersecurity team.
The handbook also requires officials to review AI-generated content for accuracy and security before using it for official purposes. AI-generated material cannot be used in government work without human oversight.
The new guidelines place the use of AI in government affairs under three key principles: security, privacy, and human oversight.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pakistan’s cellular mobile operators have failed to meet several prescribed quality benchmarks, with mobile broadband emerging as the most significant area of concern, according to the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority’s (PTA) independent Quality of Service (QoS) survey for the second quarter of 2026.
The survey, conducted between April and June across 11 cities, found considerable differences in network coverage, internet speeds, latency, voice calls, and SMS services among Jazz, Zong, Ufone, and Telenor.
While operators demonstrated high compliance in several areas, the findings identified persistent shortcomings in mobile broadband performance, with overall compliance reaching just 85 percent. Coverage compliance stood at 98%, followed by SMS at 97% and voice services at 92%.
The assessment was conducted under the Cellular Mobile Network Quality of Service Regulations, 2021, which require operators to meet or exceed prescribed performance standards.
Jazz recorded the highest overall compliance, meeting 130 of the 132 assessed KPIs, while falling short on two. Zong followed with 128 compliant KPIs and four non-compliant indicators.
Ufone met 121 benchmarks but failed 11, while Telenor recorded the lowest overall compliance, meeting 112 indicators and missing 20.
The findings indicate that the extent of non-compliance varied considerably across operators and surveyed locations.

Mobile broadband recorded the lowest compliance rate at 85%, followed by voice services at 92%. SMS services achieved 97% compliance, while network coverage recorded the highest rate at 98%.
In terms of 4G coverage, Jazz, Zong, and Ufone met the prescribed signal-strength benchmark in all 11 surveyed cities. Telenor achieved compliance in only five cities.
Jazz leads download speeds; Zong dominates uploads
Jazz recorded the strongest performance in mobile broadband download throughput under auto-mode testing, securing the highest speeds in nine of the 11 cities.
Zong led download throughput in the remaining two cities, while Ufone and Telenor occupied the third and fourth positions, respectively, in the survey’s overall performance ordering.
The positions were reversed for upload throughput, where Zong secured first place in seven cities and Jazz led in four.
Third-party application testing reflected a broadly similar pattern. Jazz achieved the highest download throughput in eight cities, compared with three for Zong.
In third-party upload testing, Zong led in six cities, followed by Jazz in four.

The assessment also identified gaps in latency performance, a key measure of the time taken for data to travel between a user’s device and a network destination.
Under auto-mode testing, Zong achieved latency compliance in all 11 cities, followed by Jazz in 10.
Ufone met the prescribed threshold in seven cities, while Telenor achieved compliance in six. This meant Ufone and Telenor failed the applicable latency benchmark in four and five cities, respectively.

Voice services showed comparatively strong results for Jazz, which met all 55 assessed KPIs without recording a single instance of non-compliance.

PTA conducts extensive field testing across 11 cities
According to the authority, the survey involved 33 days of field testing and more than 2,000 kilometres of travel.
The exercise included approximately 27,300 voice call and SMS tests, alongside around 190,000 samples collected to evaluate mobile broadband performance.
The assessment covered Peshawar, Abbottabad, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Lahore, Multan, Faisalabad, Quetta, Hub, Sukkur and Karachi West.
PTA said the survey routes were selected to cover the maximum population area of the respective cities, while statistically significant samples were collected to evaluate critical network performance parameters.
The authority reiterated that cellular mobile operators are required to meet or exceed the quality benchmarks prescribed under the 2021 regulations.
The findings provide a city-level assessment of operator performance, identifying areas where network coverage and service quality remain below regulatory standards.

Pakistan’s mobile phone imports declined 8.85 percent during the first two months of the current fiscal year, falling to $274.129 million from $300.741 million in the corresponding period of last fiscal year, according to data released by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS).
In rupee terms, mobile phone imports decreased 10.53 percent to Rs76.267 billion during July-August 2026, compared to Rs85.245 billion during the same period of 2025.
On a year-on-year basis, mobile phone imports also registered a decline of 13.82 percent in August 2026, falling to $133.695 million from $155.129 million in August 2025.
On a month-on-month basis, imports of mobile phones declined 4.80 percent in August 2026 compared to $140.434 million in July 2026.
In contrast, Pakistan’s demand for telecom infrastructure remained relatively strong during the period under review, with imports of telecom equipment increasing 8.95 percent to $432.044 million during July-August 2026, compared to $395.536 million in the corresponding period of last year.
In rupee terms, telecom equipment imports rose 6.95 percent to Rs120.211 billion during the first two months of the current fiscal year, compared to Rs112.398 billion during the same period of last year.
The increase in telecom equipment imports comes amid continued investment in the country’s telecom infrastructure, including network expansion and preparations for the rollout of next-generation mobile services.
However, on a year-on-year basis, telecom equipment imports declined 3.42 percent to $197.269 million in August 2026 from $204.263 million in August 2025.
On a month-on-month basis, telecom equipment imports fell 15.98 percent in August 2026 compared to $234.775 million in July 2026.
The contrasting trends indicate a shift in the composition of telecom-related imports, with infrastructure and network equipment continuing to generate significant import demand, while handset imports remained comparatively subdued during the first two months of the fiscal year.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
OpenAI baru saja mengungkap sebuah informasi mengejutkan terkait perilaku AI menyimpang yang ditemukan selama proses pelatihan dan evaluasi model mereka.
Perusahaan memperkenalkan framework baru untuk melacak, menyelidiki, dan melaporkan kasus model misalignment pada Rabu, 16 September 2026.
Bersamaan dengan pengumuman tersebut, OpenAI langsung menerbitkan enam laporan terkait perilaku model dinilai tidak sesuai dengan instruksi atau ekspektasi pengembang.
Baca Juga: Demi iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Enthusiast Indonesia Berburu ke Malaysia
“Kasusnya beragam, mulai dari model menyembunyikan informasi hingga mengambil tindakan tanpa izin untuk melewati hambatan tertentu,” tulis OpenAI dalam keterangannya, Jumat (18/9/2026).
Laporan ini menjadi perubahan pendekatan perusahaan dalam mengidentifikasi dan melaporkan keselamatan AI. Sebelumnya, perusahaan yang dipimpin Sam Altman ini mengakui publikasi terkait misalignment cenderung tidak konsisten dan baru muncul setelah beberapa kasus dikumpulkan sekaligus.
Kini, OpenAI ingin laporan perilaku AI menyimpan ini dapat diterbitkan lebih cepat, ketika penyebab suatu perilaku belum sepenuhnya dipahami atau belum tersedia solusi permanen
Enam Kasus Perilaku AI Menyimpang yang Diungkap OpenAI
OpenAI memperkenalkan framework baru untuk melacak dan melaporkan perilaku model AI yang tidak sesuai dengan instruksi.
Dalam laporan awalnya, OpenAI membeberkan enam contoh perilaku model yang dianggap penting untuk diketahui publik dan peneliti.
Salah satu kasus melibatkan model riset yang belum dirilis. Model tersebut memasukkan instruksi tambahan ke dalam ringkasan tugas yang digunakan untuk melanjutkan pekerjaannya di context window berikutnya.
Instruksi tambahan itu termasuk perintah untuk mengabaikan batasan normal yang seharusnya tetap berlaku. OpenAI mengatakan menemukan 27 ringkasan yang terdampak oleh perilaku AI menyimpang tersebut.
Kasus perilaku AI menyimpang lain melibatkan model memberikan instruksi untuk menyembunyikan kesalahan di dalam ringkasan tugas. Reuters juga melaporkan ada contoh model mencoba melakukan tindakan tanpa izin, termasuk mengakses informasi atau berkomunikasi melalui situs web di luar mekanisme diharapkan.
OpenAI menekankan, enam kasus tersebut merupakan contoh individual dan tidak bisa digunakan untuk menyimpulkan seberapa sering perilaku semacam ini terjadi di seluruh model mereka yang sudah diluncurkan hingga saat ini.
Dengan kata lain, laporan perilaku AI menyimpang ini bukan berarti setiap model OpenAI menunjukkan perilaku tersebut dalam penggunaan sehari-hari.
Kenapa OpenAI Buka Laporan Misalignment?
Menurut OpenAI, kemampuan sistem AI terus meningkat dan mulai digunakan dalam lebih banyak tugas dengan tingkat otonomi lebih besar. Kondisi ini membuat perilaku tidak diharapkan menjadi semakin penting untuk dilacak secara sistematis.
Framework baru tersebut akan mencatat sejumlah informasi utama, mulai dari perilaku AI menyimpang ditemukan, tingkat keparahan, dampak eksternal, waktu kejadian, model yang terlibat, hingga langkah mitigasi yang sedang atau akan dilakukan.
Jika memungkinkan, OpenAI juga akan menjelaskan bagaimana perilaku tersebut ditemukan, cakupan investigasi, pertanyaan yang belum terjawab, serta implikasinya terhadap riset alignment dan keamanan AI.
Untuk kasus yang terjadi pada penggunaan pelanggan, perusahaan mengatakan akan membagikan informasi sejauh yang diizinkan oleh kewajiban privasi dan kontrak.
Langkah ini muncul di tengah meningkatnya perhatian terhadap sistem AI yang semakin mampu mengambil keputusan dan menjalankan tugas secara mandiri.
Reuters mencatat, beberapa insiden sebelumnya telah memicu perdebatan mengenai apakah mekanisme pengawasan terhadap perusahaan AI saat ini sudah cukup.
Bukan Berarti AI Berontak
Istilah model misalignment memang sering terdengar dramatis, tetapi tidak otomatis berarti sebuah AI memiliki niat, kesadaran, atau berusaha “memberontak” terhadap manusia.
Dalam konteks ini, misalignment merujuk pada kondisi ketika model melakukan tindakan tidak sejalan dengan tujuan, instruksi, atau batasan yang sudah ditetapkan.
Perilaku itu bisa muncul karena berbagai faktor, termasuk bagaimana model dilatih, konteks diberikan, struktur reward, hingga cara model mencari solusi ketika menghadapi hambatan.
Karena itu, laporan OpenAI lebih tepat dipahami sebagai upaya mendokumentasikan kegagalan sistem secara terbuka, bukan bukti bahwa model AI memiliki kehendak sendiri.
OpenAI mengatakan framework ini akan terus digunakan untuk menerbitkan laporan baru ketika kasus memenuhi kriteria ditemukan. Perusahaan juga menyebut enam laporan awal tersebut belum mencakup seluruh kasus yang sedang atau pernah diselidiki.

items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
“India will need hundreds of semiconductor companies to build a globally competitive chip ecosystem, as the country looks to move beyond setting up fabs and develop capabilities across the wider value chain”, Sandeep Kumar, CEO, L&T Semiconductor Technologies (LTSCT), reportedly said during at the Semicon India 2026 today.
As per a report by PTI, Kumar highlighted how it is difficult for a single company to address the breadth of the global semiconductor market. Thus, he believes that the ecosystem’s growth lies in the emergence of multiple Indian chip companies rather than monopolisation of a select few companies.
India has developed capabilities in digital and compute technologies, analogue and mixed-signal design, and radio frequency technologies. However, it still has gaps in system architecture, high-power semiconductors, memory, optics and manufacturing.
He said system architecture, which is understanding customer requirements and designing products around market needs, is a bigger gap than chip architecture, partly because Indian engineers have historically had less direct exposure to global end customers.
During the event, L&T unveiled 40 semiconductor products at the conference, including its first silicon carbide (SiC) product platform and a fully designed-in-India BLDC motor controller.
The company’s 1,200V SiC MOSFET platform is designed for applications including EV fast chargers, microgrids, solid-state transformers and traction inverters. Its BLDC motor controller is aimed at energy-efficient ceiling fans and is designed to serve multiple models while reducing bill-of-materials costs.
LTSCT’s portfolio also includes a vision camera SoC with on-device AI acceleration, a secure identity platform for applications such as e-passports and payment cards, and connectivity modules for smart metering, automotive and digital payments.
SEMICON India Shifts Focus To Ecosystem
Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the fifth edition of Semicon India in Delhi on Thursday (September 17). The first day saw Applied Materials commit $5 Bn through 2035, while the government announced around ₹1 Lakh Cr in investment commitments under Semicon 2.0.
As part of the next steps, MeitY Secretary S Krishnan said India now has semiconductor production at six locations and that Semicon 2.0 will focus on closing gaps in advanced packaging, industry-linked R&D and manufacturing talent.
Meanwhile, foreign secretary Vikram Misri said India does not need to replicate the entire global semiconductor supply chain domestically, but should focus on building sovereign capabilities in strategically important areas such as chip design and packaging, while partnering with trusted global players for other parts of the value chain.
Separately, the government has introduced tighter conditions for companies receiving incentives under Semicon 2.0, barring them from selling or mortgaging supported projects until they achieve full commercial production and requiring them to maintain operations for at least three years thereafter; promoters must also retain at least 51% equity and voting rights during the support period.
Meanwhile, global semiconductor giant Micron said it expects its Sanand facility to process hundreds of millions of chips in 2027, up from tens of millions this year. The plant is already in commercial production, processing DRAM and NAND wafers shipped from Micron’s global manufacturing network and sending finished products to customers worldwide.
On the domestic front, Tata Electronics said its Dholera fab and Assam packaging facility’s operational timelines are on schedule. During the event yesterday, the company also entered a strategic partnership with Netherland-based Nexperia under which Nexperia’s MOSFETs will be manufactured at Tata’s upcoming Dholera fab, while its discrete chips will be assembled and tested at Tata’s Jagiroad facility.
The partnership comes as the Dutch chipmaker seeks to diversify its manufacturing footprint amid an ongoing rift with Chinese parent Wingtech. Its partnership with Tata Electronics will now give it a manufacturing foothold in India, spanning wafer fabrication in Dholera and assembly and testing in Assam.

items.author: Tom Jackson
items.content:
Nigerian startup Drive45 Mobility has secured a US$3 million debt facility from TLG capital to support the company’s next phase of growth.
Founded in 2021, Drive45 Mobility is transforming access to vehicle ownership through a flexible rent-to-own vehicle subscription model, enabling individuals and businesses to access vehicles with manageable payments and minimal upfront capital.
Its offering combines vehicle financing with insurance, maintenance, tracking, documentation, and fleet management. The company operates more than 170 active vehicles and has recorded no payment defaults in five years of operation.
Drive45 has now secured a US$3 million senior debt facility with TLG Capital, a leading private credit firm operating across Sub-Saharan Africa. The investment strengthens Drive45’s balance sheet and positions the company for its next phase of growth as demand for mobility services continues to increase across the country.
The startup will now deploy more capital into fleet growth, broaden its customer base, and deepen its presence across Nigeria. In the coming years, it aims to increase its footprint to Port Harcourt, Abuja, Kano, Kaduna and other major business hubs across Nigeria.
The transaction combines TLG’s flexible private credit with a guarantee provided by Cascador, delivered in partnership with Morgan Stanley. Through this innovative partnership, high-growth African businesses like Drive45 can access the institutional capital suited to their growth. Cascador has delivered financial and non-financial resources to the company since Drive45 completed Cascador’s ScaleUp programme in 2024.
“Mobility access is a capital business, so having the right financial backing is everything. TLG has been a thoughtful partner from day one. They took the time to understand how our business works and structured their capital to fit the growth trajectory we know is possible. Ultimately, their money goes directly towards our plans to reach more businesses across Nigeria. Just as important has been Cascador. They believed in Drive45 from our earliest days, gave us the tools and network to become investment-ready, and have worked alongside us every step of the way to help structure this financing. We’re grateful to have them as long-term partners as we keep scaling,” said Oluwaseyi Adefemi, CEO of Drive45.
Isha Doshi, co-founder and partner at TLG Capital, said Drive45 was a prime example of disciplined capital deployment to meet a clear market need.
“Oluwaseyi and his team have a very clear vision for what mobility can look like in Nigeria’s business community – and they have built a fantastic business around it. TLG is proud to support Drive45 in its expansion journey. This transaction also would not have been possible without Cascador. It’s easy to see how they’ve built an exceptional track record in Nigeria: they combine seasoned experience in the market with a relentless bias towards action. This is exactly the type of partner we look to grow with,” he said.
Trish Thomas, CEO of Cascador, said so many investors focus on getting capital out the door without thinking about setting companies up for long-term viability.
“TLG is an exception: not only are they commercially-minded, but they have a unique drive to get things done with speed, imagination, and excellence. Funders looking for true economic impact in Africa should look to TLG as an execution-focused financing partner. This partnership is perfect for a company like Drive45. Oluwaseyi and his team have built a business with real corporate demand and the integrity to match it. That’s exactly what Cascador exists to find, and it’s been a privilege watching them grow into a business ready for commercial capital,” she said.

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Honor dikabarkan sedang menyiapkan smartphone dengan layar kedua di bagian belakang, mengikuti tren yang sebelumnya diperkenalkan Xiaomi lewat Xiaomi 17 Pro dan 17 Pro Max. Informasi ini datang dari Digital Chat Station melalui Weibo, yang menyebut fitur tersebut akan hadir pada salah satu anggota Honor 700 Series.
Perangkat yang dimaksud kemungkinan adalah Honor 700 Pro. Berdasarkan rumor tersebut, smartphone ini akan menggunakan layar utama flat berukuran 6,57 inci dengan resolusi 1.5K dan bezel yang sangat tipis serta simetris. Di sektor kamera, perangkat ini juga disebut membawa kamera utama 200MP, spesifikasi yang sebelumnya sudah sempat muncul dalam rumor mengenai Honor 700 Series.
Namun, fitur yang paling menarik perhatian justru layar sekundernya. Honor 700 Pro disebut akan memiliki layar berukuran 1,72 inci di bagian belakang. Untuk saat ini, belum diketahui secara pasti bagaimana layar tersebut akan ditempatkan dan fungsi apa saja yang nantinya tersedia. Dengan informasi yang masih terbatas, implementasinya belum bisa dipastikan akan sama seperti pendekatan Xiaomi.
Baca Juga: Honor Magic9 Series Punya Tiga Model, Bawa Baterai 11.000 mAh
Layar Belakang Jadi Tren Baru Smartphone Flagship
Xiaomi sebelumnya menggunakan layar belakang pada Xiaomi 17 Pro dan 17 Pro Max sebagai area tambahan yang dapat menampilkan berbagai informasi dan menjalankan fungsi tertentu. Konsep ini membuat modul kamera tidak hanya menjadi tempat sensor, tetapi juga menyediakan ruang interaksi tambahan bagi pengguna.
Honor tampaknya mulai mengeksplorasi pendekatan serupa melalui Honor 700 Series. Meski begitu, layar berukuran 1,72 inci tentu tidak akan menggantikan fungsi layar utama. Nilai praktisnya akan sangat bergantung pada aplikasi dan fitur yang nantinya diberikan Honor, termasuk apakah layar tersebut hanya digunakan untuk informasi tertentu atau bisa menjalankan fungsi yang lebih luas.
Posisi Layar Honor 700 Pro Masih Jadi Misteri
Salah satu detail yang belum terungkap adalah lokasi layar belakang tersebut. Ada kemungkinan Honor menempatkannya di atas modul kamera seperti pada perangkat Xiaomi, tetapi Digital Chat Station belum memberikan informasi mengenai desain akhirnya. Bisa saja Honor memilih posisi atau bentuk yang berbeda.
Untuk saat ini, informasi mengenai Honor 700 Pro masih sebatas rumor dan belum dikonfirmasi secara resmi. Selain posisi layar belakang, detail seperti ukuran modul kamera, fungsi layar sekunder, chipset, kapasitas baterai, harga, hingga jadwal peluncuran juga belum diketahui. Karena itu, masih perlu menunggu informasi berikutnya untuk melihat bagaimana Honor akan menerapkan konsep layar belakang tersebut.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The federal government has decided to introduce a fresh set of austerity measures in response to rising petroleum product prices in international markets, including a 50 percent cut in fuel allocations for government vehicles for three months.
Under the measures, fuel allocations for government vehicles will be reduced by half for the next three months. However, operational vehicles of the armed forces, civil armed forces, and law enforcement agencies will remain exempt.
Operational vehicles of essential services and the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) will also be exempted from the fuel cuts.
The government has further decided to reduce non-ERE (non-Employee Related Expenditure) budgets for the fiscal year 2026-27 by 5%. The cuts will be implemented on a monthly basis.
Government curbs spending, IT sector gets exemption
The government has imposed a complete ban on the purchase of all types of government vehicles, while procurement of durable goods will also remain prohibited, except for IT-related purchases.
The measures also include a three-month ban on official foreign visits and related travel expenditure. Visits undertaken under scholarships, training courses, and institutional agreements will be exempted.
In cases where foreign travel is deemed unavoidable, ministers and government officials will be required to travel in economy class.
Government meetings have also been directed to be held through teleconferencing wherever possible.
The government has prohibited official dinners except those hosted for foreign delegations, while seminars, training programs, and conferences funded through government resources will also be restricted.
For unavoidable events, government auditoriums and committee rooms have been recommended as venues.
The government has also directed that only one dish be served at wedding functions.
As part of broader energy conservation measures, shops, markets, shopping malls, and bazaars will close by 9 pm. Marriage halls, marquees, and other commercial event venues will close by 10 pm, while restaurants, cafes, and food outlets will close by 11 pm.
Takeaway and home-delivery services will be exempt from the specified closing hours.
Pharmacies, clinics, hospitals, medical laboratories, and medical equipment shops will also remain exempt, along with bakeries, milk and dairy shops, fuel stations, and electric vehicle charging stations.
Gyms, sports facilities, IT companies, and call centers have also been exempted from the restrictions.
Requests for exemptions from the austerity measures will be considered on a case-by-case basis, with recommendations to be submitted to the prime minister for approval.
Provincial and local governments may also consider adopting similar austerity measures.
The latest measures come as the government seeks to contain public expenditure and reduce fuel consumption amid higher petroleum prices in international markets.

items.author: Tom Jackson
items.content:
Kenya-based Spiro, a leader in two-wheel transportation and battery-swapping, has signed a partnership with Chinese company Yadea, the world’s leading manufacturer of electric two-wheelers, to scale accessible and sustainable electric transport across Africa.
Spiro is Africa’s largest electric mobility company, operating the continent’s most extensive and fastest growing network of battery-swapping for electric two-wheel vehicles. It has operational assembling facilities in Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, Rwanda, Togo, Cameroon and Benin.
With more than 95,000 electric motorcycles, over 2,500 battery swapping stations and more than 30 million battery swaps to date, Spiro has achieved over 1 billion kilometres of low-carbon emissions travel, the company is substituting expensive imported fossil fuel- based transportation with affordable, accessible and sustainable solutions.
Disrupt Africa reported in June Spiro had raised a further US$55 million in capital to close its latest round of funding at US$270 million, and it has now signed a strategic partnership with Yadea, which operates in more than 100 countries and serves over 100 million users worldwide.
The partnership combines Yadea’s global manufacturing and R&D capabilities with Spiro’s operational network and battery-swapping ecosystem across seven countries. Together, the companies aim to build a scalable, commercially sustainable EV framework serving millions of commercial fleet operators, delivery services, logistics providers, and daily commuters in Africa’s fastest-growing mobility markets.
Under the agreement, Yadea will supply electric two-wheelers and related EV products tailored to Spiro’s expanding regional markets, while Spiro will integrate the vehicles into its proprietary battery-swapping and energy infrastructure. The companies will also co-develop customised two-wheeler platforms engineered specifically for local road conditions and commercial utility across Africa.
This partnership deepens the China-Africa connection, pairing Yadea’s manufacturing scale with Spiro’s battery-swapping network and unique knowledge of African market dynamics to accelerate the continent’s transition to affordable electric transport.
“When we launched Spiro, our mission was to lay the energy and mobility foundation for Africa’s green transition. Our strategic partnership with Yadea is a major endorsement of our execution to date and opens fantastic opportunities to jointly pioneer the next era of electric mobility in emerging markets”, stated Gagan Gupta, founder of Spiro and chairman of Equitane.
Anant Badjatya, CEO of Spiro, said Africa’s shift to electric mobility was accelerating and this partnership would help it meet that demand at scale.
“By bringing together Yadea’s manufacturing strength with Spiro’s electric mobility ecosystem and operating experience across Africa, we are compressing the timeline to clean transport — helping thousands more riders switch to affordable EVs faster and multiplying our climate impact across the continent,” he said.
Wang Jiazhong, senior vice president of Yadea, said Africa represented a massive frontier for zero-emission transport.
“Our mission to reduce carbon emissions has reached a powerful milestone through this partnership with Spiro. Together, we are combining global innovation with local infrastructure to deliver scalable and sustainable mobility solutions that serve millions of riders and transform Africa’s urban transit,” he said.

items.author: Rizwana Omer
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pakistan’s phone market runs on contradictions rarely seen in more developed economies, a country building 5G infrastructure while millions still rely on 2G for their first taste of connectivity. Few executives are better placed to explain that paradox than Sanmeet Singh Kochhar, who oversees HMD’s business across Asia, the Middle East and Africa. In an exclusive conversation with PhoneWorld, Kochhar addressed the questions that have followed HMD and Nokia for months: where the licensing arrangement stands, why feature phones are making a comeback among digitally fatigued adults, and how Pakistan’s affordability crunch is reshaping product strategy from the ground up.
About Sanmeet Kochhar: Sanmeet Singh Kochhar is Vice President at HMD Global, responsible for strategy, operations, and business across the Asia, Middle East, and Africa regions, with a specific mandate to strengthen Nokia’s standing as a consumer brand there. A mechanical engineer with an MBA from the Management Development Institute, Gurgaon, he has spent more than a decade with Nokia, Microsoft, and HMD Global, holding senior roles spanning sales, channel development, and business operations across multiple countries. Earlier in his career, he worked at Colgate-Palmolive and Dabur India.
PW: HMD has called Pakistan a key market in the past. Two years into that push, how has HMD’s actual strategy for Pakistan evolved, pricing tier, retail footprint, local manufacturing or assembly, and where does the country rank today against other markets in the Asia, Middle East and Africa region you oversee?
SK: Two years in, Pakistan has genuinely earned the “key market” label. We’ve especially become more competitive on 2G feature phones, because that’s still where a meaningful share of the country buys its first or second device. Alongside that, we’ve been actively building the HMD brand itself across both feature phones and smartphones, along with our Nokia device portfolio.
The bigger shift, though, has been around access. We’ve put real focus behind device financing, because for a lot of Pakistani consumers, a key constraint has been paying for a smartphone upfront. Our retail footprint has become noticeably stronger too, particularly in the north of the country. And on manufacturing, we’ve had two local assembly facilities operating in Pakistan for several years now, and we’re actively exploring what expanding that could look like.
Against the other markets I oversee, Pakistan is consistently one of our stronger performers, and that’s not just because of its size. The engagement, the pace at which the HMD brand is gaining recognition, and the depth of our distribution all justify the investment we’ve made here.
PW: There’s real uncertainty right now about where the Nokia name goes from here; some reports point to the licensing arrangement extending, others suggest HMD is moving fully to its own brand for smartphones. Can you clarify where things stand?
SK: I understand the curiosity, and I do want to clarify this. HMD operates a multi-brand approach today, and that’s deliberate. We have HMD, which encapsulates our own-brand phones and accessories portfolio. We have Nokia feature phones, which continue to be a core part of our business. And we have exciting new collaborations that bring fresh energy to the portfolio.
What I can confirm clearly is that we will continue to sell Nokia feature phones. That’s not a transitional position; it reflects the fact that Nokia feature phones serve a real and growing audience in Pakistan and globally. Beyond that, our multi-brand strategy gives us the flexibility to bring the right product to the right market under the brand that best serves the consumer.
PW: There’s a growing conversation globally around social media detoxing, “dumbphone” trends, and younger users deliberately stepping back from smartphones. HMD has one of the strongest feature phone portfolios in the industry. Are you seeing this show up in actual demand data yet, and does it change how HMD thinks about feature phones, not as a legacy category, but as a genuine growth opportunity among younger users?
SK: Yes, and this has moved well beyond a conversation; we’re seeing real demand. Our Better Phone Project surveyed over 37,000 parents and children globally, and what it revealed is a genuine contradiction at the heart of modern parenting: families want connectivity for safety and staying in touch, but they feel they’ve lost control over what a smartphone opens the door to on day one. Young people themselves told us something striking: many recognised their relationship with their phone wasn’t healthy but felt powerless to change it because their entire social world lives on those platforms.
That research has directly shaped our product decisions. Devices like our Nokia 4G feature phones, calls, messaging, basic connectivity, no app stores, and no social media aren’t a step backward. For a parent in Karachi, Lahore, or even Dubai, they’re a considered first device for a child. And we’re seeing a second audience grow fast: digitally savvy adults who already own a premium smartphone and are deliberately buying a simpler device as a companion for weekends, travel, or simply to create space from the constant pull of notifications.
So to answer directly, yes, this changes how we think about feature phones. They’re not legacy; they’re a growth category with two distinct and expanding audiences. In a market like Pakistan, where affordability and dependability already drive feature phone demand, the digital wellbeing angle adds a genuinely new layer of relevance on top of what was already a strong commercial case.
PW: With component costs, DRAM, chipsets, modems, rising industry-wide this year, how is HMD managing pricing without ceding ground to more aggressive low-cost competitors?
SK: Memory prices have moved more in the last two quarters than in the previous two years, and it’s the affordable tier, entry 4G smartphones and low-cost feature phones especially, that feels it first, because the margin at that end was always thin.
We’re not going to chase a race to the bottom. What we are doing is locking in component supply earlier, qualifying chipsets harder before a design gets committed, and in some cases accepting a slightly higher landed cost rather than cutting something a consumer will notice within a year. That last point matters a lot in markets like Pakistan, where a phone has to last and perform, because for many buyers, it’s the single biggest piece of technology they own. Competing on price alone by compromising build quality or software support is a short-term game, and it’s not one we’re interested in playing.
PW: Pakistan’s 2G user base has stayed unusually large even as 5G rolls out elsewhere. What’s your own read on why that persists here specifically, and does it change how HMD thinks about the market?
SK: This has less to do with appetite for newer technology and everything to do with what a phone actually costs here. A 5G-capable device still runs north of PKR 50,000 once duties are factored in, and 4G and 5G networks are still being built out beyond the major cities. For most of these users, a feature phone isn’t a stopgap; it’s the sensible, practical choice.
That reality absolutely shapes how we think about Pakistan. It’s why we keep investing seriously in the 2G and 4G feature phone tier rather than treating it as something the market will simply outgrow. In many other markets I oversee, the conversation has moved to replacement cycles and ecosystem products. Here, first-time connectivity is still a very real opportunity, and building devices that meet people where they are, rather than where analysts think they should be, is where we see our biggest responsibility and our biggest commercial opportunity.
PW: Looking at the next 12 to 18 months, what should Pakistani consumers actually expect from HMD, new device categories, price points, and retail partnerships, and is there anything in the pipeline you can share now?
SK: Expect us to keep leaning into the segments that match how people here actually buy and use phones: rugged devices for anyone working outdoors or in tough environments, affordable smartphones priced for real budgets, and smarter 4G feature phones that do more without asking for a smartphone-sized wallet.
I won’t put specific model names or dates on the table today, but the direction is set, and it’s consistent with what we’ve been building. Durability and value stay the priority over chasing specifications. We’ll continue deepening our retail and distribution partnerships, particularly in areas where our presence is still growing. And device financing will remain central to how we make our portfolio accessible here, because in a market like Pakistan, availability without affordability isn’t really availability at all.
The post HMD’s Sanmeet Kochhar Maps Out What’s Next for Nokia and Pakistan’s Phone Market appeared first on PhoneWorld.

items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
Apple is eyeing the launch of its payments service Apple Pay in India as early as next month, with Axis Bank likely to be its first banking partner.
The iPhone maker is expected to initially enable Axis Bank credit cards on Apple Pay before adding more lenders to the service, Reuters reported, citing sources.
Apple has also held discussions with HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank for the India rollout. However, the two banks are yet to agree on commercial terms with Apple.
The US-based company plans to ⁠add lenders over time through direct, bank-by-bank deals, mirroring the phased rollout of Apple Pay in other markets.
Questions sent to Apple remained unanswered at the time of publication. The story will be updated upon receiving a response.
The launch would mark the culmination of Apple’s nearly decade-long effort to bring its payments service to India, one of the few major markets where Apple Pay is currently unavailable.
Apple first indicated plans to launch the service in India in 2017. However, the rollout subsequently ran into regulatory and technical hurdles, including India’s data localisation requirements and challenges around integrating with UPI.
Apple’s Card Payments Play
Apple Pay allows users to make contactless payments using tokenised card details stored on their iPhones or Apple Watches. Transactions can be authenticated using Face ID, Touch ID, or a device passcode without opening a separate payments app.
The RBI last year allowed alternative authentication mechanisms, including biometrics, for card payments. The regulatory change enabled services such as Apple Pay to authenticate transactions made using Indian bank cards through Face ID or Touch ID.
Axis Bank is India’s fourth-largest credit card issuer, behind HDFC Bank, SBI Cards, and ICICI Bank. It had around 16.26 Mn active credit cards in circulation as of July. However, Apple Pay’s addressable user base will initially be limited to Apple device users with cards issued by participating banks.
The service will also enter a digital payments market overwhelmingly dominated by UPI, which accounts for about 84% of the country’s digital payment volumes.
UPI supports contactless transactions through UPI Tap & Pay, allowing users to tap NFC-enabled smartphones on compatible payment terminals. However, unlike Apple Pay’s expected card-based offering, UPI Tap & Pay processes transactions through the UPI network.
Apple has also held discussions with major lenders and card networks like Mastercard and Visa for the launch of the service in India, but it has faced friction over the division of fees. The tech giant has reportedly sought a 15-20 bps share of the interchange fee on transactions processed through Apple Pay, while some banks have proposed a lower share of around 10 bps.

items.title: Demi iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Enthusiast Indonesia Berburu ke Malaysia
items.summary:
Apple resmi menjual duo iPhone 18 Pro secara global di sejumlah Apple Store di berbagai negara per hari ini, Jumat (18/9/2026). Berhubung belum masuk secara resmi di Indonesia, sejumlah pengguna Apple di Tanah Air berbondong-bondong beli iPhone baru tersebut di negara tetangga.
Salah satunya adalah Bagus Hernawan. Jadi salah satu pengguna setia produk Apple, mantan jurnalis dari MakeMac ini rela menjemput varian Pro yang sudah dibeli ke Apple Store TRX di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Seperti Apple Store di berbagai negara, toko ini sudah ramai sebelum dibuka pada penjualan perdana iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max. Apple enthusiast sekaligus kreator konten Bhaguz melihat antrean pembelian langsung atau walk-in paling panjang, dengan jumlah orang diperkirakan mencapai 100.
“Yang paling panjang yang walk-in. Sampai ada 100 orang mungkin,” kata Bhaguz, saat diwawancarai tim Gizmologi, Jumat (18/9/2026). Bhaguz sendiri berada di Apple Store TRX untuk mengambil iPhone 18 Pro yang sudah dipesan
items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Apple resmi menjual duo iPhone 18 Pro secara global di sejumlah Apple Store di berbagai negara per hari ini, Jumat (18/9/2026). Berhubung belum masuk secara resmi di Indonesia, sejumlah pengguna Apple di Tanah Air berbondong-bondong beli iPhone baru tersebut di negara tetangga.
Salah satunya adalah Bagus Hernawan. Jadi salah satu pengguna setia produk Apple, mantan jurnalis dari MakeMac ini rela menjemput varian Pro yang sudah dibeli ke Apple Store TRX di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Seperti Apple Store di berbagai negara, toko ini sudah ramai sebelum dibuka pada penjualan perdana iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max. Apple enthusiast sekaligus kreator konten Bhaguz melihat antrean pembelian langsung atau walk-in paling panjang, dengan jumlah orang diperkirakan mencapai 100.
“Yang paling panjang yang walk-in. Sampai ada 100 orang mungkin,” kata Bhaguz, saat diwawancarai tim Gizmologi, Jumat (18/9/2026). Bhaguz sendiri berada di Apple Store TRX untuk mengambil iPhone 18 Pro yang sudah dipesan lewat pre-order.
Tiga Jalur Antrean iPhone 18 Pro Series di Apple Store TRX
Suasana Penjualan Perdana iPhone 18 Pro Series di Malaysia. (Foto: Appleisme)
Menurut Bhaguz, antrean terbagi menjadi tiga kelompok: undangan influencer, pembeli yang mengambil pesanan melalui layanan pick-up, dan pembeli walk-in yang datang tanpa pemesanan.
Untuk jalur pick-up, ia memperkirakan ada sekitar 20–30 orang saat itu. Pembeli dalam kelompok ini memiliki slot pengambilan dipilih saat memesan, seperti pukul 08.00, 08.30, atau 09.00 waktu Malaysia.
“Kalau pick-up kan emang ada jam-jamnya. Kita bisa milih mau pick-up jam 8, setengah 9, jam 9,” ujar Bhaguz. Ia menilai pembagian jadwal membantu membuat antrean pengambilan pesanan lebih teratur. Sementara itu, pembeli walk-in harus mengecek apakah perangkat yang ingin dibeli masih tersedia.
Antrean Tidak Sepanjang Peluncuran Terdahulu
Suasana Penjualan Perdana iPhone 18 Pro Series di Malaysia. (Foto: Appleisme)
Meski toko sudah ramai sejak pagi, Bhaguz merasa antrean kali ini tidak sepanjang penjualan perdana yang pernah ia ikuti. “Menurut saya, gak begitu panjang kayak biasanya sih,” katanya.
Ia mengaitkan kesan tersebut dengan pilihan perangkat pada momen penjualan yang ia datangi, yakni Pro dan Pro Max. Menurut pandangan Bhaguz, peluncuran dengan lebih banyak varian dapat menarik kelompok konsumen yang lebih beragam.
Ada Pembeli iPhone 18 Pro Series Indonesia di Lokasi
Penjualan perdana iPhone 18 Pro Series. (Foto: Appleisme)
Saat ditanya apakah ada pembeli iPhone 18 series lain dari Indonesia, “ada, tapi tidak kenal atau tahu,” jelas Bhaguz. Karena situasi yang padat, ia pun tidak sempat berkenalan atau menanyakan alasan mereka datang ke Malaysia.
Bagi Bhaguz sendiri, alasan beli perangkat sejak hari pertama menjadi alasan utama. Sebagai kreator konten karena ingin segera menggunakan iPhone baru untuk kebutuhan pembuatan konten.
Adapun ia mengambil iPhone 18 Pro berkapasitas 512 GB dengan warna Burgundy.
Bocoran Harga iPhone 18 Pro Indonesia
Meski harga resmi dan jadwal penjualan ponsel ini masih belum diumumkan secara langsung, bocoran tentang kemungkinan harga iPhone Duo dan iPhone 18 Pro series.
Informasi tersebut dibagikan Apple enthusiast Bhaguz Hernawan melalui akun X pribadinya di @bhaguz_403. Dalam cuitannya, Bhaguz menyebut kemungkinan varian Pro ini dibanderol mulai Rp 27.999.000.
Sedangkan untuk Pro Max mulai dari Rp 29.999.000. Lalu untuk harga iPhone Duo dibanderol mulai Rp 44.999.000.
Apple sendiri belum mengumumkan harga iPhone Duo, Pro, dan Pro Max di Tanah Air. Karena itu, angka yang dibagikan Bhaguz ini masih sebatas bocoran atau perkiraan hingga ada pengumuman resmi dari Apple atau jaringan reseller.
Jika bocoran tersebut benar, model 18 Pro dan 18 Pro Max bakal mengalami kenaikan harga cukup besar dibanding generasi sebelumnya. Sedangkan harga iPhone Duo akan menjadi kategori baru.
Saat pertama dijual di Indonesia pada Oktober 2025, harga iPhone 17 Pro 256GB dibanderol mulai dari Rp 23.749.000. Sedangkan untuk varian iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB dijual dengan harga Rp 25.749.000.
Berikut perbandingan Harga iPhone 17 Pro Series dengan iPhone 18 Pro Series:
ModelHarga Generasi SebelumnyaBocoran Harga BaruSelisih
iPhone 17 Pro → iPhone 18 ProRp 23.749.000Rp 27.999.000Rp 4.250.000
iPhone 17 Pro Max → iPhone 18 Pro MaxRp 25.749.000Rp 29.999.000Rp 4.250.000
Jika bocoran harga ini benar, maka harga Pro dan Pro Max ini naik sekitar Rp 4.250.000. Kenaikan tersebut juga sejalan dengan perubahan harga di pasar Amerika Serikat.
Meski demikian, harga global tidak bisa dijadikan patokan langsung untuk Indonesia. Harga iPhone Duo dan iPhone 18 Pro Series lokal dapat dipengaruhi berbagai faktor, termasuk struktur harga Apple untuk setiap pasar.

items.summary:
Menghadirkan serangkaian pembaruan untuk semua lini produknya, Gizmo friends yang tengah menggunakan perangkat ekosistem Apple lengkap, bisa merasakan benefit yang dibawa lewat OS27 terbaru. Selain untuk iPhone, iPad, hingga Mac, juga tersedia untuk wearables melalui kehadiran watchOS 27. Kompatibel untuk beberapa seri Apple Watch terbaru, membawa sejumlah kemampuan baru yang wajib untuk kamu ketahui.
watchOS 27 tidak hanya tersedia untuk Apple Watch Series 9 ke atas atau Apple Watch Ultra 2 ke atas, namun juga untuk opsi smartwatch Apple termurah (dan terbaru saat ini) yakni Apple Watch SE 3. Besar kemungkinan bila semua fitur baru yang dibawa oleh watchOS 27, memerlukan chipset mumpuni. items.author: Prasetyo Herfianto
items.content:
Menghadirkan serangkaian pembaruan untuk semua lini produknya, Gizmo friends yang tengah menggunakan perangkat ekosistem Apple lengkap, bisa merasakan benefit yang dibawa lewat OS27 terbaru. Selain untuk iPhone, iPad, hingga Mac, juga tersedia untuk wearables melalui kehadiran watchOS 27. Kompatibel untuk beberapa seri Apple Watch terbaru, membawa sejumlah kemampuan baru yang wajib untuk kamu ketahui.
watchOS 27 tidak hanya tersedia untuk Apple Watch Series 9 ke atas atau Apple Watch Ultra 2 ke atas, namun juga untuk opsi smartwatch Apple termurah (dan terbaru saat ini) yakni Apple Watch SE 3. Besar kemungkinan bila semua fitur baru yang dibawa oleh watchOS 27, memerlukan chipset mumpuni. Di mana cip Apple S9 dan S10 tidak memiliki perbedaan signifikan, sehingga masih tersedia untuk Apple Watch Series 9 rilisan tiga tahun lalu.
Sembari menggulirkan watchOS 27, Apple pekan lalu juga memperkenalkan dua opsi smartwatch terbarunya, yakni Apple Watch Series 12 dan Watch Ultra 4. Keduanya memiliki sejumlah pembaruan baik dari sisi hardware maupun software, sehingga bisa memberikan pemantauan kesehatan lebih komplit yang tidak bisa dihadirkan ke generasi sebelumnya hanya dengan pembaruan perangkat lunak saja.
Baca juga: iPadOS 27 Bikin iPad Jadul Lebih Kencang, Kompatibel Untuk Tablet Rilisan 2020
Kini Hadir Opsi One Tap Untuk Akses Smart Stacks
Walau begitu, watchOS 27 membawa fitur-fitur kecil baru yang bisa dimanfaatkan dalam keseharian. Opsi gestur, misalnya. Kalau sebelumnya menghadirkan opsi double tap menggunakan telunjuk dan ibu jari untuk opsi gulir notifikasi hingga Smart Stack, kini dihadirkan opsi single tap yang bisa berperan untuk memberikan konfirmasi.
Misalnya, ketika Gizmo friends sedang berada pada widget pemutar musik, gestur one tap di watchOS 27 bisa mengendalikan pemutaran musik (play/pause). Sementara pada widget lain seperti cuaca, one tap memungkinkan Gizmo friends untuk melihat informasi perkiraan cuaca lebih komplit. Ketika sudah selesai, gestur wrist flick tetap bisa digunakan untuk kembali ke tampilan awal alias watch face.
Dan sama seperti di iOS 27, aplikasi Wallet pada watchOS 27 juga bisa menampilkan kartu member yang sudah kamu daftarkan secara kustom, memudahkan akses ketika harus dilakukan proses scan, tak perlu mengeluarkan smartphone. Apple juga memperbarui tampilan Find My, memudahkan pemantauan baik perangkat lain atau teman dan keluarga.
Tampilan Liquid Glass juga ikut disempurnakan, dibuat lebih selaras dengan kontras yang juga diperbaiki, agar konten yang tertampil lebih jelas terlihat. Juga ada peningkatan ekstra lainnya seperti memutar musik lebih instan, hingga notifikasi khusus ketika Apple Watch menonaktifkan fitur yang tidak pernah digunakan, demi membuat daya tahan baterai Apple Watch dengan watchOS 27 lebih awet.
watchOS 27 Beri Kendali Ekstra Untuk Orang Tua dalam Pemantauan Anak
Dalam menghadirkan platform OS27, Apple turut mengedepankan akses yang lebih aman untuk anak hingga remaja. Tidak hanya menambahkan cukup banyak opsi baru yang memudahkan pemantauan saat menggunakan iPad, melalui watchOS 27, Apple juga memberikan tambahan fitur agar para orang tua lebih merasa aman memberikan Apple Watch kepada anak. Salah satunya dengan menghadirkan opsi akun anak alias child account.
Lewat opsi akun anak, sistem akan secara otomatis memberikan lapisan proteksi tambahan yang diperlukan untuk membuat pengguna dengan rentang umur lebih muda, sementara orang tua akan mendapatkan akses yang lebih komprehensif terkait pemantauan penggunaan perangkat lewat parental controls. Tampilan screen time di watchOS 27 juga didesain ulang, dan orang tua bisa lebih memastikan agar anak hanya bisa menghubungi nomor kontak tertentu maupun aplikasi apa saja yang bisa diakses.
Seperti yang disebutkan sebelumnya, watchOS 27 bisa diunduh untuk Apple Watch Series 9 ke atas, Ultra 2 ke atas, hingga SE 3 ke atas. Tentunya memerlukan sambungan ke iPhone dengan iOS 27 yang kompatibel untuk iPhone 11 ke atas.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Jadwal MPL ID S18 hari ini, Jumat (18/9/2026), akan menghadirkan tiga pertandingan dalam lanjutan Reguler Season Week 6. Berbeda dari jadwal Jumat sebelumnya, ada satu laga tambahan untuk mengakomodasi pertandingan Dewa United Esports yang sempat ditunda pekan lalu.
Alhasil, fans Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) akan menyaksikan Anak Dewa menjalani dua pertandingan secara beruntun. Mereka akan berhadapan dengan Evos terlebih dahulu, sebelumnya akan kembali bertanding melawan RRQ Hoshi.
Baca Juga: Bill Skarsgård Jadi Pemeran Utama Physint, Ada Don Lee hingga Minami Hamabe
Laga tambahan ini merupakan bagian dari penyesuaian jadwal setelah dua laga Dewa United di Week 5 ditunda akibat kondisi force majeure. Duel kontra RRQ dipindah ke 18 September, sedangkan duel tertunda melawan Evos baru digelar pada 8 Oktober 2026.
Selain dua pertandingan tersebut, hari pertama MPL ID S18 Week 6 juga menghadirkan pertemuan Onic melawan Geek Fam. Laga ini akan menjadi kesempatan kedua bagi Onic usah kalah dari Geek Fam pada pekan sebelumnya.
Jadwal MPL ID S18 Hari Ini
Onic vs Geek Fam – 14:00 WIB
Dewa United Esports vs Evos – 17:00 WIB
RRQ vs Dewa United Esports – 20:00 WIB
ONIC vs Geek Fam, Kesempatan Membalas Kekalahan di Leg Pertama
Week 5 MPL ID S18 dibuka dengan pertandingan EVOS vs Dewa United dan Geek Fam vs ONIC pada Jumat, 11 September 2026.
Pertandingan pembuka jadwal MPL ID S18 hari ini mempertemukan ONIC dengan Geek Fam. Keduanya baru saja bertemu pada 11 September lalu, ketika Geek Fam berhasil mengalahkan ONIC dengan skor 2-1.
Hasil tersebut menjadi kemenangan pertama Geek Fam di MPL ID S18 setelah sebelumnya menelan tujuh kekalahan beruntun. Sayangnya, momentum tersebut belum berlanjut setelah mereka kembali takluk 0-2 dari Team Liquid ID pada 13 September.
Sementara itu, ONIC juga belum berhasil memperbaiki performa mereka. Setelah kalah dari Geek Fam, tim berjuluk Landak Kuning tersebut kembali menelan kekalahan 0-2 saat menghadapi Alter Ego.
Hasil itu membuat ONIC memasuki Week 6 dengan catatan tiga kemenangan dan enam kekalahan. Mereka masih berada di posisi kelima klasemen sementara, tetapi persaingan menuju playoff belum aman.
Pertemuan kedua melawan Geek Fam di jadwal MPL ID S18 hari ini menjadi kesempatan ONIC untuk memperbaiki catatan pertemuan mereka musim ini. Di sisi lain, Geek Fam membutuhkan kemenangan tambahan untuk memperbaiki posisi dari dasar klasemen.
Dewa United Hadapi EVOS dan RRQ dalam Satu Hari
Jadwal MPL ID S18 Hari Ini 18 September: Dewa United Esports Hadapi EVOS dan RRQ
Sorotan utama jadwal MPL ID S18 hari ini tertuju kepada Dewa United Esports. Anak Dewa harus menghadapi EVOS pada pukul 17.00 WIB, kemudian kembali bertanding melawan RRQ Hoshi pada pukul 20.00 WIB.
Jadwal padat tersebut merupakan imbas penundaan pertandingan pada Week 5. Sebelumnya, sejumlah pemain dan anggota staf pelatih Dewa United harus menjalani perawatan di rumah sakit sehingga tim tidak dapat mengikuti dua pertandingan sesuai jadwal awal.
Pihak MPL Indonesia kemudian mengumumkan penyesuaian jadwal dengan mempertimbangkan kondisi tim-tim yang terdampak.
Laga tertunda RRQ melawan Dewa United akhirnya dipindahkan ke hari ini. Sementara itu, pertandingan EVOS melawan Dewa United yang semula dijadwalkan pada 11 September akan digelar pada 8 Oktober mendatang.
Dengan demikian, duel Dewa United kontra EVOS pukul 17.00 WIB dalam jadwal MPL ID S18 hari ini merupakan pertandingan reguler Week 6, bukan pertandingan tunda dari pekan sebelumnya.
